pmid-24726236.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫摘出後に改善した急性小脳運動失調の22歳女性症例。傍腫瘍症候群で、基礎奇形腫に伴う免疫介在性神経学的合併症。腫瘍切除により改善可能な臨床像を示す。
pmid-24726236.summary_en: Case report of a 22-year-old woman with acute cerebellar ataxia that resolved following ovarian teratoma resection. This represents reversible paraneoplastic syndrome associated with ovarian germ cell tumor. Demonstrates immune-mediated neurologic complications that may be treatable through tumor removal.

pmid-24728702.summary_ja: 生後16日の新生児に発生した心膜内未熟奇形腫の症例報告。大量の心膜液貯留を呈した。完全外科的切除に続きJEBによる補助化学療法を行い、良好な治療結果が得られた。再発検出のためAFPのモニタリングと画像検査によるフォローアップを行っており、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍のまれな症例である。
pmid-24728702.summary_en: Case report of intrapericardial immature teratoma in a 16-day-old neonate presenting with massive pericardial effusion. Successfully treated with complete surgical resection followed by adjuvant JEB chemotherapy. AFP monitoring and imaging surveillance were used for recurrence detection in this rare extragonadal germ cell tumor.

pmid-24732004.summary_ja: 62歳の閉経後中国人女性に発生した純粋な非妊娠性子宮絨毛癌の症例報告。短鎖反復配列解析により確定された。胚細胞に由来する非妊娠性絨毛癌は妊娠性絨毛性疾患とは異なり、適切な予後判定と治療のために正確な鑑別が必要である。
pmid-24732004.summary_en: Case report of pure nongestational uterine choriocarcinoma in a 62-year-old postmenopausal Chinese woman, confirmed with short tandem repeat analysis. Nongestational choriocarcinoma arising from germ cells is distinct from gestational trophoblastic disease, requiring accurate distinction for appropriate prognosis and management.

pmid-24739847.summary_ja: 仙骨前部に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有し、その中にグレード2の神経内分泌腫瘍を合併した35歳女性の症例。画像所見では良性病変が疑われたが、病理組織学的検査により非胚細胞成分の悪性転化が確認された。性腺外腫瘤は、悪性転化を検出するため徹底的な病理学的検査を行う必要があることを強調している。
pmid-24739847.summary_en: A 35-year-old female with pre-sacral mature cystic teratoma containing grade 2 neuroendocrine tumor. Imaging suggested benign lesion, but histopathologic examination revealed malignant transformation of non-germ cell components. Case emphasizes importance of thorough pathologic examination of extragonadal masses to detect malignant transformation.

pmid-24741207.summary_ja: 2006-2013年に腹腔鏡で管理された小児卵巣病理46例の後方視的分析。成熟奇形腫7例を含む。卵巣温存囊胞摘出術40例。組織検査で成熟奇形腫確認。追跡超音波検査で温存卵巣の正常形態と血流を確認。
pmid-24741207.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 46 pediatric ovarian pathology cases managed laparoscopically (2006-2013), including 7 mature teratomas with torsion. Conservative ovary-preserving cystectomy was performed in 40 cases. Histology confirmed 7 mature teratomas. Follow-up ultrasound showed normal ovarian morphology and blood flow in preserved ovaries.

pmid-24744929.summary_ja: 三胚葉構造を有する18歳女性の付属器腫瘤。組織学的に成熟囊胞性奇形腫内からのオリゴデンドログリオーマを確認。GFAP、EGFR、P53陽性。成熟奇形腫内の神経上皮性腫瘍は極めて稀で、13ヶ月間無再発経過。
pmid-24744929.summary_en: An 18-year-old female with adnexal mass containing all three germ layers. Histopathologic examination revealed oligodendroglioma within mature cystic teratoma, confirmed by GFAP, EGFR, and P53 positivity. This represents a rare neuroepithelial malignancy arising within mature teratoma, with no recurrence at 13-month follow-up.

pmid-24744942.summary_ja: 膣分娩後に卵巣囊胞性奇形腫が腹腔内破裂し化学性腹膜炎を発症した29歳女性の症例。MRI/CT検査により悪性卵巣病変が除外され、腹腔鏡下卵巣摘出術を施行。組織検査で良性奇形腫と確認。骨盤腫瘤管理における術前画像検査の重要性を示唆。
pmid-24744942.summary_en: Case of intraperitoneal rupture of cystic ovarian teratoma following vaginal delivery in a 29-year-old woman, causing chemical peritonitis. MRI/CT imaging distinguished this from malignant ovarian disease. Laparoscopic oophorectomy was performed with histologic confirmation of benign teratoma, emphasizing the importance of preoperative imaging in managing pelvic masses.

pmid-24744972.summary_ja: 妊娠34週にMRIで診断された口咽頭真性奇形種の稀な症例。出生前診断において、MRIが超音波やCTより診断・管理計画において有用であることを示唆した。
pmid-24744972.summary_en: Case report of rare congenital oropharyngeal true teratoma diagnosed antenatally at 34 weeks by MRI in pregnant woman with polyhydramnios. MRI superior to ultrasound and CT for prenatal diagnosis and perinatal management planning of oropharyngeal teratomas.

pmid-24745342.summary_ja: Currarino syndromeの仙骨部病変として奇形種を含む疾患を検討。潜在性脊椎形成不全とtethered cordのリスク、奇形種の臨床的意義を論じた総説である。
pmid-24745342.summary_en: Review of Currarino syndrome (sacral dysgenesis, presacral mass, anorectal malformation) emphasizing high frequency of occult spinal dysraphism (60%). Teratomas as presacral masses may have lower tethered cord risk compared to lipomas. Case presented with lipomyelomeningocele and imperforate anus.

pmid-24750260.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後に見られるgrowing teratoma syndrome（GTS）15症例の臨床・画像的特性と手術成績を報告。激進的外科摘出により全患者が無病状態を達成した。
pmid-24750260.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 15 patients with growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) following chemotherapy for testicular germ cell tumors. GTS tumors contain cystic/necrotic components and require aggressive surgical resection. All patients achieved disease-free status with excellent long-term outcomes.

pmid-24750519.summary_ja: 卵巣未分化奇形種Grade 3の16年後の遅発再発症例報告。初回治療で完全奏効を得たが、肝臓・胸膜再発を認めた。5年以上の遅発再発は初の報告である。
pmid-24750519.summary_en: Case report of grade 3 immature ovarian teratoma with unusual late recurrence 16 years after complete remission from surgery and chemotherapy at age 15. Recurrent disease in liver/pleura treated with paclitaxel/carboplatin; first reported case of delayed recurrence beyond 5 years.

pmid-24753766.summary_ja: セミノーマ患者の放射線療法前後における精子の数的染色体異常を検討。放射線療法後に異数体率が有意に増加し、生殖遺伝的リスクの増加を示した。
pmid-24753766.summary_en: Study assessing numerical sex chromosomal abnormalities in sperm from seminoma patient before/after radiotherapy using three-color FISH. Post-radiotherapy showed significant increase in aneuploidy and diploidy rates. Recommends genetic/prenatal diagnosis for improved pregnancy outcomes in treated patients.

pmid-24753980.summary_ja: マウス胚性幹細胞由来の奇形腫をin vivoで検出するため、多重化SERSナノタグを開発した。近赤外ラマン試薬の固有のスペクトル指紋を用い、奇形腫内の外胚葉、中胚葉、内胚葉の3つの胚葉を識別することに成功した。
pmid-24753980.summary_en: Development of multiplexed SERS nanotags for detecting teratomas derived from mouse embryonic stem cells in vivo. Successfully identifies three germ layers (ectoderm, mesoderm, endoderm) within teratomas using NIR Raman reporters with unique spectroscopic fingerprints.

pmid-24757335.summary_ja: 小児卵巣腫瘍の85%が胚細胞腫瘍であることを述べ、yolk sac tumor、dysgerminoma、奇形種の診断と化学療法による治療成績の向上を示した総説である。
pmid-24757335.summary_en: Comprehensive review of childhood ovarian malignancies with emphasis that 85% are germ cell tumors. Discusses histopathological features of yolk sac tumor, dysgerminoma, and teratomas; role of immunohistochemistry and molecular markers (SALL4, KPNA2). Documents dramatic survival improvement with platinum-based chemotherapy.

pmid-24761256.summary_ja: 付属器腫瘤の急性症状での発症57症例の臨床病理検討。奇形種が最多（26%）であり、70%が保存的手術で妊孕性温存可能であることを示した。
pmid-24761256.summary_en: Retrospective study of 57 women with adnexal masses presenting acutely. Teratoma was most common pathology (26%), followed by corpus luteal hemorrhage and endometriosis. Conservative ovarian-sparing surgery achieved in 70%, preserving reproductive potential.

pmid-24765832.summary_ja: 乳幼児咽頭周囲未分化奇形種による気道閉塞の症例。頭頸部奇形種は稀だが、新生児呼吸困難の鑑別診断に考慮すべきことを示唆した。
pmid-24765832.summary_en: Case report of immature teratoma in parapharyngeal space causing airway obstruction in an infant. Though teratomas typically occur in sacrococcygeal, gonadal, or mediastinal sites, head/neck teratomas should be considered in differential diagnosis of neonatal respiratory distress.

pmid-24767514.summary_ja: 生後14か月の男児に生じた先天性原発性陰茎成熟奇形腫の稀な症例。陰茎遠位部に水疱様の腫瘤として presenting した。5歳時の摘出術による組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と確認された。悪性転化を防ぐため、早期認識と外科的治療の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-24767514.summary_en: Rare case of congenital primary penile mature teratoma in 14-month-old boy presenting as blister-like mass on distal penis. Surgical extirpation at age 5 confirmed mature teratoma histologically. Highlights need for early recognition and surgical treatment to prevent malignant transformation.

pmid-24772930.summary_ja: 14歳思春期前女児の卵巣未分化奇形種（Stage Ia）症例。LDHおよびCA125上昇を認めながら卵巣温存腫瘍摘出術を実施し、妊孕性温存の実現可能性を示した。
pmid-24772930.summary_en: Case of 14-year-old premenarchal girl with left ovarian immature teratoma (Stage Ia) showing elevated tumor markers (LDH, CA125). Organ-sparing tumorectomy performed. Demonstrates fertility-preserving surgical approach in pediatric ovarian germ cell tumors.

pmid-24773063.summary_ja: NMDAR脳炎と関連する卵巣奇形種2症例を報告。腹腔鏡下手術による腫瘍摘出が治療効果をもたらし、生殖機能温存の重要性と課題を強調した。
pmid-24773063.summary_en: Two case reports of anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratomas treated with laparoscopic surgery. Both patients achieved good postoperative recovery. Discusses fertility-sparing approaches (cystectomy vs oophorectomy) and challenges in consent/management of young women with paraneoplastic autoimmune encephalitis.

pmid-24777265.summary_ja: 眼窩周囲類皮嚢腫（先天性成熟奇形腫）に対する非外科的泡硬化療法の症例集積研究。4例中、3か月以内に完全消失が得られた。泡硬化療法に関連する合併症は認められなかった。外科的切除に代わる低侵襲で審美的な治療法として有用である。
pmid-24777265.summary_en: Case series of nonsurgical foam sclerotherapy treatment for periorbital dermoid cysts (congenital mature teratomas). Four patients achieved complete cyst resolution within 3 months. Minimally invasive approach provides aesthetic alternative to surgical excision without sclerotherapy-related complications.

pmid-24778657.summary_ja: 新生児時代の仙骨部奇形種切除後、31年後に再発し悪性転化（adenocarcinoma）を伴った症例。完全摘出と仙骨除去の重要性を強調した報告である。
pmid-24778657.summary_en: Case of recurrent sacrococcygeal teratoma in 31-year-old woman initially resected at age 3 without coccygectomy. Late recurrence at 31 years showed malignant transformation with adenocarcinoma nests. Emphasizes importance of complete resection including coccyx.

pmid-24780013.summary_ja: 甲状腺腫瘤として初診した胸腺奇形種の稀な症例報告。頸部における胚細胞腫瘍は非常に稀であり、多学科的アプローチの必要性を示唆した。
pmid-24780013.summary_en: Case report of thymic teratoma presenting as apparent intrathyroid lesion—an extremely rare neck presentation requiring two operations and multidisciplinary management. Highlights importance of surgical preparedness for unexpected diagnoses.

pmid-24781184.summary_ja: NMDAR脳炎患者の卵巣奇形種に特徴的な異常神経細胞（dysplastic neurons）を認識し、コントロール群とを鑑別する組織病理学的マーカーを同定した。自己免疫脳炎関連奇形種の病態機構を明らかにした。
pmid-24781184.summary_en: Case-control study comparing ovarian teratomas from NMDAR encephalitis patients with controls. Abnormal dysplastic CNS neuronal elements found in 4/5 cases but 0/39 controls (P<0.001). Abnormal neurons closely associated with immune infiltrates distinguish teratomas associated with paraneoplastic autoimmunity.

pmid-24781282.summary_ja: 精巣の正常精子形成とCIS/セミノーマを培養系で維持し、activin A処理の影響を検討した研究。KIT発現低下を確認し、組織ニッチ内での胚細胞悪性化機構の解明に有用なモデルを確立した。
pmid-24781282.summary_en: Establishes hanging drop tissue culture model for normal and malignant testicular germ cells (CIS and seminoma). Activin A treatment significantly reduced KIT transcript/protein levels in seminoma cultures, demonstrating treatment response within preserved tissue niche environment.

pmid-24783110.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟囊胞性奇形腫に含まれる甲状腺組織（struma ovarii）の症例である。著しく上昇したCA-125と大量腹水を呈し、進行卵巣癌と誤診されたが、組織診で成熟囊胞性奇形腫が確認された。術後に甲状腺機能低下症が発生した。
pmid-24783110.summary_en: This case describes struma ovarii (thyroid tissue constituent of mature ovarian teratoma) presenting with highly elevated CA-125 (>1721 IU/L) and massive ascites that mimicked advanced ovarian carcinoma in a 63-year-old woman. Thyroid tissue is a frequent component of mature ovarian teratomas; this case highlights diagnostic challenges.

pmid-24784368.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマの傍大動脈放射線療法における域外臓器被曝と二次がんリスクの評価である。生涯がん帰属リスク（LAR）は膀胱および食道がんで特に増加していた。患者年齢と照射野の影響を検討した。
pmid-24784368.summary_en: This study used Monte Carlo modeling to calculate out-of-field radiation doses and estimate lifetime cancer risks from para-aortic radiotherapy (20 Gy) for stage I testicular seminoma. Results showed increased risks for thyroid, lung, bladder, prostate, and esophageal cancers depending on patient age and field size.

pmid-24786121.summary_ja: 妊娠中の正常胎盤およびGTD（胞状奇胎、侵襲性胞状奇胎、胎盤部絨毛腫瘍、絨毛癌）におけるADAMTSメタロプロテアーゼの発現パターンを検討した。ADAMTS-1はGTDで侵襲性と相関して増強され、ADAMTS-4/5はGTDで増加していた。
pmid-24786121.summary_en: This study examined expression of ADAMTS metalloproteinases (1, 4, 5, 14) in normal placenta across gestation and in gestational trophoblastic diseases (complete moles, partial moles, invasive moles, placental site tumors, choriocarcinomas). ADAMTS-1 showed stronger staining in GTD correlating with invasive potential, while ADAMTS-4/5 were increased in GTD.

pmid-24786602.summary_ja: 次世代シーケンシングにより、転移性と非転移性精巣セミノーマを判別する小RNAシグネチャーを同定した研究である。特定の2つの小RNAの組み合わせにより転移サブタイプに関わらず完全な判別が可能であり、転移予測バイオマーカーとなる可能性がある。
pmid-24786602.summary_en: This NGS study identified small RNA signatures that completely discriminate metastasized seminoma (lymphogenic or occult) from non-metastasized seminoma. Specific combinations of two small RNAs achieved complete discrimination independent of metastasis subtype, suggesting potential biomarkers for predicting seminoma metastasis.

pmid-24786700.summary_ja: 性分化疾患(DSD)患者における胚細胞がんのリスク上昇について検討したレビューである。複数のリスク因子が同定されているが、相互作用と相対的影響は不明確である。生検と性腺摘出術の選択や組織学的所見の解釈が管理上の課題として論じられている。
pmid-24786700.summary_en: This review examines elevated germ cell cancer risk in patients with disorders of sex development (DSD). Various risk factors have been identified, though their interactions and relative impact remain unclear. The paper discusses management decisions regarding biopsy versus gonadectomy and interpretation of histological findings.

pmid-24786701.summary_ja: 本総説は、停留精巣を胚細胞腫瘍リスク増加に関連する精巣機能障害の症状として検討している。早期の精巣固定術は精子形成を改善するが、がんリスクを正常化しない。精巣下降のホルモン調節と、早期矯正後も続く腫瘍サーベイランスの重要性について論じている。
pmid-24786701.summary_en: This review examines cryptorchidism as a symptom of impaired testicular function linked to increased germ cell cancer risk. Early orchiopexy improves spermatogenesis but does not normalize cancer risk. The paper discusses hormonal regulation of testis descent and the importance of cancer surveillance despite early correction.

pmid-24787484.summary_ja: 胚性幹細胞と体細胞のハイブリッドの機能評価である。生体内での奇形腫形成を評価し、ハイブリッド細胞の多能性と分化能を検討している。生殖細胞腫瘍の実験的評価に関連する研究である。
pmid-24787484.summary_en: This study evaluates ES-somatic cell hybrids created by fusing embryonic stem cells with somatic cells. The research shows that hybrids maintain their tetraploid state in vivo and develop teratomas, but display altered hematopoietic potential despite active transcription of the somatic genome during differentiation.

pmid-24788992.summary_ja: 臨床的明白な転移と潜在的転移を有する精巣セミノーマの遺伝子発現を比較した研究である。mRNAとmiRNAプロファイルの詳細な解析により、両者は生物学的にほぼ区別不可能であり、別個の腫瘍実体ではない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-24788992.summary_en: This study used whole-genome microarrays and small RNA next-generation sequencing to compare primary seminomas with clinically apparent metastases versus occult metastases. Despite extensive analysis of mRNA and miRNA profiles, occult and apparent metastasized seminomas were found to be biologically almost indistinguishable.

pmid-24789770.summary_ja: ブレオマイシン投与を受けた小児がん生存者の長期的な肺機能を後方視的に検討した(207例投与、80例でPFTデータあり)。胚細胞腫瘍は最も多い診断名の一つであった。患者の52.5%に肺機能異常が認められ、閉塞性22.5%、拘束性7.5%であった。異常の大半は臨床症状を伴わない無症候性であった。
pmid-24789770.summary_en: This retrospective study examines long-term pulmonary function abnormalities in childhood cancer survivors treated with bleomycin (n=207, 80 with available PFT data). Germ cell tumors were among the most common diagnoses. Over half the patients showed pulmonary dysfunction (52.5%), with 22.5% obstructive and 7.5% restrictive disease.

pmid-24790512.summary_ja: トルコの一地域における妊娠絨毛疾患（GTD）の疫学研究である。1000出生あたり1.22例の発生率であった。全胞状奇胎26%、部分胞状奇胎74%の発生比であり、化学療法は2例のみで死亡例はなく、早期診断と監視の重要性が示された。
pmid-24790512.summary_en: This epidemiological study reports gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) incidence of 1.22 per 1000 births in a Turkish province over 8 years (73 cases among 59,754 births). Complete moles occurred in 26% and partial moles in 74%. Only two patients received chemotherapy, with no mortality, highlighting the favorable prognosis with early diagnosis and monitoring.

pmid-24791849.summary_ja: 妊娠25週に診断された大型咽頭部奇形腫（epignathus）の症例である。三次元超音波とMRIにより診断が確認された。中枢神経系は正常であったが、卵膜早期破裂と胎盤剥離により新生児は死亡した。小児先天性生殖細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-24791849.summary_en: This case describes prenatal diagnosis of a large epignathus teratoma (75×54 mm) protruding from the fetal mouth at 25 weeks gestation. Three-dimensional ultrasound and MRI confirmed the diagnosis with normal central nervous system. Despite EXIT procedure preparation, premature rupture of membranes and placental abruption led to adverse fetal outcome.

pmid-24799706.summary_ja: ヒトiPSCの移植後、三層胚葉を含む成熟奇形腫が急速に形成された。このSCIDブタモデルは再生医療と異種移植研究に有用である。生殖細胞腫瘍の実験的評価に関連する。
pmid-24799706.summary_en: This study describes creation of severe combined immunodeficiency (SCID) pigs for regenerative medicine and xenotransplantation research. Human induced pluripotent stem cells (iPSCs) were successfully engrafted, rapidly developing mature teratomas containing all three germ layers, validating the model for tumorigenicity assessment.

pmid-24799795.summary_ja: 生まれつきの眼窩奇形腫の稀な症例である。新生児の著しい眼球突出を呈し、三層胚葉の成熟要素と歯を含んでいた。眼窩摘出術が施行され、組織診で成熟囊胞性奇形腫が確認された。小児先天性生殖細胞腫瘍である。
pmid-24799795.summary_en: This case report presents a massive congenital orbital teratoma diagnosed in a 3-day-old neonate with unilateral proptosis. The teratoma contained mature elements from all three germ layers including a tooth. Lid-sparing orbital exenteration was performed, and histopathology confirmed cystic teratoma with mature elements.

pmid-24800694.summary_ja: 多能性幹細胞の腫瘍形成能評価のための腎被膜移植法の改善である。ガラス毛細管を用いた正確な細胞数投与と最小限の漏出（17%）により、治療用幹細胞製品のリスク評価が向上する。生殖細胞腫瘍の実験的評価に関連している。
pmid-24800694.summary_en: This paper presents a modified kidney capsule transplantation protocol for improved teratoma assay in pluripotent stem cell research. The method uses glass capillary injection to deliver defined cell numbers with minimal leakage (17%), enabling better assessment of tumorigenicity risk from residual undifferentiated stem cells in therapeutic applications.

pmid-24801011.summary_ja: 人間の奇形腫由来のNT2細胞株から生成されたニューロンとアストロサイトを、一次培養ヒト胎児細胞と比較検証した。形態学的特性、電気生理特性、および化学的プロファイルで一次細胞と同等であり、神経疾患研究の有用な再生可能な細胞ソースとして有効性が示された。
pmid-24801011.summary_en: This study compares NT2 neurons and astrocytes—derived from human teratoma—with primary human fetal neurons and astrocytes using multiple analytical techniques. NT2-derived cells demonstrate similar morphology, physiological properties, and chemical profiles to primary cells, validating them as reliable renewable alternatives for studying neurological disease mechanisms.

pmid-24803390.summary_ja: P19胚性癌細胞の分化機構の分子的解析である。Foxa1がGrg3共抑制因子を募集してNanog発現を直接抑制し、レチノイン酸誘導分化中にNanog プロモーターを不活性クロマチン状態に変える機構を示した。
pmid-24803390.summary_en: This study investigates transcriptional mechanisms in P19 embryonal carcinoma cells, a pluripotent model system derived from germ cell tumors. The research shows that Foxa1 directly represses Nanog expression by recruiting the corepressor Grg3, switching the Nanog promoter to an inactive chromatin state during retinoic acid-induced differentiation.

pmid-25815097.summary_ja: 通常は出産年齢の女性に限定される純粋子宮絨毛癌が閉経後女性に発生した稀な症例である。組織診断とhCG測定により診断が確定され、全子宮摘出と3回の化学療法後、5年間の追跡で完全寛解が得られた。
pmid-25815097.summary_en: This paper reports a rare case of pure choriocarcinoma occurring in a postmenopausal woman, typically only seen in women of childbearing age. Diagnosis was confirmed by histopathology and hCG measurement. Hysterectomy followed by three courses of chemotherapy resulted in complete remission after five years.

pmid-26266001.summary_ja: 生存可能な子宮内妊娠と共存する卵管原発絨毛癌の初の報告症例である。妊娠20週で診断され、妊産婦および胎児の健康状態の厳重な監視下で31週まで管理された後、帝王切開およびEMA-CO化学療法が施行された。母児ともに良好な転帰を得た。
pmid-26266001.summary_en: This is the first reported case of primary fallopian tube choriocarcinoma coexisting with viable intrauterine pregnancy at 20 weeks gestation. The patient was successfully managed with careful fetal and maternal monitoring until 31 weeks, followed by cesarean section and EMA-CO chemotherapy, with favorable outcomes for both mother and fetus.

pmid-26905713.summary_ja: 下降不全精巣は精巣腫瘍リスクを顕著に増加させる。本症例は双側下降不全精巣に伴う双側同時性精巣セミノーマの稀な報告である。双側精巣腫瘍の大多数（80%）は転移的（metachronous）であり、同時性は非常に稀である。
pmid-26905713.summary_en: Cryptorchidism significantly increases testicular tumor risk (11-fold for inguinal, 50-fold for intra-abdominal testes). This paper presents a rare case of bilateral synchronous testicular seminoma in a patient with bilateral cryptorchidism, contrasting with the typical 80% metachronous presentation of bilateral testicular tumors.

pmid-26905716.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性卵巣奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）は、最も一般的な卵巣胚細胞腫瘍である。本論文では、両側性の発生（10～12%）、三つの胚葉すべての組織からなる組織学的構成、多様な臨床像、および悪性転化（3～4%）、主に扁平上皮癌への転化について論じている。
pmid-26905716.summary_en: Mature cystic ovarian teratomas (dermoid cysts) are the most common ovarian germ cell tumors. The paper discusses their bilateral occurrence (10-12%), histological composition with tissues from all three germ layers, variable clinical presentations, and rare malignant transformation (3-4%), primarily to squamous cell carcinoma.

pmid-26952048.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍で、腫瘍マーカーが正常化した後も転移性腫瘤が化学療法中に増大する稀な病態であるgrowing teratoma syndromeの症例を報告し、文献をレビューする。化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘤には成熟奇形腫が含まれることがあり、化学療法に抵抗性を示す。
pmid-26952048.summary_en: Case report of growing teratoma syndrome—a rare condition where metastatic masses enlarge during appropriate chemotherapy despite normalized tumor markers in nonseminomatous germ cell tumor patients. Reviews retroperitoneal residual masses after chemotherapy containing mature teratoma.

pmid-29147385.summary_ja: 22歳の無症状男性に、両肺の広範な砲弾状転移を伴う精巣胚細胞腫瘍の稀な初発例を認めた症例報告である。精巣胚細胞腫瘍は若年男性で最も多い悪性腫瘍であり、治癒率が高いことが述べられている。若年男性の精巣がんは高い治癒率を示すことが指摘されている。
pmid-29147385.summary_en: Case report of rare initial presentation of testicular germ cell tumor in 22-year-old asymptomatic male with widespread cannonball-pattern lung metastases. Testicular GCTs are most common malignancy in young men with high cure rates.

pmid-29699154.summary_ja: 両側精巣がん5例の男性科学的転帰を検討した研究で、内訳は両側セミノーマ3例、セミノーマと非セミノーマの混合2例であり、両側精巣摘除術と補助療法で治療された。アンドロゲン補充療法はテストステロン欠乏の症状を安全に緩和した。一方で男性不妊への対応は依然として困難であると報告している。
pmid-29699154.summary_en: Study of andrological outcomes in 5 subjects with bilateral testicular cancer (3 bilateral seminomas, 2 mixed seminoma/nonseminoma) treated with bilateral orchiectomy and adjuvant therapy. Androgen replacement therapy safely relieved testosterone deficiency symptoms. Male infertility management remains challenging.

pmid-21458311.summary_ja: 進行セミノーマの18例に外来で施行したカルボプラチンを含むCEB療法を評価し、シスプラチン併用化学療法の毒性の少ない代替法としての有用性を検討しています。5年無増悪生存期間(無増悪生存率)は86.6%、5年および10年全生存期間(全生存率)は100%と85%でした。主な急性毒性は血液毒性で、晩期の心血管イベントや二次がんは認められませんでした。
pmid-21458311.summary_en: This study evaluated a carboplatin-based regimen (carboplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, CEB) as a less toxic alternative to cisplatin-based chemotherapy in 18 patients with advanced seminoma treated on an outpatient basis. Five-year progression-free survival was 86.6%, and 5- and 10-year overall survival were 100% and 85%. The main acute toxicity was hematologic, with no late cardiovascular events or secondary malignancies. The authors conclude that CEB is effective with minor toxicity and may be a good alternative to cisplatin-based therapy.

pmid-21665493.summary_ja: 1980〜2001年に治療された病期IIセミノーマの67例を対象とした単施設の解析で、病期に応じたリスク適応型戦略を検討しています。中央値9.4年の追跡で28%が再発し、ほとんどは化学療法で救済されました。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は97%でした。選択された病期IIB患者への化学療法の適応拡大の検討が示唆されています。
pmid-21665493.summary_en: This single-institution analysis of 67 patients with stage II seminoma treated between 1980 and 2001 examines a risk-adapted strategy: radiotherapy for stage IIA-B disease and cisplatin-based chemotherapy for stage IIC disease, with a 3 cm tumor-size threshold in IIB. With median follow-up of 9.4 years, 28% relapsed, most salvaged with chemotherapy. The 5-year overall survival was 97%, and only three patients died of seminoma. The authors suggest chemotherapy might be extended to selected stage IIB patients.

pmid-21803619.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣胚細胞腫瘍で精巣摘除術後に2年以上経ってから再発した晩期再発例29例を、早期再発例140例と比較した後方視的研究です。晩期再発は高齢で純粋セミノーマが多く、導入化学療法後の完全奏効率が低く、無増悪生存期間と全生存期間が有意に不良でした。後腹膜リンパ節が大きいことも特徴でした。
pmid-21803619.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1,069 chemotherapy-naive patients with advanced testicular germ cell tumors identified 169 with prior stage I disease who did not receive adjuvant treatment. Late relapse (2 years or more after orchiectomy) occurred in 29 patients and early relapse in 140. Late relapse was associated with older age, a higher proportion of pure seminoma, larger retroperitoneal lymph nodes, lower complete response after induction chemotherapy, and significantly worse progression-free and overall survival. The authors conclude that late relapse after stage I disease is associated with seminoma, older age, and poorer outcome.

pmid-21904862.summary_ja: 右間接鼠径ヘルニア嚢内に偶然見つかった寄生性卵巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。右卵巣は正常位置に認められず、組織学的には生存卵巣組織を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫でした。炎症または捻転による卵巣の自己切断が示唆されています。報告例の少ない部位と臨床像です。
pmid-21904862.summary_en: A 66-year-old woman presented with a parasitic ovarian dermoid cyst incidentally found in the sac of a right indirect inguinal hernia. The right ovary was absent from its normal position. Histology showed a mature cystic teratoma containing viable ovarian tissue, suggesting auto-amputation of the ovary by inflammation or torsion. The authors note that extragonadal mature cystic teratomas are uncommon and most often arise in the omentum, and they highlight this case as an unreported location and clinical presentation.

pmid-22056036.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の右卵巣に生じたαフェトプロテイン(AFP)産生卵巣腫瘍の症例報告です。血清AFPは102768 ng/mLと著明に高値でした。腺管構造を示し、SALL4などが免疫染色で陽性でした。胚細胞分化を伴う腺癌として分類するか、腺型の卵黄嚢腫瘍とすべきかが議論されています。
pmid-22056036.summary_en: The authors describe an alpha-fetoprotein (AFP)-producing ovarian tumor in a 58-year-old postmenopausal woman, with a serum AFP of 102,768 ng/mL. The tumor consisted of glands resembling secretory endometrium or fetal gut with abundant stroma, and the glands were positive for SALL4, glypican-3, and hepatocyte nuclear factor 1β. The authors considered it an AFP-producing adenocarcinoma with adenofibroma showing germ cell differentiation, while questioning whether it should be classified as a glandular-type yolk sac tumor. Expression profiles of SALL4, OCT4, and glypican-3 are discussed as diagnostic aids.

pmid-22134517.summary_ja: 病期Iおよび病期IIのセミノーマに対し、3次元原体照射、IMRT、陽子線療法の線量分布を比較した研究です。陽子線療法は胃、腎臓、膵臓、腸管の平均線量を減らし、病期IIでは膀胱と直腸も減らしました。ユニフォームスキャニングが最も線量低減効果が高いとされています。前向き研究が提案されています。
pmid-22134517.summary_en: Using representative patients with stage I (paraaortic) and stage II (paraaortic and iliac) seminoma, the authors compared dose distributions from 3D conformal radiotherapy, IMRT, and two proton techniques. Proton therapy reduced mean doses to the stomach, kidney, pancreas, and bowel in both stages, and to the bladder and rectum in stage II. Uniform-scanning protons gave greater reductions than double-scatter protons. The authors suggest that proton therapy may improve the therapeutic ratio by lowering risks of gastrointestinal toxicity, infertility, and secondary malignancy, and recommend prospective study.

pmid-22175797.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマに伴う抗Ma1/2抗体介在性傍腫瘍症候群で、眼振と小脳性運動失調を呈した症例です。MRIでは内側側頭葉の高信号を認め、FDG-PETでは深部小脳核と外眼筋にFDG集積の亢進を認めました。眼振の病態として小脳核が関与する機序を、生体内の機能画像で示した初の報告です。
pmid-22175797.summary_en: A patient with ocular flutter and cerebellar ataxia due to anti-Ma1/2 antibody-mediated paraneoplastic syndrome associated with testicular seminoma underwent FDG-PET imaging. Brain MRI showed anterior mesial temporal hyperintensity without gadolinium enhancement. FDG-PET revealed increased uptake in the deep cerebellar nuclei and in the inferior rectus and superior oblique extraocular muscles. The authors report that this is the first in vivo functional imaging demonstration of a possible neuropathological mechanism for ocular flutter involving the cerebellar nuclei.

pmid-22238139.summary_ja: 下大静脈に転移性血栓が及んだ進行侵入奇胎の症例報告です。超音波検査で子宮筋層、卵巣、転移性血栓内に小胞が認められ、絨毛癌ではなく侵入奇胎と診断されました。妊娠性絨毛性疾患の評価における超音波検査の有用性が示されています。
pmid-22238139.summary_en: The authors present a case of advanced invasive mole with a metastatic thrombus extending into the inferior vena cava. Sonography showed vesicles in the myometrium and ovaries as well as in the metastatic thrombus, supporting a diagnosis of invasive mole rather than choriocarcinoma. The report illustrates the value of ultrasonography in characterizing gestational trophoblastic disease and its vascular spread, which can otherwise be difficult to distinguish from choriocarcinoma.

pmid-22298374.summary_ja: 28歳男性の前縦隔に偶然発見された嚢胞成分を伴う腫瘍の症例報告です。切除時の嚢胞液の細胞診で大型の腫瘍細胞が確認され、術中にセミノーマと診断されました。SALL4の核陽性は、縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍を他の腫瘍と鑑別するマーカーとして有用とされています。
pmid-22298374.summary_en: A 28-year-old man had an incidentally discovered anterior mediastinal tumor with a cystic component. Cytology of the cystic fluid obtained at resection showed large round to polygonal tumor cells with PAS-positive cytoplasm admixed with lymphocytes, allowing an intraoperative diagnosis of seminoma. Immunostaining showed nuclear SALL4 positivity. The authors propose SALL4 as a useful marker for distinguishing mediastinal germ cell tumors from malignant lymphoma, thymoma, and thymic carcinoma.

pmid-22353016.summary_ja: 血管腫と誤診された仙尾部奇形腫の2症例を報告しています。軟部組織腫瘤を覆う皮膚の血管性変化が誤診の原因でした。悪性化の可能性があるため、迅速な認識と外科的切除が必要です。本腫瘍は、血管腫、特に先天性血管腫の鑑別診断に含めるべきだと述べています。
pmid-22353016.summary_en: Two cases of sacrococcygeal teratoma initially misdiagnosed as hemangiomas are reported. Their cutaneous vascular stains overlying a soft tissue mass led to the misdiagnosis. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is rare, occurring in about one in 40,000 live births, and can have malignant potential, so prompt recognition and surgical resection are essential. The authors argue that this tumor should be included in the differential diagnosis of hemangiomas, particularly congenital hemangiomas.

pmid-22405521.summary_ja: 帝王切開で33週に出生した男児で、口腔から突出する巨大腫瘤を認めました。気管切開の後、生後2日目に部分切除が行われました。病理診断は腎芽腫成分を伴う悪性エピグナトゥスでした。文献上初めての報告であり、稀な先天性腫瘍の治療成功例として報告されています。
pmid-22405521.summary_en: A male infant born at 33 weeks by cesarean delivery had a large mass protruding from the mouth and attached to the palate. Tracheostomy was performed immediately, and partial surgical excision was done on day two, removing most of the teratoma (epignathus). Pathology showed malignant epignathus with a nephroblastoma component, described as the first such case in the literature. The paper reports successful management of this rare congenital tumor.

pmid-22461324.summary_ja: 頸部腫瘤を有する胎児4例(リンパ管腫3例、奇形腫1例)で、仮想気管支鏡検査による気道開存性評価を検討しました。MRIから作成した3次元気道モデルで全例の気道開存性が明瞭に示され、出生後にも確認されました。胎児頸部腫瘍の評価に有用な手法となりうると述べています。
pmid-22461324.summary_en: This study evaluated virtual bronchoscopy for assessing airway patency in four fetuses with cervical tumors: three lymphangiomas and one teratoma. Three-dimensional airway models were built from MRI and examined virtually. Airway patency was clearly shown in all fetuses and was confirmed after birth. The authors suggest MRI-based virtual bronchoscopy could be a useful tool for assessing fetal airway patency in cervical tumors.

pmid-22537538.summary_ja: 1974〜2007年にMayo Clinicで放射線療法を受けた病期II精巣セミノーマ52例を後方視的に検討しました。中央値19年の追跡で10年全生存率は94%、無再発生存率は80%でした。縦隔・鎖骨上領域への予防的照射により同部位の再発が減少しました。心イベントや二次悪性腫瘍は治療後20年以上で出現しており、長期フォローアップの重要性が示されました。
pmid-22537538.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 52 patients with stage II testicular seminoma treated with megavoltage radiotherapy at Mayo Clinic from 1974 to 2007. With a median follow-up of 19 years, 10-year overall survival was 94% and relapse-free survival was 80%. Prophylactic mediastinal and supraclavicular radiotherapy significantly reduced relapse risk in those regions. Major cardiac events and second malignancies appeared decades after treatment, highlighting the need for long-term follow-up.

pmid-22579464.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の奇形腫成分45例を検討し、免疫染色により1例の精巣と後腹膜リンパ節転移に前立腺分化を確認した。通常のHE染色では見逃されやすいため、免疫染色が奇形腫内の前立腺分化の同定に有用であり、従来考えられていたより稀ではない可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22579464.summary_en: This study examined 45 postpubertal male germ cell tumors with a teratoma component for prostatic differentiation within the teratoma. Routine H&E review missed glandular structures, but immunohistochemistry (PSA, PSAP, prostein/P501S) confirmed prostatic differentiation in one patient's testis and in a retroperitoneal lymph node metastasis. Because prostatic differentiation in teratoma has been reported fewer than 20 times, the authors suggest it may be underrecognized and that immunostains help identify it among teratoma's epithelial components.

pmid-22585599.summary_ja: 胎児超音波検査で出生前に診断された腎成熟奇形腫の症例報告である。腎奇形腫は極めて稀で、画像所見が出生前に記載された例はこれまでなかった。出生前診断の可能性を示した初の報告であり、精巣・卵巣以外の部位に生じる稀な奇形腫の認識における超音波検査の役割が示唆された。
pmid-22585599.summary_en: This case report describes a renal mature teratoma diagnosed prenatally by fetal ultrasound. Renal teratoma is extremely rare and usually found in adolescents and young adults, and its prenatal imaging appearance had not been described before. The authors state that this is the first report of prenatal sonographic diagnosis of renal teratoma, highlighting the potential role of fetal ultrasound in recognizing this rare extragonadal lesion.

pmid-22623132.summary_ja: 卵巣腫瘤の超音波画像105例を対象に、自動テクスチャ解析アルゴリズムの診断精度を評価した。皮様嚢腫(成熟卵巣奇形腫)は、アルゴリズムおよび観察者のいずれにおいても最も診断精度が低かった。経験の浅い術者への診断補助や教育ツールとしての有用性が示唆された。
pmid-22623132.summary_en: This study tested an automatic texture-based algorithm (ATBA) on 105 ultrasound images of ovarian masses, including malignancies, functional cysts and dermoid cysts (mature ovarian teratomas). ATBA outperformed junior and senior trainees but not level II examiners, while expert ultrasonographers performed best. Dermoid cysts had the poorest diagnostic performance for both ATBA and observers. The authors propose ATBA as a training and diagnostic aid for less experienced examiners.

pmid-22646829.summary_ja: 10歳の雄ヒトコブラクダにおける片側精巣セミノーマの症例報告である。超音波検査で精巣実質が不均一に描出され、精巣摘出後の病理検査で高分化型のびまん性セミノーマと診断された。臨床所見、超音波画像、繁殖能の経過が記載されている。
pmid-22646829.summary_en: A 10-year-old male dromedary camel with progressive unilateral testicular enlargement was examined by ultrasonography, which showed a diffusely heterogeneous testicular parenchyma. After surgical removal of the testicle, histopathology diagnosed a well-differentiated, diffuse seminoma. Before diagnosis the animal had sired 31 female offspring from 32 matings over 5 years. The report documents the clinical, ultrasonographic and fertility findings of unilateral testicular seminoma in this species.

pmid-22690948.summary_ja: 無精子症および極めて重度の乏精子症の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者で、精巣摘除術後に腫瘍患者の精巣内精子採取(onco-TESE)を実施した。4例で精子が得られ、2例が臨床的妊娠に至った。化学療法前の妊孕性温存に有用な手法であると結論づけられている。
pmid-22690948.summary_en: Four azoospermic and two very severely oligozoospermic cancer patients underwent onco-testicular sperm extraction (TESE) after orchiectomy, to attempt fertility preservation before cytotoxic therapy. Spermatozoa were found in the testicular tissue of four patients with testicular germ cell tumours. Histology showed seminomatous (three) and nonseminomatous (two) tumours, with one patient having no malignancy. Two patients achieved clinical pregnancy, and the authors conclude that TESE is useful for obtaining sperm before therapy in such men.

pmid-22693072.summary_ja: ドイツのMAHO/MAKEI登録データを用い、頭蓋外悪性胚細胞腫瘍の小児・思春期患者838例を解析した。診断時に縦隔原発で頭蓋外転移を有する群では脳転移リスクが37.5%と高値であった。この高リスク群には強化化学療法と中枢神経系の厳重なフォローアップが推奨されている。
pmid-22693072.summary_en: Using the German MAHO/MAKEI registry, this study analyzed 838 eligible children and adolescents with extracranial malignant germ cell tumors to identify risk factors for later brain metastases. Nine developed brain metastases, none of them in the absence of extracranial metastases at diagnosis. A decision tree analysis found that patients with mediastinal primaries and extracranial metastases had a 37.5% risk, compared with 1.2% for extracranial metastases without a mediastinal primary. The authors propose intensified chemotherapy and close CNS surveillance for this high-risk group.

pmid-22763193.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(セミノーマと奇形腫の成分を含む)に、二次性の悪性腫瘍として肝細胞癌が発生した症例報告です。免疫組織化学染色で肝細胞癌の性質を確認し、セミノーマ成分の特徴も記載しています。胚細胞腫瘍における稀な現象として認識すべきだと述べています。
pmid-22763193.summary_en: The authors report a testicular germ cell tumor with seminomatous and teratomatous components in which hepatocellular carcinoma developed as a secondary somatic malignancy. The HCC was positive for cytokeratin, HepPar-1, AFP, glypican-3, Oct3/4 and Ki-67, and showed adenocarcinoma and rhabdomyoblastic differentiation. The seminoma component was positive for PLAP, Sal-like 4 and Oct3/4. The authors believe this rare phenomenon in germ cell tumors deserves recognition.

pmid-22763659.summary_ja: 1998〜2011年に埼玉がんセンターで治療された性腺外非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍13例を後方視的に検討しました。縦隔と後腹膜に原発がみられ、シスプラチンまたはカルボプラチンを用いた化学療法に加え、大量化学療法や外科的切除などを組み合わせて治療されました。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は62%でした。進行例でも集中的な化学療法と手術により治癒が得られ得ると結論づけています。
pmid-22763659.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 13 patients with extragonadal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors treated at Saitama Cancer Center between 1998 and 2011. Six primaries were mediastinal and seven retroperitoneal, and seven had distant metastases at diagnosis. All received cisplatin- or carboplatin-based chemotherapy, followed by multimodal treatment including high-dose chemotherapy, surgery and salvage regimens. Eight achieved complete response. Five-year overall survival was 62% and cancer-specific survival 68%. The authors conclude that even far-advanced tumors can be cured with intensive chemotherapy plus surgery.

pmid-22773349.summary_ja: 1996〜2011年に治療された小児の後腹膜奇形腫5例の後方視的カルテ検討と文献レビューを組み合わせた報告です。全例で高度の癒着がみられ、胃や胆管の損傷が合併しました。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)では血管解剖の描出が不十分な場合があり、下大静脈の結紮が必要な例もありました。外科的切除は治癒に必要ですが困難であり、晩期合併症として再発や高血圧が挙げられています。
pmid-22773349.summary_en: This review combined a retrospective chart review of five children with retroperitoneal teratomas treated between 1996 and 2011 with a literature review of operative complications. Four patients were infants. Dense adhesions were present in all cases, and resection was complicated by gastric and bile duct injury, and spillage in two. Inferior vena cava ligation was required in one patient. Computed tomography often inadequately delineates vascular anatomy. The authors conclude surgical resection is necessary for cure but challenging, with recurrence and hypertension as late complications.

pmid-22781383.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いて、精巣摘除術後の病期I精巣セミノーマ患者6,764例を、術後放射線療法群と観察群で比較した研究です。全生存期間(全生存率)は5年・10年時点で放射線療法群がやや高く、20年時点ではほぼ同等でした。多変量解析では術後放射線療法は癌特異的生存の改善と関連しました。現代の放射線療法技術の評価には追加研究が必要です。
pmid-22781383.summary_en: This SEER-based population analysis compared overall and cause-specific survival in 6,764 men with stage I testicular seminoma after orchiectomy, treated with adjuvant radiation therapy (5,265) or observation (1,499). With median follow-up of 7.6 years, 5-, 10- and 20-year overall survival was 97.9% versus 95.0%, 94.8% versus 92.2%, and 83.5% versus 84.1%, with cause-specific survival favoring radiation. On multivariate analysis, adjuvant radiation was associated with improved cause-specific survival (HR 0.37). Further studies are needed to evaluate modern techniques, given the trend toward chemotherapy.

pmid-22807194.summary_ja: 2004〜2010年に当施設で治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)14例の臨床的特徴と経膣超音波検査所見を検討した研究です。主な症状は不正性器出血で、β-hCGは概して低値でした。超音波所見は、子宮内腔の充実性腫瘤、筋層内の充実性腫瘤、血流の豊富な嚢胞性病変の3型に分類されました。臨床所見と組み合わせることで、PSTTの疑い診断と治療判断に役立つと述べています。
pmid-22807194.summary_en: The authors reviewed 14 pathologically confirmed cases of placental site trophoblastic tumor treated at their institution between 2004 and 2010, focusing on clinical features and transvaginal sonography. Abnormal vaginal bleeding was the most common symptom, and serum beta-hCG was generally low. Sonographic findings were classified into three types: solid intrauterine masses, solid myometrial masses, and cystic myometrial lesions with high vascularity. The authors suggest that combined clinical and sonographic features can support suspicion of PSTT and aid clinical decision-making.

pmid-22820662.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍36例でHIF-1αとpVHLの免疫組織化学染色を行った研究。HIF-1αの発現は悪性腫瘍の約3分の1で認められたものの、陽性細胞は少数（平均3%）にとどまった。pVHLは組織型にかかわらず広範に減少していたが、VHL遺伝子の変化は認められなかった。
pmid-22820662.summary_en: This study examined HIF-1α and pVHL expression by immunohistochemistry in 36 primary testicular germ cell tumors (11 seminomas, 24 mixed germ cell tumors, and 1 pure intratubular germ cell neoplasia) and adjacent benign tissue. HIF-1α was detected in about one third of malignancies, but only in a small fraction of cells (mean 3%), with no difference between seminomas and nonseminomas. pVHL expression was substantially lost in germ cell tumors regardless of histology, while VHL gene alterations were absent in cases with low pVHL. The authors conclude that testicular GCTs show consistently low HIF-1α overexpression and partial pVHL loss without VHL gene alteration.

pmid-22832114.summary_ja: 顆粒膜細胞腫瘍と卵黄嚢腫瘍の鑑別における免疫染色マーカーとしてSALL4とSF-1を検討した研究。卵黄嚢腫瘍27例は全例SALL4陽性・SF-1陰性、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍24例は全例SF-1陽性・SALL4陰性であった。両マーカーは困難な鑑別診断に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-22832114.summary_en: This study evaluated SALL4 and steroidogenic factor-1 (SF-1) immunostaining to distinguish granulosa cell tumors from yolk sac tumors, which can be confused when granulosa cell tumors show a reticular pattern with mitoses. In 27 yolk sac tumors and 24 granulosa cell tumors, all yolk sac tumors were SALL4-positive and SF-1-negative, whereas all granulosa cell tumors were SF-1-positive and SALL4-negative. The difference was statistically significant. The authors conclude that these two markers can be used to distinguish the tumors in difficult diagnostic situations.

pmid-22889418.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の33歳46,XY女性で、ディスジャーミノーマが疑われた付属器腫瘤を呈した症例。Y染色体の性決定領域に新規変異c.301C>G（p.L101V）が同定された。悪性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクが高く有効なスクリーニングがないため、予防的性腺摘出が必須と結論づけている。
pmid-22889418.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old 46,XY female with Swyer syndrome who presented with an adnexal mass suspected to be a dysgerminoma. Genetic analysis identified a novel variant in the sex-determining region on the Y chromosome, c.301C>G (p.L101V). Because patients with 46,XY gonadal dysgenesis carry a high risk of malignant germ cell tumors and effective screening is unavailable, the authors conclude that prophylactic gonadectomy is mandatory. The report highlights the importance of risk-reducing surgery in this population.

pmid-22892555.summary_ja: 再発した原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍12例に対し、大量化学療法と末梢血幹細胞移植を行った研究。3例が完全寛解に至り、生存期間中央値は11か月であった。少数例では長期寛解が得られるが、可能であれば外科的切除が望ましいと結論づけている。
pmid-22892555.summary_en: This study summarizes high-dose chemotherapy with peripheral blood stem cell transplant for recurrent primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, a group previously considered to have poor outcomes after salvage therapy. Twelve patients received two courses of carboplatin plus etoposide with autologous stem cell rescue, and eight had major thoracic resections at relapse. Three achieved complete remission, and median survival was 11 months. The authors conclude that durable remission and probable cure are possible in a small subset, and that surgical resection is preferred when anatomically feasible.

pmid-22918484.summary_ja: 精子形成障害を伴う無精子症と精巣胚細胞腫瘍を中心に、ギャップ結合蛋白コネキシン43の役割をまとめた総説。細胞増殖、分化、アポトーシスの均衡を調節し、その破綻が無秩序な増殖につながるとされる。コネキシン43は精巣がんの診断・予後マーカーおよび治療標的になりうると提案している。
pmid-22918484.summary_en: This review examines the role of connexin 43, a gap junction protein, in human testis diseases, focusing on azoospermia with impaired spermatogenesis and testicular germ cell tumors. Connexin 43 helps balance germ cell proliferation, differentiation, and apoptosis, and its disruption can promote uncontrolled proliferation. The authors propose connexin 43 as a potential diagnostic and prognostic marker for testicular cancer and as a therapeutic target for testicular diseases. The review integrates genomic evidence from gene deletion models.

pmid-22943385.summary_ja: 予後良好な転移性セミノーマ61例に対し、カルボプラチン(AUC 10)単剤療法を3～4サイクル施行した。3年全生存率は96.3%、3年無増悪生存率(PFS)は93.2%で、51%が完全奏効を得た。主な毒性は血液毒性であり、治療関連死は認められなかった。併用化学療法と比べ毒性が少なく、有効な治療選択肢となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-22943385.summary_en: This series assessed single-agent carboplatin AUC 10 in 61 patients with good-prognosis metastatic seminoma treated at the authors' institution and affiliated centers. Treatment consisted of three or four three-weekly cycles. With median follow-up of 36 months, three-year survival was 96.3% and three-year progression-free survival was 93.2%, with 51% achieving complete response. The main toxicity was hematological, including grade 3/4 thrombocytopenia in 54%. No treatment-related deaths occurred. The authors conclude that carboplatin monotherapy is an effective option with less toxicity than combination regimens.

pmid-22958743.summary_ja: 精巣がんの既往がある29歳男性の後腹膜腫瘤は、転移性セミノーマが疑われた。放射線療法を拒否したため化学療法を施行したが腫瘤は不変で、後腹膜リンパ節郭清後に後腹膜神経鞘腫と確定診断された。後腹膜腫瘤を有する精巣がん患者では、誤診と過剰治療を避けるため神経鞘腫の可能性を念頭に置くべきだと強調している。
pmid-22958743.summary_en: A 29-year-old man with a prior seminoma presented with a single retroperitoneal mass suspected to be metastatic. After refusing radiotherapy, he received three cycles of cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin, but post-chemotherapy computed tomography showed the mass unchanged. Retroperitoneal lymph node dissection found negative nodes but a mass in the attached fat. Pathology and immunohistochemistry confirmed retroperitoneal schwannoma. The authors stress that schwannoma should be considered in testicular cancer patients with retroperitoneal masses to avoid misdiagnosis and overtreatment.

pmid-22961361.summary_ja: 約110万人のイスラエル人男性を追跡し、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の発生を出身地別に解析した。北アフリカ・アジア出生者では欧州系に比べ発生率が著しく低かった一方、イスラエル生まれの同出身者ではリスクが中等度に上昇し、次世代移民で大きく増加した。組織亜型でも同様の傾向が認められ、現代の生活様式や環境が病因に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22961361.summary_en: This migrant cohort study analyzed 1,092,373 Jewish Israeli males who underwent health examinations at ages 16-19, linked to the national cancer registry. Among 1,001 testicular germ cell tumors during 19.2 million person-years, men born in North Africa and Asia had markedly lower risk than those of European origin. However, Israeli-born men of North African or Asian origin had intermediate risk, and risk increased markedly in next-generation migrants. Findings persisted across histologic subtypes, suggesting that modern lifestyle and environment may shape testicular germ cell tumor etiology.

pmid-22987628.summary_ja: 本研究では、新鮮凍結された48例のGCT検体と4種のGCT細胞株でEPCAM発現を測定した。EPCAMは良性ではなく悪性のGCTで発現しており、奇形腫では未熟度とともに発現が増加した。発現は血清AFPおよびhCGと相関し、卵黄嚢腫瘍および絨毛癌で最も高かった。免疫組織化学およびインビトロの解析でも、これらの結果が裏付けられた。著者らは、これらの非セミノーマ性GCTがEPCAM免疫療法の候補標的となる可能性があり、さらなる評価が必要であると述べている。
pmid-22987628.summary_en: This study measured EPCAM expression in 48 fresh-frozen germ cell tumors and four GCT cell lines. EPCAM was expressed in malignant but not benign GCTs and increased with immaturity in teratomas. Expression correlated with serum AFP and hCG levels and was highest in yolk sac tumors and choriocarcinomas, as confirmed by immunohistochemistry and in vitro work. The authors suggest these nonseminomatous GCTs may be candidate targets for EPCAM-directed immunotherapy, which warrants further evaluation.

pmid-22987789.summary_ja: 27歳男性が喘鳴で受診し、喉頭・気管を閉塞する腫瘤が認められた。部分的輪状気管切除後の7cm欠損を、骨皮膚橈骨前腕皮弁で一期的に再建した。術後に気管カニューレを抜去でき、発声と嚥下も良好であった。成人の喉頭に発生した悪性未熟奇形腫の初報告であり、新規の再建手技として報告している。
pmid-22987789.summary_en: This case report describes a 27-year-old man with stridor due to a laryngeal and tracheal mass, diagnosed as a malignant immature teratoma. He underwent noncircumferential partial cricotracheal resection creating a 7-cm defect, reconstructed with an osteocutaneous radial forearm flap without prefabrication. He was decannulated and had good speech and swallowing postoperatively. The authors report this as the first malignant immature teratoma involving the larynx in an adult and describe a novel single-stage reconstructive technique.

pmid-23001941.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫を中心とする高心拍出量病変の胎児35例を後方視的に検討した研究である。体重で補正した心拍出量と心血管プロファイルスコア(CVPS)の間に有意な負の相関が認められた。子宮内死亡や介入を要した例の80%ではCVPSが8未満であり、CVPSはリスク層別化に有用な可能性がある。
pmid-23001941.summary_en: This retrospective echocardiographic study of 35 fetuses with high cardiac output lesions, mostly sacrococcygeal teratoma, examined the relationship between estimated combined cardiac output indexed to fetal weight and the cardiovascular profile score. Higher cardiac output correlated with lower CVPS. Most fetuses that experienced in-utero demise or required intervention had a CVPS below 8, suggesting CVPS may help stratify risk and select fetuses for intervention.

pmid-23007804.summary_ja: HIV感染歴のある成人男性で、反復する頻脈を契機に心膜内腫瘤が見つかった症例報告である。外科的切除後に病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)が有用な画像検査であり、リンパ腫や感染症が鑑別に挙がった。奇形腫は化学療法や放射線療法に抵抗性のため、手術が主な治療となる。
pmid-23007804.summary_en: This case report describes an HIV-positive adult man who presented with recurrent tachycardia and was found to have an intrapericardial mass. After surgical excision, histopathology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors review imaging, with CT and MRI being most useful, and differential diagnoses including lymphoma and infection. They note that surgery is the main treatment because cardiac teratomas are relatively resistant to chemotherapy and radiotherapy.

pmid-23016566.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんに対する化学療法後に精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を同時施行した42例を後方視的に解析した。後腹膜リンパ節では壊死が多かったが、リンパ節に腫瘍が残らない症例でも精巣には生存腫瘍が認められることが多かった。組織学的不一致率は38.1%であり、進行精巣胚細胞腫瘍における完全精巣摘除術の意義を支持する結果となった。
pmid-23016566.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 42 patients who underwent simultaneous orchidectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection after chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer. Necrosis predominated in most lymph node specimens, yet viable tumor often persisted in the orchiectomy despite tumor-free nodes, and histological discordance occurred in 38.1% of cases. The findings support completion orchidectomy as part of treatment for advanced testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-23017517.summary_ja: 1980年から2007年に化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた精巣がん患者1,790例を後方視的に解析した。腎摘除術は14.8%で施行され、近年は減少傾向であった。後腹膜腫瘤が10cmを超えることが最も強い予測因子であった(OR 9.30)。がん組織、救援化学療法、左側原発、腫瘍マーカー上昇も腎摘除術の増加と関連した。
pmid-23017517.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 1,790 patients who underwent post-chemotherapy RPLND for testicular cancer from 1980 to 2007 found nephrectomy in 14.8%, with incidence declining over time. A retroperitoneal mass larger than 10 cm was the strongest predictor, with an odds ratio of 9.30. Higher rates were also associated with cancer histology, salvage chemotherapy, a left primary tumor, and elevated markers at surgery.

pmid-23021090.summary_ja: 1993年から2010年に化学療法後腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた、病期II非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の初回100例を後方視的に検討した。手術は実施可能で合併症も少なかった。平均74か月の観察期間中に再発は1例のみで、手術野内の再発はなかった。両側神経温存術後の患者の95.2%で順行性射精が保たれた。
pmid-23021090.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review covered the first 100 patients with stage II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor who underwent postchemotherapy laparoscopic RPLND between 1993 and 2010. Surgery was feasible with low morbidity. Only one patient recurred during a mean follow-up of 74 months, with no recurrence inside the surgical field. Of patients who underwent bilateral nerve-sparing surgery, 95.2% reported antegrade ejaculation.

pmid-23046175.summary_ja: 新生児の女児に生じたエピグナサス奇形腫の症例報告である。下顎骨と舌が重複しており、出生時に開口障害と上気道閉塞を生じた。救命のため気管切開を行い、その後、腫瘍減量と解剖学的異常の矯正を段階的に実施した。気道リスクの軽減と外観・生活の質の改善が得られた。
pmid-23046175.summary_en: This report describes a female infant with an epignathus teratoma, a congenital teratoma of the oropharyngeal region, with duplication of both the mandible and tongue. The mass caused trismus and upper airway obstruction at birth, requiring life-saving tracheostomy. Staged operations, including debulking and correction of the anatomical anomaly, were then performed, reducing airway risk and improving facial appearance and quality of life.

pmid-23052753.summary_ja: 24歳女性の後腹膜腫瘤を報告。術前は未熟成分を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断されたが、切除標本で奇形腫内に潜在する原発性カルチノイド腫瘍が確認された。術後24か月間再発は認められていない。術前画像で良性と思われても、成人の後腹膜奇形腫では悪性転化が起こり得ることを強調している。
pmid-23052753.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman presented with an abdominal mass that was preoperatively diagnosed as a retroperitoneal mature teratoma with an immature component. Histology revealed mature fat, soft tissue and bone with prostate-like tissue, and an incidental latent primary carcinoid tumor within the teratoma, establishing a diagnosis of carcinoid arising in a mature teratoma. The patient remained free of recurrence for 24 months after surgery. The authors highlight that malignant transformation can occur in adult retroperitoneal teratoma even when preoperative imaging suggests a benign lesion.

pmid-23059385.summary_ja: 高齢男性の精巣および精巣付属器腫瘍を概説。通常型のセミノーマや非セミノーマは20〜45歳に多いが、60歳以上では精子細胞性セミノーマ、悪性ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍、精巣のリンパ腫、精巣周囲の肉腫が多くみられる。高齢者の非典型的な精巣腫瘤を認識する際の参考となる。
pmid-23059385.summary_en: This review discusses testicular and paratesticular neoplasms in elderly men, which differ markedly from those in younger patients. Conventional seminoma and nonseminoma typically occur between ages 20 and 45, whereas spermatocytic seminoma, malignant Leydig cell tumors, testicular lymphomas and paratesticular sarcomas are more common after age 60. The authors describe the entities most often diagnosed in older men, providing context for recognizing atypical testicular masses in this population.

pmid-23062817.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍に対し、パクリタキセルを含む大量化学療法(TECTIC)と自家幹細胞救済を行った48例の成績とQOLを報告。無増悪生存期間の中央値は11.8か月、全生存期間は21.7か月であった。長期生存者は全般的健康スコアが高い一方、身体機能は低く、持続的寛解と許容できるQOLが示された。
pmid-23062817.summary_en: The authors report the clinical course and quality of life of patients with relapsed or refractory germ cell tumors treated with the TECTIC regimen (high-dose paclitaxel, etoposide, carboplatin, ifosfamide) with autologous stem cell rescue. Of 48 enrolled patients, median PFS was 11.8 months and median OS 21.7 months. Among interviewed survivors, global health scores exceeded historical cohorts while physical functioning was lower. HDCT with TECTIC produced durable remissions with acceptable quality of life in long-term survivors.

pmid-23065465.summary_ja: 正常胎盤、部分・完全胞状奇胎、侵入奇胎、および絨毛癌の免疫組織化学的検討。p16は栄養膜細胞で妊娠週数とともに増加し、侵入奇胎の絨毛間質での強い発現が侵襲性に関与する可能性がある。絨毛癌ではBcl-2とp16がともに弱く、速い細胞周期回転が進行の鍵と考えられた。
pmid-23065465.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined p16 and Bcl-2 expression across normal placenta, partial, complete and invasive hydatidiform moles, and post-molar choriocarcinomas. p16 expression in cytotrophoblast rose with gestational age, and strong p16 in the villous mesenchyme of invasive moles may contribute to their invasiveness. Bcl-2 was syncytiotrophoblast-specific. In choriocarcinoma, weak Bcl-2 with weak p16 suggested high apoptotic and proliferative potential, with rapid cell-cycle turnover proposed as the driver of progression.

pmid-23072289.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後にシスプラチン・ブレオマイシン・エトポシドによる補助化学療法を受けた病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。22か月後、奇形腫成分の悪性転化により生じた後頭部転移が横紋筋肉腫のみで構成されていた。悪性転化を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の補助化学療法の課題を示す。
pmid-23072289.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with stage I testicular non-seminomatous germ cell tumor who received two cycles of adjuvant cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Twenty-two months later, an occipital metastasis composed solely of rhabdomyosarcoma developed, arising from malignant transformation of a teratoma component. The case highlights the challenges of adjuvant chemotherapy for germ cell tumors with malignant transformation.

pmid-23073996.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ61例と正常精巣23例を対象に、GP5+/GP6+コンセンサスプライマーを用いたリアルタイムPCRでHPV DNAを検索した。いずれの検体からもHPV DNAは検出されなかった。セミノーマとHPVの関連は支持されないと結論づけ、精巣腫瘍発生におけるHPVの役割については今後の検討が必要としている。
pmid-23073996.summary_en: This study used real-time PCR with GP5+/GP6+ consensus primers to test for human papillomavirus DNA in 61 seminoma specimens and 23 normal testicular samples. No HPV DNA was detected in any specimen. The authors conclude that the data do not support an association between HPV and seminoma, while noting that further studies are needed to definitively clarify any role of HPV in testicular tumorigenesis.

pmid-23078915.summary_ja: Tgkdトランスジェニックマウスを用いて、卵巣奇形腫の発生におけるInpp4bの役割を検討した研究。Tgkdの挿入によりInpp4bの発現が低下し、顆粒膜細胞でPI3K/AKTシグナルが亢進していた。奇形腫は減数分裂Iを終えた成熟卵子に由来しており、PI3K/AKT経路の過剰活性化が卵巣奇形腫の形成を促進すると示唆している。
pmid-23078915.summary_en: This study examines the role of inositol polyphosphate-4-phosphatase type II (Inpp4b) in ovarian teratoma formation using Tgkd transgenic mice, which are highly susceptible to teratomas. Tgkd insertion near Inpp4b reduced its expression and increased PI3K/AKT signaling in granulosa cells, creating a folliculogenesis defect. Tgkd teratomas were found to originate from trapped mature oocytes that had completed meiosis I. The findings suggest PI3K/AKT hyperactivation promotes teratoma formation.

pmid-23098692.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の細胞株において、1,25-ジヒドロキシビタミンD3がシスプラチン感受性を高めるかを、インビトロおよびインビボで検討した研究である。胎児性癌由来のNTera2細胞では、多能性遺伝子の抑制と細胞周期調節因子の上昇により、ビタミンDがシスプラチンの細胞傷害性を増強した。セミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞や2102Ep細胞では有意な効果はなかった。ヌードマウスの異種移植モデルでは、併用によりOCT4は低下したが、シスプラチン単独を超える腫瘍増殖抑制は得られなかった。
pmid-23098692.summary_en: In vitro and in vivo study of whether 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D3 enhances cisplatin sensitivity in testicular germ cell tumor cell lines. Vitamin D augmented cisplatin cytotoxicity in the NTera2 embryonal carcinoma line by downregulating pluripotency genes and upregulating cell-cycle regulators, with no significant effect in seminoma (TCam-2) or 2102Ep lines. In NTera2 xenografts in nude mice, the combination reduced OCT4 expression but did not significantly enhance tumor growth inhibition beyond cisplatin alone, and dietary cholecalciferol did not increase cisplatin sensitivity.

pmid-23103591.summary_ja: 生後9か月の女児に生じた膣原発卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。不正性器出血で発症し、内視鏡・腹腔鏡下生検で診断された。PEB療法後に残存病変を外科的切除し、腫瘍は縮小した。2年後も無病生存中であり、生殖機能の温存を考慮した治療の重要性を述べている。
pmid-23103591.summary_en: Case report of a 9-month-old girl with an endodermal sinus (yolk sac) tumor of the vagina presenting with metrorrhagia. Diagnosis was established using endoscopic and laparoscopic examination with biopsy. After platinum-based PEB chemotherapy, a residual lesion was removed during follow-up, and the tumor regressed. At two-year follow-up the patient was alive and disease-free. The authors stress that the vagina is a critical site where reproductive and sexual function should be preserved when possible.

pmid-23104458.summary_ja: 57歳女性の後縦隔に生じた成熟奇形腫の症例報告。下行大動脈に接着した石灰化と液体成分を伴う腫瘍を、胸腔鏡手術で根治的に切除した。後縦隔の良性奇形腫は周囲構造と癒着しやすく、術前所見からこれを想定することの重要性を述べている。
pmid-23104458.summary_en: Case report of a 57-year-old woman with a posterior mediastinal mature teratoma adhering to the descending aorta. Preoperative work-up showed a calcified tumor with fluid components. The tumor was radically resected by video-assisted thoracic surgery, and histology confirmed a mature teratoma with cystic change. The authors note that benign posterior mediastinal teratomas often adhere to major surrounding structures such as the aorta, chest wall, and esophagus, and that this should be anticipated when typical features are present preoperatively.

pmid-23104726.summary_ja: 2つの第III相試験に登録された、再発・進行性の播種性非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者を解析した研究。化学療法6週後のAFPおよびhCGの低下の程度(腫瘍マーカー減少度)が、無増悪生存期間と全生存期間の独立した予測因子であった。Lorch予後スコアとは独立した因子で、救済療法における予後評価に有用と結論している。
pmid-23104726.summary_en: Secondary analysis of 400 patients with progressive or relapsed disseminated non-seminomatous germ cell tumors from two prospectively accrued phase III trials. Serum AFP and hCG were measured at baseline and after six weeks of salvage chemotherapy. An unfavorable marker decline was an independent predictor of poorer progression-free and overall survival in both training and validation sets, beyond the Lorch prognostic score, supporting its use in the salvage setting.

pmid-23104768.summary_ja: 12週齢のSwiss albinoマウスに自然発生した精巣腫瘍の病理組織学的・免疫組織化学的解析の報告。左精巣に絨毛癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、胎児性癌が、右精巣に奇形腫が認められ、転移は見られなかった。マウスで自然発生した非転移性の複合的胚細胞腫瘍の初報告としている。
pmid-23104768.summary_en: Histopathological and immunohistochemical characterization of spontaneous testicular tumors in a 12-week-old Swiss albino mouse. The left testis contained choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, and embryonal carcinoma, and the right testis contained a teratoma. The neoplasms were nonmetastatic. The authors report this as the first description of spontaneously arising, nonmetastasizing choriocarcinoma, yolk sac tumor, embryonal carcinoma, and teratoma together in the testes of a mouse.

pmid-23110807.summary_ja: 欧州12地域の癌登録と米国SEERデータを用い、1993〜97年と2003〜07年に診断された精巣セミノーマおよび非セミノーマの相対生存率を比較した研究。50歳未満のセミノーマは98%以上の生存率を示した。高齢の非セミノーマ患者では改善が見られたものの依然として低く、欧州の患者は米国に比べ死亡リスクが高かった。
pmid-23110807.summary_en: Population-based analysis of 12 European cancer registries and the US SEER 9 database, comparing relative survival of testicular seminoma and nonseminoma patients diagnosed in 1993-1997 and 2003-2007. Five-year relative survival for seminoma was at least 98% in patients under 50. Nonseminoma survival remained lower, and older nonseminoma patients improved substantially but still lagged behind older seminoma patients. After adjustment, European patients had higher relative excess risk of death than US patients.

pmid-23114647.summary_ja: 症例報告である。48歳女性に発生した侵襲性の高い両側性の肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍を報告している。腫瘍は原始生殖細胞マーカーに陽性で、第3染色体多倍体を示した。肺の原発性胚細胞腫瘍で初めて報告された染色体異常とされている。著者らは、Oct3/4とSox2の相互作用が性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の発生に寄与している可能性を論じている。
pmid-23114647.summary_en: Case report of a 48-year-old woman with an aggressive bilateral primary yolk sac tumor of the lung. The tumor stained positive for primordial germ cell markers and showed chromosome 3 polysomy, described as the first chromosomal aberration in a primary lung germ cell tumor. The study frames the findings around the interaction between Oct3/4 and Sox2 as a possible contributor to the pathogenesis of extragonadal germ cell tumors.

pmid-23117007.summary_ja: 18歳女性の後腹膜に生じた大型の成熟奇形腫の症例報告。他院で包虫嚢胞と誤診されて手術を受け、切除不能として紹介された。下大静脈や右腎静脈を含む血管合併切除と再建により完全切除が可能であり、術後経過は順調だった。術前画像検査と手術計画の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23117007.summary_en: Case report of an 18-year-old woman with a large retroperitoneal benign cystic teratoma that had been misdiagnosed as a hydatid cyst at another hospital. CT angiography showed a 14 cm cystic mass invading the retrohepatic suprarenal inferior vena cava, the right renal vein, and the liver. The tumor was completely resected with vascular reconstruction using a Dacron graft and renal vein reimplantation, with an uneventful recovery. The authors emphasize the importance of preoperative imaging and planning.

pmid-23117572.summary_ja: 本研究は精巣腫瘍107例でナトリウム/ヨウ素シンポーター(NIS)発現を検討し、セミノーマの大部分と胎児性癌の多くでNISが陽性であることを示した。NIS陽性はリンパ管侵襲と関連した。ヒストン脱アセチル化酵素阻害薬はNTERA細胞でNIS発現と放射性ヨウ素取り込みを増強し、侵襲性の高い精巣腫瘍への標的治療の可能性が示唆された。
pmid-23117572.summary_en: This study examined sodium/iodide symporter (NIS) expression in 107 testicular tumors, mostly seminomas, and found it in 90 of 98 seminomas and 5 of 7 embryonal carcinomas, but not in Leydig cell tumors. NIS positivity correlated with lymphovascular invasion. In the embryonal carcinoma line NTERA, histone deacetylase inhibitors markedly increased NIS expression and radioiodine uptake, suggesting NIS-targeted radioiodine could be a therapeutic option for aggressive testicular tumors.

pmid-23129837.summary_ja: 26歳女性の右付属器腫瘤に対し部分卵巣摘出術が施行された。腫瘤は嚢胞成分と充実成分から成っていた。病理では卵巣奇形腫に由来する結合組織形成型髄芽腫と診断され、卵巣髄芽腫としては4例目の報告である。卵巣原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍の一亜型として位置づけられ、文献的な稀少性も検討されている。
pmid-23129837.summary_en: The authors report a 26-year-old woman with a right adnexal mass containing cystic and solid components, treated with partial oophorectomy. Pathology showed a desmoplastic medulloblastoma arising from an ovarian teratoma, the fourth such case of ovarian medulloblastoma reported. The tumor belongs to the primitive neuroectodermal tumor spectrum of the ovary. The paper also reviews the rarity and classification of ovarian primitive neuroectodermal tumors.

pmid-23136239.summary_ja: 病期II精巣腫瘍の治療後21か月目に血清hCGが徐々に上昇した22歳男性例。画像検査では精巣微小石灰化以外に病変は指摘されなかった。左精巣摘除術で微小な悪性胚細胞腫瘍と、hCG陽性の精細管内トロホブラストが確認された。術後hCGは正常化し、6か月後も再発はなかった。
pmid-23136239.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a previously treated stage II right testicular tumor had a gradual rise in serum hCG 21 months later, while imaging showed no lesion apart from testicular microlithiasis. Left testis biopsy showed intratubular germ cell neoplasia, and orchiectomy revealed a small malignant germ cell tumor plus hCG-positive intratubular trophoblasts. hCG normalized immediately after surgery and no recurrence was seen at 6 months, illustrating an isolated tumor marker elevation.

pmid-23137282.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株5種と胚性幹細胞株6種のエクソンレベル解析を比較し、28の差次的発現遺伝子を同定した。NR5A2の過剰発現は、WNTを介した多能性の破綻と悪性化の関連を示唆した。DNMT3Bなどで選択的スプライシングが確認され、原発性胎児性癌および正常精巣のデータと照合された。
pmid-23137282.summary_en: Exon-level transcriptomic profiles of five embryonal carcinoma cell lines, a germ cell tumor subtype, were compared with six human embryonic stem cell lines, using only purified undifferentiated cells. Of 28 differentially expressed genes, many had cancer and stemness roles, and NR5A2 overexpression in malignant cells suggested WNT-mediated pluripotency dysregulation. Alternative splicing in DNMT3B and other genes was validated, and the findings were checked against primary EC tumors and normal testis.

pmid-23148694.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の33歳未経妊女性が、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる化学療法中に全身性血栓塞栓症を発症した症例報告である。脳梗塞、両側肺動脈および骨盤静脈の多発塞栓、右上肢の広範な深部静脈血栓症を認めた。化学療法中に血栓症を認めた場合は、全身性か局所性かを検討する必要があると著者らは強調している。
pmid-23148694.summary_en: Case report of a 33-year-old nulligravida Japanese woman with ovarian germ cell tumor who developed systemic thromboembolism during cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin chemotherapy. She had brain infarction, bilateral pulmonary artery and pelvic vein emboli, and extensive deep vein thromboses in the right limb. Given the high cure rate of cisplatin-based regimens, the authors emphasize that thrombosis detected during chemotherapy should be evaluated for systemic versus local origin.

pmid-23150218.summary_ja: 北京協和医院で1990〜2012年に妊娠に合併した卵巣悪性腫瘍41例を後方視的に解析した。悪性胚細胞腫瘍10例と卵巣絨毛癌1例を含む。死亡率は24.4%で、新生児の多くは健康に生存した。外科的治療が主体で、根治的手術の遅延は予後不良と関連していた。
pmid-23150218.summary_en: Retrospective analysis of 41 ovarian malignancies complicating pregnancy at a single center (1990-2012). Included were epithelial cancers, borderline tumors, malignant germ cell tumors (10 cases), sex cord-stromal tumors, metastatic tumors, and one primary choriocarcinoma. Median overall survival was 30 months, with 24.4% mortality. Most neonates survived healthy. Surgery was the main treatment, and delayed radical surgery was associated with poor prognosis.

pmid-23159816.summary_ja: フランスの絨毛性疾患基準施設で2000〜2011年に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（PSTT）または類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍（ETT）と診断された22例を後方視的に解析した。患者の約3分の1は子宮外妊娠と誤診されていた。初回の病理診断の39%が誤りであり、専門家による病理再評価の重要性が強調されている。
pmid-23159816.summary_en: Retrospective review of 22 patients with placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) or epithelioid trophoblastic tumor (ETT) at the French reference center (2000-2011). Because these two gestational trophoblastic neoplasia subtypes share diagnostic, therapeutic, and prognostic features, they were analyzed together. Presentations were irregular bleeding or amenorrhea, and about a third were initially misdiagnosed as ectopic pregnancy. The initial histological diagnosis was wrong in 39% of evaluable patients, highlighting the need for expert pathology review.

pmid-23160138.summary_ja: 小児の仙尾部奇形腫5例を、Currarino症候群や総排泄腔奇形などの非典型的特徴とともに報告し、文献を併せてレビューした。1例は術後に卵黄嚢腫瘍成分を伴って再発し、AFP上昇が先行していた。補助化学療法と再切除で治癒した。著者らは完全切除、AFPの経過観察、長期の監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-23160138.summary_en: Five children with sacrococcygeal teratomas showing atypical features, including Currarino syndrome and cloacal anomalies in some patients, are reported and reviewed with the literature. Four were managed in the neonatal period, and two had prenatal diagnosis. One girl with Currarino syndrome died after surgery. One patient relapsed two years later with a yolk sac tumor component, anticipated by elevated AFP, and remained disease-free after adjuvant chemotherapy and re-excision. The authors emphasize complete excision, AFP monitoring, and long-term surveillance.

pmid-23164315.summary_ja: スペインの単一施設における20例の小児抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例シリーズで、患者の年齢中央値は13歳、70%が女性であった。ステロイド、免疫グロブリン、血漿交換などの治療により、多くの患者が十分に回復した。2例で卵巣奇形腫が確認され、そのうち1例は発症時に認められた。著者らは特徴的な脳波パターンを記述し、単純ヘルペス脳炎後の舞踏アテトーゼと抗NMDAR脳炎との新たな関連を指摘している。
pmid-23164315.summary_en: This single-center Spanish series reviews 20 pediatric patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, with a median age of 13 years and 70% female. Most recovered substantially after steroids, intravenous immunoglobulin or plasma exchange, with rituximab or cyclophosphamide in some. Ovarian teratoma was identified in two patients, one at onset. The authors describe a characteristic EEG pattern and a novel link between post-herpes simplex encephalitis choreoathetosis and anti-NMDAR encephalitis.

pmid-23165333.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍127例を用い、SF-1の免疫組織化学的発現を組織マイクロアレイで評価した研究である。セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍、奇形腫などでは核内発現が認められなかった。一方、対照の非胚細胞腫瘍組織23例はいずれも強陽性であった。SF-1は性索間質性病変に特異的であり、生検での鑑別に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-23165333.summary_en: This tissue microarray study examined SF-1 immunohistochemistry in 127 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminoma, embryonal carcinoma, yolk sac tumor, teratoma and choriocarcinoma. No nuclear SF-1 expression was seen in any germ cell tumor, whereas all 23 non-germ cell control tissues, including Sertoli and Leydig cells, were strongly positive. The authors conclude that SF-1 is specific for sex-cord stromal lesions and is useful for distinguishing them from germ cell tumors on biopsy.

pmid-23171623.summary_ja: 新生児の希少な気道病変2例を報告する研究である。上咽頭奇形腫と先天性喉頭嚢胞がそれぞれ外科的に治療された。診断の難しさや手術・麻酔上の課題を考察し、新生児喘鳴に関する文献も概説した。奇形腫などの希少病変を見逃さないことと、施設内での多職種による管理の重要性が結論づけられている。
pmid-23171623.summary_en: This report describes two rare neonatal airway lesions managed surgically: a nasopharyngeal teratoma and a congenital laryngeal saccular cyst. The authors discuss diagnostic difficulty and the surgical and anaesthetic challenges, and review the literature on neonatal stridor. They conclude that rare lesions such as teratomas must not be overlooked in neonatal airway distress, and that management should be multidisciplinary within an institutional setting.

pmid-23186076.summary_ja: 1981年から2010年に転移性精巣がんに対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を受けた96例を対象に、推算糸球体濾過量で腎機能を評価した研究である。化学療法の1年後に23%が慢性腎臓病を呈した。治療前の軽度腎障害と血圧高値がリスク因子であった。化学療法後少なくとも1年間は腎機能を慎重にモニタリングすることが重要と結論づけている。
pmid-23186076.summary_en: This retrospective study followed 96 patients treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy for metastatic testicular cancer between 1981 and 2010, assessing renal function using estimated GFR. One year after chemotherapy, 23% had chronic kidney disease. Mild renal damage and elevated blood pressure before treatment were independent risk factors, with odds ratios of 2.63 and 4.22. The authors advise close renal monitoring for at least one year after chemotherapy, particularly in patients with these risk factors.

pmid-23199791.summary_ja: 新たに樹立された絨毛癌細胞株iC3-1の遺伝子発現を、既存の絨毛癌・栄養膜細胞株および正常胎盤と比較した研究。IGF1R、CHFR、HAS2、CD44、S100Pなどに発現差が示された。絨毛癌組織でも一部タンパクの免疫反応性が確認された。絨毛癌の発生機序を研究するための有用なモデルになると結論づけている。
pmid-23199791.summary_en: The authors established a new choriocarcinoma cell line, iC3-1, and compared its gene expression profile with existing trophoblast and choriocarcinoma lines (BeWo, JEG3, HTR8/SVneo) and normal third-trimester placenta. Several genes, including IGF1R and CHFR, were upregulated relative to BeWo and JEG3, while HAS2, CD44, and S100P were elevated relative to parental HTR8/SVneo cells and normal placenta. Choriocarcinoma tissue also showed HAS2, CD44, and S100 immunoreactivity. The authors propose iC3-1 as a useful model for studying choriocarcinoma tumorigenesis.

pmid-23202784.summary_ja: 満期産胎盤内に発生した原発性胎盤内妊娠性絨毛癌の症例報告。高度に多形性の栄養膜細胞が胎盤に浸潤し、腫瘍内に絨毛が孤立して残存する像を示した。腫瘍と胎盤のSTR解析で10座位すべての遺伝子型が一致した。よって現妊娠の胎盤由来であり、胚細胞由来の非妊娠性絨毛癌ではないと結論づけている。
pmid-23202784.summary_en: A case of primary intraplacental gestational choriocarcinoma in a full-term placenta is described. Histology showed sheets of highly pleomorphic trophoblasts invading the placenta, with isolated chorionic villi remaining within the tumor. Short tandem repeat analysis of tumor and placental DNA showed a complete genotype match at all 10 loci examined. This indicates the tumor arose from the current pregnancy's placenta rather than being a nongestational choriocarcinoma of germ cell origin.

pmid-23224120.summary_ja: 縦隔・後腹膜・中枢神経系の性腺外胚細胞腫瘍19例と非胚細胞腫瘍20例でSALL4免疫染色を評価した研究。胚細胞腫瘍の18例(95%)でSALL4が強発現し、特異度は100%だった。他の胚細胞マーカーは21〜69%の陽性率にとどまった。
pmid-23224120.summary_en: The authors evaluated SALL4 immunostaining in 19 extragonadal germ cell tumors (six mediastinal, five retroperitoneal, eight CNS) and 20 non-GCT controls. SALL4 was strongly expressed in 18 of 19 GCTs (95%) with 100% specificity, outperforming other GCT markers, which were expressed in 21-69% of cases. The authors recommend SALL4 in the first antibody panel for midline tumors in patients under 40 and in the workup of undifferentiated tumors of any location.

pmid-23224440.summary_ja: 小児の卵巣奇形腫9例に対する卵巣温存手術の後方視的検討。平均追跡期間は29.5か月。病理診断は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が中心で、未熟奇形腫も1例含まれた。術後経過は良好で、術前に奇形腫と診断されれば卵巣温存手術は安全に施行できると結論づけている。
pmid-23224440.summary_en: Nine children (mean age 11.2 years) who underwent ovary-sparing surgery for teratoma were retrospectively reviewed, with mean follow-up of 29.5 months. Most masses were mature cystic teratomas, with one immature teratoma included. Ultrasonography, MRI, and tumor markers supported the diagnosis, and ovarian tissue was preserved in 12 ovaries using a dissection plane between tumor and normal ovary. Outcomes were uneventful, supporting ovary-sparing surgery when the preoperative diagnosis is teratoma.

pmid-23225212.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍28例を対象に、SNPアレイCGHと腫瘍抑制遺伝子・インプリンティング遺伝子のメチル化を解析した。減数分裂エラーや発生段階の異なる起源を示唆する所見を報告した。卵黄嚢腫瘍では遺伝的・エピジェネティックな変化が蓄積しており、悪性転化への関与が示唆された。
pmid-23225212.summary_en: This study examined 28 pediatric germ cell tumors using SNP array comparative genomic hybridization and methylation analysis of tumor suppressor genes and imprinted loci (H19, SNRPN). Some tumors showed segmental or whole uniparental disomy, suggesting origins from meiosis I errors, endoreduplication, or premeiotic primordial germ cells. Recurrent gains at 3p and 20q and losses at 1p36-p35 were common, with RUNX3 promoter methylation in 16 tumors. Two yolk sac tumors with extensive UPD showed 20q gain, 1p loss, and multiple methylated tumor suppressor genes, suggesting these alterations may have driven malignant transformation.

pmid-23238629.summary_ja: 精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍148例を後方視的に解析した研究である。血管侵襲と精巣網・門部軟部組織への浸潤が、診断時の進行臨床病期と独立して関連した。転移性疾患の予測因子として、門部浸潤を日常の病理報告に含めるべきだと結論づけている。
pmid-23238629.summary_en: This retrospective study of 148 consecutive nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis evaluated pathologic and clinical features against clinical stage at presentation. Vascular invasion, rete testis invasion, and hilar soft tissue invasion were significantly associated with advanced stage on univariate analysis. On multivariate analysis, vascular invasion and invasion into the rete testis and hilar soft tissues remained significant. The authors conclude that tumor invasion into the testicular hilum should be routinely reported by pathologists, alongside vascular invasion, as a predictor of metastatic disease at presentation.

pmid-23240671.summary_ja: 卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と性索間質性腫瘍の免疫組織化学的診断について、実践的なアプローチを総説したものである。SALL4、OCT4、AFP、glypican-3などの各腫瘍型マーカーを、感度・特異度を踏まえて解説する。卵巣カルチノイドの原発巣推定における免疫組織化学の限界にも触れている。
pmid-23240671.summary_en: This review presents a practical approach to using immunohistochemistry in diagnosing ovarian germ cell tumors and sex cord-stromal tumors. It covers markers for malignant germ cell differentiation (SALL4, PLAP), dysgerminoma (OCT4, CD117, D2-40), yolk sac tumor (AFP, glypican-3), embryonal carcinoma (OCT4, CD30, SOX2), sex cord-stromal differentiation (calretinin, inhibin, SF-1, FOXL2), and steroid cell tumors (melan-A). The authors emphasize understanding each marker's sensitivity and specificity for specific differential diagnoses. They also discuss the limited role of immunohistochemistry in determining the primary site of ovarian carcinoid tumors.

pmid-23249573.summary_ja: 精巣がんの術後CT監視を受ける患者について、マルコフモデルで生涯リスクと余命損失を比較した。病期Iのセミノーマを有する33歳男性では、生涯死亡リスクはがんの方がわずかに高かった。一方、余命損失はがんによる方が3倍以上大きかった。生涯リスク指標は短期的な健康リスクに比べ、放射線リスクを過大評価しうると結論づけている。
pmid-23249573.summary_en: This Markov model study projected outcomes for patients undergoing CT surveillance for testicular cancer in the decade after orchiectomy. It compared lifetime mortality risk and life expectancy loss from testicular cancer with those from radiation-induced cancers caused by CT. For 33-year-old men with stage I seminoma, lifetime mortality risk was slightly higher from testicular cancer, but life expectancy loss from testicular cancer was more than three times greater. The authors argue that lifetime risk estimates may overemphasize radiation-induced cancer risks relative to short-term health risks.

pmid-23251245.summary_ja: 本研究は、マイクロRNA(miRNA)-145が絨毛癌の病態に果たす役割を検討した。絨毛癌細胞株JARおよびJEG-3にmiR-145発現ウイルスを導入するとSox2の発現が低下し、in vitroで細胞増殖が抑制された。異種移植モデルでも腫瘍増殖が抑制された。内因性miR-145がSox2を介して絨毛癌の発症に関与し、治療標的となりうることが示唆された。
pmid-23251245.summary_en: This study examined the role of microRNA-145 in human choriocarcinoma. Transfecting JAR and JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells with a miR-145 expression virus reduced Sox2 mRNA and protein levels. miR-145 suppressed proliferation through cell cycle regulation in vitro, and xenograft experiments showed reduced tumor growth in vivo. The findings suggest that endogenous miR-145 may contribute to choriocarcinoma pathogenesis through epigenetic regulation of Sox2, indicating potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-23273044.summary_ja: 本報告は、出生時から眼窩腫瘤を認めた7歳女児の成熟眼窩奇形腫例である。右眼球は欠如しており、腫瘤内には異所性の歯を認めた。眼瞼温存眼窩内容除去術が施行された。病理組織学的検査で三胚葉由来の成分が確認された。1年間のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-23273044.summary_en: This case report describes a 7-year-old girl with an orbital mass present since birth, with absence of the right eyeball and an ectopic tooth within the tumor. Lid-sparing exenteration was performed. Histopathology showed elements of all three germ layers, consistent with mature orbital teratoma. No normal ocular structures were identified, and there was no recurrence at one year of follow-up.

pmid-23274560.summary_ja: 1996年から2011年に単施設で治療された胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)の17例を後方視的に解析した研究です。全生存期間の中央値は86か月で、FIGO病期IVは生存の悪化と有意に関連しました。前妊娠からの期間、hCG値、年齢は予後と関連せず、病期が最も重要な予後因子とされています。
pmid-23274560.summary_en: This single-center retrospective study of 17 patients with placental-site trophoblastic tumor (1996 to 2011) evaluated presentation, treatment, and prognostic factors. Median overall survival was 86 months. Higher FIGO stage, particularly stage IV, was the only factor significantly associated with worse survival (p=0.009), while antecedent pregnancy interval, outcome, hCG level, and age were not. The authors conclude that FIGO stage is the most important predictor of survival.

pmid-23274926.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍に対する5日間のシスプラチン併用化学療法を受ける初回治療患者50例を対象とした第II相単群試験です。5-HT3受容体拮抗薬とデキサメタゾンに7日間のアプレピタントを追加し、1サイクル目の1〜7日目に嘔吐がなかった割合は82%でした。以降の各サイクルでも効果は維持され、重篤な予期せぬ有害事象は報告されませんでした。
pmid-23274926.summary_en: This phase 2 single-arm trial enrolled 50 chemo-naive patients receiving 5-day cisplatin-based chemotherapy for germ cell tumors. A 7-day aprepitant schedule was added to a 5-HT3 antagonist and dexamethasone. The primary endpoint, no emesis on days 1 to 7 of cycle 1, was 82%. Efficacy was maintained across cycles with over 80% of patients free of emesis each day. No unexpected or serious adverse events were reported, and nausea was more common than vomiting.

pmid-23287532.summary_ja: TP53を有する胎児性癌細胞株PA-1をエトポシドで処理し、DNA損傷に対する応答を検討した研究です。TP53をノックダウンするとOCT4AやP21CIP1の上昇が抑えられ、有糸分裂異常や老化マーカーの増加が認められました。TP53が自己複製と老化の経路を連結し、ゲノムの安定性を保つ仕組みが示唆されています。
pmid-23287532.summary_en: This study examines PA-1 embryonal carcinoma cells, a TP53-competent line, after etoposide-induced DNA damage. OCT4A and P21CIP1 were upregulated after G2/M arrest, and cells with persistent damage senesced. TP53 knockdown blocked these increases, raised DNA damage, and caused mitotic abnormalities and senescence markers such as p16 and SA-β-galactosidase.
