pmid-24040591.summary_ja: 4歳男児が1年間の便秘と軽度の腹部膨満を訴えた。画像検査で肝尾状葉に多房性の嚢胞性病変があり、壁に限局性石灰化を伴っていた。開腹下に開窓術が行われ、病理組織学的に肝の成熟奇形腫と診断された。非特異的症状を呈する小児の肝奇形腫の稀な例である。
pmid-24040591.summary_en: A four-year-old boy presented with a year of constipation and mild abdominal distention. Imaging showed a multiloculated cystic lesion with focal wall calcification in the caudate lobe of the liver. Laparotomy with marsupialization was performed, and histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma of the liver. The report highlights hepatic teratoma as a rare pediatric entity that can present with nonspecific symptoms.

pmid-24040596.summary_ja: 小児の腸間膜奇形腫は極めてまれである。5歳女児が腹部腫瘤と発熱で受診し、手術で空腸間膜内に膿を含む多嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかった。病理組織学的に感染を伴う成熟奇形腫と診断された。発熱を伴う小児の腹部腫瘤では、感染の合併も念頭に置く必要がある。
pmid-24040596.summary_en: Mesenteric teratomas are extremely rare in children. A five-year-old girl presented with an abdominal mass and fever. Surgery revealed a multicystic mass within the jejunal mesentery containing pus. Histopathology confirmed an infected mature teratoma of the mesentery. The case shows that infection can complicate mesenteric teratomas and should be considered in febrile children with abdominal masses.

pmid-24040601.summary_ja: 小児の後縦隔奇形腫の報告は少ない。12歳の患者は、遠方の施設で18か月間膿胸として治療されていた。当施設のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で、脂肪・骨・歯を含む多房性嚢胞性腫瘤が見つかった。切除により感染を伴う後縦隔奇形腫と病理組織学的に確認された。持続する胸膜感染の小児では、奇形腫を示唆する画像所見を見逃さないことが重要である。
pmid-24040601.summary_en: Posterior mediastinal teratomas are rarely reported in children. A 12-year-old was treated for empyema for 18 months before presentation to the authors' centre. CT revealed a multiloculated cystic mass containing fat, bone, and teeth. Excision confirmed an infected posterior mediastinal teratoma on histopathology. The case highlights diagnostic delay when imaging features suggestive of teratoma are overlooked in a child with persistent pleural infection.

pmid-24046785.summary_ja: 縦隔奇形腫の気管支・肺への破裂はまれだが、肺癌や結核と紛らわしい。20歳女性が反復性喀血と咳嗽で受診した。CTで舌区へ進展する脂肪含有性の前縦隔病変が示されたが、細針吸引細胞診では確定診断に至らなかった。全摘出術により、気管支樹と肺へ破裂した良性奇形腫と確認された。
pmid-24046785.summary_en: Ruptured mediastinal teratomas are uncommon, and airway rupture can mimic lung cancer or tuberculosis. A 20-year-old woman presented with recurrent hemoptysis and cough. CT showed a fat-containing anterior mediastinal lesion extending into the lingula, while fine needle aspiration was nondiagnostic. Total excision confirmed a benign teratoma that had ruptured into the bronchial tree and lung, and imaging helps distinguish ruptured from unruptured lesions.

pmid-24049381.summary_ja: 2005年から2011年に、停留精巣由来の胚細胞腫瘍14例を対象とした。全例に初回のBEP療法(ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチン)3サイクルを施行した。11例が完全奏効、3例が部分奏効を示し、後者は残存腫瘍切除と後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を受けた。フォローアップ中の13例に再発はなかった。
pmid-24049381.summary_en: This study reviewed 14 patients with germ cell tumors arising in undescended testes treated at one institution between 2005 and 2011. All received primary BEP chemotherapy (bleomycin, etoposide, cisplatin) for three cycles. Eleven achieved complete response and three partial response, the latter undergoing residual tumor resection with retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Thirteen patients were followed without recurrence. Primary cisplatin-based chemotherapy appears a good option for bulky undescended testis tumors.

pmid-24050037.summary_ja: 過剰胎盤部反応は、中間型栄養膜細胞が子宮内膜と筋層に過剰に浸潤する、まれな良性の妊娠関連病変である。帝王切開後に子宮弛緩が持続し、薬物療法と外科的処置に抵抗する重篤な産後出血をきたした症例である。最終的に頸管上部子宮摘出術が必要となった。弛緩による出血が標準的治療に反応しない場合、本病変を考慮すべきである。
pmid-24050037.summary_en: Exaggerated placental site reaction is a rare, benign pregnancy-related lesion in which intermediate trophoblastic cells infiltrate the endometrium and myometrium. This case report describes a woman whose cesarean delivery was complicated by persistent uterine atony and severe postpartum hemorrhage refractory to medical and surgical measures. Supracervical hysterectomy was ultimately required. The authors advise considering this lesion when atony-related bleeding does not respond to standard management.

pmid-24050039.summary_ja: 成熟奇形腫は妊娠中の一般的な合併症である。19歳の初妊婦(妊娠14週、子宮底長37cm)の症例で、超音波検査により30×28×17cmの腫瘤が確認された。開腹術で奇形腫を切除した。著者らの知る限り、文献上最大の妊娠中の奇形腫である。子宮内発育の制限、破裂・捻転のリスク、強い疼痛、悪性が疑われる場合は切除すべきと勧めている。
pmid-24050039.summary_en: Mature teratoma is a common complication of pregnancy. This case report describes a 19-year-old primigravida at 14 weeks with a 37-cm fundal height. Ultrasonography revealed a 30 x 28 x 17 cm mass, which was excised by exploratory laparotomy. The authors believe this is the largest teratoma in pregnancy reported in the literature. They recommend excision of masses that limit intrauterine growth, risk rupture or torsion, cause severe pain, or appear suspicious for malignancy.

pmid-24051221.summary_ja: 正常初期胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるPAK-1、PAK-4、PAK-6およびエストロゲン受容体の発現を免疫組織化学的に検討した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)の奇胎ではPAK-6とPAK-4が正常胎盤より有意に上昇していた。エストロゲン受容体の核内発現は全標本で検出されなかった。PAK-6による抑制がその一因と考えられる。
pmid-24051221.summary_en: This study examined p21-activated kinases (PAK-1, PAK-4, PAK-6) and estrogen receptor expression in normal first-trimester placentas, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. PAK-6 and PAK-4 were upregulated in moles compared with normal placenta, while PAK-1 was reduced in partial moles. Nuclear estrogen receptor expression was undetectable in all samples. The authors suggest PAK-6 may repress nuclear estrogen receptor in trophoblastic tissue, contributing to gestational trophoblastic disease.

pmid-24056494.summary_ja: ドイツ4地域で実施された住民ベースの症例対照研究により、社会的地位と精巣がんリスクの関連を検討した。症例266例(セミノーマ167例、非セミノーマ99例)と対照797例を比較した。徒弟修業や大学卒業で軽度のリスク上昇、農業従事者で過剰リスクがみられた。社会経済的地位による明確な傾向は認められず、農業関連職業の所見は職業曝露の検討が必要とされた。
pmid-24056494.summary_en: A population-based case-control study in four German regions examined whether social position is associated with testicular germ cell tumour risk. It included 266 patients (167 seminoma, 99 non-seminoma) and 797 controls. Education, occupational sector, and socioeconomic status were assessed. Modest risk elevations were seen with apprenticeship or university education, and farmers showed excess risk. The ISEI-based socioeconomic measure showed no clear trend, and the authors conclude that occupational social factors were not a clear risk factor. The farm-occupation finding warrants further study of occupational exposures.

pmid-24056656.summary_ja: 37歳男性の縦隔肺腫瘤の症例報告である。CT下穿刺吸引生検では血管成分が優勢で血管腫と診断された。切除標本で稀な悪性上皮成分と多形細胞が確認され、CD30、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、β-hCGなどの免疫組織化学により縦隔混合型胚細胞腫瘍と確定した。一成分が優勢だと見逃されやすいため、十分な検体採取と丁寧な切片作製が重要であると述べている。
pmid-24056656.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with a 16.3 cm mediastinal pulmonary mass. Computed tomography-guided fine needle biopsy showed predominantly vascular elements and was diagnosed as hemangioma. After excision, rare foci of malignant epithelium and pleomorphic cells were found, and immunostaining for CD30, pan-cytokeratin, AFP, β-hCG and CD117 led to a diagnosis of mediastinal mixed germ cell tumor. The authors emphasize adequate sampling and thorough sectioning, since a dominant component can mask other tissue types.

pmid-24057924.summary_ja: 臀部血管腫を伴った腹腔内型(IV型)仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。仙尾部奇形腫は乳幼児で最も多い性腺外胚細胞腫瘍である。腹腔内に進展する例は稀で、臨床所見に乏しいことがある。仙骨や臀部の皮膚病変が唯一の手がかりとなりうるため、腰部・臀部の皮膚所見の観察が早期診断に重要であることを示している。
pmid-24057924.summary_en: This report describes an intra-abdominal type IV sacrococcygeal teratoma that presented with an anatomically separate buttock hemangioma. Sacrococcygeal teratoma is the most common extragonadal germ cell tumor in infants and young children. Intra-abdominal presentation is uncommon and may cause few clinical findings. Overlying cutaneous lesions over the sacrum or buttocks may be the only clue to the tumor. The case highlights the value of examining the lower back and buttock skin of neonates and infants to prompt timely evaluation.

pmid-24058257.summary_ja: 腹部膨満の精査中にCTで発見された3か月男児の、巨大で組織学的に非典型的な副腎成熟型嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。乳児の後腹膜原発奇形腫は極めて稀で、副腎奇形腫はさらに稀とされる。早期診断と外科的切除が治療に重要であり、本論文は治療の考察と文献の概説を含む。
pmid-24058257.summary_en: This case report describes a 3-month-old male infant with a giant, histologically unusual mature cystic teratoma of the adrenal gland. The mass was found by computed tomography during evaluation of abdominal distension. The authors note that primary retroperitoneal teratomas are very rare in infants and adrenal teratomas are extremely rare. Early diagnosis and surgical resection are essential for effective treatment. The paper includes a discussion of management and a review of the literature.

pmid-24059746.summary_ja: CCDC6の精巣胚細胞腫瘍発症への関与を検討した研究である。マウス精巣ではセルトリ細胞と精原細胞に発現していた。ヒト原発腫瘍およびセミノーマ細胞株TCam2ではCCDC6の消失が最も一貫した所見であった。CCDC6をサイレンシングするとGC1細胞は酸化ストレス誘発性のアポトーシスに抵抗し、活性酸素種の放出も低下した。CCDC6の喪失が精原細胞の生存を助け、腫瘍増殖に寄与すると結論づけている。
pmid-24059746.summary_en: This study investigates whether CCDC6, a pro-apoptotic ATM substrate, contributes to testicular germ cell tumour pathogenesis. CCDC6 was expressed in Sertoli and spermatogonial cells in mouse testis, and its loss was the most consistent feature in human primary tumours and the TCam2 seminoma cell line. Silencing CCDC6 in GC1 cells protected them from H2O2-induced apoptosis and reduced reactive oxygen species release. The authors conclude that CCDC6 loss may help spermatogonial cells evade oxidative damage and promote testicular neoplastic growth.

pmid-24068641.summary_ja: 若年患者の卵巣甲状腺腫を、124I-Naを用いたPET/CTで描出した症例報告です。本トレーサーは標的と背景の比に優れ、分解能が高いため、左卵巣の微小な腫瘍を明確に同定できました。通常は良性の経過をたどりますが、異所性甲状腺組織内に悪性腫瘍が生じることもあります。
pmid-24068641.summary_en: This case report describes a young patient with struma ovarii, a rare ovarian tumour made of ectopic thyroid tissue, imaged with iodine-124 sodium iodide PET/CT. The tracer gave an excellent target-to-background ratio and high resolution, allowing identification of a minimal tumour in the left ovary. The authors note that the imaging approach is, to their knowledge, the first of its kind for this condition. Although struma ovarii usually behaves benignly, malignancy can occasionally arise within the ectopic thyroid tissue.

pmid-24070501.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の切除を受けた382例を後方視的に解析した研究です。平均43か月の追跡で再発率は4.2%でした。30歳未満、8cm以上の大きな嚢胞、両側性の3因子は再発の予測因子であり、3因子すべてを有する患者の再発率は21.0%でした。
pmid-24070501.summary_en: This retrospective study of 382 patients who underwent surgical excision of ovarian mature cystic teratoma assessed recurrence and its predictors. Over a mean follow-up of 43 months, 16 recurrences occurred, a rate of 4.2%. Younger age under 30 years, cyst diameter of 8 cm or more, and bilateral cysts were independently associated with recurrence in Cox models. Patients with all three factors had a recurrence rate of 21.0%, compared with 3.4% for the rest. The findings help identify patients who may need closer surveillance after surgery.

pmid-24082479.summary_ja: 在胎35週で出生した新生児の巨大で高血管性の仙尾部奇形腫1型の症例報告です。腫瘍に血液を送る動脈を術前に塞栓し、出血量12mlで安全に外科的切除できました。巨大な仙尾部奇形腫の切除における出血リスクを減らす有用な方法であることが示されています。
pmid-24082479.summary_en: This case report describes a newborn born at 35 weeks gestation with a giant, highly vascular sacrococcygeal teratoma type 1. Resection of such tumours in neonates can cause fatal bleeding, so the arteries supplying the tumour were embolised beforehand. The procedure allowed a safe surgical resection with an estimated blood loss of only 12 ml. The authors conclude that preoperative embolisation can substantially reduce bleeding risk during resection of giant sacrococcygeal teratomas.

pmid-24082764.summary_ja: 子宮筋腫で子宮全摘と両側卵管卵巣摘出を受けた41歳女性が、4か月後に前腹壁の腫瘤で来院した症例報告です。腹直筋内の腹膜外腫瘤が病理組織学的に原発性絨毛癌と確認されました。CTで肺転移があり、併用化学療法によく反応しました。非妊娠女性の通常と異なる部位に生じた原発性絨毛癌は極めてまれです。
pmid-24082764.summary_en: This case report describes a 41-year-old woman who presented with an anterior abdominal wall mass four months after total hysterectomy and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy for fibroids. Laparotomy showed an extraperitoneal mass within the rectus muscle, and histopathology confirmed primary choriocarcinoma. CT revealed pulmonary metastases, and combination chemotherapy produced a good response. The case is notable because primary choriocarcinoma arising outside the usual sites in a non-pregnant woman is extremely rare.

pmid-24083728.summary_ja: 10年間に753例の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫のうち11例（1.46%）に悪性転化がみられた後方視的研究です。扁平上皮癌と粘液性癌が同程度にみられ、半数以上が病期Iaでした。平均無病生存期間は5.53年で、早期発見と最適な手術の重要性が示されています。
pmid-24083728.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed 11 cases of malignant transformation among 753 mature cystic teratomas over 10 years, an incidence of 1.46%. Squamous cell carcinoma and mucinous carcinoma were equally common histologies. Most patients presented with a palpable mass, and over half had stage Ia disease. Complete cytoreduction was achieved in 45.5%, and patients beyond stage Ia received chemotherapy. Mean disease-free survival was 5.53 years, supporting early detection and optimal surgery.

pmid-24094656.summary_ja: 1989年から2002年にかけて原発性後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた病期II精巣胚細胞腫瘍の183例を対象とした後方視的検討である。胎児性癌が最も多い組織型で、節外進展も高頻度に認められた。腫瘍マーカーが正常で経過観察された73例のうち19例が再発したが、再発と有意に関連する病理学的・臨床的因子は同定されなかった。
pmid-24094656.summary_en: This study reviewed 183 patients with pathologic stage II testicular germ cell tumors treated with primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection between 1989 and 2002. Embryonal carcinoma was the most common histology, and extranodal extension was frequent. Among 73 patients managed expectantly with normal tumor markers, 19 relapsed, but no pathologic or clinical variable was significantly associated with relapse. The authors call for larger studies to validate these findings.

pmid-24097319.summary_ja: 54歳の女性が複雑部分発作と辺縁系脳炎で受診し、卵巣奇形腫が認められた。脳脊髄液で抗NMDA受容体抗体が陽性であったため、卵巣奇形腫に伴う抗NMDAR脳炎と診断され、右卵巣摘出術が施行された。発症6か月後の脳生検で膠芽腫と診断された。著者らは、卵巣奇形腫を伴い脳脊髄液に自己抗体を有する膠芽腫の初例であると述べ、NMDAR抗体陽性患者は慎重に診断すべきであると指摘している。
pmid-24097319.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman presented with complex partial seizures and limbic encephalitis, and was found to have an ovarian teratoma. CSF tested positive for anti-NMDA receptor antibodies, leading to a diagnosis of anti-NMDAR encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma; ovariectomy was performed. Six months later, a brain biopsy revealed glioblastoma, a finding the authors describe as the first such case with ovarian teratoma and CSF autoantibodies. The report cautions that NMDAR antibody-positive patients require careful diagnosis.

pmid-24098438.summary_ja: 著者らは、原発性精巣セミノーマ由来の細胞株であるTCam-2セミノーマ細胞に卵白(EW)を添加すると表現型が変化するかを検討した。EWは、増殖および生存に影響を与えることなく、細胞の広がり、接着、アクチン構造、細胞間接合を変化させ、化学走性および集団的遊走の両方を低下させた。フラクタル形態計測では細胞形状の変化が示された。著者らは、胚性の手がかりがセミノーマ細胞の腫瘍-転移性挙動を部分的に是正しうるという仮説を提示している。
pmid-24098438.summary_en: The authors examined whether egg white (EW) supplementation alters the phenotype of TCam-2 seminoma cells, a cell line derived from a primary testicular seminoma. EW changed spreading, adhesion, actin organization and cell-cell junctions without affecting proliferation or survival, and reduced both chemotactic and collective migration. Fractal morphometry showed altered cell shape. The authors hypothesize that embryonic cues may partly reverse the neoplastic-metastatic behavior of seminoma cells.

pmid-24101656.summary_ja: 地域医療ネットワークで導入化学療法を受けた転移性精巣がん86例を後方視的に解析した。筑波大学病院への集約により各薬剤の相対用量強度は0.96を超えた。5年全生存率は良好、中間、不良予後群でそれぞれ97%、93%、84%であった。集約管理により高い用量強度と良好な転帰が得られたと結論している。
pmid-24101656.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 86 patients with metastatic testicular cancer treated with induction chemotherapy across a regional network, centralized at Tsukuba University Hospital. Relative dose intensity exceeded 0.96 for each drug, and most poor-prognosis patients were treated at the central hospital. The 5-year overall survival was 97%, 93%, and 84% for good-, intermediate-, and poor-prognosis groups. The authors conclude that centralized management enabled high dose intensity and excellent outcomes.

pmid-24116336.summary_ja: 3歳男児。胸部X線で左半胸の広範な均一陰影と石灰化を認め、当初は肺結核と誤診された。最終的に良性成熟奇形腫に閉塞後肺炎を合併したと診断された。縦隔偏位と石灰化を伴う胸部X線所見では、一般的な感染症だけでなく、まれな疾患も鑑別に挙げて慎重に評価する必要があることを強調している。
pmid-24116336.summary_en: A 3-year-old boy with a large homogeneous opacity and calcifications in the left hemithorax on chest X-ray was initially misdiagnosed with pulmonary tuberculosis. He was ultimately diagnosed with a benign mature mediastinal teratoma complicated by post-obstructive pneumonia. The report emphasizes careful evaluation of chest radiographs in children, particularly when mediastinal shift and calcifications are present, so that rare diagnoses are not overlooked in favor of common infections.

pmid-24124914.summary_ja: 17歳男性の非セミノーマ精巣がん転移例で、左頸部腫瘤を呈した。化学療法後の残存病変に対し、左選択的頸部郭清、胸腺摘出、縦隔リンパ節郭清などを施行した。18か月後の評価でも再発を認めなかった。精巣がんの頸部リンパ節転移に対する選択的頸部郭清の意義を文献的に検討し、化学療法後の残存腫瘤への適応を提案している。
pmid-24124914.summary_en: A 17-year-old man with metastatic nonseminomatous testicular carcinoma presented with a left neck mass. After chemotherapy, he underwent left selective neck dissection, thymectomy, sternotomy, thoracotomy and mediastinal lymph node dissection for residual disease. Computed tomography showed no recurrence 18 months later. The authors review cervical nodal metastases from testicular cancer and propose selective neck dissection for residual masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-24125998.summary_ja: 胚細胞腫瘍の治療歴があり、フォローアップ中に腫瘍マーカーの上昇を認めた症例。18F-FDG PET/CTのみが、再発部位を正しく同定できた非侵襲的検査であった。ガイドラインでは進行セミノーマの残存腫瘤評価における陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)の役割が示されているが、フォローアップでの役割は未確立である。形態学的検査を補完する有用性が示唆される。
pmid-24125998.summary_en: A patient treated for germ cell tumor had rising marker levels during follow-up. 18F-FDG PET/CT was the only noninvasive examination able to correctly identify the site of recurrence. Guidelines assign PET a role in evaluating residual masses after advanced seminoma treatment, but its role in follow-up has not been defined. The authors suggest PET/CT may complement morphological imaging in the management of germ cell tumor patients during follow-up.

pmid-24134929.summary_ja: ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の高値が持続し、卵巣腫瘤を呈した20歳女性。左卵管卵巣摘出術の結果、卵巣原発完全胞状奇胎と診断された。短鎖反復配列(STR)解析により単精子性完全奇胎と確定した。異所性妊娠と絨毛癌の鑑別における病理組織学的検討の重要性を指摘し、困難な症例での分子解析の有用性を強調している。
pmid-24134929.summary_en: A 20-year-old woman with persistently elevated hCG and an ovarian mass underwent left salpingo-oophorectomy. Histology showed a hemorrhagic corpus luteum with a focus of atypical trophoblast, and the final diagnosis was ovarian complete hydatidiform mole. Short tandem repeat analysis confirmed a monospermic complete mole. The authors emphasize distinguishing ectopic molar pregnancy from choriocarcinoma histologically and note that STR analysis is a useful adjunct in difficult cases.

pmid-24137347.summary_ja: 1か月前からの腹部腫瘤を主訴とした55歳女性。初回開腹術では大量出血を来し、腫瘍の一部のみを切除した。病理検査で成熟奇形腫と診断された。11か月後の再開腹で6kgの腫瘤を切除し、フォローアップでは安定していた。巨大後腹膜奇形腫の安全な切除計画のため、術前画像検査の重要性を強調している。
pmid-24137347.summary_en: A 55-year-old woman presented with a palpable abdominal mass. Her first laparotomy caused massive hemorrhage, and only a small portion of the tumor was resected; pathology showed a mature teratoma. Eleven months later, a 22 x 18 x 10 cm, 6 kg tumor was resected at a second laparotomy. She remained stable at follow-up. The authors stress the importance of preoperative imaging for planning safe excision of giant retroperitoneal teratomas.

pmid-24137385.summary_ja: 59歳の閉経後女性の子宮体部類内膜腺癌で、絨毛癌様成分を伴う症例を報告。免疫組織化学でβ-hCG陽性の合胞体巨細胞を認めた。既報9例を含めた解析では、10例中9例に転移があり、4例が死亡しており、本症は侵襲性が高いと考えられた。
pmid-24137385.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old postmenopausal woman with endometrioid adenocarcinoma of the uterine corpus containing a choriocarcinomatous component. Immunohistochemistry showed syncytial giant cells positive for β-hCG. The authors reviewed nine previously reported cases; most patients were postmenopausal, and nine of ten displayed metastases, with four deaths. The choriocarcinomatous component is thought to reflect aberrant differentiation of the carcinoma, which shares genetic alterations with the conventional component, although genetic analyses of this entity have not been performed.

pmid-24137411.summary_ja: 24歳女性が仙骨部痛と仙骨前部腫瘤で受診し、MRIでは仙骨前腫瘍と誤診された。術中の超音波検査と凍結切片により、右卵巣由来の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と判明し、仙骨経由で切除された。卵巣奇形腫が仙骨前病変に類似しうる点と、術中評価の有用性を示した症例報告。
pmid-24137411.summary_en: A 24-year-old woman presented with sacrococcygeal pain and a presacral abdominal mass, which was initially misdiagnosed as a presacral tumor on MRI. Intraoperative ultrasound and frozen section analysis identified a mature cystic teratoma arising from the right ovary and lying between the rectum and uterus. The mass was resected through the abdominal cavity via a transsacral approach. Histopathological examination confirmed a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary. The report highlights the diagnostic pitfall of an ovarian teratoma mimicking a presacral lesion and the value of intraoperative assessment.

pmid-24148527.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ精巣腫瘍とブレオマイシン肺障害の既往がある患者が、フォローアップ中に一過性の好酸球増多を伴う肝病変を認めた。肺障害の改善後に出現したことから、転移性再発と即断せず、画像の経時的評価と病理組織学的検査が必要と結論づけた。
pmid-24148527.summary_en: A patient with a history of non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor and bleomycin-induced pneumonitis developed liver lesions during follow-up, accompanied by transient eosinophilia. The liver lesions appeared after the pneumonitis had regressed. The authors suggest these represent eosinophilic liver disease possibly related to eosinophil migration from the regressing lung process, rather than metastatic relapse. They conclude that such transient eosinophilic liver lesions should not be presumed to be metastatic tumor recurrence and warrant further sequential imaging and histopathological examination.

pmid-24151399.summary_ja: S状結腸腺癌と多発肝転移をもつ68歳男性で、病理学的に絨毛癌成分が確認された。腹腔鏡下S状結腸切除後、薬剤感受性試験に基づきmFOLFOX6とベバシズマブを投与し、4か月間腫瘍進行を抑制した。大腸癌の標準化学療法が有効な可能性を示した。
pmid-24151399.summary_en: A 68-year-old man with sigmoid colon adenocarcinoma and multiple liver metastases was found on pathology to have a choriocarcinoma component. After laparoscopic sigmoidectomy, treatment with mFOLFOX6 and bevacizumab, selected by collagen gel droplet-embedded culture drug sensitivity testing, suppressed tumor growth for four months. The patient died nine months after diagnosis. The authors suggest that standard colorectal cancer chemotherapy may have suppressive effects against primary colorectal choriocarcinoma, and that drug sensitivity testing may help select appropriate agents.

pmid-24152517.summary_ja: 29歳女性の骨盤壁腫瘤で、超音波検査により右骨盤壁に充実性腫瘤を認めた。病理組織学的検査と免疫組織化学でhCG陽性などを示し、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断された。術後に6サイクルの多剤化学療法を施行し、18か月間再発はなかった。子宮外発生は稀である。
pmid-24152517.summary_en: A 29-year-old woman presented with amenorrhea and irregular vaginal bleeding; ultrasonography revealed a solid mass in the right pelvic wall. Histology showed large polygonal cells with brisk mitoses and vascular invasion. Immunohistochemistry was positive for hCG, human placental lactogen and other markers, with Ki-67 around 80%. The tumor was diagnosed as placental site trophoblastic tumor. After surgery, the patient received six cycles of multidrug chemotherapy and remained recurrence-free for 18 months. The authors note that extrauterine PSTT is rare, may have a good prognosis, and may be managed with resection and adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-24155767.summary_ja: 56歳女性の右乳房腫瘤を陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で評価し、FDG集積は低かった。乳房切除で浸潤性乳管癌と絨毛癌様の病巣を認めた。絨毛癌様細胞はhCG陽性で、HER2、エストロゲン受容体、プロゲステロン受容体は陰性だった。韓国での初報告とされる。
pmid-24155767.summary_en: A 56-year-old woman presented with a palpable right breast mass. FDG PET/CT showed a single focus of low uptake (SUVmax 1.98). Mastectomy revealed invasive ductal carcinoma with multiple foci of choriocarcinoma-like features. Immunohistochemistry showed that the choriocarcinoma-like cells were positive for hCG but negative for HER2, estrogen receptor and progesterone receptor. Nongestational choriocarcinoma differentiation is extremely rare in breast neoplasms. The authors report this as the first case of invasive carcinoma with choriocarcinomatous features and low FDG uptake in Korea.

pmid-24156175.summary_ja: 若年男性に生じた縦隔の絨毛癌の症例報告です。初発症状は失神で、上大静脈症候群を伴っていました。標準的な三剤化学療法により、初回サイクル後に腫瘍マーカーは正常化しました。18か月後も再発の所見はありません。若年男性の失神では縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍も鑑別に挙げるべきだと結論づけています。
pmid-24156175.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with mediastinal choriocarcinoma, a rare germ cell tumor, whose initial presentation was syncope caused by superior vena cava syndrome. He was treated with a standard chemotherapy triplet, and tumor markers normalized after the first cycle. At 18 months he remained free of relapse. The authors emphasize that mediastinal germ cell tumors should be considered in young males presenting with syncope.

pmid-24158884.summary_ja: ドイツのMAHO 98プロトコルで治療された10歳未満の男児の精巣胚細胞腫瘍の成績を報告します。鼠径部精巣摘除後の待機観察は、stage IAの卵黄嚢腫瘍の男児にも拡大されました。128例中、奇形腫の患者は全員無イベント生存でした。約80%は鼠径部からの精巣摘除術のみで治癒しています。適切なフォローアップがあれば待機観察は実行可能で安全と結論づけています。
pmid-24158884.summary_en: This study reports outcomes of boys under 10 years with testicular germ cell tumors treated under the German MAHO 98 protocol. The watch-and-wait strategy after inguinal orchiectomy was extended to young boys with stage IA yolk sac tumor, and some patients received non-recommended transscrotal surgery. Among 128 patients, all teratoma patients survived event-free, and all patients in the surgical subgroups survived. About 80% were cured by inguinal orchiectomy alone. The authors conclude watch-and-wait is feasible and safe with adequate follow-up.

pmid-24163567.summary_ja: 小児に生じた先天性の頬部奇形腫に顎関節強直を伴った症例を報告します。原発性の頬部奇形腫は極めて稀で、強直を伴った報告はこれまでありませんでした。強直した骨を切除し、極薄シリコーンシートによる介在関節形成術を行い、下顎の高さを保ちました。術後は再発予防のため、個別に作製した動的顎運動器を用いた積極的な理学療法を実施しています。手術時間の短縮や異物反応の少なさが利点とされています。
pmid-24163567.summary_en: This report describes a congenital cheek teratoma in a child that was accompanied by temporomandibular joint ankylosis. Because primary cheek teratomas are extremely rare and none previously had associated ankylosis, the case is notable. The surgeons removed the ankylotic bone and performed interpositional arthroplasty with an ultra-thin silicone sheet, preserving mandibular height. Aggressive postoperative physiotherapy with a custom dynamic jaw exerciser was used to prevent recurrence. The authors note advantages including short operative time and minimal foreign body reaction.

pmid-24163666.summary_ja: 転移性の妊娠性絨毛癌を有する39歳女性で、エトポシド投与中に急性の気管支攣縮、頻脈、低酸素、低血圧を生じた症例です。輸液、メチルプレドニゾロン、ジフェンヒドラミン、酸素投与により1時間以内に症状は消失しました。その後、エトポシドリン酸エステルは問題なく投与されました。エトポシドの過敏反応は稀ですが、妊娠性絨毛癌の化学療法中は留意すべきと示しています。
pmid-24163666.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma who developed acute bronchospasm, tachycardia, hypoxia, and hypotension during etoposide infusion. Symptoms resolved within an hour after intravenous fluids, methylprednisolone, diphenhydramine, and oxygen. Subsequently, the patient safely received etoposide phosphate without incident. The report highlights that hypersensitivity to etoposide, though infrequent, should be considered during chemotherapy for gestational choriocarcinoma and managed with premedication and careful monitoring.

pmid-24163669.summary_ja: 37歳女性に生じた再発性の高リスク妊娠性絨毛癌(FIGO病期IV、WHOスコア12)の症例報告です。膣出血で発症し、2年前の子宮摘出術の瘢痕部に再発しました。積極的な化学療法を行いましたが、全身状態は不良で、感染症と肝不全により死亡しました。高リスク絨毛癌の進行の速さと再発・転移傾向、そして予後不良を示す症例です。
pmid-24163669.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with relapsed high-risk gestational choriocarcinoma, FIGO stage IV and WHO score 12, who presented with vaginal bleeding. The relapse developed at the scar from a hysterectomy performed two years earlier. Despite aggressive chemotherapy, her general condition was poor, and she died from infection and liver insufficiency. The case illustrates the aggressive course of high-risk choriocarcinoma, its tendency toward relapse and metastasis, and the poor outcome when treatment is limited by patient condition.

pmid-24166348.summary_ja: 本報告は、卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した30代後半の女性について述べている。奇形腫の切除と25か月にわたる複数の免疫抑制治療にもかかわらず改善せず、最小意識状態が持続した。血清および脳脊髄液の抗体価は高値で持続し、特に脳脊髄液で顕著であった。著者らは、これを改善なしの積極的治療期間として報告された最長の症例とし、抗体価の持続的な高値が予後に関する意義を持つ可能性を示唆している。
pmid-24166348.summary_en: This report describes a woman in her late thirties with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. Despite teratoma resection and multiple immunosuppressive treatments over 25 months, she never improved and remained in a minimally conscious state. Serum and cerebrospinal fluid antibody titers persisted at high levels, especially in the cerebrospinal fluid. The authors describe this as the longest active treatment without improvement reported, suggesting that persistently high antibody titers may carry prognostic significance.

pmid-24179931.summary_ja: 46,XX核型で表現型も正常な14歳女児が、巨大腫瘍、男性化徴候、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)およびαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の高値を呈しました。組織学的に卵巣の性腺芽細胞腫とディスジャーミノーマ(未分化胚細胞腫)の併存が確認されました。性腺芽細胞腫へのディスジャーミノーマ併存は約50%と報告されています。表現型・染色体ともに正常な女性での発生は極めて稀で、腫瘍マーカーの上昇が診断を難しくすることが指摘されています。
pmid-24179931.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl with a normal 46,XX karyotype presented with a large tumor, virilization, and elevated hCG and alpha-fetoprotein. Histology revealed an ovarian gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma, a combination reported in about 50% of gonadoblastomas. The authors note that gonadoblastoma in phenotypically and chromosomally normal women is very rare, and that elevated tumor markers can make the diagnosis challenging.

pmid-24180158.summary_ja: ナイジェリア南東部エヌグの三次医療機関における、5年間の絨毛癌症例の後方視的解析です。非転移例5例、転移例10例が含まれ、平均年齢は33.6歳でした。流産が最も多い誘因、肺が最多の転移部位でした。来院時死亡が8例、化学療法中または後のフォローアップからの脱落が7例で、致死率・脱落率が高いことが示されています。流産後患者のフォローアップ強化と脱落患者の積極的な追跡が推奨されています。
pmid-24180158.summary_en: A five-year retrospective analysis of choriocarcinoma cases at a tertiary hospital in Enugu, Nigeria, including 5 non-metastatic and 10 metastatic patients with a mean age of 33.6 years. Abortion was the most common predisposing factor and the lung was the most common metastatic site. Eight patients died on admission and seven were lost to follow-up, indicating high case fatality and attrition. The authors recommend improved follow-up of post-abortal patients and active tracing of defaulters.

pmid-24187502.summary_ja: 28歳女性が異常子宮出血、腹部腫瘤、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)およびβ-hCGの高値で受診しました。大網生検で卵黄嚢腫瘍様分化を伴う類内膜腺癌が確認されました。子宮全摘術、両側卵管卵巣摘出術、大網切除、転移巣の切除を行い、術後に化学療法を施行しました。術後8か月でAFPとβ-hCGが再上昇しました。文献上の子宮内膜原発卵黄嚢腫瘍や栄養膜分化を伴う子宮内膜癌もあわせてレビューされています。
pmid-24187502.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with abnormal vaginal bleeding, an abdominal mass, and elevated alpha-fetoprotein and beta-hCG was found to have endometrioid adenocarcinoma with yolk sac tumor-like differentiation in an omental biopsy. She underwent hysterectomy, bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy, omentectomy and resection of metastatic disease, followed by postoperative chemotherapy. AFP and beta-hCG rose again eight months later. The authors also review endometrial primary yolk sac tumors and endometrial carcinomas with trophoblastic differentiation reported in the literature.

pmid-24187632.summary_ja: 40歳女性の右卵巣に発生した大型奇形腫の症例報告です。奇形腫内に異所性の歯が認められた稀な所見です。卵巣奇形腫は多くの女性に見られ、臨床的に進行した段階で発見されることがあり、治療の選択肢が制限される場合があると述べられています。新しい診断技術は病変の同定に有用であり、本症例の診断法と外科的治療法が検討されています。
pmid-24187632.summary_en: A 40-year-old woman with a large teratoma of the right ovary, in which ectopic teeth were found. The case report discusses the diagnostic and surgical management of this lesion. The authors note that ovarian teratomas occur in a considerable number of women and may present only at a late clinical stage, limiting treatment options. They emphasize that newer diagnostic techniques are valuable for identifying these lesions, and they highlight the rarity of ectopic teeth in ovarian teratoma.

pmid-24190004.summary_ja: 21歳男性が頭痛、低体温、傾眠で発症し、急性汎下垂体機能低下症を呈した。MRIで下垂体と視床下部の病変を認め、血清と脳脊髄液からMa2抗体が検出された。FDG-PETで上縦隔の腫瘍が見つかり、病理組織学的検査で縦隔セミノーマと診断された。プレドニゾロン投与で速やかに改善した。傍腫瘍性Ma2脳炎は急性汎下垂体機能低下症の稀な鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。
pmid-24190004.summary_en: A 21-year-old man developed acute panhypopituitarism, hypothermia and somnolence. MRI showed pituitary and hypothalamic lesions, and Ma2 antibodies were detected in serum and CSF. FDG-PET revealed a superior mediastinal tumor, which histology confirmed as seminoma. Prednisolone produced rapid improvement. The authors highlight paraneoplastic Ma2 encephalitis as a rare differential diagnosis of acute panhypopituitarism.

pmid-24192476.summary_ja: 若い女児に両側卵巣腫瘤が見つかり、保存的治療と積極的治療のどちらを選ぶかが問題となった。両側卵巣摘出術は有力な選択肢だが、不妊とホルモン補充が避けられない。病理組織学的検査で成熟奇形腫と判明し、腫瘍壁に増殖する毛細血管様および海綿状の大きな血管の集簇がみられた。このような血管の所見は稀で、血管性腫瘍との鑑別が必要である。
pmid-24192476.summary_en: A young girl presented with bilateral ovarian masses, raising the dilemma between conservative and aggressive management. Bilateral oophorectomy was considered a viable but fertility-compromising option. Histopathological examination revealed mature teratoma with proliferating capillary and cavernous-sized vessels in the tumor wall. The authors note that such vascular features are rare and must be distinguished from a vascular neoplasm.

pmid-24192771.summary_ja: 2000〜2009年にハンブルクで白金製剤併用化学療法を受けた胚細胞腫瘍患者193例を後方視的に解析した。静脈血栓塞栓イベントは11%に発生し、多くは化学療法開始前に起きた。セミノーマ、後腹膜リンパ節転移、LDH上昇、中心静脈カテーテルなどが危険因子とされた。化学療法中の発症には鎖骨上リンパ節転移と中心静脈カテーテル使用が関連した。
pmid-24192771.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 193 germ cell tumor patients treated with platinum-based chemotherapy in Hamburg from 2000 to 2009. Venous thromboembolic events occurred in 11%, mostly before chemotherapy. Risk factors included seminoma, retroperitoneal nodes, elevated LDH and central venous catheters. Supraclavicular node metastases and catheter use were linked to events during chemotherapy.

pmid-24195175.summary_ja: 33歳女性が感冒様症状の後に精神症状、痙攣、呼吸不全を呈した。MRI、脳波、脳脊髄液検査では異常がみられなかった。その後のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で卵巣腫瘍が判明し、免疫抑制療法と腫瘍切除が行われた。抗NMDAR抗体陽性により診断が確定した。抗NMDA受容体脳炎は多様な病態の鑑別診断として考慮すべきである。
pmid-24195175.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with a flu-like illness developed agitation, psychosis, seizures and respiratory failure. MRI, EEG and CSF analysis were unremarkable. Abdominal CT later revealed an ovarian tumor. Immunosuppressive therapy and tumor resection were performed, and a positive anti-NMDAR antibody confirmed the diagnosis. The authors emphasize considering anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis in the differential diagnosis to prevent neurologic complications or death.

pmid-24210442.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患の画像診断と治療方針決定における役割を総説している。診断には超音波検査が第一選択とされる。磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は局所浸潤の評価に用いられ、問題解決の手段となる。病期分類では胸部X線が初期検査として推奨され、陰性なら胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)を行う。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では化学療法抵抗性の症例で活性のある転移巣を同定し、切除可能性を判断する。
pmid-24210442.summary_en: This review covers imaging in gestational trophoblastic disease. Ultrasonography is the first-choice initial investigation. Pelvic MRI assesses local invasion as a problem-solving tool. Chest radiography is the recommended initial staging modality, with chest CT if negative. FDG-PET helps identify viable metastatic sites and determine resectability in chemoresistant disease.

pmid-24216554.summary_ja: 35歳男性がCTで偶然見つかった2cmの膵尾部嚢胞性病変である。超音波内視鏡(EUS)では蜂巣状の複雑な病変を認めた。細針穿刺吸引では壊死物質と組織球、良性上皮細胞が得られた。遠位膵切除と脾摘出後の病理組織学的検査で、重層扁平上皮に覆われ皮脂腺を伴う膵類皮嚢腫と診断された。本稿は、この稀な良性胚細胞腫瘍のEUSおよびFNA所見を示している。
pmid-24216554.summary_en: A 35-year-old man had an incidental 2 cm cystic pancreatic tail lesion on CT. EUS showed a complex honeycomb lesion, and FNA yielded necrotic material with histiocytes and benign epithelial cells. Distal pancreatectomy with splenectomy revealed a cyst lined by stratified squamous epithelium with sebaceous units, consistent with pancreatic dermoid cyst. The authors highlight EUS and FNA findings for this rare benign germ cell tumor.

pmid-24217652.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマと正常精巣におけるクラステリンの発現を比較した研究である。セミノーマ13例と前立腺がんで去勢術を受けた16例の組織を解析した。リアルタイムPCRでセミノーマのクラステリンmRNAは正常の13%と有意に低下していた。ウエスタンブロットと免疫組織化学でもタンパク質の減少が確認された。精巣がんにおけるクラステリンの初の包括的研究である。
pmid-24217652.summary_en: This study compared clusterin expression in testicular seminoma with normal testis. Tissues from 13 seminoma patients and 16 controls undergoing castration for prostate cancer were analyzed. Real-time PCR showed clusterin mRNA at only 13% of normal levels in seminoma. Western blot and immunohistochemistry confirmed reduced protein. The authors conclude clusterin is significantly downregulated in seminoma, a first comprehensive study in human testicular cancer.

pmid-24217901.summary_ja: 42歳女性の悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と頸部甲状腺の乳頭状甲状腺癌の併存例を報告した。組織学的、免疫組織化学的、分子学的解析で両腫瘍は不一致を示し、転移ではなく同時性の独立した原発腫瘍と考えられた。著者らは場の癌化による多発性の可能性を指摘し、悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例では甲状腺の画像検査を行い、悪性が疑われる場合は甲状腺全摘術を推奨している。
pmid-24217901.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with malignant struma ovarii, a monodermal teratoma in which thyroid tissue predominates, coexisting with multifocal papillary thyroid carcinoma in the cervical thyroid gland. Histology, immunohistochemistry (cytokeratin-19, galectin-3) and BRAF, RAS and RET-PTC molecular profiling showed discordant features between the two tumours, supporting two synchronous, independent primary malignancies rather than metastasis. The authors suggest field cancerization may explain the multifocality and recommend thyroid imaging and thyroidectomy in patients with malignant struma ovarii.

pmid-24219714.summary_ja: 2004年から2011年に当施設でEXITの適応となった胎児7例（頸部奇形腫、エピグナトゥス、CHAOS）を後方視的に検討した。2例は妊娠が中断され、5例が生児で出生し、気道確保は挿管または気管切開で行われた。母体合併症はなく、長期的な小児の予後は良好であった。著者らは、EXITは有効な気道確保法であり、症例選択には多職種による出生前評価が不可欠であると結論づけている。
pmid-24219714.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluates ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) in seven fetuses with cervical teratoma, epignathus or congenital high airway obstruction syndrome at a tertiary centre between 2004 and 2011. Two pregnancies were terminated and five infants were delivered alive at about 32 weeks, with the airway secured by intubation or tracheostomy and no maternal complications. Long-term paediatric outcome was favourable. The authors conclude that EXIT is an efficient airway technique and that multidisciplinary prenatal assessment is essential for case selection.

pmid-24222875.summary_ja: 22歳の分類不能型免疫不全症の女性が、大きな卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の切除後にシスプラチンとエトポシドの4サイクルを受け、完全寛解に至った。フォローアップ中に臍部腫瘤と腹水が出現した。腹水の細胞診は腫瘍陽性と判定され再発が疑われたが、腫瘍マーカーは陰性のままであった。腹腔鏡検査で成熟奇形腫と判明し、細胞診は偽陽性であった。著者らは、生存腫瘍と成熟奇形腫の鑑別には腫瘍生検または腹腔鏡下の観察が必要であると強調している。
pmid-24222875.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman with common variable immunodeficiency underwent resection of a large ovarian germ cell tumor, followed by four cycles of cisplatin and etoposide, achieving complete remission. During follow-up she developed an umbilical mass and ascites. Ascitic cytology was read as tumour-positive, raising suspicion of relapse, but tumour markers remained negative. Laparoscopy revealed a mature teratoma, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome, and the cytology was a false positive. The authors emphasise that tumour biopsy or laparoscopic inspection is needed to distinguish viable tumour from mature teratoma.

pmid-24228096.summary_ja: パキスタンのAga Khan大学病院で1992年から2013年に診断された精母細胞性セミノーマ16例を後方視的に検討した。年齢中央値は60歳、腫瘍径の平均は10.4cmであった。全例で浮腫がみられ、リンパ球浸潤は認めなかった。グリコーゲンとPLAPは陰性であった。CD117は検査した全例で陽性であり、古典型セミノーマとの鑑別には限定的な有用性しかない。PAS染色とPLAP免疫染色がこの鑑別により有用であった。
pmid-24228096.summary_en: This 21-year retrospective study from Aga Khan University Hospital in Pakistan reviewed 16 spermatocytic seminomas diagnosed between 1992 and 2013. Patients had a median age of 60 years and a mean tumour size of 10.4 cm. All cases showed oedema and no lymphocytic infiltrate, while cytoplasmic glycogen and PLAP were negative. CD117 was positive in all tested cases, so it has limited value in distinguishing spermatocytic from classic seminoma. PAS staining and PLAP immunostaining were more helpful for this distinction.

pmid-24228123.summary_ja: 馬蹄腎の37歳男性で、成熟奇形腫内に原発性カルチノイド腫瘍が生じ、淡明細胞型腎細胞癌を併存した症例を報告した。奇形腫には粘液性円柱上皮、偽重層円柱上皮、線毛上皮、成熟平滑筋が含まれ、PSAが陽性の前立腺腺房組織も認められた。類似例は過去に4例しか報告がない。腎の成熟奇形腫の組織学的多様性と、馬蹄腎に生じる原発腫瘍の範囲を広げる知見である。
pmid-24228123.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old man with a horseshoe kidney in whom a primary carcinoid tumour arose within a mature teratoma, concurrent with a clear cell renal cell carcinoma. Both tumours showed classic morphology. The teratoma contained mucinous columnar, pseudostratified and ciliated epithelium, mature smooth muscle, and foci of prostatic acinar tissue confirmed by PSA immunoreactivity. Only four similar cases had been reported previously. The authors expand the histologic spectrum of renal mature teratomas and the range of primary tumours arising in horseshoe kidneys.

pmid-24235832.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株(JEG-3)において、ヘパラナーゼのアンチセンスを搭載した磁性ナノ粒子が浸潤と増殖を抑制し、ヘパラナーゼの発現も低下させた。ヌードマウスの移植腫瘍でも増殖抑制が確認され、明らかな有害作用は認められなかった。本研究は細胞株と異種移植モデルに限られた前臨床研究である。
pmid-24235832.summary_en: This preclinical study tests Fe3O4-dextran-anti-βhCG nanoparticles carrying heparanase antisense oligodeoxynucleotide as a gene therapy for choriocarcinoma. In JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, the particles reduced invasion, proliferation, and heparanase mRNA and protein expression. In nude mice with transplanted tumors, they inhibited tumor growth without apparent harm. The authors conclude that the nanoparticles are an effective and harmless gene vector, although the evidence is limited to cell lines and xenograft models.

pmid-24251245.summary_ja: 26歳女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例で、腹腔鏡手術とBEP化学療法で治療した。低侵襲手術により妊孕性を温存しながら腫瘍を切除できた。文献的考察も併せて提示している。若年女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍では、妊孕性温存手術と標準化学療法の組み合わせが実施可能であることを示唆している。
pmid-24251245.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old woman with a yolk sac tumor of the ovary, treated with laparoscopic surgery followed by BEP chemotherapy. The minimally invasive approach allowed tumor removal while preserving fertility. The authors also provide a brief literature review. The report suggests that fertility-sparing laparoscopic surgery combined with standard chemotherapy can be feasible for young women with ovarian yolk sac tumor.

pmid-24262714.summary_ja: 25歳男性の精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(IIIB期、多発肺転移)の症例である。精巣摘除後の病理で絨毛癌、胎児性癌、成熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍が確認された。複数の化学療法後も腫瘍マーカーが高値のままだったため、妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍のレジメンであるMEA療法を救援化学療法として実施し、マーカーは正常化した。その後の肺部分切除後、14か月間再発はみられていない。
pmid-24262714.summary_en: This Japanese case report describes a 25-year-old man with stage IIIB testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumor and multiple lung metastases. Histology after orchiectomy showed choriocarcinoma, embryonal carcinoma, mature teratoma, and yolk sac tumor, with elevated hCG and AFP. Tumor markers stayed elevated despite several chemotherapy regimens until salvage MEA therapy, a gestational trophoblastic neoplasia regimen, normalized them. Partial lung resection followed, and no recurrence was observed over 14 months.

pmid-24267117.summary_ja: 停留精巣のセミノーマ手術歴がある患者が、左外腸骨動脈と S 状結腸の瘻孔による大量の下部消化管出血を呈した症例。外腸骨動脈結紮と左結腸切除により治療に成功した。動脈と消化管の瘻孔は稀だが致死的になりうるため、進行精巣がん患者では早期の認識と治療が重要であると示している。
pmid-24267117.summary_en: This case report describes a patient previously treated for seminoma of a cryptorchid testis who presented with massive lower gastrointestinal bleeding caused by a fistula between the left external iliac artery and the sigmoid colon. The fistula was treated surgically with external iliac artery ligation and left colectomy, and the patient recovered successfully. The report highlights that arterio-enteric fistulas, though rare, can be fatal and that prompt recognition and treatment are essential in patients with advanced testicular cancer.

pmid-24267667.summary_ja: 孤立性肺病変を呈した37歳女性で、極めてまれな原発性肺絨毛癌を報告。外科的切除後、2か月後からブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法を実施した。1年後のフォローアップで良好に生存し、β-hCGは正常化している。本腫瘍は手術と化学療法を行っても予後不良であることを強調している。
pmid-24267667.summary_en: A 37-year-old woman with an isolated lung lesion was found to have primary pulmonary choriocarcinoma, an extremely rare germ cell tumour. The tumour was surgically resected, and chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin began two months later. At one-year follow-up she was alive in good condition with normal hCG levels. The authors emphasise the very poor prognosis of this tumour despite surgery and chemotherapy.

pmid-24283184.summary_ja: 妊娠23週の女児胎児に見られた、直径10cmの未熟性悪性仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告。超音波検査と病理学的評価により特徴を明らかにした。発生頻度（出生35,000〜40,000例に1例、女児に多い）を整理し、出生前の超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法（MRI）による仙尾部および頸部奇形腫の診断の有用性を述べている。
pmid-24283184.summary_en: A case report of an immature malignant sacrococcygeal teratoma in a 23-week female fetus, a rare tumour arising from all three germ layers. The solid, partly cystic 10 cm mass weighing 308 g was characterised by ultrasound and pathology. The authors summarise its incidence of roughly one in 35,000 to 40,000 live births, with a female predominance, and note that prenatal ultrasound and MRI can diagnose sacrococcygeal and cervical teratomas. The paper also reviews teratomas as a field of research.

pmid-24283190.summary_ja: 左卵巣の嚢胞性病変を訴えた33歳の不妊女性の症例。経腟超音波検査と腹腔鏡検査で、同一卵巣内の類皮嚢腫と子宮内膜症が判明した。腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢胞摘出術を行い、病理組織学的に両診断が確定した。体外受精の準備として3か月間GnRHアナログ療法を受けた。
pmid-24283190.summary_en: A 33-year-old infertile woman presented with a cystic left adnexal mass, and transvaginal ultrasound and laparoscopy revealed a dermoid cyst and endometriosis in the same left ovary. Laparoscopic cystectomy was performed, and histopathology confirmed both diagnoses. She recovered without complications and received three months of GnRH analogue therapy before in vitro fertilization. The case shows that a mature teratoma and endometriosis can coexist in one ovary, which matters for ovarian mass differential diagnosis and fertility planning.

pmid-24286014.summary_ja: 松果体ジャーミノーマに対しステロイドと放射線療法を受けた37歳男性が、7年後に精巣セミノーマの症状で受診した症例。根治的精巣摘除術が施行された。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍と後の純粋型精巣セミノーマの関連の可能性を文献とともに考察している。他部位の胚細胞腫瘍について、フォローアップ中の注意が必要であることを示す。
pmid-24286014.summary_en: A 37-year-old man previously treated for a pineal germinoma with steroids and radiotherapy presented seven years later with symptoms of a testicular seminoma, which was managed by radical orchidectomy. The authors review possible causes of the link between an earlier intracranial germ cell tumour and a subsequent pure testicular seminoma, an extremely rare association. The case shows that patients with a history of germ cell tumour need ongoing vigilance for metachronous tumours at other sites, including the testis, during follow-up.

pmid-24288470.summary_ja: JEG-3絨毛癌細胞において、ERK1/2阻害がLIF誘導性STAT3シグナルに与える影響を検討した基礎研究である。ERK1/2を阻害するとSTAT3のリン酸化およびDNA結合能が増強され、浸潤能は高まる一方、増殖は低下した。ERK1/2とSTAT3の核内クロストークが絨毛癌細胞の性質を制御することを示し、浸潤の制御に向けた標的となりうる知見である。
pmid-24288470.summary_en: This study examines how ERK1/2 inhibition affects leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF)-induced STAT3 signaling in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells. Using Western blot, immunocytochemistry, ELISA-based DNA-binding assays, and MTS and Matrigel assays, the authors found that blocking ERK1/2 increased LIF-induced STAT3 phosphorylation and DNA-binding capacity. This was accompanied by enhanced invasiveness but reduced proliferation. The findings reveal an intranuclear crosstalk between ERK1/2 and STAT3 that differentially regulates choriocarcinoma cell behavior, suggesting potential signaling targets for controlling trophoblast-derived tumor invasion.

pmid-24289484.summary_ja: 両側卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する38歳女性で、右卵巣に非腸型の粘液性腺癌が発生した症例報告である。診断時に骨盤および後腹膜リンパ節への転移を認め、化学療法を3ライン施行したが、約15か月後に広範な進行で死亡した。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は予後不良であり、診断時の病期が最も重要な予後因子であることを示す。
pmid-24289484.summary_en: The authors describe a 38-year-old woman with mature cystic teratoma of both ovaries in whom a mucinous adenocarcinoma of non-intestinal type arose in the right ovary. The tumor metastasized to pelvic and retroperitoneal lymph nodes at diagnosis and was treated with three lines of chemotherapy. Despite this, she died about 15 months later with extensive progression. The report highlights that somatic malignant transformation of mature cystic teratoma carries a poor prognosis, with tumor stage at diagnosis being the most important prognostic factor.

pmid-24290033.summary_ja: 本免疫組織化学的研究は、精巣の上皮内癌および顕性セミノーマにおける免疫細胞浸潤を、腫瘍を伴わない不妊男性の生検検体と比較したものである。マクロファージ、CD8⁺およびCD45R0⁺ T リンパ球がすべての群で優勢であり、CD4⁺やFoxP3⁺ T 細胞はわずかであった。CISを含む精細管では、セルトリ細胞のHLAクラスI発現が高かった。腫瘍の有無にかかわらず構成は類似しており、精巣胚細胞がんにおいて能動的な免疫監視が欠如していることが示唆された。
pmid-24290033.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study compares immune cell infiltrates in testicular carcinoma in situ and overt seminoma with those in biopsies from infertile men without neoplasia. Macrophages and CD8+ and CD45R0+ T lymphocytes predominated across all groups, with few CD4+ or FoxP3+ T cells. HLA class I expression on Sertoli cells was higher in tubules containing CIS. The composition was comparable regardless of neoplasia, suggesting an absence of active immune surveillance in testicular germ cell cancer.

pmid-24294529.summary_ja: 50歳患者の胃底部腫瘍で血清AFPが高値を示し、卵黄嚢腫瘍成分の存在が疑われた症例である。切除された胃腺癌には卵黄嚢腫瘍への分化が認められ、肝転移巣にもその成分が含まれていた。卵黄嚢腫瘍分化を伴う胃癌は稀で予後不良であり、胃腫瘍での高AFP血症は本組織型を念頭に置くべきことを示す。
pmid-24294529.summary_en: The authors report a 50-year-old patient with a gastric fundal tumor, in whom high serum alpha-fetoprotein levels suggested a yolk sac tumor component. The resected gastric adenocarcinoma showed yolk sac tumor differentiation, and liver metastases contained the yolk sac tumor component. The case illustrates that gastric carcinoma with yolk sac differentiation is rare and carries a poor prognosis, and that elevated AFP in a gastric tumor should prompt consideration of this histology.

pmid-24303501.summary_ja: 頸部腫瘤を主訴とした25歳女性の症例で、組織学的に良性成熟奇形腫と診断された。頸部奇形腫は成人では稀であり、多くは出生前または乳児期に気道圧迫などで発見される。外科的切除後9年以上無病で経過しており、完全切除による長期的な治癒が期待できることを示す。
pmid-24303501.summary_en: A 25-year-old woman presented with a cervical mass, and histology revealed a benign mature teratoma. Teratomas of the neck are rare in adults, as most present prenatally or in infancy with airway compromise. The tumor extended from the neck toward the thoracic cavity. After surgical removal, the patient has remained disease-free for more than nine years, illustrating that complete resection of cervical teratomas can provide durable cure.

pmid-24311897.summary_ja: 本報告は、臨床病期Ibの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の患者に対して施行した、ロボット支援腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清の手術手技と経験を紹介するものである。臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、サーベイランス、化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が選択肢となり、開腹手術が依然として標準とされている。著者らは、ロボット支援手術が低侵襲な選択肢として実施可能であることを示唆している。
pmid-24311897.summary_en: This report describes robot-assisted laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (RPLND) performed in a patient with clinical stage Ib non-seminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis. Clinical stage I non-seminomatous tumors can be managed with surveillance, chemotherapy, or RPLND, and open RPLND remains the gold standard. The authors share their surgical technique and experience, suggesting that the robotic approach is a feasible minimally invasive option for this procedure.

pmid-24313181.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の女性2例を紹介するものである。1例は神経症状の悪化を初発として、もう1例は不正性器出血に続いて神経症状を呈した。両例とも手術、化学療法、放射線療法を併用した集学的治療により良好なQOLを保って生存している。若年女性の脳転移では婦人科悪性腫瘍を考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-24313181.summary_en: This case report describes two women with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the brain. One presented with neurological deterioration as the first sign of metastasis, and the other with metrorrhagia followed by neurological symptoms. Both were treated with a combined approach of surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation therapy and survived with good quality of life. The authors conclude that gynecological malignancy should be considered in young women presenting with brain metastases.

pmid-24320591.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、1970年から2013年に診断された原発性精巣がん1,438例を単一施設で解析したものである。両側性精巣がんは68例で、そのうち63例は異時性であった。異時性例は単側性例より有意に若年で診断され、セミノーマ患者では同一組織型の二次性悪性腫瘍が多くみられた。対側腫瘍の管理は個別化し、長期フォローアップと生涯のテストステロン補充療法が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-24320591.summary_en: This retrospective single-center study reviewed 1,438 patients with primary testicular cancer diagnosed from 1970 to 2013, including 68 with bilateral disease, of whom 63 were metachronous. Metachronous bilateral patients were diagnosed at a significantly younger age than unilateral patients, and seminoma patients often developed a second tumor of the same histology. The authors argue that management should be individualized and that long-term follow-up and lifelong testosterone replacement are needed.

pmid-24321309.summary_ja: 本報告は、初回精巣腫瘍の21〜36年後に対側精巣に胚細胞腫瘍を発症した男性3例と、既報例のレビューを紹介するものである。各症例の周囲組織には精巣上皮内腫瘍が認められた。既報の20年以上の間隔をおいた両側例は22例で、最長は40年であった。二次性胚細胞腫瘍のリスクは生涯続くと結論づけ、対側精巣生検によるリスク同定の可能性を示唆している。
pmid-24321309.summary_en: This report describes three men with contralateral testicular germ cell tumors arising 21 to 36 years after their first tumor, along with a review of similar cases. Testicular intraepithelial neoplasia was found in the surrounding tissue of each. The authors note that 22 previously reported bilateral cases had intervals of 20 years or more, with the longest being 40 years. They conclude that the risk of a second germ cell tumor persists lifelong and that contralateral testicular biopsy might identify at-risk patients.

pmid-24324907.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、成熟した純粋な精巣奇形腫の内部に発生した砂粒腫性髄膜腫を紹介するものである。髄膜腫成分は上皮膜抗原、S100蛋白、ビメンチンに陽性であった。診断は免疫組織化学によって裏付けられた。精巣奇形腫に生じる良性腫瘍はきわめてまれであり、本組み合わせの報告は見当たらないとしている。
pmid-24324907.summary_en: This case report describes a psammomatous variant of meningioma arising within a pure, mature testicular teratoma. Immunohistochemistry showed the meningiomatous component to be positive for epithelial membrane antigen, S100 protein, and vimentin. The authors note that benign neoplasms arising in testicular teratomas are extremely rare and that they found no prior report of this combination, describing it as a unique phenomenon.

pmid-24327990.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、妊娠中の女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から扁平上皮癌が生じた症例を紹介するものである。補助化学療法は行わず保存的に治療された。術後60か月以上にわたり従来の検査と陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)を用いて無病の経過が確認されている。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は約1〜3%とされ、文献的考察も加えている。
pmid-24327990.summary_en: This case report describes squamous cell carcinoma arising from an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a pregnant woman. The tumor was managed conservatively without adjuvant chemotherapy. The patient remained disease-free for more than 60 months after surgery, monitored with conventional tools and PET-CT. The authors review the literature on this rare complication, noting that malignant transformation occurs in about 1% to 3% of mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-24328003.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に発生した原発性悪性黒色腫の症例を紹介するものである。嚢胞性奇形腫の悪性転化は約0.2〜1.8%とされ、卵巣原発の黒色腫はきわめてまれである。皮膚黒色腫と同様に真皮表皮接合部から発生することが多い。確立された補助療法は存在せず、治療方針は定まっていないと述べている。本論文は既報に加えて1例を提示するものである。
pmid-24328003.summary_en: This case report describes primary malignant melanoma arising within a cystic teratoma of the ovary. The authors note that malignant transformation of cystic teratomas is rare, occurring in about 0.2% to 1.8% of cases, and that ovarian primary melanoma is extremely uncommon. Such melanomas most often originate at the dermoepidermal junction, similar to cutaneous melanoma. No standard adjuvant regimen exists for primary ovarian melanoma, so management remains undefined.

pmid-24348387.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化（TM）を有し、性腺外胚細胞腫瘍が判明した男性2例を報告している。33歳では腰部ヘルニアの疑いでMRIを施行した際に後腹膜の未熟奇形腫が見つかり、39歳では腹痛と黄疸で受診し卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。偶発的にTMが見つかった患者に対し、精巣と後腹膜の年1回の超音波サーベイランスを推奨している。
pmid-24348387.summary_en: This report presents two men with testicular microlithiasis (TM) who were found to have extragonadal germ cell tumors. A 33-year-old had a retroperitoneal immature teratoma discovered during MRI for suspected hernia, and a 39-year-old had a yolk sac tumor presenting with abdominal pain and jaundice. Testicular ultrasound showed bilateral TM without focal lesions. The authors recommend annual ultrasound surveillance of the testis and retroperitoneum in patients with incidentally detected TM.

pmid-24348391.summary_ja: 左卵巣の混合型胚細胞腫瘍と腹水細胞診陽性で初診した患者の、卵巣growing teratoma syndromeの症例を報告している。手術と化学療法後、成熟奇形腫が骨盤腹膜播種、傍大動脈リンパ節腫瘤、肺腫瘤として再発した。播種、リンパ行性、血行性の3つの転移パターンを示し、長期フォローアップと全身検索の重要性を強調している。
pmid-24348391.summary_en: This case report describes growing teratoma syndrome (GTS) of the ovary in a patient first treated for a mixed germ cell tumor of the left ovary with ascites cytology positive. After surgery and chemotherapy, mature teratoma recurred as pelvic peritoneal dissemination, a para-aortic lymph node mass and a lung mass. The authors show three metastatic patterns (dissemination, lymphogenous and hematogenous) and emphasize long-term follow-up and whole-body search in suspected GTS.

pmid-24353600.summary_ja: 右卵巣腫瘍と大量の腹水を伴い全身状態が不良な33歳女性の症例を報告している。まず超音波ガイド下の低体温腹腔内灌流化学療法（HIPC）を行い、腹水が制御された後に減量手術（CRS）を施行した。子宮摘出標本で妊娠性絨毛癌と診断され、患者は現在も良好な状態で生存している。
pmid-24353600.summary_en: This case report describes a 33-year-old woman with a right ovarian tumor, massive ascites and poor general condition. She first received ultrasound-guided hypothermic intraperitoneal perfusion chemotherapy (HIPC), followed by cytoreductive surgery (CRS) once ascites was controlled. Hysterectomy pathology showed gestational choriocarcinoma (GC). She remained alive and in good health. The authors suggest HIPC first, then CRS, as a reasonable option for GC with massive ascites in patients with poor health.

pmid-24362870.summary_ja: 病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し精巣摘除術と後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた2例が、5年後と21年後に前立腺転移を発症した。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の前立腺転移の報告はこれまでになく、文献的検討を行っている。前立腺転移は極めて稀であり日常的なスクリーニングは推奨されないが、精巣がん既往者の下部尿路症状は速やかな評価が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-24362870.summary_en: This report describes two men who developed prostatic metastases from testicular nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, 5 and 21 years after initial orchiectomy and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for stage I disease. Prostatic metastasis from nonseminomatous germ cell tumor had not been reported before, whereas a few seminoma cases had been. The authors review the literature and conclude that prostatic metastasis is highly unusual. Lower urinary tract symptoms in patients previously treated for testicular cancer warrant prompt evaluation, but routine screening for prostatic involvement is not recommended given its rarity.

pmid-24363873.summary_ja: 29歳男性に生じた肉腫成分を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマの症例で、文献上12例目の報告である。肉腫への分化は転移や予後不良と関連する。根治的鼠径精巣摘除術を施行し、文献レビューの結果から、限局例では補助化学療法を強く考慮すべきと結論している。
pmid-24363873.summary_en: This report describes a 29-year-old man with spermatocytic seminoma containing a sarcomatous component, the 12th such case in the literature. Sarcomatous differentiation is associated with a higher likelihood of metastatic disease and poor prognosis. The tumor presented as a slow-growing testicular mass and was treated with radical inguinal orchidectomy. After a concise literature review, the authors conclude that localized spermatocytic seminoma with sarcoma should be treated by radical orchidectomy, with strong consideration of adjuvant chemotherapy.

pmid-24365007.summary_ja: 病期IIIの卵巣胚細胞腫瘍に対してブレオマイシンを投与された21歳女性に、体幹と四肢のかゆみを伴う鞭状紅斑が出現した症例である。化学療法に伴う皮膚毒性として、その病態機序が考察されている。胚細胞腫瘍の治療で用いられるブレオマイシンの重要な副作用として、臨床医が認識すべき報告である。
pmid-24365007.summary_en: This dermatology report describes a 21-year-old woman who developed a pruritic eruption on the trunk and extremities after receiving bleomycin for stage III ovarian germ cell tumor. Examination was consistent with bleomycin-induced flagellate erythema. The authors discuss the pathophysiologic mechanism underlying this cutaneous toxicity. The case highlights an important adverse effect of bleomycin, a key agent in germ cell tumor chemotherapy, which clinicians treating these patients should recognize.

pmid-24371678.summary_ja: 妊娠中に卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた中枢性原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍(cPNET)の症例報告と文献レビューである。早期の卵巣PNETでは妊孕性温存手術を考慮しうると述べられている。本腫瘍は中枢神経原発ではなく、卵巣由来である。
pmid-24371678.summary_en: This case report describes central primitive neuroectodermal tumor (cPNET) arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary in a pregnant woman. The authors also review the medical literature on this rare entity. They note that fertility-sparing surgery can be considered for early-stage ovarian PNET, which is relevant when counseling young patients who wish to preserve reproductive potential. The tumor is ovarian in origin and is not a primary central nervous system germ cell tumor.

pmid-24371685.summary_ja: 完全型アンドロゲン不応症(CAIS)と診断されてから約20年後に大型のセミノーマが発生した症例報告である。患者はde novoのアンドロゲン受容体変異を有していた。CAISでは温存された性腺に胚細胞腫瘍が生じうるため、遺伝カウンセリングを含む適切な管理の必要性が強調されている。
pmid-24371685.summary_en: This case report describes a large seminoma that developed about 20 years after the diagnosis of complete androgen insensitivity syndrome (CAIS) in a patient with a de novo androgen receptor mutation. The authors note that patients with CAIS may develop germ cell tumors in retained gonads. They emphasize that proper management of CAIS, including appropriate genetic counseling, is necessary.

pmid-24371690.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫から発生した血管肉腫の症例報告である。治療の基本は手術で、補助化学療法としてはパクリタキセルの研究が最も多い。抗血管新生療法も選択肢として考慮しうるとされる。卵巣血管肉腫は侵襲性が高く、個別化された集学的治療が必要であると強調されている。
pmid-24371690.summary_en: This case report describes angiosarcoma arising from an ovarian mature teratoma, a rare malignancy with complex treatment considerations. The authors note that surgery is the basis of treatment and that paclitaxel is the most studied adjuvant chemotherapy for this entity. Anti-angiogenic therapies may also be considered as options. The report emphasizes the aggressive clinical course of ovarian angiosarcoma and the need for individualized multimodal management.

pmid-24371699.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から生じた原発性卵巣神経芽腫の2症例の報告である。極めて稀で予後不良とされる。2例に同一の併用療法を行い、有効性が示された。ただし、症例数が2例に限られる点には留意が必要である。
pmid-24371699.summary_en: This report describes two cases of primary ovarian neuroblastoma arising from mature cystic teratomas. Primary ovarian neuroblastomas are extremely rare and carry poor prognoses. The authors present the outcomes of the same combination therapy given to both patients and conclude that it was effective for this tumor, although the evidence is limited to two cases.

pmid-24375037.summary_ja: 高カルシウム血症型小細胞癌(SCCHT)に適合する卵巣腫瘍2例を検討した予備的研究。両例に未熟奇形腫の病巣がみられ、1例では卵黄嚢腫瘍成分も認められた。非定型奇形腫様ラブドイド腫瘍(AT/RT)との類似からSMARCA4とINI-1を評価し、SMARCA4の発現消失と遺伝子変異を確認した。SCCHTは未熟奇形腫由来の胚性腫瘍で、悪性ラブドイド腫瘍と関連する可能性が提唱されている。
pmid-24375037.summary_en: This pilot study examined two ovarian tumors histologically compatible with small cell carcinoma of hypercalcemic type (SCCHT). Foci of immature teratoma were identified in both, and yolk sac tumor components were found in one case, including omental metastasis. Given morphological resemblance to atypical teratoid/rhabdoid tumor, the authors assessed INI-1 and SMARCA4 expression; SMARCA4 was lost while INI-1 was retained. Sequencing identified SMARCA4 mutations in both tumors. The authors propose that SCCHT may be an embryonal tumor arising from immature teratoma and related to malignant rhabdoid tumor.

pmid-24377208.summary_ja: 3週間の腹痛とその後の腹部膨満を訴えた16歳女性の症例報告。超音波検査で卵巣腫瘍が疑われ、緊急開腹術で卵巣茎捻転と被膜が保たれた切迫壊疽を認めた。病理組織学的に、焦点状壊死を伴う悪性胚細胞腫瘍(ディスジャーミノーマ)と診断された。左卵巣摘出術による温存手術を受けたが、その後フォローアップから脱落した。
pmid-24377208.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old girl with three weeks of abdominal pain followed by abdominal swelling. Ultrasound suggested an ovarian tumor, and urgent laparotomy revealed pedicle torsion with an intact capsule and imminent gangrene. Histology showed a malignant germ cell neoplasm (dysgerminoma) with focal necrosis and no infiltration of the omentum. She underwent conservative surgery (left oophorectomy) but did not return for follow-up. The authors note that dysgerminomas present classically in this way.

pmid-24377621.summary_ja: 2008〜2013年に治療された若年トルコ人精巣胚細胞腫瘍96例の後方視的研究。平均年齢26.4歳で、セミノーマ17.7%、混合型非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍43.8%。83.3%が化学療法を受け、25%が後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた。5年全生存率は90.2%、2年全生存率は病期I 100%、病期II 94%、病期III 70.2%で、病期間に有意差があった。
pmid-24377621.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 96 young Turkish patients with testicular germ cell tumors treated at a military hospital between 2008 and 2013. Mean age was 26.4 years; 17.7% had seminoma and 43.8% had mixed non-seminomatous germ cell tumors. Most patients (83.3%) received chemotherapy, and 25% underwent RPLND. The 5-year overall survival was 90.2%, with 2-year survival of 100% in Stage I, 94% in Stage II and 70.2% in Stage III, a statistically significant difference. The authors conclude that appropriate treatment yields good outcomes, with a favorable prognosis even in advanced disease.

pmid-24382543.summary_ja: 11歳男児の回盲部に生じた類皮嚢腫の症例報告。腹腔鏡補助下切除術で治療した。回盲部は類皮嚢腫の発生がきわめてまれな部位であり、小児の回盲部嚢胞性腫瘤の鑑別診断に類皮嚢腫を含めるべきと結論づけている。小児における当該部位の初例とされる。
pmid-24382543.summary_en: This case report describes an 11-year-old boy with a dermoid cyst in the ileocecal region, which the authors describe as the first childhood case at this site. The lesion was treated with laparoscopy-assisted excision. The authors note that this rare location is not usually considered in the differential diagnosis of cystic masses of the ileocecal region in children, and recommend including dermoid cyst in that differential.

pmid-24386123.summary_ja: 本研究は、成人ヒト精巣および胚細胞がんにおけるTET1-3の発現と5-メチルシトシン酸化産物を検討した。精子形成が進むにつれて酸化シトシンの量は減少し、上皮内癌および大部分のセミノーマは非セミノーマと比べて低メチル化であった。遺伝子発現データのメタ解析では、胚細胞がんにおいてTET1とTDGの発現が高いことが示された。異種移植モデルでは、セミノーマ様のTCam-2細胞が胎児性癌様の状態へ移行し、DNMT3BおよびDNMT3Lの発現が上昇した。細胞株ではIDH1/2変異は検出されなかった。
pmid-24386123.summary_en: This study examined TET1-3 expression and 5-methylcytosine oxidation products in adult human testis and in germ cell cancers. Oxidized cytosine levels decreased during spermatogenesis, while carcinoma in situ and most seminomas were hypomethylated compared with non-seminomas. Meta-analysis of gene expression data indicated high TET1 and TDG expression in germ cell cancers. In a xenograft model, seminoma-like TCam-2 cells transitioned to an embryonal carcinoma-like state with upregulated DNMT3B and DNMT3L. IDH1/2 mutations were not detected in cell lines.

pmid-24391856.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍(TGCT)と神経膠腫におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)-199aの制御機構と作用を検討した。TGCTではmiR-199a-1と-2の両プロモーターの高メチル化により発現が低下していた。REST蛋白はメチル化プロモーターに優先的に結合した。TGCTでmiR-199a-5pの標的としてMAFBを同定し、腫瘍抑制作用はMAFBを介することを示した。
pmid-24391856.summary_en: This study examined how miR-199a is regulated and how it acts in testicular germ cell tumors (TGCTs) and glioblastomas. In TGCTs, hypermethylation of both miR-199a-1 and -2 loci reduced expression, whereas hypomethylation of miR-199a-2 was associated with elevated expression in gliomas. REST preferentially bound the methylated promoters of both loci. MAFB was identified as a putative target of miR-199a-5p in TGCTs, and the tumor suppressive activity of the microRNA was mediated through MAFB.

pmid-24396669.summary_ja: 54歳女性の頸部腫瘤に対し、甲状腺左葉切除術が施行され、三胚葉由来の組織から成る良性甲状腺奇形腫と診断された。術前の超音波検査およびCTで脂肪を含む境界明瞭な腫瘤が示唆され、穿刺吸引細胞診では甲状腺濾胞細胞は確認されなかった。成人の甲状腺奇形腫は極めて稀で、韓国での初報告例とされる。
pmid-24396669.summary_en: This case report describes a 54-year-old woman with a growing neck mass who was found to have a benign teratoma of the thyroid gland. Preoperative thyroid ultrasonography and neck CT suggested a fat-containing, well-defined cystic mass, while ultrasound-guided fine needle aspiration failed to identify thyroid follicular cells. Left thyroid lobectomy was performed, and histology showed tissue derived from all three germ layers, confirming a benign thyroid teratoma. The authors note this is the first reported case of this entity in Korea, and that thyroid teratomas are extremely rare in adults.

pmid-24396822.summary_ja: 32歳女性の腹部膨満に対し、画像所見から卵巣悪性腫瘍と腹膜播種が疑われた。術中凍結切片では確定診断に至らず、病期分類のための開腹術により大網原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる補助化学療法を3週間間隔で6サイクル施行し、4年間の外来フォローアップで再発は認めていない。
pmid-24396822.summary_en: This report describes a 32-year-old woman with abdominal distension and ascites whose imaging suggested ovarian malignancy with peritoneal seeding. Frozen biopsy of the omentum was nondiagnostic, and staging laparotomy confirmed a yolk sac tumor originating in the omentum, an extremely rare primary site. She received six cycles of adjuvant bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy at three-week intervals. After four years of outpatient follow-up, she remained free of relapse. The case highlights the limited clinical information available for omental yolk sac tumors and the diagnostic challenge of distinguishing primary from metastatic disease.

pmid-24397105.summary_ja: 精巣原発の絨毛癌で、頸部リンパ節生検により転移性絨毛癌と診断された男性の症例である。血清β-hCGは1227 ng/mLと著明に高値であった。PEB化学療法（シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシン）を行ったが、画像および腫瘍マーカーで進行を認めた。救援化学療法が計画されたが、その後フォローアップから脱落した。男性の絨毛癌は予後不良で、化学療法および放射線療法への反応も乏しいと結論づけられている。
pmid-24397105.summary_en: A man with a testicular primary presented with abdominal pain, cough, weakness, and a left cervical mass. Incisional biopsy of the neck mass showed metastatic choriocarcinoma, and serum beta-hCG was markedly elevated at 1227 ng/mL. He received PEB chemotherapy (cisplatin, etoposide, bleomycin) but developed progressive disease on imaging and tumor marker monitoring. Salvage chemotherapy was planned, but he was lost to follow-up. The authors conclude that male choriocarcinoma has a dismal prognosis with poor response to chemotherapy and radiotherapy, and that surgery plays no role in its management.

pmid-24403258.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の浸潤および転移におけるBDNF/TrkBシグナル伝達系の役割を、培養細胞およびマウスモデルで検討した前臨床研究である。可溶性TrkB細胞外ドメインやTrk阻害剤K252aにより、浸潤能とMMP-2発現が低下した。ヌードマウスでは局所浸潤が、SCIDマウスでは遠隔転移が抑制され、β-hCGや血管新生マーカーの低下も認められた。本経路の阻害は絨毛癌に対する新規治療法となる可能性がある。
pmid-24403258.summary_en: This preclinical study investigated the role of the BDNF/TrkB signaling pathway in choriocarcinoma invasion and metastasis. Treatment of cultured choriocarcinoma cells with a soluble TrkB ectodomain or the Trk inhibitor K252a reduced invasion and MMP-2 expression. In nude mouse xenografts, TrkB inhibition suppressed local invasion, while in SCID mice receiving intravenous injections, K252a inhibited distant metastasis, reduced proliferation, increased apoptosis, and decreased beta-hCG and angiogenic markers. The authors propose BDNF/TrkB blockade as a potential therapeutic strategy for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-24409080.summary_ja: 49歳男性が急性右側腹痛で受診し、肝臓に多発腫瘤を認めた症例である。陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)では肝のみに集積があり、精巣には集積を認めなかった。肝内胆管癌として切除を計画したが、急速な増大・破裂と肺転移により生検なく60日後に死亡した。剖検による病理組織学的評価で原発性肝絨毛癌と確定された。中年男性の肝腫瘍では本疾患を鑑別に含め、肝生検とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)測定を行うことが推奨される。
pmid-24409080.summary_en: This case report describes a 49-year-old man with acute right abdominal pain and rapidly growing multinodular liver tumors. FDG-PET showed uptake only in the liver, with no testicular uptake, and a preoperative diagnosis of cholangiocarcinoma was considered. The tumors ruptured and lung metastases developed rapidly, so the patient died 60 days after presentation without a pathological diagnosis. Postmortem histopathological and immunohistological examinations established a primary hepatic choriocarcinoma. The authors emphasize considering this entity in middle-aged men with liver tumors and recommend liver biopsy and serum hCG testing.

pmid-24413870.summary_ja: 生後5か月の女児が左眼球突出と眼瞼腫脹で受診し、眼窩蜂窩織炎として抗菌薬投与を受けたが改善しなかった。膿瘍排液で症状は一部軽快したが突出が持続したため精査され、部分的に嚢胞性の腫瘍が確認された。病理組織学により成熟奇形腫と診断された。乳児の眼窩腫瘤は感染症だけでなく奇形腫も念頭に置くべきであると、著者らは一般眼科医に注意を促している。
pmid-24413870.summary_en: A 5-month-old healthy girl presented with acute left proptosis, eyelid swelling, chemosis, and exposure keratopathy, initially treated as orbital cellulitis with intravenous antibiotics without improvement. Drainage of a presumed abscess partially relieved symptoms, but persistent proptosis prompted further exploration. The orbital lesion was a partially cystic tumor, and histopathology confirmed a mature teratoma. The authors discuss this rare orbital entity to alert general ophthalmologists that orbital masses in infants may be teratomas rather than infection alone.

pmid-24421855.summary_ja: 卵巣未熟奇形腫に、腹膜、リンパ節、ダグラス窩に及ぶ腹膜神経膠腫症が合併し、子宮内膜症も併存した症例研究である。発生機序として、奇形腫組織の播種よりも体腔上皮系幹細胞の化生が関与する可能性を著者らは論じている。子宮内膜症を伴う腹膜神経膠腫症は過去7例のみの報告であり、節性神経膠腫症との併存例は初めてとされる。
pmid-24421855.summary_en: This case study describes ovarian immature teratoma accompanied by gliomatosis peritonei involving the peritoneum, lymph nodes, and Douglas' pouch, with endometriosis coexisting in the same region. The authors review the pathogenesis, proposing that metaplasia of coelomic stem cells, rather than implantation of teratomatous tissue, may underlie endometriosis and gliomatosis. They note that only seven prior cases of gliomatosis peritonei with endometriosis have been reported, and that nodal gliomatosis coexisting with gliomatosis peritonei and endometriosis has not been reported before.

pmid-24421920.summary_ja: 10年前に異時性の甲状腺悪性腫瘍の既往がある閉経後女性の卵巣腫瘤で、甲状腺濾胞と乳頭状甲状腺癌の病巣が認められた症例である。卵巣甲状腺腫由来の乳頭癌と甲状腺癌の卵巣転移の鑑別が問題となる。甲状腺成分が優勢な場合や卵巣病変内に悪性甲状腺組織を認める場合には卵巣甲状腺腫を考慮すべきとされる。両疾患の臨床、画像、治療について文献的に検討し、最も可能性の高い診断を提示している。
pmid-24421920.summary_en: This case report describes a postmenopausal woman with an ovarian mass containing thyroid follicles and foci of papillary thyroid carcinoma, who had a metachronous thyroid malignancy 10 years earlier. The differential diagnosis between papillary carcinoma arising in struma ovarii and an ovarian metastasis from primary thyroid carcinoma is discussed. Struma ovarii should be considered when thyroid components predominate or malignant thyroid tissue is identified within an ovarian lesion. The authors review the clinical, imaging, and therapeutic features of both entities and present the most likely diagnosis.

pmid-24422957.summary_ja: 本2013年のPathology International報告は、卵巣のgrowing teratoma syndromeの2症例を記述し、初診から10年および22年後に二次性腫瘍が発生したことを示す。1例では、3つの胚細胞層すべての成熟成分から多発性の微小カルチノイドが生じ、潜在する多能性幹細胞からの発生が示唆された。もう1例では、小さな腸型腺癌が腸型腺の悪性転化によると考えられた。腹膜の成熟奇形腫には子宮内膜症の病巣があり、主に神経膠成分に存在していた。著者らは、本症候群における二次性腫瘍形成について2つの異なる組織発生経路を提案している。
pmid-24422957.summary_en: This 2013 Pathology International report describes two cases of growing teratoma syndrome of the ovary in which secondary neoplasms developed 10 and 22 years after initial presentation. In one case, multicentric microscopic carcinoids arose from mature elements of all three germ layers, suggesting origin from latent pluripotent stem cells. In the other, a small intestinal-type adenocarcinoma was most likely caused by malignant transformation of intestinal-type glands. Peritoneal mature teratomas contained endometriosis foci, mainly in glial components, suggesting a role for glia in endometriosis development. The authors propose two distinct histogenetic pathways for secondary neoplasia in this syndrome.

pmid-24422958.summary_ja: 13歳女児の卵巣腫瘍の症例報告。穿刺生検で腸型粘液性腺癌が確認され、切除標本にも成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の領域とともに認められた。分子解析で癌、境界粘液性腫瘍、良性腸型上皮にKRAS変異が検出されたが、奇形腫の表皮成分には認められなかった。奇形腫由来の粘液性癌でKRAS変異を示した初の報告である。大腸癌の卵巣転移との鑑別には広範な組織サンプリングが重要とされる。
pmid-24422958.summary_en: This Pathology International case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a large ovarian mass. Fine needle biopsy showed intestinal-type mucinous adenocarcinoma, which was also found in the full surgical specimen alongside areas of mature cystic teratoma. Molecular analysis detected a KRAS mutation in the carcinoma, borderline mucinous tumor and benign intestinal-type epithelium, but not in the epidermal component of the teratoma. This is described as the first report of a KRAS mutation in mucinous carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma. The authors stress extensive sampling to distinguish teratoma-derived carcinoma from metastatic colorectal carcinoma, and suggest KRAS mutation is an early event in carcinogenesis.

pmid-24426412.summary_ja: 慢性の尾骨部痛を訴えた患者の仙骨前間隙に、良性嚢胞性奇形腫が認められた症例報告。一括切除を行い、患者は良好に回復した。画像と病理所見を提示し、臨床的特徴を考察している。直腸後方腫瘍はまれで多様であり、確定診断と良好な転帰のためには完全切除が必要とされる。
pmid-24426412.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a patient with chronic tailbone pain who was found to have a benign cystic teratoma in the presacral space. The tumor, a retrorectal lesion, was removed by en bloc resection, and the patient recovered well. The report presents radiographic and pathologic images from this unusual case and discusses its clinical features. It highlights that retrorectal tumors are rare and heterogeneous, and that complete surgical excision is required for definitive diagnosis and optimal outcome.

pmid-24426491.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が小腸閉塞の症状で発症した症例報告。単純X線で右腸骨窩に高濃度陰影が認められた。卵巣腫瘍の10〜15%を占め、若年者に多いとされる。機能性を持たない卵巣病変は通常無症状で、腫瘤による機械的症状を示すことが多い。奇形腫が機械的圧迫により腸閉塞を起こしうることを示す。
pmid-24426491.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary that presented as small intestinal obstruction. Plain abdominal radiography showed a radiopaque shadow in the right iliac fossa. The authors note that mature cystic teratoma is a relatively common ovarian tumor, accounting for 10-15% of ovarian tumors and typically occurring at an early age. Non-functional ovarian lesions are usually asymptomatic and present with mechanical symptoms from the mass. This case illustrates that a teratoma can cause bowel obstruction by mechanical compression.

pmid-24426505.summary_ja: 38歳女性の左腰部の痛みと重感の症例報告。単純X線で左腰部に不整な石灰化を認め、超音波検査とCTで副腎腫瘍と後腹膜奇形腫が疑われた。切除標本で後腹膜奇形腫内に生じた粘液産生腺癌と確認された。後腹膜奇形腫からの腺癌発生はまれであり、画像診断では副腎由来と誤認される可能性がある。
pmid-24426505.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a 38-year-old woman with left lumbar pain and heaviness. Abdominal X-ray showed irregular calcifications in the left lumbar region. Ultrasonography and CT initially suggested an adrenal tumor and a retroperitoneal teratoma, respectively. Excision confirmed a mucin-secreting adenocarcinoma arising within the retroperitoneal teratoma. The case documents a rare malignant transformation of a retroperitoneal teratoma into adenocarcinoma. It also illustrates how imaging can mistake the lesion for an adrenal origin, which may be relevant to preoperative planning.

pmid-24426520.summary_ja: 1歳児に後腹膜鏡下腎摘除を施行した原発性腎内奇形腫の症例報告。病理検査で腎異形成を伴う原発性成熟奇形腫と診断された。原発性腎内奇形腫はまれで、腎異形成の合併はさらにまれである。小児泌尿器領域における特異な病態の一例である。
pmid-24426520.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a primary intrarenal teratoma in a 1-year-old child who underwent retroperitoneoscopic nephrectomy. Pathologic examination identified a primary mature teratoma associated with renal dysplasia. Primary intrarenal teratomas are uncommon, and their association with renal dysplasia is rarer still. The report highlights an unusual entity in pediatric urology and documents the histologic features that allowed its diagnosis. It is a rare example of a teratoma arising within the kidney itself, rather than from a gonadal or sacrococcygeal site.

pmid-24426547.summary_ja: 10か月の乳児の無症状の上腹部腫瘤の症例報告。開腹で小弯側から発生した腫瘤を切除し、病理組織学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。胃奇形腫は小児の奇形腫の1%未満とまれで、文献上約102例のみである。18か月のフォローアップで再発はなかった。
pmid-24426547.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a 10-month-old infant with an asymptomatic upper abdominal mass, diagnosed as gastric teratoma. Laparotomy showed the mass arising from the lesser curvature of the stomach, and it was excised. Histopathology showed a mature cystic teratoma. The authors note that gastric teratoma is rare, accounting for less than 1% of teratomas in infants and children, with only about 102 cases reported in the literature. The infant showed no recurrence after 18 months of follow-up.

pmid-24426558.summary_ja: 21歳男性の持続性咳嗽の症例報告。胸部CTで前縦隔の大きな腫瘤を認め、大血管の圧迫と胸壁・心膜・肺との癒着が見られた。右前側方開胸により完全切除し、経過は順調であった。病理組織学的に良性嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。前縦隔奇形腫はまれな胚細胞腫瘍として文献的にレビューされている。
pmid-24426558.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a 21-year-old man with a persistent cough who was found to have an anterior mediastinal teratoma. Chest CT confirmed a large mass compressing the great vessels and adherent to the chest wall, pericardium, and lung. A right anterolateral thoracotomy achieved complete excision, and the patient recovered uneventfully. Histopathology showed a benign cystic teratoma. The authors describe anterior mediastinal teratomas as rare germ cell tumors and review the literature on their presentation and management.

pmid-24426596.summary_ja: 腹腔内停留精巣から発生したセミノーマで、同側の腎無形成を合併した症例報告。停留精巣由来の精巣腫瘍は確立しているが、腎無形成の合併は診断と治療を難しくする。手術前に対側腎の機能評価を行い、補助放射線療法を行う場合は腎を保護する必要がある。文献上の類似例は3例のみである。
pmid-24426596.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes a seminoma arising from an intra-abdominal undescended testis in a patient with ipsilateral renal agenesis. The authors note that testicular tumors arising from cryptorchidism are well established, but their coexistence with renal agenesis poses diagnostic and management challenges. Only three similar cases had been reported before. They emphasize assessing the function of the contralateral kidney before surgery and protecting it if adjuvant radiotherapy is planned. The report highlights the importance of recognizing this association in patients with abdominal cryptorchidism and testicular tumors.
