pmid-24426616.summary_ja: 臀部の腫瘤を主訴とした11歳女児の仙尾部胎児様奇形腫(Altman 1型)の症例報告。胎児様奇形腫は古典的奇形腫より臓器様分化が強く、四肢の原基を伴うことがある。仙尾部発生は従来ほぼ新生児例に限られており、本例は年長児としてまれである。年長児の胎児様奇形腫に関する限られた文献を補うものである。
pmid-24426616.summary_en: This Indian Journal of Surgery case report describes an 11-year-old girl who presented with a gluteal mass and was diagnosed with a sacrococcygeal fetiform teratoma (homunculus), Altman type 1. Fetiform teratomas show more organoid differentiation than classical teratomas, often with rudimentary limbs, but not enough to be classified as fetus-in-fetu. The authors note that sacrococcygeal location has previously been reported mainly in neonates, which makes this older-child case unusual. The report adds to the limited literature on fetiform teratomas in older children.

pmid-24426624.summary_ja: 縦隔に生じた嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告です。縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍として最も多い成熟奇形腫を、超音波検査で評価しました。嚢胞内に特徴的な輝度の高い可動性の小球体を認めました。奇形腫は通常無症状で、胸部X線検査やCTで偶発的に見つかります。安価で広く利用できる超音波検査が、縦隔奇形腫の診断に有用な所見をもたらすと考察しています。
pmid-24426624.summary_en: This case report describes a mediastinal cystic teratoma, the most common mediastinal germ cell tumor, which was identified on ultrasonography. The lesion contained characteristic echogenic mobile spherules within its cyst. Mature teratomas are usually asymptomatic and found incidentally on chest radiography or CT, which typically confirms the diagnosis by showing fat, fluid, soft tissue and calcification. The authors argue that ultrasound, being inexpensive and widely available, can provide valuable diagnostic features for mediastinal teratomas.

pmid-24426636.summary_ja: 生後2か月の乳児に生じた未熟胃奇形腫の症例報告です。腹部腫瘤と閉塞性黄疸で発症しました。穿刺吸引細胞診では小円形細胞腫瘍とされ、神経芽腫よりWilms腫瘍が疑われ、診断に苦慮しました。手術で総胆管を圧迫していることが分かり、最終的な病理組織学的検査でGrade IIIの未熟胃奇形腫と診断されました。細胞診が奇形腫の診断を誤らせうることを強調しています。
pmid-24426636.summary_en: This case report describes a two-month-old infant with an immature gastric teratoma presenting with an abdominal lump and neonatal obstructive jaundice. Fine needle aspiration cytology suggested a small round cell tumor and favored Wilms tumor over neuroblastoma, which made the diagnosis difficult. Intraoperatively, the tumor was found compressing the common bile duct. Final histopathological examination revealed a grade III immature gastric teratoma. The authors emphasize that gastric teratoma can present with obstructive jaundice and that cytology may be misleading in diagnosing teratomas.

pmid-24426646.summary_ja: 生後3か月の乳児に生じた未熟胃奇形腫の症例報告です。胃奇形腫は極めて稀で、小児の奇形腫の1%未満を占め、報告例は100例強にすぎません。完全切除により予後は良好とされています。未熟型の報告はさらに少なく、この稀な疾患の症例を追加報告しています。
pmid-24426646.summary_en: This case report describes a three-month-old infant with an immature gastric teratoma. Gastric teratomas are extremely rare, accounting for less than 1% of teratomas in infants and children, with only about 100 cases reported in the literature. Most reported cases are mature rather than immature. The authors note that complete surgical excision of the tumor carries a good prognosis, and they present this case to add to the limited literature on this rare entity.

pmid-24426766.summary_ja: 精巣摘除で線維化のみが認められ、後腹膜リンパ節転移として発症した燃え尽き型精巣腫瘍の症例報告です。免疫組織化学でセミノーマと診断されました。14か月の化学療法後も3cm未満の残存リンパ節がありましたが、腫瘍マーカーは正常で経過観察中です。若年男性の後腹膜腫瘤では、この病態を考慮すべきであることを示しています。
pmid-24426766.summary_en: This case report describes a man whose initial presentation was a retroperitoneal metastatic seminoma, despite the testis showing only fibrosis on orchidectomy, consistent with a burned-out testicular primary. Retroperitoneal lymph node biopsy confirmed metastatic seminoma by immunohistochemistry. After 14 months of chemotherapy, a residual node smaller than 3 cm remained, but serum tumor markers were normal and the patient is under observation. Burned-out germ cell tumors can present with metastases alone, and clinicians should consider this possibility in retroperitoneal masses in young men.

pmid-24450083.summary_ja: 野生のメスのアメリカクロクマに生じた縦隔奇形腫の獣医学的症例報告です。多房性の大きな縦隔腫瘤が肺と心臓を圧排していました。腫瘤は線維組織、軟骨、骨、神経組織、平滑筋、上皮構造を含み、組織学的に縦隔奇形腫と診断されました。予後不良のため安楽死されました。野生動物の縦隔奇形腫は稀であり、その記録としての価値があります。
pmid-24450083.summary_en: This veterinary case report describes a free-ranging female American black bear with a large multiloculated mediastinal mass displacing the lungs and heart. The bear was euthanized because of poor prognosis. Microscopically, the mass contained fibrous tissue, cartilage, bone, nervous tissue, smooth muscle and various epithelial structures. The mass was diagnosed as a mediastinal teratoma on the basis of these features. The report documents an uncommon occurrence of a mediastinal teratoma in a wild animal.

pmid-24454592.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、ステージIA精巣セミノーマに対し精巣摘除術と補助放射線療法を受けた39歳男性を記述する。3年後、総腸骨動脈付近の腫瘤が後期リンパ節再発と疑われた。経皮生検が不明瞭であったため腹腔鏡下リンパ節郭清が行われ、最終病理で軟部組織の血管周囲類上皮細胞腫瘍（PEComa）と判明した。患者は補助治療なしで無病の状態である。著者らは、胚細胞腫瘍のフォローアップ中の後腹膜腫瘤の鑑別診断として、稀な軟部組織腫瘍を考慮すべきと勧めている。
pmid-24454592.summary_en: This case report describes a 39-year-old man treated for stage IA testicular seminoma with orchidectomy and adjuvant radiation therapy. Three years later, a mass near the common iliac artery was suspected to be a late lymph node relapse. Because percutaneous biopsy was equivocal, laparoscopic lymphadenectomy was performed, and the final pathology showed a soft tissue perivascular epithelioid cell tumor (PEComa). The patient remains disease-free without further treatment. The authors recommend considering rare soft tissue neoplasms in the differential diagnosis of retroperitoneal masses during germ cell tumor follow-up.

pmid-24469482.summary_ja: 本研究は、資源の乏しい三次医療機関で1999年から2012年に治療された小児の複雑性性腺外奇形腫21例の治療成績を後方視的に検討した。好発部位は仙尾部、頸部、縦隔、腹部であった。悪性転化が5例に認められた。全体の死亡率は23.8%だった。受診遅延、栄養障害、敗血症、小児集中治療室の不足が予後不良と関連しており、早期受診と集中治療体制の整備が必要である。
pmid-24469482.summary_en: This retrospective review examines outcomes of 21 complicated extragonadal teratomas in children treated over 14 years at a tertiary centre in a resource-poor setting. Common sites were sacrococcygeal, cervical, mediastinal, and abdominal. Complications included respiratory distress, intestinal obstruction, and malignant transformation in five patients. Overall mortality was 23.8%, with post-excision mortality of 11.8%. Delayed presentation, malnutrition, sepsis, and lack of paediatric intensive care were associated with poor outcomes, highlighting the need for earlier presentation and better intensive care resources.

pmid-24473964.summary_ja: 本報告は、精巣微小石灰化と左精巣の腫大を伴う思春期前の男児例を報告している。嚢胞性の精巣腫瘍を切除し、同側の精巣を温存した。病理組織学的検査では精巣皮様嚢腫(成熟奇形腫の一型)と診断された。小児における精巣腫瘍と微小石灰化の関係は不明確であり、思春期前の小児に対する専用のフォローアップ方針の策定が必要であると著者らは述べている。
pmid-24473964.summary_en: This report describes a pre-adolescent boy with testicular microlithiasis and a cystic enlarged left testis. Excision with testis preservation was performed, and histology revealed a testicular dermoid tumor, a mature teratoma type. The authors review the ill-defined relationship between testicular tumors and microlithiasis in children. They argue that testis-sparing surgery may be feasible in selected cases. They also call for specific follow-up protocols for prepubertal children with microlithiasis, given limited evidence in this population.

pmid-24475006.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腎外傷後に側腹部痛で受診した28歳男性の、偶発的に発見された転移性セミノーマを報告している。血清β-hCGが著明に上昇していた。精巣摘除術と化学療法の後、β-hCG値は正常化した。セミノーマは典型的には無痛性の精巣腫瘤として病期Iで見つかるが、本例は非典型的な転移性の提示を示す。
pmid-24475006.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old man with an incidentally discovered metastatic seminoma. He presented with flank pain after renal trauma, and his serum β-human chorionic gonadotropin was markedly elevated. Following orchidectomy and chemotherapy, his β-hCG level normalized. Seminoma is the most common histological subtype of testicular carcinoma and typically presents as a painless lump at stage I. This case illustrates that metastatic disease can present atypically, with flank pain and an incidental finding after trauma.

pmid-24475592.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、14歳時にFIGO病期IVの悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断され化学療法を受けた19歳女性を報告している。骨盤痛、無月経、骨盤内遊離液体を認め、β-hCGがわずかに上昇していた。当初は再発が疑われたが、待機的管理と反復超音波検査で子宮内の正常妊娠と確認され、帝王切開で健康な新生児が出生した。
pmid-24475592.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with a prior FIGO stage IV malignant ovarian germ cell tumor, treated with etoposide, ifosfamide, and cisplatin chemotherapy. She presented with pelvic pain, amenorrhoea, free pelvic fluid, and a slight rise in serum β-hCG. Recurrence was initially suspected, but a wait-and-see approach and repeated ultrasound confirmed a normal intrauterine pregnancy, which was delivered by cesarean section. The case highlights that β-hCG elevation in patients with a history of ovarian germ cell tumor may reflect pregnancy, and that conservative management can preserve future fertility.

pmid-24497867.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、帝王切開瘢痕部妊娠と誤診された原発性子宮頸部絨毛癌を報告している。不正性器出血が最も多い症状であるが、本疾患は極めて稀であるため臨床診断は困難である。子宮全摘術と化学療法の併用により寛解が得られた。帝王切開瘢痕部の既往を伴う出血では、子宮頸部絨毛癌を鑑別診断に含めることが重要である。
pmid-24497867.summary_en: This case report describes primary choriocarcinoma of the uterine cervix that was initially misdiagnosed as a cesarean section scar ectopic pregnancy. Abnormal vaginal bleeding was the most common symptom, and the clinical diagnosis proved difficult due to the rarity of the disease. Remission was achieved with hysterectomy combined with chemotherapy. The authors emphasize that cervical choriocarcinoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of bleeding in patients with a prior cesarean scar, and that combined surgical and chemotherapeutic treatment can lead to remission.

pmid-24601053.summary_ja: 本総説は、中国および国際的な文献と著者らの臨床経験に基づき、思春期の悪性卵巣腫瘍の診断と治療を検討している。思春期の悪性卵巣腫瘍の大多数は悪性胚細胞腫瘍であり、悪性度が高く早期診断が困難で見過ごされやすい。誤診や過剰治療を避けるため、正確な早期診断が重要である。予後を損なわずに妊孕性を温存できる治療法の選択も論じている。
pmid-24601053.summary_en: This comprehensive review examines the diagnosis and treatment of malignant ovarian tumors in adolescents, drawing on Chinese and international literature and the authors' clinical experience. Most adolescent malignant ovarian tumors are malignant germ cell tumors, which are highly malignant and difficult to diagnose early, often leading to neglect. The authors emphasize accurate early diagnosis to avoid misdiagnosis and over-treatment. They also discuss selecting therapy that preserves fertility without compromising prognosis, and tolerable treatment approaches tailored to young patients.

pmid-24601055.summary_ja: 17歳女性で原発性無月経と乳房発育不良を呈し、XY性腺異形成症と診断された症例報告。腹腔鏡手術で両側の索状性腺を摘出したところ、性腺芽腫と右側のディスジャーミノーマが病理組織学で確認された。性腺異形成症では胚細胞腫瘍の発生リスクが高いことを示す症例であり、原発性無月経を呈する患者の評価に留意が必要である。
pmid-24601055.summary_en: This case report describes a 17-year-old woman with primary amenorrhea and poor breast development, diagnosed with XY gonadal dysgenesis. Laparoscopic bilateral removal of streak gonads revealed gonadoblastomas and a right-sided dysgerminoma on histopathology. The report highlights the increased risk of germ cell tumor development in patients with gonadal dysgenesis, emphasizing that such gonads should be removed given their malignant potential and that patients presenting with primary amenorrhea need careful evaluation.

pmid-24601056.summary_ja: ホルモン異常や男性化・脱女性化の兆候を伴わない、両側性の低分化型セルトリ・ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍の症例報告。ディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の合併を認めた。低分化型は組織診断が難しく、発見が遅れて予後不良となりやすいことを踏まえ、その診断と治療について述べている。
pmid-24601056.summary_en: This case report describes a bilateral, poorly differentiated Sertoli-Leydig cell tumor of the ovary associated with dysgerminoma, in a patient without hormonal imbalance or signs of virilization or defeminization. Sertoli-Leydig tumors are rare, and poorly differentiated forms are difficult to diagnose histologically and often present late, leading to poorer prognosis. The authors describe the heterologous histologic features, diagnostic workup, and treatment.

pmid-24601057.summary_ja: 無月経と右下腹部腫瘤を呈した18歳女性の純粋卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例報告。AFPが著明に上昇し、妊孕性温存手術により病期IAと判明した。化学療法は行わず、36か月の集中的なフォローアップで再発は認めなかった。無月経を初発症状とする初の報告であり、症状が長期間続いたにもかかわらず病期IAであった点が注目される。
pmid-24601057.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with amenorrhea and a palpable right lower abdominal mass, diagnosed with a pure yolk sac tumor of the ovary. Markedly elevated AFP was noted. Fertility-sparing surgery revealed stage IA disease, and chemotherapy was avoided. Thirty-six months of intensive follow-up showed no recurrence. The authors note this is the first reported case of a pure ovarian yolk sac tumor presenting with amenorrhea and emphasize its stage IA status despite prolonged symptoms.

pmid-24604963.summary_ja: 上大静脈症候群で発症した22歳男性の原発性縦隔セミノーマの症例。白金製剤を用いた化学療法と放射線療法への反応が不良であり、無病期間1年で骨および軟部組織に再発した。このような攻撃性の高い病型を事前に識別する方法の必要性を強調している。本症例は、標準治療に抵抗性を示す縦隔セミノーマの臨床的特徴を示す重要な報告である。
pmid-24604963.summary_en: This report describes a 22-year-old man with primary mediastinal seminoma who presented with superior vena cava syndrome. The tumor responded poorly to platinum-based chemotherapy and radiotherapy. It relapsed within one year at unusual sites, including bone and soft tissue. The authors emphasize the need to identify methods for pre-screening such aggressive variants to guide more effective treatment strategies.

pmid-24639765.summary_ja: 治療を受けていない停留精巣をもつ成人不妊男性13例を対象とした横断研究。PLAP染色により3例(23.1%)で精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)が確認され、うち1例はセミノーマを伴っていた。停留精巣の成人患者では、悪性腫瘍のスクリーニングを含む注意深い臨床評価とフォローアップが必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-24639765.summary_en: This cross-sectional study assessed the prevalence of intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCN) in untreated cryptorchid testes of 13 adult infertile men with impalpable intra-abdominal testes. Sections were examined by H&E and stained for placental like acid phosphatase (PLAP). Three cases (23.1%) were PLAP-positive, one of which also showed seminoma. The authors recommend closer clinical evaluation and follow-up of untreated cryptorchid adults for malignancy screening.

pmid-24765493.summary_ja: 左上腹部痛を主訴とした23歳女性の症例報告。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で腹腔動脈付近の後腹膜に膵後方奇形腫を認め、胸腔内へ進展していた。開腹下に腫瘍を切除した。成人では稀な後腹膜奇形腫が胸腔内へ進展した点が特徴的であり、報告の意義がある。
pmid-24765493.summary_en: This case report describes a 23-year-old woman presenting with left upper quadrant abdominal pain. CT demonstrated a primary retroperitoneal teratoma located near the celiac axis, extending into the thorax. The tumor was resected via laparotomy. The authors highlight the unusual intrathoracic extension of a retropancreatic teratoma, an uncommon presentation of this rare adult retroperitoneal neoplasm.

pmid-24895508.summary_ja: 分化型甲状腺癌の術後に施行した全身I-131スキャンで骨盤部に偽陽性の集積を認めた症例報告。偶発的に診断された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が原因であった。卵巣の良性病変が放射性ヨウ素検査で転移に類似しうることを示し、不要な治療を避けるため慎重な読影が重要であると述べている。
pmid-24895508.summary_en: This case report describes a false-positive pelvic iodine uptake on a post-thyroidectomy whole-body I-131 scan in a patient with well-differentiated thyroid cancer. The uptake was ultimately attributed to an incidentally diagnosed mature cystic teratoma. The authors highlight that such benign ovarian lesions can mimic metastatic disease on radioiodine imaging, underscoring the importance of careful scan interpretation to avoid unnecessary treatment.

pmid-25390537.summary_ja: 24歳男性が自然前房出血、高眼圧、毛様体腫瘤を呈し、摘出眼では低分化腫瘍が確認された。精査で広範転移を伴う原発性精巣胎児性癌と診断された。精巣癌の毛様体転移として初めての報告であり、自然前房出血を伴う同種腫瘍としても初めてである。
pmid-25390537.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with spontaneous hyphema, high intraocular pressure and a ciliary body mass, whose enucleated eye showed a poorly differentiated neoplasm. Evaluation revealed a primary testicular embryonal carcinoma with widespread metastases. This is the first reported metastasis of testicular carcinoma to the ciliary body and the first tumor of this type associated with spontaneous hyphema.

pmid-26023424.summary_ja: 14年間に新生児仙尾部奇形腫の手術を受けた10例を後方視的に検討した。大半は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で、未熟奇形腫は2例であった。出生前診断は低率で、尾骨切除を伴う完全切除により死亡例はなく合併症率も低かった。ただしフォローアップが不十分で、長期の再発評価には限界がある。
pmid-26023424.summary_en: This retrospective review of 10 neonates operated for sacrococcygeal teratoma over 14 years found mostly mature cystic teratoma, with two immature cases. Antenatal detection was poor, and complete excision with coccygectomy led to no mortality and a low complication rate. However, follow-up was poor in this series, limiting the assessment of long-term recurrence. The authors conclude that neonatal sacrococcygeal teratomas are usually benign with good outcomes.

pmid-26023429.summary_ja: 妊娠中の26歳女性が、仙骨前部の腫瘤の詳細な超音波検査のため出生前診断センターに紹介された。尿生殖洞を伴うIV型仙尾部奇形腫は、腎奇形や閉塞性尿路症を伴う骨盤正中の嚢胞性腫瘤を呈し、総排泄腔異常と誤診されうる。本報告は、この両者の出生前鑑別の難しさを示している。
pmid-26023429.summary_en: This case report describes a 26-year-old pregnant woman referred to a prenatal diagnosis center for detailed ultrasonography of a presacral mass. The authors discuss the difficulty of distinguishing a type IV sacrococcygeal teratoma associated with a urogenital sinus from cloacal abnormalities. Both conditions can present as a pelvic midline cystic mass with renal malformations and obstructive uropathy during pregnancy, making prenatal diagnosis challenging.

pmid-26023453.summary_ja: 出生前に発見された、後腹膜に生じた巨大な未熟奇形腫の新生児例の報告。先天性奇形腫は通常性腺外に発生し、仙尾部が最も多い部位である。肉眼的に切除したにもかかわらず腫瘍が再発したことから、化学療法の明確な役割が示唆される。診断と治療上の課題を文献レビューとともに考察している。
pmid-26023453.summary_en: This report describes a rare case of an antenatally detected, large immature teratoma of the retroperitoneum in a neonate. Congenital teratomas usually arise at extragonadal sites, most commonly the sacrococcygeal region. The diagnostic and therapeutic challenges are discussed alongside a literature review. The tumor recurred after gross surgical removal, which the authors argue supports a definitive role for chemotherapy in such cases.

pmid-26181730.summary_ja: 72歳女性が再発性の発熱と腹部膨満で受診し、CA125高値と胸水・腹水を認めた。良性の左卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の自然破裂による化学性腹膜炎と胸膜炎と最終診断された。患者は開腹術を拒否したが、12か月かけて自然に改善した。後方視的なCT所見で腹水中の脂質粒子が確認され、奇形腫の破裂が裏付けられた。
pmid-26181730.summary_en: This case report describes a 72-year-old woman with recurrent fever, abdominal distension and elevated CA125 who was found to have chemical peritonitis and pleuritis after spontaneous rupture of a benign left cystic ovarian teratoma. The patient declined laparotomy and improved over 12 months without surgery. A retrospective review of CT images showed lipid particles in the ascites, supporting the diagnosis of teratoma rupture. The authors recommend including chemical peritonitis in the differential diagnosis of peritonitis.

pmid-26328119.summary_ja: 両側性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に関する総説。発生率は1〜5%で、約3分の1が同時性、約3分の2が異時性に診断される。精巣がん患者の約5%は対側に精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を有し、対側の胚細胞腫瘍へ進展しうる。両側性の報告は少なく、本総説では発生率、病理学的特徴、臨床転帰を概説している。
pmid-26328119.summary_en: This review summarizes the incidence, pathological features and clinical outcomes of bilateral testicular germ cell tumors. Bilateral disease occurs in about 1-5% of cases, with roughly one third diagnosed synchronously and two thirds metachronously. About 5% of patients with testicular cancer have contralateral intratubular germ cell neoplasia, which may progress to a contralateral germ cell tumor. Data on bilateral disease remain limited.

pmid-26328122.summary_ja: 22歳男性が超音波検査で偶発的に発見された小型の右精巣腫瘍に対し、精巣温存手術を受けた。MRIで1cm超の造影効果を伴う精巣内腫瘤が認められ、病理ではセミノーマであった。9か月のフォローアップで残存腫瘍はなく、精巣の輪郭は正常で萎縮も認めなかった。健常な対側精巣があっても、小型の片側腫瘍には精巣温存手術が選択肢となりうる。
pmid-26328122.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with an incidentally detected small unilateral testicular tumor underwent testis-sparing surgery. MRI showed a contrast-enhanced intratesticular mass of about 1 cm, and pathology revealed seminoma. Nine months of follow-up showed no residual tumor, a normal testicular contour and no atrophy. The authors suggest testis-sparing surgery is an option for small unilateral tumors even when the contralateral testis is healthy.

pmid-26992345.summary_ja: 22歳男性の胚細胞腫瘍後腹膜転移症例です。化学療法後、腹部大動脈および下大静脈を巻き込む巨大腫瘤に対し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清と大動脈・下大静脈の同時再建(新たな下大静脈分岐の作成を含む)が施行されました。術後経過は良好で、36か月の時点で移植血管の開存と局所・遠隔再発の欠如が確認されています。血管合併切除を伴う外科的治療の一例として示されています。
pmid-26992345.summary_en: A 22-year-old man with a retroperitoneal metastasis from a germ cell tumor, previously treated with chemotherapy, presented with a large mass involving the infrarenal aorta and inferior vena cava. He underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection with concomitant aortic and caval reconstruction, including creation of a new caval bifurcation. Recovery was uneventful, and at 36 months the grafts remained patent without local or distant recurrence. The report illustrates complex vascular reconstruction during surgical management of retroperitoneal germ cell tumor disease.

pmid-27001882.summary_ja: 42歳女性の良性前縦隔奇形腫に対し、ロボット支援胸腔鏡下切除を施行した症例報告です。前縦隔というまれな部位の腫瘤に対するロボット手術の応用例を示しています。縦隔手術、特に胸腺摘出術においてロボット支援手術の有用性が報告されつつあり、本症例はその適用範囲を縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍へ広げるものです。腫瘍学的転帰よりも手術手技の実現可能性に重点が置かれています。
pmid-27001882.summary_en: This report describes a 42-year-old woman with a benign anterior mediastinal teratoma resected by robotic-assisted thoracoscopic surgery. The case illustrates the application of robotic techniques to a less commonly encountered mass in the anterior mediastinum. Robotic-assisted surgery has emerged as a viable approach for mediastinal procedures, particularly thymectomy, and this case extends its use to germ cell tumors of the anterior mediastinum. The brief report emphasizes technical feasibility rather than oncologic outcomes.

pmid-27122746.summary_ja: 37歳女性の前縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と甲状腺クリーゼが併存した症例報告です。術中は胸腺嚢胞と診断されましたが、病理学的に奇形腫と確定し、特殊染色では甲状腺組織は認められませんでした。術後も症状が続き、β遮断薬と抗甲状腺薬の併用で改善しています。著者らは両者の併存は偶発的と結論づけつつ、縦隔腫瘍の術前に甲状腺機能亢進症のスクリーニングを行うことを推奨しています。
pmid-27122746.summary_en: This case report describes a 37-year-old woman with thyroid storm and an incidental anterior mediastinal mature cystic teratoma. Initially identified intraoperatively as a thymic cyst, the lesion was confirmed as teratoma pathologically, with no thyroid tissue on special staining. Her symptoms persisted after surgery until beta blockers and antithyroid agents were added. The authors conclude the coexistence was coincidental but recommend preoperative screening for hyperthyroidism in anterior mediastinal tumors to prevent perioperative complications.

pmid-27276927.summary_ja: カラードプラ超音波検査とMRIで出生前に診断された、口蓋から発生するまれな口腔咽頭奇形腫(エピグナトス)の胎児例です。従来報告の急速増大例と異なり、本症例は血流に乏しく、妊娠中に縮小しました。組織学的には壊死巣を認めています。ドプラ検査で血流が乏しい所見は良好な予後を示す指標になりうると著者らは示唆しています。
pmid-27276927.summary_en: This report describes a fetus with an epignathus, a rare oropharyngeal teratoma arising from the palate, detected prenatally by color Doppler ultrasound and MRI. Unlike previously reported rapidly growing epignathus, this tumor was hypovascular and decreased in size during gestation. Histopathology showed necrotic areas. The authors suggest that hypovascularity on Doppler imaging may indicate a favorable prognosis.

pmid-28191180.summary_ja: 妊娠34週で転移性妊娠性絨毛癌と生存胎児を有する妊婦の症例報告です。胎児貧血の検出に中大脳動脈の最大収縮期血流速度を用いたドプラ超音波検査を行い、分娩時期を決定しました。これにより胎児成熟のための妊娠延長を図りつつ、胎児母体間出血の監視も可能となりました。妊娠中に絨毛癌が診断された場合、この検査は重要な手段になりうると結論づけています。
pmid-28191180.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-week pregnant woman with metastatic gestational choriocarcinoma and a viable fetus. Middle cerebral artery peak systolic velocity Doppler ultrasonography was used to detect fetal anemia, guiding the timing of delivery to prolong pregnancy for fetal maturity while monitoring for feto-maternal hemorrhage. The authors conclude that this approach may be a critical tool when choriocarcinoma is diagnosed during pregnancy.

pmid-28920241.summary_ja: 原発性縦隔セミノーマの若年男性4例を後方視的に検討した報告です。全例がシスプラチン、ブレオマイシン、エトポシドによる化学療法で良好な反応を示しました。化学療法後のFDG-PETは3例で陰性で、30mm超の腫瘤を有した2例は外科的切除で壊死組織のみが確認されました。PET陽性で残存腫瘍を認めた1例は放射線療法後も進行しています。化学療法後のPETは残存腫瘍の生存細胞の予測に有用と考えられています。
pmid-28920241.summary_en: This retrospective review examines four young men with primary mediastinal seminoma treated with three to four cycles of cisplatin, bleomycin and etoposide. All responded well. Post-chemotherapy FDG-PET was negative in three patients, and two patients with masses over 30 mm underwent resection showing only necrotic tissue. One patient with a PET-positive residual mass progressed after radiotherapy. The authors suggest post-chemotherapy PET may help predict viable residual tumor.

pmid-28920327.summary_ja: 24歳男性の前縦隔嚢胞性セミノーマの症例報告です。CTでは造影効果を伴う肥厚壁を有する単房性嚢胞、MRIでは隔壁構造として描出されました。FDG集積は有意ではなく、組織学的に嚢胞壁内に散在するセミノーマ細胞を認めました。化学療法や放射線療法を行わず切除のみで、術後20か月で生活の質は良好でした。若年患者では補助療法を行わない完全切除で十分な可能性があると述べています。
pmid-28920327.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with an anterior mediastinal cystic seminoma presenting as a unilocular cyst with an enhancing thickened wall on CT and septal structures on MRI. FDG uptake was not significant, and seminoma cells were scattered in the cyst wall histologically. Resection alone was performed without chemotherapy or radiation, and twenty months later the patient's quality of life was good. The authors suggest complete resection without adjuvant therapy may suffice for young patients.

pmid-29539567.summary_ja: ペルーのエテンにある植民地初期の埋葬例で、思春期女性の腹腔内から見つかった骨と歯の塊を記載した古病理学的症例研究である。骨83点、歯37点を確認し、異所性妊娠、胎児内胎児、リトペディアなどと鑑別した。結論として、所見は成熟卵巣奇形腫と高い整合性を示すとされる。考古学試料における同種腫瘍の同定と有病率についても考察する。
pmid-29539567.summary_en: This paleopathological case study examines a bone and tooth mass found in the abdominal cavity of an adolescent female from an Early Colonial period burial in Eten, Peru. The authors document 83 bony and 37 dental elements and consider differential diagnoses including ectopic pregnancy, fetus in fetu, lithopedia and ovarian teratoma. They rule out the first three and conclude that the findings are highly consistent with a mature ovarian teratoma. The paper also discusses the identification, recovery and prevalence of such neoplasms in archaeological material.

pmid-23860605.summary_ja: 2007～2011年に後腹膜の傍大動脈・傍下大静脈病変を有した25例を対象とした。17例で腹腔鏡下切除を行い、全例でR0切除が達成された。腹腔鏡群は開腹群より在院日数が短かった（2日対6日）。非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の病期分類に用いられる後腹膜リンパ節郭清が背景にある報告である。
pmid-23860605.summary_en: A consecutive series (2007–2011) of 25 patients with paraaortic, aortocaval, or paracaval tumors under 10 cm. Seventeen underwent laparoscopic resection, achieving R0 in all; one was converted to open surgery for bleeding and one had diffuse peritoneal disease. Laparoscopic patients had shorter hospital stays than open patients (2 vs 6 days). The lesions included primary retroperitoneal tumors and metastases, and the background is laparoscopic lymph node dissection used for staging nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-20189842.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術時に奇形腫を認めた83例を対象に、初回と化学療法後の後腹膜リンパ節郭清(RPLND)を比較した。混合組織型が多く、胎児性癌は87%に認めた。リンパ節転移陽性率は初回群43%、化学療法後群77%で、陽性節の多くは奇形腫であった。再発3例はすべて化学療法後群であった。後腹膜に所見が残る場合は化学療法後郭清が推奨される。
pmid-20189842.summary_en: This single-institution review compared primary RPLND with post-chemotherapy RPLND in 83 patients with teratoma at orchiectomy. Mixed histology was common, with embryonal carcinoma in 87% and lymphovascular invasion in 43%. Positive nodes were found in 43% of primary and 77% of post-chemotherapy cases, mostly containing teratoma. All three recurrences occurred in the post-chemotherapy group. Post-chemotherapy RPLND is recommended when retroperitoneal findings persist.

pmid-20339953.summary_ja: 22歳女性が右骨盤内腫瘤で受診した。腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術により悪性卵巣甲状腺腫と判明し、その内部に乳頭状甲状腺癌を認めた。全甲状腺摘出術と術後の放射性ヨウ素(I-131)療法を施行した。卵巣甲状腺腫の悪性転化は約1〜2%とされ、サイログロブリン測定のため甲状腺の完全摘出が重要と指摘されている。
pmid-20339953.summary_en: A 22-year-old woman presented with a right pelvic mass. Laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy revealed a malignant struma ovarii containing papillary thyroid carcinoma. She underwent total thyroidectomy followed by postoperative radioiodine (I-131) therapy. The authors note that malignant transformation occurs in about 1–2% of struma ovarii and emphasize complete thyroid removal to permit thyroglobulin monitoring.

pmid-20451425.summary_ja: 精巣の小型腫瘤を有する患者16例に対し、鼠径部からの探索と凍結切片診断を行った。11病変(69%)は良性で精巣温存手術を施行し、5例は悪性(セミノーマ3例、胎児性癌1例、奇形腫1例)で精巣摘除術を受けた。凍結切片の結果は永久標本と完全に一致した。平均28～48か月の追跡で再発は報告されなかった。著者らは、小型の良性病変に対して精巣温存手術は安全であると結論づけている。
pmid-20451425.summary_en: Sixteen patients with small testicular masses (8–25 mm) underwent inguinal exploration with frozen section analysis. Eleven lesions (69%) were benign and treated with testis-sparing surgery; five were malignant (three pure seminomas, one embryonal carcinoma, one teratoma) and underwent orchiectomy. Frozen section results fully concorded with permanent sections. With average follow-up of 28–48 months, no recurrences were reported. The authors conclude testis-sparing surgery is safe for small benign lesions.

pmid-20471872.summary_ja: 性腺外胚細胞腫瘍51例のうち、5例が異時性精巣胚細胞腫瘍を発症した。6年累積発生率は8.3%で、診断までの期間中央値は64か月であった。5例は精巣摘除術を受け生存している。非セミノーマの5年生存率は後腹膜で94.7%、縦隔で58.8%であった。後腹膜例は特に長期フォローアップが必要とされる。
pmid-20471872.summary_en: In 51 patients with extragonadal germ cell tumors (25 mediastinal, 26 retroperitoneal), five developed metachronous testicular GCT, with a cumulative 6-year risk of 8.3%. The median interval to diagnosis was 64 months. All five underwent orchiectomy and survived. Five-year survival was 94.7% for retroperitoneal and 58.8% for mediastinal nonseminomatous tumors. The authors conclude that prognosis is adequate without testicular biopsy and that retroperitoneal patients need long-term follow-up.

pmid-20822932.summary_ja: 内臓転移、β-hCG高値、再発を伴う非典型的なセミノーマ25例を後方視的に検討したパイロット研究。イホスファミド、パクリタキセル、シスプラチンを含むレジメンが有効だったが、全体として化学療法抵抗性の傾向がみられた。免疫組織化学では古典的セミノーマに類似した発現パターンを示し、胎児性癌成分とは異なっていた。
pmid-20822932.summary_en: This pilot retrospective study reviewed 25 patients with seminoma showing atypical features: visceral metastases, markedly elevated beta-hCG, or recurrence. Ifosfamide, paclitaxel and cisplatin-containing regimens showed efficacy, although these tumors were generally chemoresistant. Immunohistochemistry for OCT3/4, PLAP, CD30, TRA-1-60, c-kit and gp200 in six tissue samples resembled classic seminoma and the seminomatous component of mixed tumors, not embryonal carcinoma. The authors conclude that these atypical seminomas do not arise from embryonal carcinoma.

pmid-20870430.summary_ja: SEERデータベースを用いた1973~2005年の精巣がん20,245例の解析で、婚姻状況と生存の関連を検討した。既婚男性は年齢、病期、組織型、人種とは独立して全生存とがん特異的生存が良好であった。病期IまたはIIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では、後腹膜リンパ節郭清が全生存の独立した予測因子であったが、婚姻状況は郭清の実施に影響しなかった。
pmid-20870430.summary_en: This SEER-based cohort analysis of 20,245 testicular cancer cases diagnosed from 1973 to 2005 examined whether marital status predicts survival. Married men had better overall and cancer-specific survival independent of age, stage, histology and race. Among men with stage I or II nonseminomatous germ cell tumor, retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was an additional independent predictor of improved overall survival, although marital status did not affect whether men underwent RPLND.

pmid-20933444.summary_ja: 1998年から2005年に治療された縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の男性34例(非セミノーマ27例、純粋セミノーマ7例)を対象とした単施設後方視的研究である。NSGCTの無増悪生存期間は、卵黄嚢腫瘍以外の組織型、β-hCG 1000 mIU/mL超、縦隔外進展の危険因子がないことと関連していた。初回増悪時からの3年全生存率は23%であった。セミノーマ患者は白金系化学療法で一様に良好であった。化学療法後の外科的統合療法により、縦隔NSGCT患者の54%が長期の無増悪生存を得た。
pmid-20933444.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study of 34 men with primary mediastinal germ cell tumors (27 nonseminomatous, 7 pure seminoma) treated from 1998 to 2005 assessed treatment outcomes and survival. Progression-free survival in NSGCT depended on the absence of risk factors: non-yolk-sac histology, beta-hCG above 1000 mIU/mL, or disease outside the mediastinum. Three-year overall survival from first progression was 23%. Patients with seminoma did uniformly well with platinum-based chemotherapy. Chemotherapy followed by surgical consolidation gave long-term progression-free survival to 54% of patients with mediastinal NSGCT.

pmid-21236595.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ10例のCT画像を用いて陽子線と光子線の線量分布を比較した線量学的研究。陽子線では標的体積の被覆は同等のまま、多くの正常組織の平均線量が有意に低く、胃で最大の低減が見られた。臓器別リスクモデルでは、光子線は胃・大腸・膀胱での二次がんの過剰発生が多いと予測された。陽子線で治療した50例につき1例の二次がんが減ると推定された。
pmid-21236595.summary_en: This dosimetric study compared photon and proton radiotherapy for stage I seminoma in 10 consecutive patients using planning CT images. Proton plans gave significantly lower mean doses to most normal tissues, with the largest reduction in the stomach, while target coverage was comparable. Using organ-specific risk models, photon therapy was predicted to cause more excess secondary cancers per 10,000 patient-years in the stomach, large bowel and bladder. The authors estimate one fewer secondary cancer for every 50 patients treated with protons and recommend further study.

pmid-21353416.summary_ja: 病理学的に確認された原発性非奇形腫性縦隔胚細胞腫瘍15例のCT所見を後方視的に解析した研究。多くは大型で分葉状・境界不明瞭な不均一な腫瘤で、石灰化や造影後の不均一な増強を示した。セミノーマは均一な濃度・増強を示す傾向があった。心膜、胸膜、隣接血管への浸潤と遠隔転移(肺転移3例)がみられた。
pmid-21353416.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed CT features of 15 pathologically proven primary non-teratomatous mediastinal germ cell tumors. Most masses were large, lobulated and ill-circumscribed, with heterogeneous attenuation, low-attenuation foci, stippled calcification and heterogeneous enhancement. Seminomas typically showed homogeneous attenuation and enhancement. Tumors frequently involved the pericardium, pleura and adjacent vessels, and three patients had pulmonary metastases. These findings may help radiologists consider this tumor in young men with anterosuperior mediastinal masses.

pmid-21460378.summary_ja: 転移性セミノーマで白金製剤含有化学療法後に残存腫瘤を認めた症例について、FDG-PETの有用性を検証した研究である。177件のPET結果を解析し、最終化学療法から6週間以降に実施した検査では感度・特異度・陰性的中率が向上した。正確度は73%から88%に改善した。適切な時期のFDG-PETは不要な治療を避ける臨床判断に有用と結論づけられている。
pmid-21460378.summary_en: This study validated the SEMPET trial recommendations on FDG-PET for residual masses after platinum-based chemotherapy in metastatic seminoma. Across 177 PET results, timing mattered: sensitivity, specificity, and negative predictive value were higher when scans were performed at least 6 weeks after the last chemotherapy cycle. Accuracy improved from 73% before the cutoff to 88% after it. The authors conclude that FDG-PET performed at an appropriate time point remains valuable for clinical decision-making and can spare patients unnecessary therapy.

pmid-21474790.summary_ja: 片側精巣摘除を受けた精巣胚細胞腫瘍の長期生存者539例を対象に、性機能障害と慢性疼痛の影響を質問票で調べた研究である。射精障害は84.9%、性的満足度の低下は95.4%に認められた。慢性疼痛は勃起障害や射精障害、オルガズム強度の低下と有意に相関しており、慢性疼痛が性機能に悪影響を及ぼすと結論づけられた。
pmid-21474790.summary_en: This study examined sexual dysfunction and the impact of chronic pain in 539 long-term testicular germ cell tumor survivors who had undergone orchiectomy. Questionnaires assessed testicular pain and sexual function. Ejaculatory disorders affected 84.9%, reduced sexual satisfaction 95.4%, and erectile dysfunction up to 31.5%. Chronic pain correlated significantly with erectile dysfunction, ejaculation disorders, and reduced orgasm intensity. The authors conclude that chronic pain adversely affects sexuality in testis cancer survivors.

pmid-21519812.summary_ja: 本症例報告では、化学療法抵抗性の純粋精巣セミノーマに十二指腸転移が生じ、大量の上部消化管出血で緊急手術を要した経過を示している。セミノーマの消化管転移は稀で、化学療法への反応も約60%と低い。消化管転移が生じた場合は早期の外科的管理を検討し、病期分類では後腹膜リンパ節生検を強く考慮すべきと提言している。
pmid-21519812.summary_en: This case report describes a chemoresistant pure testicular seminoma with duodenal metastasis causing massive acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding that required emergency surgery. The authors review the low incidence of gastrointestinal metastasis in seminoma, its poorer chemotherapy response (about 60%), and its spread via retroperitoneal lymph nodes. They argue that early surgical management should be considered for gastrointestinal metastasis, and that retroperitoneal lymph node biopsy should be strongly considered during staging.

pmid-21609196.summary_ja: 18歳女性の右卵巣に生じた4cmの成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。奇形腫内の異所性甲状腺組織に強いリンパ球浸潤を認め、術後に軽度の甲状腺機能低下症を来した。抗TPO抗体と抗Tg抗体が高値で、穿刺吸引生検により橋本甲状腺炎と診断された。正常位置の甲状腺と異所性甲状腺の双方に橋本甲状腺炎が生じた稀な併存例である。
pmid-21609196.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with a 4 cm right ovarian mature cystic teratoma containing ectopic thyroid tissue. Histology showed a prominent lymphocytic infiltrate around thyroid follicles, and the patient later developed mild hypothyroidism with elevated anti-TPO and anti-Tg antibodies. Fine-needle aspiration confirmed Hashimoto thyroiditis in both the native and ectopic thyroid. The authors describe this as a rare coexistence of Hashimoto thyroiditis within a benign ovarian teratoma.

pmid-21611826.summary_ja: NMDAR脳炎を発症した11歳女児の症例報告である。初回の腹部のコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)と骨盤の磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)では指摘できなかった両側の小さな卵巣奇形腫が、5か月後の超音波検査のフォローアップで右12mm、左7mmとして同定された。術中超音波検査で位置を確認して切除した。小児では奇形腫が極めて小さく見逃されやすいため、初回検査が陰性でも定期的な超音波検査やMRIを検討すべきと述べている。
pmid-21611826.summary_en: This report describes an 11-year-old girl with NMDA receptor encephalitis caused by small bilateral ovarian teratomas that were missed on initial abdominal CT and pelvic MRI. Ultrasound follow-up at five months identified 12 mm and 7 mm lesions, and intraoperative sonography guided their excision. The authors stress that teratomas in children can be very small and easily missed on cross-sectional imaging, and that periodic sonography and MRI may be warranted when initial studies are negative.

pmid-21631699.summary_ja: 後腹膜リンパ節郭清（RPLND）を腹腔鏡下で行った、病理病期Iおよび病期IIの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の後方視的シリーズで、15例が対象である。術中合併症はなく、在院期間も短かった。リンパ節病変を有する5例は、補助化学療法を行わず平均30か月フォローアップされ再発はなかったが、病理病期Iの2例で孤立性肺再発が生じた。著者らは、腹腔鏡下RPLNDは安全で診断的・治療的利益があると結論づけ、より大規模で長期の研究による確認を求めている。
pmid-21631699.summary_en: This retrospective series reports laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection (L-RPLND) for pathological stage I–II nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours in 15 patients, managed without adjuvant chemotherapy. Surgery was feasible without intraoperative complications, with short hospital stays. Five patients with nodal disease were followed for a mean of 30 months without chemotherapy and remained recurrence-free, though two stage I patients developed isolated pulmonary recurrence. The authors conclude L-RPLND is safe and offers diagnostic and therapeutic benefit, pending confirmation in larger, longer studies.

pmid-21684182.summary_ja: Muir-Torre症候群の患者において、卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に皮脂腺腺腫が生じた初めての症例報告です。病理所見と文献レビューを示しています。卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫内の皮脂腺腺腫は、遺伝性がん素因症候群の手がかりとなりうるため、早期診断につなげることが重要と述べています。
pmid-21684182.summary_en: This is the first reported case of a sebaceous adenoma arising within an ovarian mature cystic teratoma in a patient with Muir-Torre syndrome. The authors describe the histopathologic findings and review the literature. They suggest that finding a sebaceous adenoma within an ovarian cystic teratoma should prompt evaluation for Muir-Torre syndrome, a hereditary cancer predisposition syndrome, so that early diagnosis and genetic counseling can be pursued.

pmid-21701836.summary_ja: 20歳以下の卵巣腫瘍183例を対象とした前向き研究で、6年間の妊孕性温存手術の成績を検討しています。大半は良性で多くの卵巣を温存できました。悪性20例のうち、胚細胞型の再発2例(未熟奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍)は化学療法で治療されました。若年者の悪性卵巣腫瘍では妊孕性温存手術の予後は良好とされています。
pmid-21701836.summary_en: This prospective study of 183 children and young adults (20 years or younger) with ovarian tumours examines outcomes of fertility-sparing surgery over six years. Most masses were benign, and most ovaries could be preserved. Twenty patients had primary malignant tumours, and two germ cell recurrences (immature teratoma and yolk sac tumour) were managed with local excision, lymph node sampling and chemotherapy. The authors conclude fertility-sparing surgery for malignant ovarian tumours in this age group has an excellent prognosis and should be attempted whenever possible.

pmid-21742657.summary_ja: 類皮嚢腫に対する経膣的卵巣嚢腫摘出術(35例)と腹腔鏡下摘出術(40例)を後方視的に比較した。手術時間や出血量、CRPに差はなく、開腹移行や合併症もなかった。ダグラス窩に位置する良性類皮嚢腫では、腹腔鏡補助下経膣アプローチが有用な選択肢となりうると結論づけている。
pmid-21742657.summary_en: This retrospective comparison of 35 transvaginal and 40 laparoscopic ovarian cystectomies for dermoid cysts found similar operative time, hemoglobin decrease, and CRP values, with no conversions to laparotomy or complications. The transvaginal approach used ultrasound-guided culdotomy with laparoscopic support when needed. The authors conclude that laparoscopically supported vaginal cystectomy is as minimally invasive as laparoscopy while preserving a fully vaginal option, which may be preferable for benign dermoid cysts located in the cul-de-sac.

pmid-21766280.summary_ja: 16歳女児の前縦隔に生じた8×8cmの嚢胞性腫瘤を報告する。当初は心膜嚢胞として胸腔鏡下穿刺が予定されたが、充実性の性状から方針を変更し、開胸で全摘出した。病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確定した。縦隔嚢胞性腫瘤では奇形腫の可能性を念頭に置き、術中所見に基づいて方針を判断することが重要であると示している。
pmid-21766280.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl had an asymptomatic 8 × 8 cm cystic anterior mediastinal mass, initially suspected to be a pericardial cyst. Intraoperatively, the solid consistency prompted a change from thoracoscopic aspiration to complete excision through a small anterolateral thoracotomy. Histopathology revealed a highly fibrous, cystic mature teratoma. The report highlights that mediastinal cystic masses may be teratomas rather than benign cysts and that intraoperative findings should guide the surgical strategy.

pmid-21780949.summary_ja: 52歳女性の卵巣腫瘍切除標本で、慢性リンパ球性炎症を伴う卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。その後の検査でハシモト病と判明し、術後11か月で甲状腺機能低下症に対しチロキシン補充を開始した。卵巣甲状腺腫内の炎症を認識したことで早期診断につながったと報告している。
pmid-21780949.summary_en: A 52-year-old woman underwent excision of an ovarian tumor that histopathologically showed struma ovarii with chronic lymphocytic inflammation. Ultrasonography and antibody testing later revealed Hashimoto disease in the thyroid. Thyroxine was started 11 months after surgery as hypothyroidism developed. The authors suggest that recognizing lymphocytic thyroiditis within struma ovarii enabled early diagnosis and timely treatment. The report describes a mature teratoma subtype with an unusual thyroid pathology.

pmid-21792865.summary_ja: 再発・難治性胚細胞腫瘍90例を対象に、単剤第II相試験7件を統合解析した。奏効率は1%にすぎず、中央値の無増悪生存期間は1.0か月、全生存期間は4.7か月であった。12週PFSを第II相試験、中央値OSを第III相試験の評価項目として提案している。
pmid-21792865.summary_en: This pooled analysis of seven single-agent phase 2 trials at Memorial Sloan-Kettering enrolled 90 patients with refractory germ cell tumors, most with testicular primaries and nonseminoma histology. Response rate was only 1%, and median PFS and OS were 1.0 and 4.7 months. The 12-week PFS rate was 9%. The authors propose 12-week PFS as the endpoint for phase 2 trials of novel agents and median OS for phase 3 trials, given the poor response-based outcome in this population.

pmid-21793190.summary_ja: 小児胚細胞腫瘍のプロテオーム解析では、自己複製する腫瘍幹細胞を反映すると考えられるディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）4例と、分化する腫瘍幹細胞を反映すると考えられる小児卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を比較した。二次元電気泳動、SDS-PAGE、LC/MS/MSにより9つのスポットが有意に変動していた。FKBP4とNF45はSDS-PAGEでも確認された。著者らは、小児胚細胞腫瘍における糖質コルチコイド受容体シグナル伝達のさらなる検討を提案している。
pmid-21793190.summary_en: Proteomic profiling compared four childhood dysgerminomas, presumed to model self-renewing neoplastic stem cells, with four childhood endodermal sinus tumors, presumed to model differentiating ones. Using 2-DE, SDS-PAGE, and LC-MS/MS, nine differentially regulated spots were identified, including APOA1, CRK, and PDIA3 upregulated in endodermal sinus tumors and TFG, VCP, and FKBP4 upregulated in dysgerminomas. FKBP4 and NF45 were confirmed by SDS-PAGE. The authors suggest that glucocorticoid receptor signaling merits further investigation in childhood germ cell tumors.

pmid-21809391.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織と胎児性癌細胞株で、LINE1およびAlu反復配列のDNAメチル化を解析した。LINE1は全組織型で低メチル化を示した。Alu配列はセミノーマで低メチル化、非セミノーマでメチル化を示し、体細胞由来のがんより脱メチル化が顕著であった。
pmid-21809391.summary_en: This study analyzed DNA methylation of LINE1 and Alu repetitive elements in testicular germ cell tumor tissues, embryonal carcinoma cell lines, adjacent normal testis, and somatic cancers. LINE1 was hypomethylated in both seminomatous and nonseminomatous tumors and in EC cell lines. Two Alu elements were hypomethylated in seminomas but methylated in nonseminomas. Demethylation was more pronounced in germ cell tumors than in somatic cancers, suggesting distinct mechanisms maintain repeat demethylation in these tumors.

pmid-21830006.summary_ja: 卵巣の良性嚢胞性奇形腫2例の報告です。腹腔鏡手術中に、腫瘍が小さく卵巣表面が正常に見えるため位置を特定しにくい場合がありました。著者らは経膣超音波プローブを術中に用い、骨盤腔を生理食塩水で満たして位置を確認しました。その結果、卵巣温存手術が可能になり、簡便で安全な方法であると結論づけています。
pmid-21830006.summary_en: This short report describes two cases of benign ovarian cystic teratoma that were difficult to localize during laparoscopy because they were small and the ovarian surface appeared normal. The authors used a standard transvaginal ultrasound probe inside the operative field, filling the pelvis with saline to create an acoustic interface. This allowed accurate localization and ovary-sparing surgery. They conclude the technique is simple, safe and applicable in most institutions.

pmid-21843901.summary_ja: 成人の精巣類皮嚢腫の症例報告です。腫瘍内に成熟神経組織が認められ、成人例では初めての報告とされています。精巣類皮嚢腫の妥当性には議論があり、精巣の成熟奇形腫とは区別されます。思春期前の持続性奇形腫と考えられ、良性の経過をたどるとされています。
pmid-21843901.summary_en: The authors describe an adult patient with a testicular dermoid cyst containing mature neural tissue, a finding not previously reported in adults. They discuss the debated validity of testicular dermoid cysts, which resemble ovarian dermoids and are distinct from mature teratoma of the testis. Such lesions may be persistent prepubertal teratomas and are thought to behave benignly. The report expands the spectrum of teratomatous elements seen in these tumors and contributes to their classification and understanding.

pmid-21879333.summary_ja: hCG陽性を示した46,XX核型の15歳女児の症例報告です。当初は子宮外妊娠が疑われ、メトトレキサート治療に失敗した後に卵巣腫瘍が発見されました。病理診断は性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマでした。文献的検討では、46,XX性腺芽腫の中で最小径の症例とされています。ホルモン産生腫瘍も鑑別診断に含めるべきとしています。
pmid-21879333.summary_en: The authors report a 15-year-old girl with a 46,XX karyotype and elevated hCG, initially suspected to have an ectopic pregnancy. After methotrexate failed, an ovarian tumor was found and diagnosed as gonadoblastoma with dysgerminoma. The authors reviewed published pure 46,XX gonadoblastoma cases and noted this tumor had the smallest diameter reported. The case highlights that perimenarcheal bleeding and hCG positivity may reflect rare hormone-producing tumors, which should be considered in the differential diagnosis alongside pregnancy.

pmid-21881343.summary_ja: 26歳男性の縦隔セミノーマ症例。導入化学療法後の反応をFDG-PET/CTで評価し、完全切除を実施した。切除標本では腫瘍細胞の生存は認められなかった。化学療法後の最適な管理は未確立であり、PET/CTによる評価の有用性を示す報告である。縦隔原発セミノーマは稀な悪性腫瘍で、速やかな診断と適切な化学療法が重要である。
pmid-21881343.summary_en: A 26-year-old man with mediastinal seminoma was treated with induction chemotherapy, with response assessed by FDG-PET/CT. Complete surgical excision followed, and pathology showed no viable tumor cells. The report notes that optimal post-chemotherapy management of primary mediastinal seminoma remains without consensus, and highlights PET/CT as a tool for guiding decisions about residual masses after chemotherapy.

pmid-21883828.summary_ja: SEERデータを用い、1973~2000年に診断された臨床病期Iの精巣セミノーマ患者を解析した。術後外部照射の使用は経時的に減少した。照射患者では全体の第二悪性腫瘍リスクが19%上昇し、甲状腺、膵臓、尿路上皮、血液悪性腫瘍などで有意に高かった。診断後15年を経てもリスクは持続しており、長期的な説明が必要である。
pmid-21883828.summary_en: This SEER-based population study examined adjuvant external beam radiotherapy use and second primary malignancies in patients with clinical stage I testicular seminoma diagnosed 1973-2000. EBRT use declined over time. Overall second malignancy risk rose 19% in irradiated patients, with significantly increased risks for thyroid, pancreatic, urothelial, bladder and hematologic cancers. Elevated risk persisted 15 years after diagnosis, supporting long-term counseling about radiation-related risks.

pmid-21925852.summary_ja: 発生頻度が低く組織型の多様な精巣腫瘍について、診断と治療の要点を概説した総説である。シスプラチン化学療法やセミノーマの放射線感受性により治癒率は向上した。胚細胞腫瘍の分子基盤や治療抵抗性の機序に関する研究の進展も紹介している。病理と腫瘍学の双方における混乱点の整理と注目領域の提示を目的とする。
pmid-21925852.summary_en: This review addresses the diagnosis and management of testicular tumours, which are rare and highly heterogeneous. It notes that cisplatin chemotherapy and the high radiosensitivity of seminoma have produced excellent cure rates. The authors describe ongoing research into the molecular basis of germ cell tumours and why some tumours resist treatment. The article aims to clarify areas of confusion in testicular pathology and oncology and highlight current topics of interest for clinicians and pathologists. It is an overview rather than primary data.

pmid-21938584.summary_ja: グローニンゲン大学の29例で、播種性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍に対する化学療法後の後腹膜残存腫瘍を腹腔鏡下に切除した成績である。成功率は86%で、成熟奇形腫が55%を占めた。在院日数は短く、早期再発は1例のみであった。適切に選択された患者では有用な選択肢となり得るが、長期的な腫瘍学的効果の検証が必要と結論している。
pmid-21938584.summary_en: This single-centre series from Groningen reports laparoscopic resection of residual retroperitoneal tumour masses in 29 patients with disseminated nonseminomatous testicular germ cell tumours after cisplatin-based chemotherapy. Laparoscopy succeeded in 86% of cases, with three conversions. Histology showed mature teratoma in 55% and viable tumour in one patient. Hospital stay was short, with one early relapse during median follow-up of 47 months. The authors conclude that laparoscopic resection is a feasible option in selected patients, pending long-term oncologic data.

pmid-21948117.summary_ja: セネガルの胞状奇胎後妊娠性絨毛癌患者43例でNLRP7の全エクソンを解析した遺伝学的研究である。患者のみに認められた新規変異3種を同定した。G487Eの頻度は集団間で大きく異なり、アフリカ由来の対立遺伝子が祖先型と考えられた。NLRP7変異の頻度が高い集団は、胞状奇胎と絨毛癌の多発地域と一致する。
pmid-21948117.summary_en: This genetic study sequences NLRP7 in 43 Senegalese women with post-molar gestational choriocarcinoma to assess susceptibility to malignant transformation of hydatidiform moles. Three novel variants were found only in patients, not in controls from Senegal, Tunisia, or Canada. Allele frequencies of the G487E variant differed markedly across populations, with the African allele likely ancestral. The authors suggest higher NLRP7 variant frequencies in Senegal and Tunisia may relate to the greater prevalence of moles and choriocarcinoma there.

pmid-21983876.summary_ja: 64歳男性に発生した膵臓の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告。膵奇形腫は極めて稀な先天性腫瘍で、術前診断が難しいとされる。本症例は画像検査により術前に診断された。文献上26例目の報告であり、嚢胞性膵腫瘤を認めた際の画像評価の重要性と、適切な手術計画の立案につながる点が示されている。
pmid-21983876.summary_en: Case report of a 64-year-old man with a mature cystic teratoma of the pancreas, the 26th reported case. The diagnosis was made preoperatively on imaging. The authors note that the preoperative diagnosis of this congenital tumor arising from totipotent cells is challenging. This is an extragonadal teratoma, relevant to the site's scope.

pmid-21989172.summary_ja: 精子形成におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)による遺伝子発現制御をまとめた総説。翻訳後の制御の乱れが精巣胚細胞腫瘍や精母細胞腫瘍の発生に関与しうるとされる。miRNAの操作は抗腫瘍薬や新たな避妊法への応用が期待される。PubMedを用いた文献検索に基づき、精子形成の分子機構、腫瘍発生との関連、治療・避妊への応用可能性について論じている。
pmid-21989172.summary_en: Review of microRNA regulation of gene expression in mammalian spermatogenesis and its involvement in testicular germ cell tumor development. Disruption of miRNA-mediated post-transcriptional control may contribute to neoplasia. The authors also discuss miRNA-based anticancer reagents and contraceptive applications.

pmid-22026641.summary_ja: 本研究は、276例の思春期前精巣検体を対象に未分類型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCNU)の有無を検討した。6例に異型胚細胞が認められた。間性の3例はIGCNUの基準を満たしたが、ダウン症候群の1例は胚細胞成熟遅延と分類された。間性疾患を除くと、真のIGCNUは見出されなかった。
pmid-22026641.summary_en: This study examined 276 prepubertal testicular specimens for intratubular germ cell neoplasia, unclassified type (IGCNU). Six specimens contained atypical germ cells. Three intersex patients met the IGCNU criteria. One Down syndrome case showed centrally located germ cells with fetal markers (Oct3/4, PLAP, CD117) and was classified as delayed germ cell maturation. The remaining cases proved to involve undiagnosed intersex disorders. The authors found no bona fide IGCNU in prepubertal testes apart from intersex conditions, which informs the pathogenesis and classification of testicular germ cell neoplasia.

pmid-22040835.summary_ja: 卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の幹細胞様細胞(SC-OYST)について、腹膜中皮細胞との共培養が及ぼす影響を検討した。共培養によりCD133陽性NOY1細胞は高いCD133発現、コロニー形成、遊走・浸潤能を示した。CXCR4阻害薬AMD3100は、これらの機能と生体内での腫瘍形成能を抑制した。腹膜中皮細胞が腹膜播種におけるニッチを提供し、治療標的となりうると示唆された。
pmid-22040835.summary_en: This study examined how peritoneal mesothelial cells interact with stem-like cells of ovarian yolk sac tumor (SC-OYST), using the NOY1 cell line sorted by CD133 status. Co-culture with mesothelial cells increased CD133 expression and colony formation, and CD133-positive cells showed greater migration and invasion. The CXCR4 inhibitor AMD3100 suppressed colony formation, migration, invasion, and in vivo tumorigenicity of CD133-positive cells. The authors suggest peritoneal mesothelium provides a niche supporting these cells in peritoneal dissemination, highlighting potential therapeutic targets.

pmid-22052450.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫26例のMRI所見を後方視的に検討し、13例ではコンピュータ断層撮影(CT)所見も比較した。全例が境界明瞭な囊胞性腫瘤で充実成分を伴い、多くは多房性であった。T1高信号点やT2低信号の小腔、CTでの高吸収域と充実成分内の曲線状石灰化が特徴的であった。画像所見が診断に有用であると結論づけられている。
pmid-22052450.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed MR images of 26 struma ovarii cases, with CT images available in 13. All tumors were well-defined cystic masses with solid components, mostly multicystic. Solid components appeared as thickened septa or walls, and T1 high-intensity foci and T2 low-intensity loculi were common. On CT, high attenuation areas and curvilinear calcifications within solid components were frequent. The authors conclude that struma ovarii typically appears as a lobulated multicystic lesion with solid components, and that imaging features aid diagnosis.

pmid-22068256.summary_ja: 64歳の女性が、卵巣甲状腺腫に由来する乳頭状甲状腺癌と判明するまで3年以上、卵巣腺癌として誤って治療されていた症例を報告する。両側卵管卵巣摘出術の既往があっても、卵巣甲状腺腫を鑑別診断に含めることの重要性を強調している。病理医、腫瘍医、外科医の連携も指摘されている。
pmid-22068256.summary_en: A 64-year-old woman was treated for ovarian adenocarcinoma for over three years before papillary thyroid carcinoma arising from struma ovarii was identified. This is reported as the first case of such thyroid carcinoma in a patient with prior bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Possible etiologies include residual ovarian tissue, ectopic thyroid, or metastatic thyroid cancer. The authors stress including struma ovarii in the differential diagnosis even after oophorectomy, and the importance of coordination among pathologists, oncologists, and surgeons.

pmid-22068818.summary_ja: セミノーマ43例、非セミノーマ14例、正常精巣組織23例を対象に、15遺伝子のプロモーターメチル化を解析した。MGMTなど4遺伝子は非セミノーマでメチル化が多く、APCとhMLH1は両組織型で正常精巣より高頻度であった。4遺伝子の組み合わせで非セミノーマの86%を同定できた。組織型と相関するため、今後の大規模検証を経てバイオマーカー開発に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-22068818.summary_en: This study analyzed promoter methylation of 15 cancer-related genes in 43 seminomas, 14 non-seminomas, and 23 normal testis tissues using quantitative methylation-specific PCR. MGMT, VGF, ER-β, and FKBP4 were more often methylated in non-seminomas than in seminomas. APC and hMLH1 were more methylated in both histologies than in normal testis. A combined panel of APC, hMLH1, ER-β, and FKBP4 identified 86% of non-seminomas and 7% of seminomas. The authors suggest the methylation profiles correlate with histology and may aid biomarker development, pending larger validation.

pmid-22072226.summary_ja: 全身型若年性特発性関節炎の19歳患者が、インフリキシマブ治療中に縦隔ジャーミノーマ（胚細胞腫）を発症した症例報告である。インフリキシマブの発がんリスクには議論があるが、本剤がジャーミノーマの増大を促した可能性が指摘されている。TNF阻害薬の適応は厳格に判断すべきであり、全国規模のコホート研究が必要と結論づけている。
pmid-22072226.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old patient with systemic-onset juvenile idiopathic arthritis who developed a mediastinal germinoma during infliximab treatment. The authors note that the cancer risk of infliximab is controversial, but that this agent may have accelerated germinoma growth. They conclude that indications for TNF inhibitors should be strictly decided and that a nationwide cohort study is needed to assess cancer risk in patients with JIA receiving biologics.

pmid-22072546.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍のゲノムワイド解析で同定された4遺伝子（KITLG、SPRY4、BAK1、DMRT1）のバリアントを、小児胚細胞腫瘍52例と新生児141例で比較した。BAK1のrs210138は小児胚細胞腫瘍全体と有意に関連した。KITLGとSPRY4のバリアントは思春期群（10〜21歳）でのみ関連を認めた。これらの遺伝子座が小児・思春期の感受性に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-22072546.summary_en: This study evaluated variants in KITLG, SPRY4, BAK1, and DMRT1, loci identified in adult testicular GCT genome-wide studies, in 52 pediatric germ cell tumors compared with 141 newborn controls. The BAK1 variant rs210138 was significantly associated with pediatric GCT overall. KITLG and SPRY4 variants were associated only in the adolescent group aged 10 to 21 years. Associations were largely similar across sexes. The authors conclude these loci may contribute to GCT susceptibility in adolescents and children, notably through BAK1.

pmid-22075622.summary_ja: 絨毛癌由来の細胞株BeWo、JAR、JEG-3を、PlGF依存性の腫瘍血管新生モデルとして評価した。in vitroと免疫不全マウスの異種移植で解析し、PlGFを中和する融合蛋白sFLT01の効果も検討した。腫瘍血管新生におけるPlGFの役割の解明や、抗血管新生療法の評価に有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-22075622.summary_en: This study characterized three human choriocarcinoma cell lines, BeWo, JAR, and JEG-3, as preclinical models for placental growth factor (PlGF)-dependent tumor angiogenesis. The cells were examined in vitro and in immunodeficient mouse xenografts using ELISA, immunohistochemistry, and double immunofluorescence. The PlGF-neutralizing fusion protein sFLT01 was tested in cell culture and xenograft studies. The authors conclude these models are valuable for exploring PlGF's role in tumor angiogenesis and for evaluating PlGF-targeted anti-angiogenic therapies.

pmid-22075658.summary_ja: 58歳の女性がHartmann手術でS状結腸腫瘍の切除を受け、病理検査で大腸原発の絨毛癌と確定した症例報告である。根治的手術と化学療法の併用が長期生存の最良の機会になると述べている。大腸原発の絨毛癌はきわめて稀であり、病理学的診断の重要性を示す症例である。
pmid-22075658.summary_en: This case report describes a 58-year-old woman whose sigmoid colon tumor, removed by Hartmann's procedure, was pathologically confirmed as primary choriocarcinoma of the colon. The authors note that radical surgery combined with chemotherapy offers the best chance of long-term survival for this rare malignancy. The case underscores the rarity of primary colonic choriocarcinoma and the role of pathological examination in establishing its diagnosis, since the tumor was identified only after surgical resection.

pmid-22078334.summary_ja: 進行期胚細胞腫瘍の残存腫瘍切除を受けた402例（414回）の多施設後方視的解析。残存腫瘍5cm以上が下大静脈介入の独立した予測因子で、IGCCCG中間/不良リスクも関連した。大きな残存腫瘍と不良リスクの患者は血管手術が可能な専門施設へ紹介すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22078334.summary_en: This multicenter German Testicular Cancer Study Group analysis of 402 patients (414 residual tumor resections) identified predictors of additional vascular procedures during residual tumor resection in advanced germ cell tumors. Of the evaluable cases, 40 underwent major vascular procedures, mostly inferior vena cava resection. In multivariate analysis, residual tumor size of 5 cm or more was the strongest predictor (OR 4.61), and intermediate or poor IGCCCG risk was also associated in univariate analysis. The authors recommend referring patients with large residual masses and unfavorable risk to specialized centers.

pmid-22080441.summary_ja: NR5A1変異を持つ46,XY思春期患者2例の解析。1例では精巣上皮内腫瘍の前駆病変が認められ、胚細胞腫瘍リスクの上昇が示された。出生時の表現型は思春期の男性化を予測しにくく、早期の精巣固定術と腫瘍スクリーニングが勧められるとする。
pmid-22080441.summary_en: Two 46,XY adolescents with NR5A1 (SF-1) mutations and a predominantly female phenotype at birth were studied for pubertal course and gonadal histology. Both had LH and testosterone in the normal male range, with virilization disproportionate to the neonatal phenotype. The girl, gonadectomized at 13 years, had incomplete spermatogenesis and bilateral precursor lesions of testicular carcinoma in situ. The boy's bilateral biopsies at 12 years showed germ cells without malignancy. The authors conclude that these patients are at increased risk for malignant germ cell tumors, warranting early orchidopexy and screening.

pmid-22081041.summary_ja: 30代の健康な男性が転落し、剖検で肺原発卵黄嚢腫瘍と心内転移が確認された症例。腫瘍はAFP陽性だった。心腔内腫瘍による流出障害が失神を招き転落につながった可能性が論じられている。死因に関与する潜在疾患を見出すため、詳細な剖検の重要性を強調している。
pmid-22081041.summary_en: A healthy man in his 30s fell down stairs and died after pulmonary contusion and cardiopulmonary arrest. Echocardiography had shown a floating left ventricular mass and severe mitral regurgitation. Autopsy revealed a primary lung yolk sac tumor with a metastatic intracardiac yolk sac tumor, which was positive for alpha-fetoprotein. The authors propose that the cardiac tumor obstructed outflow and caused syncope, which led to the fall. They emphasize that a thorough autopsy can identify latent disease contributing to death.

pmid-22084429.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマが28年後に再発し、低分化神経内分泌癌成分を伴う未分化胚細胞腫瘍として出現した症例。当初は腸管原発腫瘍の転移と誤診された。晩期再発は多様な形態をとり、臨床医・病理医双方にとって診断が困難になりうると指摘する。
pmid-22084429.summary_en: A testicular seminoma recurred 28 years after surgery as an undifferentiated germ cell tumor with a heterologous poorly differentiated neuroendocrine carcinoma component. The neuroendocrine component initially led to misdiagnosis as a metastasis from a primary intestinal tumor. The authors note that late recurrences of testicular germ cell tumors have increased since cisplatin-based chemotherapy improved survival. These recurrences can take variable forms and occur years after the primary tumor, making diagnosis challenging for both clinicians and pathologists.

pmid-22085657.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患（胞状奇胎と持続性絨毛性腫瘍）の多モダリティ画像診断の総説。超音波検査が初期検査として中心で、完全胞状奇胎は「ぶどうの房」像を示す。骨盤MRIは子宮筋層浸潤の評価に、胸部X線・頭部MRI・CTは絨毛癌の転移評価に用いられ、転移巣は高血管性で出血しやすいと述べる。
pmid-22085657.summary_en: This review describes multimodality imaging of gestational trophoblastic disease, spanning hydatidiform moles and persistent trophoblastic neoplasia. Ultrasound is the initial test of choice, showing a cluster-of-grapes appearance in complete moles and a hypervascular myometrial mass in persistent disease. Pelvic MRI helps assess myometrial invasion in equivocal cases. Chest radiography, brain MRI and CT evaluate metastases, which usually arise in choriocarcinoma and are hypervascular and prone to bleeding. The authors stress the role of imaging in staging and management.

pmid-22089368.summary_ja: 2000〜2010年に単施設で治療された小児卵巣腫瘍60例を解析した。大半は良性で、悪性例は卵黄嚢腫瘍やディスジャーミノーマを含み、術後化学療法で予後は良好であった。肺転移を伴う卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例は再発後に死亡した。年長児の良性例には卵巣温存手術を第一選択として推奨している。
pmid-22089368.summary_en: This single-institution study reviewed 60 children treated for ovarian tumors between 2000 and 2010. Most lesions were benign. Malignant cases, including yolk sac tumors and a dysgerminoma, received postoperative chemotherapy and had good prognoses; one yolk sac tumor with lung metastasis died after recurrence. Neonatal cystic lesions were managed with aspiration or umbilical-crease salpingo-oophorectomy. The authors recommend ovary-sparing resection through a modified Rocky Davis incision as first-line treatment for older children with non-malignant preoperative diagnoses.

pmid-22105889.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟奇形腫(皮様嚢腫)の壁内に存在した下垂体腺腫が、極めて高度な高プロラクチン血症の原因となった症例を報告した。皮様嚢腫内の下垂体組織による同様の報告はこれまでにない。卵巣腫瘍による異所性プロラクチン産生を文献的に概説し、血清値が高く脳画像に異常がない場合は異所性産生を考慮すべきとしている。根治には機能組織の外科的切除が必要である。
pmid-22105889.summary_en: A patient had extreme hyperprolactinemia caused by a pituitary adenoma located in the wall of an ovarian dermoid cyst, a mature teratoma. Such marked prolactin elevation from pituitary tissue within a dermoid had not been reported before. The authors review ectopic prolactin production in ovarian tumors and emphasize that ectopic prolactin should be considered when serum levels are elevated but brain imaging is normal. Definitive treatment requires surgical removal of the functioning tissue.

pmid-22114766.summary_ja: 亜麻の根と葉の抽出物が、絨毛癌細胞株Jeg 3およびBeWoのプロゲステロン・エストラジオール産生と、エストロゲン受容体・プロゲステロン受容体の発現に与える影響を検討した。両抽出物はERβ発現を低下させ、プロゲステロン産生も細胞株により抑制された。ホルモン産生を修飾しうる可能性が示され、動物実験や後方視的疫学研究などの追加研究が必要とされている。
pmid-22114766.summary_en: This study examined how crude extracts from flax (Linum usitatissimum) roots and leaves affect progesterone and estradiol production and estrogen and progesterone receptor expression in two choriocarcinoma cell lines, Jeg 3 and BeWo. Root and leaf extracts downregulated progesterone production in a cell-dependent manner, and both extracts reduced ERβ expression in both lines. Leaf extract increased ERα in BeWo cells. The authors conclude that flax extracts can modify progesterone and possibly estradiol production and alter ERβ expression, and call for animal and epidemiological studies.

pmid-22127018.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍における社会経済的地位（SEP）の影響を、発症リスクから生存者ケアまでの段階ごとに総説した。高SEPで発症リスクが高い一方、低SEPでは進行病期での診断や生存率の低下が報告されている。格差是正に向けた研究の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-22127018.summary_en: This narrative review of 63 English-language papers examines how socioeconomic position (SEP) relates to testicular germ cell tumor (TGCT) across risk, diagnosis, treatment, survival, and survivorship. Higher SEP was linked to increased incidence in most studies, while lower SEP was associated with later-stage diagnosis and poorer survival. Lower education was associated with less radiation therapy use in stage I seminoma. The authors call for more research on disparities.

pmid-22127348.summary_ja: 進行した卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍の23歳女性にBEP化学療法を行った症例である。初回投与後に腫瘍崩壊症候群を来たし、血液透析を要した。完全寛解に至ったが、ブレオマイシンによるとみられるグレード4の肺線維症を併発した。腫瘍崩壊後のブレオマイシン毒性に注意を促している。
pmid-22127348.summary_en: The authors describe a 23-year-old woman with stage IIIc pure ovarian yolk sac tumor who received BEP chemotherapy after salpingo-oophorectomy. Tumor lysis syndrome developed after the first infusion and required hemodiafiltration and hemodialysis. She achieved complete remission after three additional cycles but developed grade 4 pulmonary fibrosis, attributed to bleomycin. The report highlights bleomycin toxicity after tumor lysis in rapidly progressing disease.

pmid-22131554.summary_ja: 自動車工場労働者を対象とした症例対照研究で、金属加工液（MWF）への曝露と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した。全体およびセミノーマのリスク上昇は認められなかった。一方、油性MWFへの長期皮膚曝露は非セミノーマ性腫瘍のリスク上昇と関連し、工学的対策と保護具の使用が推奨されている。
pmid-22131554.summary_en: This case-control study of automobile workers examined whether metal-working fluid (MWF) exposure explains an elevated testicular cancer risk linked to metal-cutting tasks. Overall germ cell tumor and seminoma risks were not increased. However, long-term dermal exposure to oil-based MWF was associated with increased risk of non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumors, with particularly high odds for exposure exceeding 5000 hours. The authors recommend engineering controls and personal protective equipment.

pmid-22137539.summary_ja: 免疫組織化学により、正常、胎児、腫瘍の精巣組織においてパルボウイルスB19のカプシドタンパク質VP1およびVP2が検出された。正常精巣では約86%、腫瘍組織では約74%で陽性であった。正常精巣DNAからもB19 DNAが検出された。B19が精巣腫瘍を含む組織に持続しており、がんなどへの関与が示唆されると結論づけられた。
pmid-22137539.summary_en: Immunohistochemistry was used to detect parvovirus B19 capsid proteins VP1 and VP2 in normal, fetal, and tumor testicular tissues, and PCR was used to detect B19 DNA in normal testicular tissue. VP1/VP2 were found in 85.7% of normal adult samples and 73.9% of tumor samples. B19 DNA was detected in normal testicular DNA. The authors conclude that B19 persists in testicular tissues, including tumors, and may play a role in chronic disease and cancer. Further molecular mechanism studies are needed.

pmid-22138413.summary_ja: セミノーマ様細胞株TCam-2を用いて、エストロゲンによる増殖促進機構を検討した。エストラジオールはGPER-cAMP/PKA経路を活性化してERα36の発現を誘導し、EGFRの発現と細胞増殖を促進した。ERα36は将来の予後マーカーとなる可能性があり、in vivoでの検証が必要とされた。
pmid-22138413.summary_en: This study examined how estrogens affect proliferation of the seminoma-like TCam-2 cell line, which lacks ERα. Estradiol and testosterone both stimulated proliferation. Estradiol activated the GPER-cAMP/PKA pathway, inducing ERα36 expression. ERα36 knockdown reduced EGFR expression and cell proliferation, and ERα36 colocalized with cytoskeletal microfilaments, suggesting a role in motility. The authors propose ERα36 as a potential future prognostic marker for seminoma that should be tested in vivo.

pmid-22142638.summary_ja: 乳癌の病期分類のための画像検査中に偶然発見された胃腫瘍の症例である。胃の外科的切除標本では、表層の腺癌と深部粘膜下層の未熟奇形腫の2成分からなる衝突腫瘍であった。リンパ節転移を認めたが、術後18か月無病で経過している。胃原発の性腺外未熟奇形腫と腺癌が併存する稀な症例として報告された。
pmid-22142638.summary_en: A 54-year-old woman had an asymptomatic gastric tumor found during staging for breast carcinoma. Endoscopic biopsy showed poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma. Gastrectomy revealed two components: a superficial lymphoepithelioma-like adenocarcinoma and a deeper submucosal immature teratoma. Lymph node metastasis was present. The patient was disease-free 18 months after surgery. The report describes an unusual collision tumor combining adenocarcinoma with an extragonadal immature teratoma of the stomach.

pmid-22146529.summary_ja: 生後2か月の日本人女児に発生した右後腹膜の未熟奇形腫の症例報告です。腫瘍の約15%が腎芽腫様成分で、未熟奇形腫の成分内に存在していました。奇形腫は器官様配列の有無により奇形様Wilms腫瘍と鑑別されると述べています。予後は確立しておらず、症例の蓄積が必要だと結論づけています。
pmid-22146529.summary_en: This case report describes a 2-month-old girl with a right retroperitoneal immature teratoma containing nephroblastic components, which made up roughly 15% of the tumor. Such combinations are exceptionally rare. The authors emphasize that organoid arrangement distinguishes teratoma from teratoid Wilms tumor, which shows heterologous elements in over half the tumor. Because the prognosis of retroperitoneal teratomas with nephroblastic components is not established, the authors call for more case studies to guide clinical management.

pmid-22162396.summary_ja: 幹細胞特異的RNA結合タンパク質L1TD1が、ヒト胚性幹細胞の自己複製に必要であることを示しています。L1TD1を欠失させるとOCT4とNANOGが速やかに減少しました。L1TD1はセミノーマで高発現しており、その欠失はセミノーマ細胞の自己複製と増殖を阻害しました。L1TD1はRNAを介してLIN28と、またRNAヘリカーゼAと相互作用し、OCT4量を調節する複合体の一部と考えられています。
pmid-22162396.summary_en: This study identifies L1TD1, a stem cell-specific RNA-binding protein, as required for human embryonic stem cell self-renewal. L1TD1 depletion rapidly reduces OCT4 and NANOG, and OCT4, SOX2 and NANOG bind its promoter. L1TD1 is highly expressed in seminomas, and its depletion impairs self-renewal and proliferation of seminoma cells. The authors show that L1TD1 interacts with LIN28 via RNA and with RNA helicase A, proposing a complex that regulates OCT4 levels.

pmid-22167448.summary_ja: 2005～2010年に某施設で病理診断された成熟嚢胞性奇形腫(類皮嚢腫)50例を後方視的に解析した。左右の卵巣にほぼ同数認められ、両側例は5例であった。平均年齢は35.4歳で、腫瘍マーカー上昇が2例、捻転が1例で見られた。悪性転化率は低いと結論づけている。
pmid-22167448.summary_en: This retrospective review of 50 pathology-confirmed mature cystic teratomas (dermoid cysts) at one Turkish centre from 2005 to 2010 describes their anatomical and clinical features. Tumours were distributed almost equally between the right and left ovaries, with 5 bilateral cases. Mean age was 35.4 years, with a range of 14 to 58. Tumour markers were elevated in two patients, one presented with torsion, and one was found incidentally during delivery. The authors conclude that these benign tumours have a low malignant transformation rate.

pmid-22167657.summary_ja: 32歳女性で骨盤内類皮嚢腫に伴う多中心性キャッスルマン病が報告された。両者の併発は初報である。類皮嚢腫に浸潤したCD68陽性マクロファージがIL-6を産生していることが免疫組織化学で示された。嚢腫摘出で症状と血清IL-6は部分的に改善し、抗IL-6受容体抗体投与後に完全に改善した。
pmid-22167657.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman presented with multicentric Castleman disease (MCD) associated with a pelvic dermoid cyst, a combination not previously reported. Immunohistochemistry showed IL-6 produced by CD68-positive macrophages infiltrating the dermoid cyst. Cyst resection partially improved systemic symptoms and lowered serum IL-6. Complete improvement followed anti-IL-6 receptor antibody treatment after resection. The authors propose the dermoid cyst as a source of IL-6 contributing to MCD.

pmid-22168173.summary_ja: 子宮の胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)と考えられた5例に、妊孕性温存術式である改良Strassman法を施行した。1例は寛解を維持し妊孕性を保持した。残り4例は切除不完全のため完全子宮摘出術を要し、うち2例の子宮では残存病変は認められなかった。十分な説明の上で実施すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-22168173.summary_en: This report describes five women with presumed solitary uterine placental site trophoblastic tumours (PSTT) treated with a modified Strassman procedure, a fertility-sparing alternative to radical hysterectomy. One patient remained in remission with intact fertility. Four required completion hysterectomy because of incomplete excision, and no residual disease was found in two of those uteri. The authors advise offering this only after extensive counselling and plan to study intraoperative frozen section with cold-knife dissection.

pmid-22173179.summary_ja: 巨大な後腹膜growing teratoma syndromeに対し、血管合併切除を伴う根治的後腹膜リンパ節郭清を施行した12例を後方視的に検討した。完全切除率は100%で、手術死亡はなかった。追跡期間中央値59か月で10例が無病生存し、1例は転移性悪性黒色腫で死亡、1例は傍大動脈領域に再発した。血管外科手術の併用は正当化されると結論づけている。
pmid-22173179.summary_en: This retrospective series of 12 patients treated with radical RPLND for bulky growing teratoma syndrome (retroperitoneal mass 10 cm or more) evaluated aggressive vascular resection. Procedures included aortic resection and grafting, inferior vena cava resection, and left nephrectomy. All resections were complete, with no operative deaths and acceptable morbidity. With median follow-up of 59 months, 10 patients were disease-free, one died of melanoma, and one had a para-aortic recurrence. The authors consider combined vascular surgery with RPLND justified.

pmid-22175254.summary_ja: SWENOTECA IVの集団ベース研究で、転移性非セミノーマ性精巣がん882例中55例(6.2%)が大量化学療法を受けた。適応は腫瘍マーカー低下不良、手術時の生存腫瘍、選択的再発であった。中央値7.5年の追跡で、全生存率は適応別に72%、100%、58%であった。治療中に3例が死亡し、最も多いグレード4の非血液毒性は腎毒性であった。
pmid-22175254.summary_en: This SWENOTECA population-based study reports 55 men with metastatic non-seminomatous testicular cancer (6.2% of 882 patients) treated with high-dose chemotherapy. Indications were poor tumour marker response, residual vital cancer at surgery, or selected relapses. Median follow-up was 7.5 years. Overall survival was 72%, 100%, and 58% by indication, and failure-free survival was 64%, 71%, and 42%. Three patients died during treatment, and nephrotoxicity was the most common grade 4 non-haematological toxicity.

pmid-22176344.summary_ja: Swyer症候群の16歳女児に発生した両側ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。骨盤内腫瘤で受診し、病期IBと診断された。補助化学療法としてBEP療法を3コース施行。純粋型性腺異形成症では家族内の核型検査が性腺悪性腫瘍の予防に重要と強調している。
pmid-22176344.summary_en: A 16-year-old girl with Swyer syndrome and primary amenorrhea was diagnosed with bilateral dysgerminoma at laparotomy, four years after she presented with a pelvic mass. The tumor was stage IB without capsular invasion. She received adjuvant BEP chemotherapy with three cycles. The authors emphasize that karyotype screening of family members in pure gonadal dysgenesis can help prevent gonadal malignancy.

pmid-22177144.summary_ja: 精巣の胚細胞腫瘍男性119例を後方視的に解析し、診断用放射線被ばく量を推定した研究。セミノーマと非セミノーマで差はなかった。5年以上のフォローアップを受けた患者の78%が年間20mSvの基準を超え、生涯の致死的がんリスクは約2.1%と推定された。画像検査の慎重な運用を提言している。
pmid-22177144.summary_en: This retrospective analysis of 119 men with testicular germ cell tumors estimated cumulative diagnostic radiation exposure. Lifetime and annual doses did not differ between seminoma and nonseminoma groups. Of patients with more than 5 years of follow-up, 78% exceeded the annual 20 mSv guideline. The estimated lifetime excess risk of fatal cancer was 2.1%. The authors recommend judicious use of imaging in this population.

pmid-22177913.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた91例を解析。術中合併症は4.3%、平均在院日数は2.1日であった。pN0・pN1症例では後腹膜再発を認めなかった。安全で有効、腫瘍学的にも妥当なアプローチと結論づけている。
pmid-22177913.summary_en: This review of 91 patients undergoing laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors reports favorable perioperative outcomes, with a 4.3% intraoperative complication rate and a mean hospital stay of 2.1 days. No patient with pN0 or pN1 disease developed retroperitoneal recurrence. Among pN0 patients, five had systemic relapse. The authors conclude that the approach is safe, effective, and oncologically sound.

pmid-22180527.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対し病期分類目的の腹腔鏡下後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた85例を解析。31.8%の患者で転移を認めた。転移陽性リンパ節は平均1.05cm、陰性は0.55cmであった。1cmをカットオフとすると転移の60%を見逃すため、0.7～0.8cmへの引き下げを提案している。
pmid-22180527.summary_en: Analysis of 85 patients who underwent staging laparoscopic retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Metastases were found in 31.8% of patients. Metastatic nodes averaged 1.05 cm versus 0.55 cm for benign nodes. A 1 cm cutoff would miss 60% of metastatic nodes, so the authors suggest lowering the threshold to 0.7–0.8 cm, which yields 70% sensitivity and specificity.

pmid-22180529.summary_ja: 28歳男性の右肺全体を占めた肺原発悪性奇形腫の剖検例と文献的考察。腫瘍は軟骨肉腫様、骨肉腫様、脂肪肉腫様などの悪性間葉系成分と、悪性上皮成分が混在していた。極めて稀な疾患であり、文献をレビューしている。
pmid-22180529.summary_en: A case report of a 28-year-old man with a primary malignant teratoma involving the entire right lung, diagnosed at autopsy. The tumor combined malignant mesenchymal components resembling chondrosarcoma, osteosarcoma, liposarcoma and pleomorphic sarcoma with malignant epithelial elements. The authors review the literature on this rare entity.

pmid-22181336.summary_ja: 卵巣甲状腺腫由来の高分化甲状腺癌4例の報告と文献53例のレビュー。全例が中央値9年のフォローアップで無病生存であった。卵巣内限局例の25年累積再発率は7.5%と低値であった。卵巣外進展や遠隔転移がなければ、広範な骨盤内手術は必要ない可能性を示している。
pmid-22181336.summary_en: This report of four patients with well-differentiated thyroid cancer arising in struma ovarii, together with a review of 53 literature cases, found all four alive without disease at a median follow-up of 9 years. The pooled 25-year cumulative recurrence rate for ovary-confined disease was 7.5%. The authors suggest that extensive pelvic surgery and prophylactic total thyroidectomy may be reserved for extra-ovarian spread or distant metastasis.

pmid-22194441.summary_ja: 426例の精巣胚細胞腫瘍症例と614例の対照を用いた関連解析で、KITLGの2つの変異（rs995030、rs4471514）を検討した。いずれもTGCTのリスク増加と関連し、リスクアレルのホモ接合体では約7倍のリスクであった。関連は特にセミノーマで強かった。これらのマーカーは精子産生とは関連せず、KITLGは精子形成機能とは独立してTGCTの発生に影響することが示唆された。
pmid-22194441.summary_en: This association study of 426 testicular germ cell tumor cases and 614 controls examined KITLG variants rs995030 and rs4471514. Both variants were associated with increased TGCT risk, with homozygous risk-allele carriers showing about sevenfold higher risk, and the association was strongest for seminoma. The markers were not related to sperm production, suggesting that KITLG influences TGCT risk independently of spermatogenic function.

pmid-22198244.summary_ja: 低増殖性で化学療法抵抗性を示す絨毛癌または持続性胞状奇胎に対する治療戦略を追跡した。低い過糖鎖修飾ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG、40%未満)またはhCG倍加時間が2週間を超えることで対象を同定し、hCGが3000mIU/mlを超えるまで化学療法を延期した。新規19例中16例が治療に成功し、既報を合わせると計24例で有効性が示された。
pmid-22198244.summary_en: This study extends a treatment strategy for minimally aggressive gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, in which choriocarcinoma or persistent hydatidiform mole is slow-growing and chemorefractory. Patients were identified by low hyperglycosylated hCG (below 40%) or an hCG doubling time over two weeks, and chemotherapy was deferred until hCG exceeded 3000 mIU/ml. Of 19 newly identified patients, 16 were successfully treated, bringing the total to 24 women successfully treated with this protocol.

pmid-22202548.summary_ja: 進行非セミノーマ性精巣がんで化学療法後に後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた532例のうち、130例(24%)は後腹膜外の残存腫瘤も切除されました。その約3分の1で奇形腫または活性のある非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍が確認され、後腹膜外の組織学的所見は独立した進行予測因子でした。5年無増悪生存率は74%でした。
pmid-22202548.summary_en: This institutional review of 532 patients with advanced nonseminomatous germ cell testicular cancer who underwent postchemotherapy retroperitoneal lymph node dissection assessed the 130 patients (24%) who also had resection of extraretroperitoneal residual masses. Teratoma or viable NSGCT was found in about one-third of these resected extraretroperitoneal lesions. Histology at the extraretroperitoneal site independently predicted progression, with 5-year freedom from progression of 74%. Concordance with retroperitoneal histology was low for teratoma and viable tumor, so extraretroperitoneal residual disease should be assessed separately.

pmid-22211141.summary_ja: 85歳女性の子宮体部腫瘍で、類内膜腺癌と絨毛癌成分、腹膜播種を伴う漿液性乳頭状腺癌が併存していた症例報告です。手術と保存的治療後20週で、ダグラス窩に再発が出現しました。再発腫瘍は原発巣と異なる低分化癌で、腫瘍細胞の多方向分化と高悪性度転化を示しています。
pmid-22211141.summary_en: This case report describes an 85-year-old woman with a mixed uterine carcinoma. The tumor combined endometrioid adenocarcinoma with squamous differentiation, choriocarcinoma, and a disseminated papillary serous peritoneal nodule. After surgery and conservative treatment, a recurrence in the Douglas pouch appeared 20 weeks later, showing poorly differentiated carcinoma unlike the primary. The case shows high-grade transformation and divergent differentiation of tumor cells.

pmid-22213325.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発腫瘍と細胞株でビタミンD受容体(VDR)のmRNAとタンパク質発現を初めて示した研究です。ビタミンDはGADD45の発現増加を介して細胞株の増殖を抑制する可能性があります。ビタミンD受容体シグナルが発症や抗腫瘍療法に関与する可能性が示唆されています。
pmid-22213325.summary_en: This study shows that primary testicular germ cell tumors and TGCT cell lines express the vitamin D receptor (VDR) at mRNA and protein levels. Vitamin D inhibited proliferation of TGCT cell lines, possibly via increased GADD45 expression. Expression of several other vitamin D-regulated genes was also examined as potential contributors to pathogenesis. The findings suggest vitamin D signaling may play a role in TGCT biology and could be explored as part of antitumor therapy.

pmid-22225777.summary_ja: Aicardi症候群の4歳女児に、口腔原発の性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍が生じた症例を報告する。非常に稀な胚細胞腫瘍である。臨床経過と診断の過程を示し、組織発生の推定と口腔内腫瘤の鑑別診断を考察する。口腔原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告は極めて少ない。
pmid-22225777.summary_en: A 4-year-old girl with Aicardi syndrome presented with a primary oral extragonadal yolk sac tumor, a rare germ cell tumor.
