pmid-20399485.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後に混合型胚細胞腫瘍と診断され化学療法を受けた24歳男性の症例報告。フォローアップ画像検査で後腹膜の残存病変と下大静脈内の腫瘍栓が判明した。手術で大静脈切開により腫瘍栓を摘出し、病理学的に成熟奇形腫と確認された。進行した胚細胞腫瘍では、大静脈内腫瘍栓の可能性に注意し外科的切除に備える必要があると述べている。
pmid-20399485.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with mixed germ cell tumor who received chemotherapy after orchiectomy. Follow-up imaging showed residual retroperitoneal disease and a thrombus within the inferior vena cava. During surgery, a cavotomy was performed to extract the intracaval mass, which pathology confirmed as mature teratoma. The authors emphasize that surgeons should be alert to caval tumor thrombus and prepared for resection in advanced germ cell tumors.

pmid-20408995.summary_ja: WT1遺伝子変異によるFrasier症候群の患者が、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫により急性腹膜症候群で発症した症例報告。治療後、腎移植を受けた後に腫瘍が再発し、非典型的な経過をたどった。性分化疾患の患者では性腺の胚細胞腫瘍に対する厳重なフォローアップの重要性と、移植後の再発への注意を示している。
pmid-20408995.summary_en: This report describes a patient with Frasier syndrome, an inherited WT1-related disorder with high gonadoblastoma risk and progressive renal failure. The patient presented with acute peritoneal syndrome due to an ovarian dysgerminoma. After treatment and renal transplantation, the disease recurred, producing an unusual clinical course. The case highlights the importance of close surveillance for gonadal germ cell tumors in patients with disorders of sex development and of recognizing recurrence after transplantation.

pmid-20429722.summary_ja: 1985年から2004年にかけてのエストニアの精巣がんの生存率を、がん登録データと診療記録から解析した集団ベースの研究。5年相対生存率は47.9%から74.5%に上昇したが、30歳未満に比べ30歳以上の改善は限定的だった。精巣摘除術後に腫瘍専門医へ紹介されないことや診断の不備、放射線療法の利用の少なさなどが課題とされた。専門がんセンターでの集約的な医療提供が勧められている。
pmid-20429722.summary_en: This population-based study analyzed testicular cancer survival in Estonia between 1985 and 2004 using cancer registry data and clinical record reviews. Five-year relative survival rose from 47.9% to 74.5%, with marked gains in patients under 30 but modest improvement in older patients. Deficiencies included lack of oncology referral after orchiectomy, incomplete diagnostic workup, and low radiotherapy use. The authors recommend coordinated care through specialized cancer centers.

pmid-20452116.summary_ja: 原発性肺純粋型卵黄嚢腫瘍の1例を報告した症例報告。肺原発の胚細胞腫瘍は絨毛癌や卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例がごく少数に限られる。非転移性の胚細胞腫瘍は通常前縦隔に発生するが、本症例は診断と治療の両面で非典型的な特徴を示した。稀な胚細胞腫瘍の診断上の難しさと治療の検討について述べている。
pmid-20452116.summary_en: This case report presents a primary pulmonary pure yolk sac tumor, a very rare entity because primary lung germ cell tumors are limited to a few choriocarcinoma cases and rare yolk sac tumors. Although most non-metastatic germ cell tumors arise in the anterior mediastinum, this lung tumor showed atypical features in both diagnosis and treatment. The paper highlights the diagnostic challenges and therapeutic considerations for this unusual presentation of a germ cell tumor.

pmid-20459340.summary_ja: 経膣分娩後の37歳女性が腹痛を訴えた症例。妊娠中の超音波検査では漿膜下筋腫が疑われていた。最終的に、分娩時のクリステレル圧出法により卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫が破裂し、化学性腹膜炎を起こしていたと判明した。妊娠中または産後の女性の腹痛では、卵巣奇形腫の破裂も考慮すべきだと助産スタッフに注意を促している。
pmid-20459340.summary_en: A 37-year-old postpartum woman presented with abdominal pain initially attributed to uterine involution or endometritis. Ultrasound had suggested a subserosal myoma during pregnancy. The pain was ultimately traced to chemical peritonitis caused by rupture of a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, which occurred during Kristeller's maneuver in vaginal delivery. The authors urge maternity care providers to consider ovarian teratoma rupture in pregnant or postpartum women with abdominal pain.

pmid-20461442.summary_ja: 16歳時に松果体ジャーミノーマの治療を受けた既往のある32歳男性が、後に精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍を発症した症例報告。頭蓋内胚細胞腫瘍から精巣へ播種した例は確認されておらず、異時性の精巣胚細胞腫瘍は極めて稀とされる。二つの腫瘍が独立した原発か、関連した疾患かという点を提起し、長期的なフォローアップの必要性を示している。
pmid-20461442.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man who developed a mixed testicular germ cell tumor after previously being treated for a pineal germinoma at age 16. The authors note that metachronous testicular germ cell tumors after intracranial germinoma are extremely rare, and that dissemination of intracranial GCT to the testes has not previously been confirmed. The case raises the question of whether the two tumors were independent primaries or related disease, and underscores the need for long-term surveillance.

pmid-20478006.summary_ja: 22年間に先天性仙骨前部腫瘤の外科的治療を受けた小児17例を後方視的に検討した研究。最も多い病変は成熟奇形腫で、悪性例も3例含まれた。多くが便秘を主訴とし、Currarino症候群を合併していた。1歳以上の小児では悪性化のリスクが高く、早期の外科的切除が必要だと結論づけている。
pmid-20478006.summary_en: This retrospective review evaluated 17 children who underwent surgery for congenital presacral masses over 22 years. Mature teratoma was the most common lesion, including three malignancies, and most patients presented with constipation and were diagnosed with Currarino syndrome. Malignancy risk was higher in children older than one year. The authors conclude that presacral tumors in children are mostly mature teratomas, either sacrococcygeal or associated with Currarino syndrome, and recommend early surgical resection.

pmid-20497257.summary_ja: 精巣がんにおけるPOU5F1とRASSF1Aの異常発現に、ヒストンH3のメチル化が関与するかを検討した基礎研究。非セミノーマ胚細胞腫瘍の全組織型でH3-K4およびK9のメチル化が認められた。非セミノーマ細胞株をクロマチン修飾薬の5-アザ-2'-デオキシシチジンで処理すると、RASSF1Aの発現は回復し、POU5F1の発現は低下した。遺伝子ごとに異なるヒストン修飾が精巣がんの遺伝子発現異常を引き起こすことが示唆された。
pmid-20497257.summary_en: This laboratory study examined whether histone H3 methylation regulates aberrant expression of POU5F1 and RASSF1A in testis cancer. Immunostaining showed H3-K4 and K9 methylation in all histological subtypes of non-seminoma germ cell tumors. Treating non-seminoma cell lines with 5-aza-2'-deoxycytidine restored RASSF1A expression through loss of silencing H3-K9 methylation, while reducing POU5F1 expression by removing activating H3-K4 di-methylation. The findings suggest gene-specific histone modifications drive testis cancer misregulation.

pmid-20523207.summary_ja: 再発純粋セミノーマの48例に対し、大量化学療法と自家末梢血幹細胞移植を行った後方視的研究。全体の79%が完全寛解に達し、全生存率は75%だった。初回再発例の92%は完全寛解となった。三次または四次治療として行った例では完全寛解は67%、全生存率は64%で、治療関連死が3例あった。再発セミノーマにおいて高い奏効率と生存率が期待できると結論づけている。
pmid-20523207.summary_en: This retrospective study evaluated 48 patients with relapsed pure seminoma treated with high-dose carboplatin and etoposide followed by autologous peripheral blood stem cell transplant. Overall, 79% achieved complete response, and overall survival was 75%. Among 24 patients with first relapse, 92% achieved complete response. Those treated as third- or fourth-line therapy had a 67% response rate and 64% survival, with three treatment-related deaths. The authors conclude that high-dose chemotherapy yields high response and survival rates in relapsed seminoma.

pmid-20582733.summary_ja: 30歳男性が鉄欠乏性貧血と食後腹痛で受診し、小腸原発セミノーマと確定診断された。腹腔鏡下空腸切除とシスプラチンベース化学療法で良好な治療効果を得た。精巣外発生の成因も考察されている。
pmid-20582733.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old man with iron deficiency anaemia and postprandial abdominal pain. CT showed small bowel wall thickening and mesenteric lymphadenopathy. Laparoscopic jejunal resection confirmed a primary seminoma of the small bowel with lymph node involvement. The patient received three courses of cisplatin-based chemotherapy with a good response. The authors discuss possible origins, including embryonic anomaly, lymphatic drainage from the testis, and occult or regressed testicular lesions. They conclude that unexplained iron deficiency anaemia in young men warrants full gastrointestinal investigation.

pmid-20637459.summary_ja: 45,X/46,XY混合性性腺異形成の15歳女性の症例報告である。原発性無月経と膣中隔で受診し、腹腔鏡下両側性腺摘出で左側は性腺芽腫由来のディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）、右側は性腺芽腫と判明した。術後CTで肺転移が疑われたが、患者は化学療法を選択せず保存的管理となった。性腺異形成に伴う悪性化リスクと、多職種による診療の必要性を強調している。
pmid-20637459.summary_en: This case report describes a 15-year-old female with 45,X/46,XY mixed gonadal dysgenesis who presented with primary amenorrhea and a transverse vaginal septum. Laparoscopic bilateral gonadectomy revealed dysgerminoma arising from gonadoblastoma in the left gonad and gonadoblastoma in the right. Postoperative CT suggested possible lung metastases, but the patient chose conservative management without chemotherapy. The authors emphasize the inherent malignancy risk of gonadal dysgenesis and the need for multidisciplinary diagnosis and care.

pmid-20643666.summary_ja: 精巣混合性胚細胞腫瘍で腹部転移を認め化学療法を受けた2例を報告する。画像検査で後腹膜病変が持続したため後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行ったところ、上皮様細胞の小集団が見つかった。当初は再発した転移性セミノーマと判断されたが、免疫組織化学染色により傍神経節細胞と確認された。両者の鑑別点を示し、悪性腫瘍の過剰診断を避けることの重要性を強調している。
pmid-20643666.summary_en: Two patients with a history of mixed testicular germ cell tumor and abdominal metastases, treated with chemotherapy, showed persistent retroperitoneal disease on follow-up imaging. After retroperitoneal lymph node dissection, multifocal clusters of epithelioid cells were initially read as recurrent metastatic seminoma. Immunohistochemistry later identified them as paraganglionic cells. The authors describe morphologic features that distinguish paraganglia from metastatic seminoma and stress avoiding overdiagnosis of malignancy in patient management.

pmid-20695923.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常なヒト胎児および成人の精巣、上皮内癌(CIS)、ならびにセミノーマ、胎児性癌、奇形腫を含む胚細胞腫瘍において、ヘテロクロマチンマーカーH3K9me3、HP1α、HP1γと、DNA損傷マーカーγH2AXおよび増殖マーカーを検討した。HP1γは胎児の生殖細胞、CIS、セミノーマで高値を示し、HP1αは上皮性および神経性分化を示す奇形腫の構造で増強していた。CISでは、DDRの活性化を伴わずにヘテロクロマチン化が生じており、生殖細胞の初期腫瘍形成における独自の応答が示唆される。
pmid-20695923.summary_en: This study examined heterochromatin marks H3K9me3, HP1alpha, and HP1gamma alongside the DNA damage marker gammaH2AX and proliferation markers in normal fetal and adult human testes, carcinoma in situ, and germ cell tumors including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, and teratomas. HP1gamma was high in fetal gonocytes, carcinoma in situ, and seminomas, while HP1alpha was enhanced in teratoma structures with epithelial and neuronal differentiation. Heterochromatinization in carcinoma in situ occurred without DNA damage response activation, suggesting distinct early tumorigenic responses in germ cells.

pmid-20737560.summary_ja: 精巣摘除術後、補助化学療法前の新規診断の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の男性を対象に、神経心理学的検査で認知機能を評価した。約46%に認知機能障害が認められ、健常者の基準値より有意に多かった。運動機能、言語性学習、遂行機能の障害が多く見られた。治療前から認知機能障害が存在するため、経時的な追跡と介入の必要性が示された。
pmid-20737560.summary_en: This study assessed cognition in men with newly diagnosed nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis after orchiectomy but before adjuvant chemotherapy. Using neuropsychological tests and mood questionnaires, about 46% showed cognitive impairment, significantly more than healthy norms. Deficits were most frequent in motor function, verbal learning, and executive function. The authors conclude that cognitive dysfunction is common before treatment and recommend longitudinal tracking and interventions for survivors.

pmid-20739008.summary_ja: 侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍、類上皮性トロホブラスト腫瘍を含む妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の分類と治療を概説した総説である。非転移性および低リスク転移性例は単剤化学療法でほぼ100%の生存率が得られる。高リスク例は多剤併用化学療法が必要で、生存率は80〜90%である。綿密な評価と病期分類が治療選択の鍵とされる。
pmid-20739008.summary_en: This review describes the classification and management of gestational trophoblastic neoplasia, including invasive mole, choriocarcinoma, placental site trophoblastic tumor, and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. It explains that thorough evaluation and staging guide therapy. Nonmetastatic and low-risk metastatic disease can be treated with single-agent chemotherapy with near-100% survival. High-risk disease requires multiagent chemotherapy, sometimes with radiation or surgery, achieving 80-90% survival. The overall cure rate exceeds 90%.

pmid-20868391.summary_ja: 本施設の胚細胞腫瘍における悪性転化48例を再検討した症例集積である。病期Iは全例が無病生存であった一方、病期IIIでは5年全生存期間(全生存率)が44%にとどまった。転化時の病期III、不完全な外科的切除、原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍や腺癌成分が予後不良因子であった。胚細胞腫瘍に合わせた化学療法と国際登録データベースも提案されている。
pmid-20868391.summary_en: This single-institution case series of 48 patients with malignant transformation within germ cell tumours re-reviewed pathology and treatment outcomes. All stage I patients remained disease-free, while five-year overall survival was 80% for stage II and 44% for stage III. Stage III at transformation, incomplete surgical removal, and primitive neuroectodermal or adenocarcinoma histology predicted worse survival. The authors also propose GCT-tailored chemotherapy within a multimodal strategy and an international registry for malignant transformation cases.

pmid-20869284.summary_ja: 19歳女性が腹痛と大量の腹水で受診し、胎児性癌成分を大きく含む悪性混合型卵巣胚細胞腫瘍と診断された症例報告である。外科的切除と化学療法で治療された。若年女性に多い本疾患では妊孕性温存手術を考慮した治療計画が重要であり、多くの患者が卵巣機能を保ち出産が可能であると述べられている。
pmid-20869284.summary_en: This case report describes a 19-year-old woman with abdominal pain and massive ascites who was found to have a malignant mixed ovarian germ cell tumour with a large embryonal carcinoma component. She was treated with surgical resection followed by chemotherapy. The authors emphasise that malignant germ cell tumours often affect adolescents, so fertility-sparing surgery and careful chemotherapy planning are essential. With these approaches, most patients can preserve ovarian function and later bear children.

pmid-20880069.summary_ja: 欧州神経学会連合(EFNS)のタスクフォースによる、傍腫瘍症候群に伴う原発腫瘍のスクリーニングの総説である。奇形腫や精巣腫瘍を含む複数の腫瘍が対象である。胸部CTやPET、超音波検査などの推奨が示されたが、エビデンスレベルは低く、合意に基づく提案である。
pmid-20880069.summary_en: This European Federation of Neurological Societies task force reviews how to screen for underlying tumours in paraneoplastic neurological syndromes. It covers small cell lung cancer, thymoma, breast cancer, ovarian carcinoma, and teratoma with testicular tumours. Recommendations include chest CT followed by FDG-PET, mammography with MRI, and pelvic ultrasound, with testicular ultrasound for men under 50 with dermatomyositis. Most evidence was low-level, so recommendations rest on consensus good-practice points.

pmid-20880698.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の症例367例と対照214例を対象に、アンドロゲン受容体遺伝子の多型を解析した研究である。非コードSNPのrs12014709のマイナー遺伝子型が発症リスクの上昇と関連し、GGN反復配列が短いことは転移性疾患のリスク上昇と関連した。アンドロゲン作用と環境因子の相互作用の関与が示唆されたが、関連性の検証は今後の課題である。
pmid-20880698.summary_en: This study of 367 testicular germ cell tumour cases and 214 controls examined androgen receptor gene polymorphisms in relation to risk, histology, and metastatic progression. A minor genotype of the non-coding SNP rs12014709 was associated with higher risk of testicular germ cell tumour, and a short GGN repeat was linked to metastatic disease. The authors suggest that androgen action and gene-environment interactions contribute to testicular malignancy. The associations require replication in future studies.

pmid-20881837.summary_ja: 精巣セミノーマ62例を対象とした後方視的研究で、p53、Ki67、CD30、CD117の発現を免疫組織化学で評価した。診断時の臨床的転移の有無で発現に差はなく、腫瘍径6cm超や精巣網浸潤との相関も認められなかった。これらのマーカーは臨床病期Iの症例で転移や組織学的リスク因子を予測しないと結論づけられている。
pmid-20881837.summary_en: This retrospective study of 62 pure testicular seminoma patients evaluated immunohistochemical expression of p53, Ki67, CD30 and CD117. Most patients were clinical stage I, and CD117 was expressed in 90% of cases. Expression of these markers did not differ between seminomas with and without clinical metastasis at diagnosis, nor did it correlate with tumour size above 6 cm or rete testis invasion. The authors conclude that these markers do not predict metastasis or other histopathological risk factors in clinical stage I disease.

pmid-20882281.summary_ja: ラットに移植したヒト胎児性癌異種移植片を用い、化学療法後の残存腫瘤でαvβ3インテグリンイメージングが成熟奇形腫と壊死を鑑別できるかを検証した前臨床研究である。成熟奇形腫は18F-FDG集積が低く、αvβ3イメージングでは両者が明確に区別された。非セミノーマ性精巣がんのFDG陰性残存腫瘤の評価に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-20882281.summary_en: This preclinical study used human embryonal carcinoma xenografts in rats to test whether integrin αvβ3 imaging can distinguish mature teratoma from necrosis in residual masses after chemotherapy. Cisplatin plus all-trans retinoic acid induced differentiation into mature teratoma with low FDG uptake. The tracer [99mTc]HYNIC-RGD clearly separated mature teratoma from necrosis, with strong αvβ3 expression in glandular structures. The authors conclude that αvβ3 imaging may help evaluate FDG-negative residual masses after treatment of non-seminomatous testicular cancer.

pmid-20924286.summary_ja: 耐糖能異常のある74歳女性が男性化とテストステロン高値を呈した症例報告である。左卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と乳癌が同時に見つかり、両腫瘍の同時外科的切除後にテストステロン値は低下した。ブレンナー腫瘍を含む奇形腫が、アンドロゲン産生酵素を介して高値の原因と考えられた。極めてまれな症例とされる。
pmid-20924286.summary_en: This case report describes a 74-year-old woman with impaired glucose tolerance who presented with virilization and markedly elevated testosterone. Imaging revealed a left ovarian mature cystic teratoma, and a left breast cancer was also found. Simultaneous surgical resection of both tumours lowered testosterone levels. The ovarian lesion contained a Brenner tumor and was considered the source of androgen production through androgenic enzymes. The authors note that this presentation is extremely rare.

pmid-20926549.summary_ja: ブリティッシュコロンビア州の2施設で1999〜2008年に診断された精巣セミノーマ649例の集団ベース研究。病期Iでは積極的監視が増加し、予防的放射線療法は減少した。病期II・IIIは放射線療法またはリスク適応型化学療法を受け、104例中101例が長期寛解を維持した。追跡期間中央値47か月で、セミノーマまたは治療により死亡したのは1%未満だった。治療負担を抑えつつ、ほぼ全例で病勢制御が得られた。
pmid-20926549.summary_en: This population-based study of 649 patients with testicular seminoma from two British Columbia-region centers (1999-2008) shows increasing use of active surveillance for clinical stage I disease and decreasing prophylactic radiotherapy. Stage II/III patients received radiotherapy or IGCCCG risk-adapted chemotherapy, with 101 of 104 in long-term remission. Less than 1% died of seminoma or its treatment over a median follow-up of 47 months. Progressive adoption of surveillance and risk-adapted chemotherapy achieved near-universal disease control while reducing treatment burden.

pmid-20940164.summary_ja: 縦隔の巨大腫瘤と血小板減少、腫瘍マーカー高値を呈した39歳男性の症例。骨髄と末梢血のフローサイトメトリーにより、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍と急性骨髄性白血病の合併と診断された。両疾患に併用化学療法を実施したところ、腫瘍マーカーは低下したものの腫瘍は増大し、growing teratoma syndromeが疑われた。導入療法後に外科的切除を行った。稀な病態であり、有効な治療指針の確立にはさらなる症例の蓄積が必要である。
pmid-20940164.summary_en: A 39-year-old man presented with a giant mediastinal mass, thrombocytopenia, and high tumor markers. Flow cytometry of bone marrow and blood revealed a mediastinal germ cell tumor with concurrent acute myeloid leukemia. He received combination chemotherapy for both conditions. Although tumor markers fell, the mass enlarged, consistent with growing teratoma syndrome. After induction therapy, the tumor was surgically resected. The authors note this rare syndrome needs more cases to guide effective treatment.

pmid-20952274.summary_ja: 58歳女性の卵巣原発扁平上皮癌で、単胚葉性嚢胞性粘液性奇形腫由来と考えられる症例。腫瘍と隣接する粘液性嚢胞の内張りはp63とCK5/6に強陽性を示した。このパターンは良性・境界悪性の粘液性嚢胞腺腫には見られず、成熟奇形腫に存在する。p63とCK5/6染色は、単胚葉性奇形腫を従来型の粘液性腫瘍と鑑別する助けとなる可能性がある。
pmid-20952274.summary_en: A 58-year-old woman had primary squamous carcinoma of the ovary, likely arising from a monodermal cystic mucinous teratoma. The non-involved ovary lacked other typical precursor or mimicking lesions. The tumor and adjacent mucinous cyst lining both showed strong p63 and CK5/6 positivity, a basal-cell pattern absent in benign and borderline mucinous cystadenomas but present in mature teratomas. The authors propose p63 and CK5/6 staining may help distinguish monodermal cystic mucinous teratoma from conventional mucinous tumors.

pmid-20952296.summary_ja: 副鼻腔の奇形癌肉腫症例を報告し、AFP陽性の硝子様小体を含む卵黄嚢成分と、未熟な上皮・神経上皮・間葉成分への基底層未分化細胞からの移行像を示した。これらの所見は成体体性幹細胞ではなく多能性胚性幹細胞に由来する奇形腫様腫瘍であることを示唆する。12p13の過剰コピーを示す腫瘍細胞亜集団も認められ、体性由来とする従来仮説に一石を投じている。
pmid-20952296.summary_en: This case report describes a sinonasal teratocarcinosarcoma containing yolk sac elements with papillary structures, intracytoplasmic PAS-positive hyaline globules, and alpha-fetoprotein positivity. An expanded layer of undifferentiated cells in the basal mucosal epithelium merged into immature epithelial, neuroepithelial, and mesenchymal components, suggesting origin from pluripotent embryonic-like stem cells rather than an adult somatic stem cell. Fluorescence in situ hybridization showed a tumor subpopulation with an extra copy of chromosome 12p13, supporting a teratomatous origin and challenging the prevailing somatic-origin hypothesis.

pmid-20955261.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ患者14例の晩期再発を検討した。再発は初診から中央値76.5か月後に生じ、純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍が最も多い組織型であった。再発例の一部は非胚細胞性悪性腫瘍であり、奇形腫を伴わず卵黄嚢成分から生じた例もあった。評価可能な12例中4例で高度マイクロサテライト不安定性が、4例でBRAF V600E変異が認められ、化学療法抵抗性との関連が示唆された。
pmid-20955261.summary_en: This study analyzed histopathology and molecular features in 14 patients with late relapse of non-seminomatous germ cell tumors, with relapse occurring a median of 76.5 months after initial diagnosis. Archival tissue from initial and relapse samples was examined by histology, microsatellite instability testing, and KRAS and BRAF mutation screening. Pure yolk sac tumor was the most common relapse histology, and some relapses were non-germ cell malignancies, including cases arising from yolk sac histology without teratoma. Microsatellite instability occurred in four of twelve evaluable patients and BRAF V600E in four patients, suggesting possible links to chemotherapy resistance.

pmid-20977544.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍43例を免疫組織化学で解析し、APAF-1発現を増殖マーカーや分化マーカーと比較した。APAF-1はセミノーマで非セミノーマより高く、分化が進むにつれて低下した。2種の細胞株でAPAF-1をノックダウンすると、増殖マーカーや未分化マーカーが減少し、分化マーカーが増加した。APAF-1の高発現は未分化な状態と関連すると結論づけられている。
pmid-20977544.summary_en: This study evaluated APAF-1 expression by immunohistochemistry in 43 testicular germ cell tumour samples and six normal testis specimens, alongside markers of apoptosis, proliferation, and differentiation. APAF-1 was higher in seminomas than in non-seminomas and decreased with greater differentiation, from seminoma and embryonal carcinoma to teratoma. In two cell lines, APAF-1 knockdown reduced Ki-67 and Oct-3/4 and increased mesodermal and ectodermal differentiation markers. The authors conclude that higher APAF-1 expression is associated with an undifferentiated state in the testicular germ cell tumour pathway.

pmid-21040368.summary_ja: 1984〜2008年に当施設で治療された13歳以下の小児精巣腫瘍15例の後方視的研究。大部分は良性で、奇形腫や類表皮嚢胞が多かった。11例で精巣温存手術が行われた。腫瘍マーカー陰性の触知可能な腫瘤では精巣温存手術が推奨され、再発予防のため十分な切除が必要とされる。
pmid-21040368.summary_en: This retrospective review covers 15 children aged 13 years or younger with testicular tumours treated from 1984 to 2008. Most lesions were benign, including teratomas and epidermoid cysts. Testis-preserving surgery was achieved in 11 patients. Malignant cases, including yolk sac tumour, mixed germ cell tumours and gonadoblastoma, underwent radical orchiectomy. The authors advise testis-sparing surgery for a palpable mass with negative tumour markers, with thorough excision to avoid recurrence.

pmid-21048038.summary_ja: 精巣がん患者122例を対象に、精巣摘除術後の基線時と治療終了後約12カ月のフォローアップ時に神経心理機能を前向きに評価した研究。シスプラチン併用化学療法の実施回数による3群間で、認知機能低下の割合に有意差はなかった。1年時点で全身化学療法による明らかな悪影響は認められなかった。
pmid-21048038.summary_en: This prospective study assessed neuropsychological function in 122 testicular cancer patients at baseline after orchidectomy and at about 12 months after treatment. Patients were grouped by no chemotherapy, one cycle, or two or more cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy. No significant difference in the proportion showing decline was found between groups. Decline was not linked to chemotherapy, distress or fatigue, indicating no negative effect at one-year follow-up.

pmid-21054156.summary_ja: 傍脊柱筋に生じた体腔外奇形腫の内部から発生した、腎外性Wilms腫瘍の1例を報告した論文。腎外性Wilms腫瘍は泌尿生殖器に多いが、奇形腫内に発生する例はまれである。本症例は発生部位として傍脊柱軟部組織を追加するものであり、奇形腫を背景とした発生を示す。
pmid-21054156.summary_en: This report describes an extrarenal Wilms tumour arising within an extracoelomic teratoma of the paraspinal musculature. Extrarenal Wilms tumour usually arises in the genitourinary tract, and rarely within teratomas, mostly in females with spinal defects and males with testicular teratomas. This case expands the reported locations of this rare tumour to the paraspinal soft tissues, a setting not previously described.

pmid-21057460.summary_ja: 本研究では、CNS、縦隔、仙尾部などの複数部位にわたる原発性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍131例について、LIN28の免疫組織化学を評価し、SALL4と比較した。LIN28は全てのセミノーマ/ジャーミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍を染色し、非胚細胞腫瘍406例に対しては高い特異性を示した。絨毛癌および未熟奇形腫では可変的な染色がみられ、成熟奇形腫ではまれにみられた。性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍においては、LIN28はSALL4より高感度であり、両者を併用するとさらに診断感度が向上した。
pmid-21057460.summary_en: This study evaluated LIN28 immunohistochemistry in 131 primary extragonadal germ cell tumors across multiple sites, including CNS, mediastinum, and sacrococcygeal regions, and compared it with SALL4. LIN28 stained all seminomas/germinomas, embryonal carcinomas, and yolk sac tumors, with high specificity against 406 non-germ cell tumors. Variable staining occurred in choriocarcinomas and immature teratomas, and rarely in mature teratomas. For extragonadal yolk sac tumors, LIN28 was more sensitive than SALL4, and combining both markers improved diagnostic sensitivity further.

pmid-21057824.summary_ja: 絨毛癌に起因する破裂性脳腫瘍性動脈瘤の2症例を報告し、文献レビューを加えた症例報告。妊娠可能年齢の女性で脳出血を呈した場合には、本疾患を疑う必要がある。治療の第一選択は化学療法であり、外科的処置は即時的な脅威となる大きな脳内血腫に限られる。
pmid-21057824.summary_en: This case report and literature review describes two patients with ruptured cerebral oncotic aneurysms caused by choriocarcinoma, treated at the authors' institution in 2010. Oncotic aneurysm from choriocarcinoma is extremely rare and may be misdiagnosed, so clinicians should suspect it in women of childbearing age presenting with intracerebral hemorrhage. The authors summarize clinical presentation and radiological features and discuss pathogenesis. Chemotherapy is the primary treatment, and surgery is reserved for large intracerebral hematomas that pose an immediate threat.

pmid-21061314.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の小児24例を後方視的に解析し、術後の膀胱・直腸機能を評価した研究。膀胱機能障害は半数に認められ、複数回手術を受けた群では90%に達した。直腸機能障害は認められなかった。初回手術での完全切除が膀胱機能障害の予防に重要と結論づけている。
pmid-21061314.summary_en: This retrospective study of 24 children with sacrococcygeal teratoma assessed postoperative bladder and rectal function using clinical follow-up, rectomanometry, and urodynamic studies. Bladder dysfunction occurred in half of patients, and in 90% of those requiring multiple surgeries versus 21% of those operated on once. All patients with clinical dysfunction had urodynamic abnormalities, seven with neurogenic bladder. Rectal function was preserved. The authors conclude that complete excision at the first operation is crucial to prevent bladder dysfunction.

pmid-21062302.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者376例で血清テストステロンを前向きに縦断測定した研究。セミノーマ23.9%、非セミノーマ26.2%で持続的な男性ホルモン欠乏が認められた。欠乏は残存精巣容積の減少と関連していた。化学療法や放射線療法などの治療法による影響は小さく、欠乏は初診時からすでに存在している可能性が高いとされる。
pmid-21062302.summary_en: This prospective longitudinal study measured serum testosterone in 376 testicular germ cell cancer patients and analyzed 1831 values from 160 patients with complete serial data. Persistent testosterone deficiency was found in about a quarter of seminoma and non-seminoma patients. Deficiency correlated with reduced residual testicular volume. Treatments including cisplatin-based chemotherapy, carboplatin, radiotherapy, or surgery alone had only a minor influence on the high prevalence, which is likely present at diagnosis.

pmid-21075832.summary_ja: 発作性心房細動を初発症状とした巨大縦隔奇形腫の症例。腫瘍による左房圧迫が不整脈の原因と考えられた。縦隔奇形腫は通常無症状で、増大すると気管や気管支を圧迫する。心房細動が初発症状となる例は極めてまれである。
pmid-21075832.summary_en: This report describes a giant mediastinal teratoma in a patient who presented with paroxysmal atrial fibrillation. Compression of the left atrium by the mass was identified as the cause of the arrhythmia, a very rare presentation of extrinsic cardiac compression. The authors review the typical course of benign mediastinal teratomas, which are often asymptomatic until they compress thoracic structures such as the trachea and bronchi. Atrial fibrillation as a first clinical sign of such compression is exceedingly uncommon.

pmid-21080172.summary_ja: 頭皮に発生し眼窩・耳・脳へ及んだ巨大な先天性頭蓋外未熟奇形腫の新生児例。早期の全切除により術後経過は良好で、6か月時点で神経学的欠損はなかった。巨大な先天性頭蓋顔面奇形腫では、早期の根治的切除により許容できる機能的転帰が得られると結論づけている。
pmid-21080172.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a huge congenital extracranial immature teratoma of the scalp extending to the orbit, ears, and brain. CT and MRI showed a multiloculated cystic mass larger than the head, with calvarial remodeling. Total surgical excision was performed, and histopathology confirmed immature teratoma. The child had an uneventful postoperative course and was neurologically intact at six months. The authors conclude that early radical resection can achieve acceptable functional outcomes in massive congenital craniofacial teratomas.

pmid-21083842.summary_ja: 63歳女性で左卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫に扁平上皮癌を認めた。術前に超音波検査で奇形腫と診断され、術中の凍結切片で扁平上皮癌の巣が確認された。病期分類手術で偶発的に子宮内膜腺癌(類内膜癌と粘液性癌の混在)が同時性に見つかった。2つの同時性がんの組み合わせは英語文献で報告がないと著者らは述べている。
pmid-21083842.summary_en: A 63-year-old woman was found to have squamous cell carcinoma arising in a left ovarian mature cystic teratoma, detected preoperatively by ultrasonography. Frozen section confirmed the squamous focus, and staging surgery revealed an incidental synchronous endometrial adenocarcinoma with endometrioid and mucinous components. The authors note this combination of two synchronous cancers has not been previously reported in the English literature, making this a rare case report.

pmid-21084179.summary_ja: 監視療法中に腹腔内・骨盤内で再発した精巣胚細胞腫瘍28例を後方視的に解析し、CT上のリンパ節増大速度を算出した。非セミノーマのリンパ節は中央値2.99mm/月、セミノーマは1.35mm/月で、非セミノーマで有意に速かった。著者らは、非セミノーマ患者では監視開始後2年間はCTをより頻回に行うべきと結論づけている。
pmid-21084179.summary_en: This retrospective study of 28 patients with testicular germ cell tumours on surveillance who relapsed in the abdomen or pelvis estimated lymph node growth rates from serial CT. Non-seminoma lymph nodes grew significantly faster than seminoma nodes, at a median of 2.99 versus 1.35 mm/month. The authors conclude that non-seminoma patients should undergo more frequent CT during the first two years of surveillance than seminoma patients, supporting risk-adapted imaging schedules.

pmid-21086073.summary_ja: 転移を伴う精母細胞性セミノーマの報告例は3例目で、古典的セミノーマに用いるBEP化学療法を施行した。後腹膜腫瘤の縮小効果は乏しかった。文献レビューでは、転移をきたした3例すべてが精巣摘除後に補助放射線療法を受けていなかった。著者らは、高リスク症例では補助放射線療法の検討が考慮されるべきとしている。
pmid-21086073.summary_en: The authors describe a third reported case of metastatic spermatocytic seminoma, a rare testicular germ cell tumour, treated with BEP chemotherapy as used for classical seminoma. The regimen was poorly effective in reducing a retroperitoneal mass. Literature review showed that all three patients who developed metastases had not received adjuvant radiation therapy after orchiectomy, which the authors suggest should be considered in high-risk cases.

pmid-21087978.summary_ja: 精母細胞性セミノーマの臨床病理学的特徴を文献的に整理し、報告の少ない未分化亜型の新規症例を提示した。古典的セミノーマとは臨床的・病理学的に明確に異なる腫瘍で、転移はほとんどきたさない。精巣摘除術単独で十分とされ、肉腫様変化を伴う場合は術後治療が勧められる。未分化成分の存在は良好な予後を悪化させないとされる。
pmid-21087978.summary_en: The authors review the clinicopathological features of spermatocytic seminoma, a neoplasm distinct from classical seminoma with an almost complete inability to metastasize, and describe a new case of the rare anaplastic variant, of which only five cases had been reported. They note that orchidectomy alone is generally sufficient and that surveillance is preferred, while sarcomatous transformation warrants further therapy after orchiectomy. An anaplastic component does not appear to worsen the excellent prognosis.

pmid-21102350.summary_ja: 表現型が正常な12歳女児で、46,XY純粋性腺異形成症(Swyer症候群)に卵巣絨毛癌を合併した症例を報告。性器出血と早期乳房発育で受診した。術後の月経異常と対側卵巣の縮小から性腺異形成が疑われた。著者らは、思春期前後の女児の性腺胚細胞腫瘍では基礎疾患として性腺異形成の評価が必要と強調している。
pmid-21102350.summary_en: A phenotypically normal 12-year-old girl with 46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis (Swyer syndrome) presented with vaginal bleeding and early breast development, and was first diagnosed with ovarian choriocarcinoma. The dysgenesis was suspected from abnormal postoperative menstrual patterns and a small residual contralateral ovary. The authors emphasize that prepubertal girls with gonadal germ cell tumours should be evaluated for underlying gonadal dysgenesis, since correct diagnosis guides cancer prophylaxis and hormone replacement.

pmid-21102414.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎や絨毛癌では、正常胎盤に比べてASPP1のプロモーター高メチル化により発現が低下していた。持続性に進展した奇胎では発現がより低かった。絨毛癌細胞株でASPP1を強制発現させるとアポトーシスが誘導された。高メチル化による発現低下が妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発症に関与すると示唆された。
pmid-21102414.summary_en: The authors show that ASPP1, a proapoptotic p53-interacting protein, is downregulated in hydatidiform moles and choriocarcinomas through promoter hypermethylation compared with normal placentas. Lower ASPP1 immunoreactivity was seen in moles that progressed to persistent gestational trophoblastic neoplasia than in those that regressed. In choriocarcinoma cell lines, restoring ASPP1 triggered apoptosis via intrinsic and extrinsic pathways, suggesting that hypermethylation-mediated loss contributes to gestational trophoblastic disease pathogenesis.

pmid-21102418.summary_ja: 組織マイクロアレイを用い、胚細胞腫瘍111例、精巣組織30例、転移性明細胞型腎細胞癌184例でブラキュリーの免疫染色を行った。胚細胞腫瘍を含むいずれの検体でも核内発現は認められず、脊索腫12例では全例で強陽性であった。生検検体での脊索腫との鑑別におけるブラキュリーの特異性が確認された。
pmid-21102418.summary_en: Using tissue microarrays, the authors tested brachyury immunohistochemistry in 111 germ cell tumours, 30 testicular tissues, and 184 metastatic clear cell renal cell carcinomas, plus PAX-8 and SALL-4 in chordomas. No germ cell tumour, testicular tissue, or renal carcinoma showed nuclear brachyury expression, whereas all 12 chordomas stained strongly. The findings confirm brachyury as a specific marker distinguishing chordoma from germ cell tumour and renal carcinoma mimics in biopsy specimens.

pmid-21102500.summary_ja: 前治療歴が多く、G-CSFと化学療法による動員に失敗した胚細胞腫瘍患者6例に、プレリキサホルを使用した。5例で体重1kgあたり中央値2.6×10⁶個のCD34陽性細胞を採取できた。3例が自家幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法を受け、生着までの期間は過去の報告と同程度であった。既存の動員失敗例に対して安全かつ有効と結論され、前向き研究の必要性が示された。
pmid-21102500.summary_en: Six heavily pretreated germ cell tumour patients who had failed prior G-CSF-based mobilization received plerixafor under a compassionate use program. Five yielded a median of 2.6 × 10^6 CD34+ cells per kg, and three subsequently underwent autologous high-dose chemotherapy with stem cell support, with engraftment times comparable to historical data. The authors conclude plerixafor appears safe and effective for patients who failed prior mobilization, and recommend larger prospective studies.

pmid-21104246.summary_ja: 病理学的に確定した卵巣甲状腺腫12例のCT・MRI所見を後方視的に検討した。大半は片側性で、平滑な多嚢胞性腫瘤として描出された。非造影CTでは嚢胞内容が高吸収を示し、嚢胞壁には点状石灰化がみられた。充実部は造影効果を示した。画像所見を病理所見と対比し、診断における有用性が示された。
pmid-21104246.summary_en: The authors retrospectively reviewed CT and MRI features of 12 pathologically confirmed struma ovarii cases, a specialized teratoma containing thyroid tissue. Most were unilateral and appeared as smooth, multicystic masses with high-attenuation cyst contents on precontrast CT, stippled calcification in cyst walls, and enhancing solid components. Ascites and pleural effusion occurred in some cases. These imaging features may aid in diagnosis.

pmid-21112954.summary_ja: 健常および疾患のヒト・ラット・マウスの精巣組織で14-3-3ベータの発現を検討した研究。健常精巣ではセルトリ細胞などで発現し、精細管内胚細胞腫瘍(IGCN)およびセミノーマの悪性細胞でも陽性であった。ビメンチンとの相互作用が示され、腫瘍形成や細胞生存に寄与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21112954.summary_en: This study examined 14-3-3 beta expression in healthy and diseased male reproductive tissues from humans, rats, and mice. 14-3-3 beta was detected in Sertoli cells and peritubular stroma of healthy testes. In intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCN) and classical seminoma, malignant cells stained positive for 14-3-3 beta. Proximity ligation and co-immunoprecipitation revealed interaction with vimentin, and tubulin was identified as another binding partner. The authors suggest 14-3-3 beta supports normal spermatogenesis and may contribute to tumorigenesis and survival of malignant cells.

pmid-21115610.summary_ja: 雄マウスの胚細胞においてDND1が細胞周期停止と多能性マーカーの消失を制御する仕組みを検討した研究。精巣奇形腫の発生は遺伝的背景に依存し、DND1はp27やp21などの翻訳を調節していた。これらの制御が破綻すると多能性が維持され、腫瘍形成につながると考察されている。
pmid-21115610.summary_en: This study examined how the germ cell protein DND1 regulates mitotic arrest and pluripotency reprogramming in male mouse germ cells. Teratoma susceptibility depends on genetic background: Dnd1 mutants develop testicular teratomas on 129/SvJ but not C57BL/6J. DND1 binds transcripts encoding cell cycle inhibitors such as p27 and p21, regulating their translation. Reduced levels of these regulators in susceptible strains likely cause failure of cell cycle arrest and persistent pluripotency markers, contributing to tumor formation.

pmid-21116298.summary_ja: 本総説は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病因、診断、治療をまとめたものである。停留精巣が主要な危険因子であり、疑わしい場合には精巣摘除術が必要とされる。病期分類は血清腫瘍マーカーとTNM分類に基づいて行われる。早期病期はリスクに応じてサーベイランス、化学療法、または放射線療法で管理される。転移性疾患にはシスプラチン併用化学療法と残存腫瘍切除が行われ、2回目以降の再発には大量化学療法が根治的選択肢となる。
pmid-21116298.summary_en: This review summarizes testicular germ cell tumor pathogenesis, diagnosis, and management. Cryptorchidism is the main risk factor, and orchiectomy is required for suspected cases. Staging uses serum tumor markers and TNM classification. Early-stage disease is managed with surveillance, chemotherapy, or radiotherapy based on individualized risk. Metastatic disease is treated with cisplatin-based chemotherapy and residual tumor resection, and high-dose chemotherapy is a curative option for second or subsequent relapses.

pmid-21118831.summary_ja: 出生前に診断された心膜内奇形腫の低出生体重児の症例報告。胎児期に心膜穿刺を繰り返し、妊娠34週で分娩。生後3日目に人工心肺を用いずに腫瘍を完全切除し、病理学的に未熟奇形腫と確定した。αフェトプロテイン(AFP)は長期フォローアップでの再発監視に有用とされる。
pmid-21118831.summary_en: This case report describes a prenatally diagnosed intrapericardial teratoma in a low birth weight preterm infant. Serial intrauterine pericardiocentesis was performed, and the baby was delivered at 34 weeks. Echocardiography and CT located the cystic mass near the left atrium. At three days of life the tumor was completely resected without cardiopulmonary bypass. Pathology confirmed an immature teratoma. Alpha-fetoprotein is suggested as a tool for long-term follow-up to monitor recurrence.

pmid-21131835.summary_ja: 本後方視的免疫組織化学研究は、顆粒膜細胞腫瘍16例と胚細胞腫瘍10例（ディスジャーミノーマ4例、未熟奇形腫6例）を含む非上皮性卵巣悪性腫瘍26例におけるCOX-2発現を評価した。陽性の基準は10%超の染色細胞とした。COX-2陽性は顆粒膜細胞腫瘍16例中5例（31.2%）でみられたが、未熟奇形腫では1例のみ、ディスジャーミノーマでは陽性例はなかった。著者らは、免疫組織化学的に検出されるCOX-2発現は非上皮性卵巣悪性腫瘍ではまれであると結論づけている。
pmid-21131835.summary_en: This retrospective immunohistochemical study assessed COX-2 expression in 26 nonepithelial ovarian malignancies, including 16 granulosa cell tumors and 10 germ cell tumors (4 dysgerminomas and 6 immature teratomas). COX-2 positivity, defined as more than 10% stained cells, was seen in 5 of 16 granulosa cell tumors (31.2%) but in only one immature teratoma and no dysgerminomas. The authors conclude that COX-2 expression by immunohistochemistry is uncommon in nonepithelial ovarian malignancies.

pmid-21134986.summary_ja: 1981年から2009年に治療された精巣胚細胞腫瘍40例を解析し、体細胞型悪性成分を伴う奇形腫を検討した。最も多い組織型は横紋筋肉腫と原始神経外胚葉性腫瘍で、転移部位は肺や縦隔、後腹膜リンパ節などであった。病期別生存率は病期Iで100%、病期IIで87.5%、病期IIIで53%だった。化学療法感受性が低いため、外科的切除が不可欠と結論づけている。
pmid-21134986.summary_en: This single-institution series of 40 patients treated from 1981 to 2009 analyzes testicular germ cell tumors containing teratoma with somatic-type malignant components. Malignant components were found at metastatic sites including lung, liver, mediastinum, and retroperitoneal nodes, with rhabdomyosarcoma and primitive neuroectodermal tumors most common. After a median follow-up of 37 months, 72.5% were alive and disease-free. Survival was 100% for stage I, 87.5% for stage II, and 53% for stage III. The authors recommend surgical excision of the somatic component because of reduced chemotherapy sensitivity.

pmid-21150160.summary_ja: シスプラチン耐性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍細胞株NOY1-CRを親株NOY1から樹立した。IC50は親株の22.3倍で、一部の薬剤にも交差耐性を示した。遺伝子解析でGSTA1が耐性細胞で高発現しており、そのノックダウンで感受性が回復した。GSTA1は耐性卵巣YSTの治療標的候補として示唆された。
pmid-21150160.summary_en: Researchers established a cisplatin-resistant ovarian yolk sac tumor cell line (NOY1-CR) from the parental NOY1 line. The resistant cells showed a 22.3-fold higher cisplatin IC50 and cross-resistance to several drugs, though not to etoposide or bleomycin. Microarray analysis revealed widespread gene expression changes. Knockdown of GSTA1, upregulated in resistant cells, restored cisplatin sensitivity, suggesting GSTA1 as a potential therapeutic target for resistant ovarian YST.

pmid-21159043.summary_ja: 32歳女性の大きな卵巣腫瘍の症例。充実成分にFDG-PETで強い集積を認め、悪性を否定できず片側卵管卵巣摘出術を行った。病理では悪性成分を含まない成熟奇形腫で、充実成分の中枢神経組織が強い集積の原因と考えられた。PET診断の落とし穴を示す症例である。
pmid-21159043.summary_en: A 32-year-old woman had a large ovarian tumor with solid components on ultrasonography and MRI. FDG-PET showed intense uptake (SUV 12.8 early, 14.8 delayed), raising concern for malignancy, so she underwent unilateral salpingo-oophorectomy. Pathology showed a mature teratoma without malignant elements. The solid component consisted mainly of central nervous tissue, which likely explained the intense FDG uptake, a pitfall in PET interpretation.

pmid-21160195.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の腹腔鏡下摘出で、卵巣をエンドバッグに入れ、同じバッグ内で嚢腫を取り出す修正術式の報告である。閉経前の35例で、明らかな腹腔内汚染は5.7%のみであった。平均手術時間は64.6分で、合併症はなかった。腹腔内への漏出と手術時間を減らす安全な方法と結論づけている。
pmid-21160195.summary_en: This study describes a modified laparoscopic technique for ovarian dermoid cyst enucleation in which the ovary is placed in an endobag at the start of surgery and the cyst is removed within the same bag. In 35 premenopausal patients with cysts averaging 6.3 cm, rupture occurred in 28.5% but significant peritoneal contamination in only 5.7%. Mean operative time was 64.6 minutes, with no complications and short hospital stays.

pmid-21161545.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者の対側精巣を検討した研究。全例で精細管構造と精子形成の異常が認められ、異常な精子形成の精細管ではコネキシン43の減少とコネキシン26の増加がみられた。c-KIT陽性精原細胞数は精子形成障害の程度と相関し、胚細胞の発生障害が腫瘍発生に関与する可能性を示した。
pmid-21161545.summary_en: This study examined contralateral testes from men with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumor. Alterations in tubular architecture and spermatogenesis were found in all cases. In tubules with aberrant spermatogenesis, connexin 43 was down-regulated and connexin 26 was up-regulated. c-KIT-positive spermatogonia correlated with the degree of spermatogenic impairment, supporting the idea that disturbed germ cell development contributes to tumor emergence.

pmid-21162092.summary_ja: 46,XY性腺異形成のSwyer症候群を有する16歳の患者の異形成性性腺で、性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）の併存を認めた症例。診断は接触標本による細胞診で行われた。異形成性性腺は胚細胞悪性腫瘍のリスクが高く、診断確定後の性腺摘除の重要性と、迅速な術中評価における接触標本の有用性が強調されている。
pmid-21162092.summary_en: A 16-year-old with Swyer syndrome (46,XY pure gonadal dysgenesis) was found to have gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma coexisting in a dysgenetic gonad. The diagnosis was made on touch preparation cytology. The authors emphasize the high risk of germ cell malignancy in dysgenetic gonads, the importance of gonadectomy once the diagnosis is established, and the value of touch preparations for rapid intraoperative assessment.

pmid-21163445.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の臨床像と検査所見をまとめた総説。主に小児と若年成人に生じ、卵巣奇形腫を伴うことが多い。精神症状や痙攣から無反応へと進行し、多くの患者は抗体価の低下とともに回復する。腫瘍切除と免疫療法を受けた患者は治療への反応が速く、二次治療の必要性も低かった。
pmid-21163445.summary_en: This review summarizes clinical experience and laboratory findings in anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, which predominantly affects children and young adults and is often associated with ovarian teratoma. The illness typically progresses from psychosis and seizures to unresponsiveness, and most patients recover substantially as antibody titres fall. Patients treated with tumour resection and immunotherapy respond faster and need second-line therapy less often.

pmid-21167522.summary_ja: 既往に胚細胞腫瘍のある27例の孤立精巣患者で、対側精巣悪性腫瘍が疑われ部分精巣摘除術を受けた北米の単施設経験。17例（63%）に悪性腫瘍があり、セミノーマと奇形腫が中心で、上皮内癌は9例に認めた。全腫瘍はstage 1で断端陽性はなかった。中央値5.7年の追跡で局所再発はなく、31%がテストステロン補充を要した。
pmid-21167522.summary_en: This North American single-institution series reviewed 27 men with a prior germ cell tumor who underwent partial orchiectomy for presumed contralateral testicular malignancy. Malignancy was found in 17 (63%), mostly seminoma and teratoma, and carcinoma in situ was present in 9 patients. All tumors were stage 1 with negative margins. Most patients were observed, and no local recurrences occurred over a median 5.7-year follow-up. Testosterone replacement was needed in 31%.

pmid-21173133.summary_ja: 悪性胚細胞腫瘍で高発現するmiR-371～373およびmiR-302クラスターのマイクロRNA(miRNA)の血清中レベルを検討した研究。4歳男児の卵黄嚢腫瘍では、診断時に主要8メンバーすべてが上昇し、フォローアップ中に正常化した。その推移はα-フェトプロテイン(AFP)と類似していた。悪性胚細胞腫瘍のモニタリングや診断への応用が期待される。
pmid-21173133.summary_en: This study examined serum levels of microRNAs from the miR-371~373 and miR-302 clusters, which are overexpressed in all malignant germ cell tumors. In a 4-year-old boy with yolk sac tumor, all eight main cluster members were elevated at diagnosis and normalized during follow-up, with kinetics similar to alpha-fetoprotein. The authors also describe a robust multiplex PCR protocol and propose these microRNAs as candidate biomarkers for monitoring and possibly diagnosing malignant germ cell tumors.

pmid-21177212.summary_ja: 42歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（類皮嚢腫）内に発生した良性皮膚付属器腫瘍トリコアデノーマの症例報告です。成熟奇形腫は外胚葉・中胚葉・内胚葉由来の組織から構成され、卵巣腫瘍の約25%を占めます。卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内のトリコアデノーマとしては初めての報告とされています。
pmid-21177212.summary_en: This report describes a trichoadenoma, a benign skin adnexal tumor, arising within a mature cystic teratoma (dermoid cyst) of the ovary in a 42-year-old woman. The authors review the features of mature teratomas, which account for about 25% of ovarian tumors and are composed of ectodermal, mesodermal, and endodermal tissues. Skin appendage tumors arising within mature teratomas are very rare. The authors describe this as the first report of trichoadenoma in an ovarian mature cystic teratoma. The case highlights the histologic diversity of these benign germ cell tumors.

pmid-21178576.summary_ja: 過去に妊娠性絨毛性疾患と診断されたオーストラリア人女性176名を対象とした横断的調査です。疾患の原因・治療・妊孕性への影響に関する理解を評価しています。多くの女性は原因を偶然と考えており、生活習慣要因については不確かだと回答していました。化学療法を受けた女性の多くは治療の理論を理解していました。
pmid-21178576.summary_en: This cross-sectional study surveyed 176 Australian women previously diagnosed with gestational trophoblastic disease about their understanding of its causes, treatment, and effects on fertility. Most attributed GTD to chance, and many were unsure about the roles of lifestyle and environmental factors. Surgical or medical procedures were the most commonly endorsed treatments. Among the 27 women who received chemotherapy, most understood its rationale and perceived it as successful. Although few perceived a negative fertility effect, many were reluctant to conceive again or doubted their ability to have healthy children.

pmid-21190791.summary_ja: 1981〜2005年にPrincess Margaret Hospitalで積極的監視を受けた臨床病期I非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍371例の解析です。全体の28%が再発し、再発までの中央値は7か月でした。リンパ管・血管侵襲と純粋な胎児性癌が再発の独立した予測因子でした。5年疾患特異的生存率は約99%で、リスク適応を用いない監視が有効と結論づけられています。
pmid-21190791.summary_en: This study reviews 371 patients with clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors managed with non-risk-adapted active surveillance at Princess Margaret Hospital from 1981 to 2005. Overall, 28% relapsed, with a median time to relapse of 7 months. Lymphovascular invasion and pure embryonal carcinoma independently predicted recurrence. The relapse rate was lower in the recent cohort, and five-year disease-specific survival was about 99%. Only three patients died from testis cancer. The authors conclude that non-risk-adapted surveillance is an effective, simple strategy for all stage I NSGCT.

pmid-21190874.summary_ja: 5日間の発熱と腹痛で受診した14歳女性の症例報告です。コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で右付属器の7.6cm類皮嚢腫を伴う虫垂炎と判読され、虫垂炎として治療されました。後の手術でメチシリン感受性黄色ブドウ球菌（MSSA）による重複感染が判明しました。卵巣類皮嚢腫の重複感染は極めて稀で、評価・外科的管理・卵巣温存が推奨されています。
pmid-21190874.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl who presented with five days of fever and abdominal pain. CT was read as appendicitis with a 7.6 cm right adnexal dermoid cyst, and she was treated for appendicitis. Later surgery revealed a dermoid cyst superinfected with methicillin-sensitive Staphylococcus aureus. Superinfection of ovarian dermoid cysts is extremely rare. The authors recommend standard evaluation, surgical management, and ovarian conservation for all ovarian dermoid cysts. They note that mature cystic teratomas are the most common ovarian tumor in adolescents.

pmid-21190901.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体抗体脳炎と縦隔奇形腫を合併した19歳女性の症例報告。薬剤抵抗性の非痙攣性てんかん重積状態による昏睡を呈し、脳波で全般性律動性デルタ活動を認めた。抗てんかん薬、薬剤性昏睡、腫瘍切除、ステロイド、リツキシマブ、血漿交換に抵抗したが、フェルバメート追加後に覚醒し律動性デルタ活動は消失した。
pmid-21190901.summary_en: A 19-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor antibody encephalitis and a mediastinal teratoma presented with coma due to drug-resistant nonconvulsive status epilepticus. EEG showed generalized rhythmic delta activity. The status persisted despite antiepileptics, drug-induced coma, tumor resection, steroids, rituximab, and plasmapheresis, and resolved after felbamate was added. The authors suggest rhythmic delta activity may represent status epilepticus in some anti-NMDAR encephalitis patients and that felbamate merits study as a treatment.

pmid-21195966.summary_ja: 18歳女性の右卵巣嚢腫に対し開腹卵巣摘出術を施行。病理で尿管様の管状構造を含む成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。その後の尿路系評価は正常で、尿管様構造は奇形腫の構成要素と確認された。奇形腫内の組織成分が他臓器様に見え、誤認のリスクがあることを示す症例である。
pmid-21195966.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman with a large right ovarian cyst underwent laparotomy and oophorectomy. Pathology showed a mature cystic teratoma containing a tubular structure that resembled a cross-section of ureter. Subsequent urinary tract evaluation was normal, confirming that the ureter was a component of the teratoma. The case illustrates how tissue elements within a teratoma can mimic other structures and mislead surgeons and pathologists.

pmid-21195970.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎を合併した卵巣奇形腫2例に対し、卵巣機能温存のため腹腔鏡下卵巣嚢腫切除術を施行。両例とも腫瘍切除後に完全回復した。付属器切除術と同等の効果が示され、本疾患では付属器切除が必須でない可能性がある。
pmid-21195970.summary_en: Two patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis and ovarian teratoma were treated with laparoscopic ovarian cystectomy rather than adnexectomy to preserve ovarian function. Both recovered fully after tumor resection. The authors argue that cystectomy is as effective as adnexectomy, suggesting that adnexectomy may not be necessary in anti-NMDAR encephalitis with ovarian teratoma. This short report supports fertility-sparing surgery in this setting.

pmid-21196659.summary_ja: 直腸後外側壁から発生した固形型の直腸内成熟奇形腫の1例を報告。経肛門的切除生検で切除された。扁平上皮、脂肪、毛包、軟骨、腺管を認めた。原発性直腸奇形腫は稀で、大部分は嚢胞性であり、悪性化の可能性があるため完全切除が推奨される。
pmid-21196659.summary_en: A patient with a primary solid intrarectal dermoid is reported. The lesion arose from the posterolateral rectal wall and was removed by excision biopsy. Histology showed squamous epithelium, fat, hair follicles, cartilage, and glandular columnar lining, consistent with mature teratoma. Primary rectal teratomas are rare and usually cystic. Although typically benign, they can become malignant, so complete resection is advised.

pmid-21205748.summary_ja: 2000〜2006年にノルウェーとスウェーデンの1,384例を前向きに登録した精巣セミノーマの集団ベース研究。5年疾患特異的生存率は99.6%。CS1では監視療法14.3%、カルボプラチン3.9%、放射線療法0.8%の順に再発率が示された。CS2Aでは放射線療法後の再発が化学療法より多かった。
pmid-21205748.summary_en: This binational prospective population-based study enrolled 1,384 Norwegian and Swedish patients with seminomatous testicular cancer from 2000 to 2006 to standardize care. Clinical stage 1 patients received surveillance, adjuvant radiotherapy, or adjuvant carboplatin. Five-year cause-specific survival was 99.6%. Relapse rates were 14.3% under surveillance, 3.9% after carboplatin, and 0.8% after radiotherapy. Radiotherapy in stage 2A showed more relapses than chemotherapy, and the authors note late toxicity of cisplatin-based chemotherapy.

pmid-21207375.summary_ja: デンマークの集団ベース症例対照研究で、精巣がん3,297例と対照6,594例を比較。父・兄弟・息子に精巣がんがあると発生率比は各4.63、8.30、5.23と上昇した。組織型別でも同様の傾向だった。非ホジキンリンパ腫と食道がんの家族歴も関連したが偶然の可能性がある。
pmid-21207375.summary_en: A Danish population-based case-control study compared 3,297 testicular cancer cases with 6,594 matched controls and examined cancers in 40,104 first-degree relatives. A father, brother, or son with testicular cancer was associated with rate ratios of 4.63, 8.30, and 5.23. Similar results appeared across histologic subtypes. Familial non-Hodgkin lymphoma and esophageal cancer were associated with testicular cancer, possibly by chance. Shared genes or environmental factors may explain the familial aggregation.

pmid-21210263.summary_ja: 小児の未熟奇形腫(10例)と成熟奇形腫(45例)の神経組織におけるGFAP発現を、神経芽腫(33例)を対照として免疫組織化学的に検討した研究である。GFAP発現は未熟奇形腫で有意に低く、奇形腫の成熟度を示す指標となりうることが示された。病理医による診断と分類の補助として有用と考えられる。
pmid-21210263.summary_en: This study examined glial fibrillary acidic protein (GFAP) expression in nerve tissue from pediatric immature (10 cases) and mature (45 cases) teratomas, with neuroblastoma specimens (33 cases) as controls. GFAP expression was significantly lower in immature teratomas than in mature teratomas by immunohistochemical and semi-quantitative analysis (P=0.0001). The authors conclude that GFAP is a meaningful indicator of teratoma maturation and may assist pathologists in diagnosing and classifying teratomas in children.

pmid-21212385.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマ2466例を対象とした3つのランダム化試験の成熟データを解析した。20Gyの放射線療法およびカルボプラチン単回投与は、再発に関して非劣性であることが示された。3年以降の再発はわずか4例(0.2%)であった。病期Iセミノーマの補助療法として、放射線療法またはカルボプラチンが支持される。
pmid-21212385.summary_en: This analysis of three randomized noninferiority trials (TE10, TE18, TE19) included 2466 patients with stage I seminoma, with median follow-up of 6.4 to 12 years. Adjuvant 20 Gy radiation therapy (TE18) and single-dose carboplatin (TE19) were both shown to be noninferior regarding relapse. Only four patients (0.2%) relapsed after 3 years, and CT scans contributed little to relapse detection after radiation therapy. The authors conclude that either radiation therapy or carboplatin is supported as adjuvant treatment for stage I seminoma.

pmid-21213097.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対するエルシルホスホコリン(ErPC)の作用を検討した。ErPCは細胞増殖を抑制し、細胞周期を変化させ、アポトーシスを誘導した。絨毛癌の治療薬候補となりうることが示唆されるが、本研究は単一の細胞株を用いた in vitro の検討に限られる。
pmid-21213097.summary_en: The authors evaluated erucylphosphocholine (ErPC), a membrane-targeted ether lipid, in the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. ErPC inhibited cell growth, shifted cell cycle distribution toward G0/G1 with fewer cells in S phase, and induced apoptosis, as shown by annexin V staining and loss of mitochondrial membrane potential. These effects were accompanied by altered expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype, and apoptosis. The study suggests that ErPC may be a candidate therapeutic agent for choriocarcinoma, although the work is limited to in vitro experiments on a single cell line.

pmid-21213372.summary_ja: 病期I精巣胎児性癌32例のゲノム解析を行い、6p21.33などの新規増幅領域と22q12.2の欠失を同定した。22q12.2の欠失は再発例に多く認められた。多能性およびRAS/PI3Kシグナルに関わる遺伝子が、胎児性癌の発生と進展に関与することが示唆された。
pmid-21213372.summary_en: Array comparative genomic hybridization was performed on 32 formalin-fixed, paraffin-embedded stage I testicular embryonal carcinoma samples with follow-up data. Novel minimal overlapping regions of gain at 6p21.33 (including OCT3/4), 10q11.21 (RASGEF1A), and 22q13.32, and loss at 22q12.2 were identified and confirmed by FISH. The 22q12.2 loss was more frequent in tumors that relapsed, and PIK3IP1 expression from this region was reduced. The findings implicate pluripotency-related and RAS/PI3K signaling genes in embryonal carcinoma development and progression.

pmid-21216935.summary_ja: 胎児性癌細胞株NT2/D1において、フィセチンがシスプラチンの細胞毒性を増強することを検討した。併用では、シスプラチン単独の4分の1の用量で同程度の効果が得られ、異種移植モデルでも腫瘍縮小効果が最も大きかった。本研究は前臨床研究であり、今後の臨床応用には検証が必要である。
pmid-21216935.summary_en: The authors tested whether the flavonoid fisetin enhances cisplatin cytotoxicity in human embryonal carcinoma NT2/D1 cells. The combination achieved similar cytotoxicity at a four-fold lower cisplatin dose than cisplatin alone, activated both extrinsic and mitochondrial apoptotic pathways, and modulated p53, p21, cyclin B1, and survivin. In an NT2/D1 xenograft model, the combination was the most effective at reducing tumor size. The study is preclinical, and the authors propose the regimen as a possible means to eliminate embryonal carcinoma cells.

pmid-21217646.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛癌10例の血管供給を検討した。腫瘍内部の血管腔は内皮ではなく腫瘍性トロホブラストに覆われ、CD31およびCD34陽性細胞は認められなかった。絨毛癌は脈管形成模倣(血管新生模倣)を利用して増殖している可能性が示された。
pmid-21217646.summary_en: The authors examined the blood supply of 10 gestational choriocarcinomas histopathologically and immunohistochemically. In the tumors, blood channels were lined by neoplastic trophoblastic cells rather than endothelial cells, and CD31 and CD34 were absent in the tumor interior. At the periphery, tumor cells invaded uterine blood vessels and replaced endothelium, forming anastomoses. Other gestational trophoblastic neoplasms, including placental site trophoblastic tumors and epithelioid trophoblastic tumors, showed endothelium-lined vessels. The authors propose that choriocarcinoma uses vasculogenic mimicry to support its growth.

pmid-21219387.summary_ja: 両側腹腔内停留精巣を有する32歳男性で、左精巣に大型セミノーマと傍大動脈リンパ節転移が認められた症例である。化学療法4コースにより転移は完全寛解した。触知しない停留精巣と盲端に終わる精管だけでは消失精巣の診断は不十分であり、思春期後の精巣摘除術の選択についても論じている。
pmid-21219387.summary_en: This case report describes a 32-year-old man with bilateral intra-abdominal cryptorchidism and a large left testicular seminoma with para-aortic lymph node metastasis. The left tumor was excised, and the right testis was found near the deep inguinal ring with an atrophic vas deferens, a failed urogenital union. After orchidopexy and four cycles of chemotherapy, the metastasis achieved complete remission. The authors note that an impalpable undescended testis and blind-ending vas deferens are insufficient to diagnose a vanished testis, and they discuss the choice of orchiectomy after puberty.

pmid-21225274.summary_ja: ニレ樹皮抽出物がヒト絨毛癌細胞株Jeg3およびBeWoの生存能を有意に低下させ、正常な初代栄養膜細胞では増加させることを培養細胞で検討した研究。抽出物はトリテルペンやフィトステロールを主成分とした。ホルモン依存性婦人科腫瘍の予防への応用可能性が示唆されるが、細胞実験に基づく予備的な知見である。
pmid-21225274.summary_en: This in vitro study tested whether extracts from Ulmus laevis (elm) bark affect human choriocarcinoma cell lines Jeg3 and BeWo, which model hormone-dependent gynecological tumours. Chemical analysis showed the extract was rich in triterpenes, phytosterols, and free fatty acids. The extract significantly reduced viability of both choriocarcinoma lines while increasing viability of primary trophoblast cells, suggesting selective activity. The authors propose that elm bark substances could help prevent hormone-dependent tumours, though this remains preliminary and based on cell culture only.

pmid-21225915.summary_ja: 小児・思春期の胚細胞腫瘍48例を対象に、APC遺伝子の異常とWntシグナル経路の活性化を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍で高頻度にAPCプロモーターのメチル化が認められ、奇形腫や卵黄嚢腫瘍では5q21-22のLOHもみられた。一方、ディスジャーミノーマではメチル化は認められなかった。APC単独では小児胚細胞腫瘍の発生・進展を十分に説明できないと結論づけている。
pmid-21225915.summary_en: This study examined APC gene alterations and Wnt pathway activation in 48 childhood and adolescent germ cell tumours, including mature and immature teratomas, mixed malignant GCTs, yolk sac tumours and dysgerminomas. APC promoter hypermethylation occurred predominantly in yolk sac tumours (11/13), and LOH at 5q21-22 was seen in teratomas and yolk sac tumours, but no MCR mutations or truncated protein were detected. Dysgerminomas showed no methylation. The authors conclude APC alone is unlikely to drive childhood GCT formation or progression.

pmid-21225934.summary_ja: 46,XYの核型を有するSwyer症候群の14歳女児で、一方の性腺に絨毛癌、他方に胚細胞腫瘍(ディスジャーミノーマ)を認めた症例報告。Swyer症候群では性腺悪性腫瘍のリスクが高く、絨毛癌は稀で予後不良とされる。性腺異形成の早期診断と、適切な腫瘍治療および性腺摘出の並行実施の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21225934.summary_en: This case report describes a 14-year-old girl with Swyer syndrome (46,XY karyotype) who had choriocarcinoma in one gonad and dysgerminoma in the other. The authors review that Swyer syndrome carries a high risk of gonadal malignancy, most commonly gonadoblastoma and dysgerminoma, with choriocarcinoma being rare and having a poor prognosis. They emphasize early diagnosis of dysgenetic gonads and, when a neoplasm precedes diagnosis, prompt oncologic treatment with parallel gonadectomy.

pmid-21233139.summary_ja: 米国の症例対照研究(STEED)で、身長関連SNPと精巣胚細胞腫瘍のリスクとの関連を検討。rs6060373とrs143384の2つのSNPがTGCTリスクと関連した。身長関連SNPで調整すると身長とTGCTの関連は約8.5%減弱したが統計学的に有意ではなく、身長関連変異の一部がTGCTリスクと関連する可能性を示す暫定的な知見である。
pmid-21233139.summary_en: This case-control study of 561 cases and 676 controls from the US STEED study examined whether height-related SNPs were associated with testicular germ cell tumour risk. Two SNPs, rs6060373 near UQCC and rs143384 in the 5'UTR of GDF5, were associated with TGCT risk. Adjusting for height-related SNPs reduced the height-TGCT association by about 8.5%, but this difference was not statistically significant (P = 0.26). The authors conclude that height-associated variants may partly share an association with TGCT risk, based on tentative evidence.

pmid-21238625.summary_ja: 難治性高カルシウム血症と急性腎不全を呈した小児の転移性ディスジャーミノーマの症例報告。化学療法による腫瘍崩壊症候群のリスクが高かったため、転移巣を外科的に切除したところ高カルシウム血症は正常化した。腫瘍崩壊症候群のリスクが高い固形腫瘍の小児において、切除が実践的な代替治療となりうることを示している。
pmid-21238625.summary_en: This case report describes a child with refractory hypercalcaemia, bulky metastatic tumours and acute renal failure due to metastatic dysgerminoma. Because chemotherapy carried a high risk of tumour lysis syndrome, the authors resected the metastatic tumours instead. Resection normalised the hypercalcaemia, suggesting that surgical excision may be a practical alternative control strategy in children with solid tumours at high risk of tumour lysis syndrome.

pmid-21238631.summary_ja: 在胎30週3日で出生した早産児の巨大仙尾部奇形腫の症例報告である。切除前に主に中仙骨動脈などの栄養動脈を塞栓し、致命的な出血や破裂のリスクを低減した。術中出血は少なかったが、継続的な輸血と生命を脅かす高カリウム血症が手術中に問題となった。術前塞栓を行った報告例のなかで最も小さな患者とされる。
pmid-21238631.summary_en: This case report describes a premature newborn born at 30 weeks and 3 days with a giant sacrococcygeal teratoma. The feeding arteries, mainly the middle sacral arteries, were embolized before resection to reduce the risk of fatal hemorrhage, hemolysis, or rupture. Although intraoperative bleeding was minimal, the infant required continuous transfusions and developed life-threatening hyperkalemia until resection was completed. The authors note this is the smallest reported patient treated with preoperative embolization of a sacrococcygeal teratoma.

pmid-21241492.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍を有する35歳男性が、尿道転移による急性尿閉で受診した症例報告である。膀胱鏡下生検で転移性悪性未分化奇形腫と確認された。CTとMRIで肺、骨盤内リンパ節、坐骨、陰茎への転移が示され、予後不良群と判定された。BEP療法4コースで腫瘍マーカーと画像所見の完全奏効が得られ、現在フォローアップ中である。骨盤画像検査の日常的実施を提唱している。
pmid-21241492.summary_en: A 35-year-old man with a nonseminomatous germ cell tumor of the testis presented with acute urinary retention caused by urethral metastasis, a presentation not previously reported. Cystoscopic biopsy confirmed metastatic malignant undifferentiated teratoma. CT and MRI showed pulmonary, pelvic nodal, ischial and penile metastases, leading to a poor-prognosis classification. He received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin with a complete marker and radiological response, and is under follow-up. The authors recommend routine pelvic imaging in testicular cancer staging and follow-up.

pmid-21247618.summary_ja: 1995〜2008年のオランダの全国病理データを用いた集団ベースの研究で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患の発生率を検討した。登録された4249例のうち、胞状奇胎は出生1000対あたり1.34、絨毛癌は出生10万対あたり3.1、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は出生10万対あたり1.0であった。胞状奇胎は2001年まで増加した後に横ばいとなった。母体年齢の上昇やアジア系出生の増加で一部は説明されるが、残りは説明できず、診断技術の向上も関与している可能性がある。
pmid-21247618.summary_en: This population-based study used Dutch national pathology data from 1995 to 2008 to assess the incidence of gestational trophoblastic disease. Among 4249 registered patients, the incidence of hydatidiform mole was 1.34 per 1000 deliveries, choriocarcinoma 3.1 per 100,000 and PSTT 1.0 per 100,000. Hydatidiform mole incidence rose until 2001 and then plateaued. The overall increase was partly explained by maternal age and Asian ethnicity, but part remains unexplained and may reflect improved diagnostic techniques.

pmid-21256573.summary_ja: 2施設で2000年から2010年に診療した小児女児13例の卵巣病変を検討しました。半数近くは泌尿器疾患と疑われて紹介され、後に卵巣由来と判明していました。組織型は成熟奇形腫が最多で、未熟奇形腫が2例含まれました。腫瘍マーカーは検査した全例で正常でした。小児の卵巣嚢腫・腫瘤の管理は議論が多く、診断と治療の理解が重要と結論づけています。
pmid-21256573.summary_en: This two-center review of 13 pediatric females with gonad-related conditions describes ovarian lesions that pediatric urologists may encounter. Nearly half were referred for presumed urological conditions later found to be ovarian in origin. Histologies included mature teratoma, streak gonad, and hemorrhagic cyst, with two potentially malignant tumors: immature teratoma and juvenile granulosa cell tumor. Tumor markers were normal in all six patients tested. The authors emphasize that management of pediatric ovarian cysts and masses is controversial and that urologists should understand its diagnosis and treatment.

pmid-21256579.summary_ja: 1979年から2008年に治療した悪性卵巣胚細胞腫瘍の女性40例を後方視的に検討しました。組織型は未熟奇形腫が最多でした。妊孕性温存手術を受けた22例のうち、連絡が取れた妊娠希望例の多くが自然妊娠し、14例が生児を得ました。全例で化学療法後1年以内に月経周期が正常化し、全生存期間(全生存率)は100%でした。妊孕性温存手術と補助化学療法の妊孕性や月経への影響は小さいと結論づけています。
pmid-21256579.summary_en: This retrospective study reviewed 40 women treated for malignant ovarian germ cell tumors between 1979 and 2008. Immature teratoma was the most common subtype, followed by dysgerminoma and yolk sac tumor. Twenty-two patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery, most receiving adjuvant chemotherapy. Among those desiring pregnancy who were contacted, most conceived spontaneously, yielding 14 live births. All patients regained normal menstrual cycles within one year of chemotherapy. Overall survival was 100%, and the authors conclude that fertility-sparing surgery with adjuvant chemotherapy had little effect on fertility or menses.

pmid-21257242.summary_ja: 妊娠9週の自然流産後に高血圧とネフローゼ症候群を呈した42歳女性の症例報告です。子宮摘出後に胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と診断され、化学療法で良好に治療されました。腎生検では、血栓様構造物による毛細血管閉塞を伴う非典型的な血栓性微小血管症を認めました。腎病変の病態機序を考察しています。
pmid-21257242.summary_en: This case report describes a 42-year-old woman with hypertension and nephrotic syndrome after a spontaneous incomplete abortion at nine weeks of pregnancy. A uterine placental site trophoblastic tumor was diagnosed after hysterectomy and treated successfully with chemotherapy. Kidney biopsy revealed an unusual thrombotic microangiopathy with thrombus-like capillary occlusion and immune deposits. The differential diagnosis included preeclamptic nephropathy, Waldenström disease, and lupus-related glomerulonephritis. The authors review the pathogenic mechanisms underlying this renal involvement.

pmid-21263100.summary_ja: 婦人科腫瘍学研究グループ(GOG)によるランダム化第III相試験で、低リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍の初回治療として、週1回のメトトレキサート筋注と隔週のダクチノマイシン静注を比較しました。完全寛解率はダクチノマイシンが70%、メトトレキサートが53%で、ダクチノマイシンが有意に優れていました。WHOリスクスコア5～6や絨毛癌では効果が低下しました。両治療法とも忍容性は良好でした。
pmid-21263100.summary_en: This Gynecologic Oncology Group randomized phase III trial compared weekly intramuscular methotrexate with biweekly intravenous dactinomycin for primary treatment of low-risk gestational trophoblastic neoplasia. Among 216 eligible women, dactinomycin achieved a higher complete response rate (70% vs 53%). Both regimens were less effective in patients with WHO risk score 5 or 6 or with choriocarcinoma, with complete response rates of 9% and 42%. Recurrences were rare, and both regimens were well tolerated. The authors conclude that biweekly dactinomycin yields a higher complete response rate than weekly methotrexate in low-risk GTN.

pmid-21268265.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫から単離した間葉系幹細胞様細胞を正常卵巣由来細胞と比較したプロテオーム解析である。奇形腫由来細胞は増殖能・コロニー形成能・血管新生能が高く、GSTM2が強く発現していた。GSTM2の過剰発現はp38 MAPKの低下とAKT・survivinの活性化に関連しており、奇形腫の増殖機構への関与が示唆された。
pmid-21268265.summary_en: This proteomic study compared mesenchymal stem-like cells isolated from ovarian teratoma tissue with those from normal ovary. Both cell types expressed OCT4 and NANOG, but teratoma-derived cells showed higher proliferation, colony formation, and angiogenic capacity. Among 17 proteins with over eightfold expression change, glutathione S-transferase M2 (GSTM2) was strongly upregulated in teratoma cells. GSTM2 overexpression was associated with reduced p38 MAPK signaling and activation of AKT and survivin, suggesting a role in regulating survival genes that may contribute to teratoma growth.

pmid-21269611.summary_ja: 40歳女性の右付属器充実性腫瘤を腹腔鏡下に切除した悪性卵巣甲状腺腫の症例報告である。術後1年間は追加治療なしでフォローアップされた。術前診断の困難さ、複雑な卵巣腫瘤の鑑別診断への卵巣甲状腺腫の組み入れの重要性、甲状腺全摘術と131I療法を含む治療選択肢について文献レビューを踏まえて論じている。
pmid-21269611.summary_en: This case study reports a 40-year-old woman with an incidentally detected solid right adnexal mass that was later diagnosed as malignant struma ovarii, a rare mature teratoma dominated by thyroid tissue. The tumor was removed laparoscopically, and she had no further treatment during one year of follow-up. The authors review the literature, emphasizing that preoperative diagnosis is difficult, that struma ovarii belongs in the differential diagnosis of complex ovarian masses, and that standard treatment remains undefined, with thyroidectomy and iodine-131 therapy as options.

pmid-21270422.summary_ja: 28日間の反復投与毒性試験中に、12週齢Swiss Albinoマウスの精巣に自然発生した非転移性の腫瘍を報告している。腫瘍は胎児性癌と奇形腫からなり、骨格筋や皮脂腺などの成熟組織成分を含んでいた。本系統における自然発生精巣奇形癌の初報告であり、組織形態学的特徴が詳細に示されている。
pmid-21270422.summary_en: This report describes a spontaneous unilateral testicular tumor found in a 12-week-old Swiss Albino mouse during a 28-day toxicity study. The lesion nearly replaced the left testis and comprised embryonal carcinoma and teratoma, including primitive embryonal cells, skeletal muscle, sebaceous glands, keratinized epithelium, and ciliated epithelium. The tumor was non-metastatic. The authors detail its histomorphology and note that it is the first reported spontaneous testicular teratocarcinoma in this mouse strain.

pmid-21277010.summary_ja: MITOグループによる後方視的研究で、IA期純粋卵巣未分化胚細胞腫26例を検討した。完全な病期分類を受けたのはわずか5例であり、再発は不完全な病期分類の群のみで11.5%に発生した。全例が救済療法で治癒し、中央値100か月の追跡で無病生存が確認された。完全な病期分類を伴う温存手術が標準であり、化学療法は再発時に限定すべきとしている。
pmid-21277010.summary_en: This MITO group retrospective study reviewed 26 patients with stage IA pure ovarian dysgerminoma, of whom only five had complete surgical staging. Recurrence occurred in 11.5% of patients, all in those with incomplete staging, while none of the seven patients given adjuvant chemotherapy relapsed. All relapses were salvaged. With a median follow-up of 100 months, all patients were alive without disease. The authors conclude that prognosis is excellent, that complete staging with fertility-sparing surgery is the standard, and that chemotherapy is best reserved for relapse.

pmid-21278491.summary_ja: 思春期後の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を免疫組織化学染色で解析し、エストロゲン受容体GPR30の発現を検討した研究です。管内胚細胞腫瘍、セミノーマ、胎児性癌では高発現し、奇形腫では低発現でした。ウェスタンブロットでも同様の結果が確認されました。GPR30は治療標的になりうると著者らは示唆しています。
pmid-21278491.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined GPR30, a G protein-coupled estrogen receptor, in post-pubertal testicular germ cell tumors, including 30 seminomas, 5 teratomas, 12 embryonal carcinomas and 20 intratubular germ cell tumors. GPR30 was strongly expressed in intratubular germ cell tumors, seminomas and embryonal carcinomas, but weakly in teratomas, and Western blotting confirmed these findings. Expression was also examined in the GC1 spermatogonia line and the TCam-2 seminoma line. The authors suggest GPR30 may be a therapeutic target, and that specific inhibitors could block highly proliferative neoplastic germ cells.

pmid-21282539.summary_ja: 病期Iセミノーマの術後補助療法として、単回カルボプラチンと放射線療法を比較したランダム化試験の長期成績です。5年再発フリー率は両群で同等で、カルボプラチンの非劣性が確認されました。対側の胚細胞腫瘍はカルボプラチン群で有意に少なく、治療前の高いFSH値が危険因子でした。
pmid-21282539.summary_en: This randomized trial, MRC TE19/EORTC 30982, compared single-dose carboplatin with radiotherapy as adjuvant treatment for stage I seminoma. With median follow-up of 6.5 years, 5-year relapse-free rates were 94.7% with carboplatin and 96.0% with radiotherapy, confirming noninferiority. Patients receiving at least 99% of the target carboplatin dose had better relapse-free rates. Contralateral germ cell tumors were significantly reduced with carboplatin (2 versus 15 cases), and elevated pretreatment FSH was a strong predictor of contralateral tumor. The authors conclude single-dose carboplatin is noninferior and reduces second germ cell tumor risk.

pmid-21284721.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、子宮内で診断されたグレードIIの未熟な心膜内奇形腫を有する新生児について述べたものである。腫瘤は出生後に完全に切除された。腫瘤の大きさ、部位および心膜液貯留による心血管系および呼吸器系の障害のリスクがあったにもかかわらず、切除は成功した。組織像は概ね成熟していたが、未熟な成分については連続的なαフェトプロテイン測定による長期フォローアップが必要であった。患者は生後10か月の時点で再発は認められなかった。著者らは、心膜奇形腫に対する完全な外科的切除と長期にわたる監視の重要性を強調している。
pmid-21284721.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a grade II immature intrapericardial teratoma diagnosed in utero. The mass was completely resected after birth despite the risk of cardiovascular and respiratory compromise from its size, location and pericardial effusion. Although histology was largely mature, the immature components required long-term follow-up with serial alpha-fetoprotein measurements. The patient was free of recurrence at 10 months of age. The authors emphasize complete surgical removal and extended surveillance for pericardial teratomas.

pmid-21288558.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の原発巣と転移巣計184例を対象に、LIN28の免疫染色を検討した。胚細胞腫瘍の多くで強い陽性を示し、非胚細胞腫瘍での陽性例は少なかった。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではOCT4より有用であり、SALL4と同程度の診断的有用性を持つが、SALL4を上回る利点はないと結論された。
pmid-21288558.summary_en: This study evaluated LIN28 immunohistochemistry as a diagnostic marker in 103 primary and 81 metastatic testicular germ cell tumors, including intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, teratomas and choriocarcinomas. LIN28 showed strong staining in nearly all intratubular neoplasias, embryonal carcinomas and yolk sac tumors, and in all classic seminomas, with minimal staining in 327 non-germ cell tumors. Its sensitivity was comparable to SALL4 and superior to OCT4 for yolk sac tumors, supporting LIN28 as a useful diagnostic marker, though it offered no advantage over SALL4.

pmid-21292069.summary_ja: 頸部奇形腫により気道閉塞が疑われた胎児に対し、EXIT下で気管切開を行った症例である。胎児頭皮電極を用いて連続的に心拍を監視し、臍帯圧迫による徐脈に迅速に対応できた。気道障害を伴う胎児腫瘍のEXITにおいて、有用な監視手段であると報告している。
pmid-21292069.summary_en: This case report describes a fetus with a cervical teratoma causing suspected airway obstruction, managed by tracheostomy under ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT). A fetal scalp electrode was placed for continuous heart rate monitoring, enabling prompt response to bradycardia caused by cord compression. The authors conclude that the scalp electrode is a useful tool for fetal monitoring during EXIT procedures for airway-compromising fetal tumors.

pmid-21293285.summary_ja: 再発性成熟卵巣奇形腫の患者で、子宮内膜腺癌に対する子宮摘出術時に腹膜神経膠腫症、悪性転化を伴う子宮内膜症、カルチノイド腫瘍が同時に認められた症例である。腹膜幹細胞の化生が複数の病変の発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。同時性婦人科腫瘍や転移性疾患が疑われる症例の評価に重要な知見である。
pmid-21293285.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with recurrent mature ovarian teratoma who was found at hysterectomy for endometrial adenocarcinoma to have gliomatosis peritonei, endometriosis with malignant transformation, and a carcinoid tumor. The authors note this combination has not been reported previously. They propose that metaplasia of peritoneal stem cells may explain both endometriosis and gliomatosis peritonei, and that aberrant differentiation of these cells may occur more widely. The findings are relevant to evaluating synchronous gynecologic tumors or presumed metastatic disease.

pmid-21293290.summary_ja: 非妊娠性の絨毛癌および類上皮性栄養膜腫瘍成分を併せ持つ子宮内膜類内膜癌の稀な症例である。分子遺伝学的解析により、類内膜癌から栄養膜腫瘍への克隆進化が確認された。がん幹細胞が異常な分化を獲得する機序や、成人腫瘍で栄養膜分化を誘導する分子機構の解明に示唆を与える報告である。
pmid-21293290.summary_en: This report describes a rare uterine endometrioid carcinoma containing a nongestational trophoblastic component, composed of both choriocarcinoma and epithelioid trophoblastic tumor. Molecular genetic analysis demonstrated clonal evolution from the endometrioid carcinoma to the trophoblastic tumor, indicating that the trophoblastic component arose from the same tumor clone. The findings have diagnostic and biological implications, suggesting how cancer stem cells may adopt aberrant differentiation programs and what molecular switches might initiate trophoblastic differentiation in adult tumors.

pmid-21300926.summary_ja: SEERデータを用いた27,948例の集団ベース研究で、精巣がん特異的死亡の予後因子を検討した。40歳以上での診断は、セミノーマと非セミノーマの双方で死亡リスクを約2倍にし、転移性疾患で最も顕著だった。非セミノーマでは、未婚、低い社会経済的地位、非白人も死亡リスクを高めた。後腹膜リンパ節郭清を行わないことは死亡リスクの大幅な上昇と関連した。
pmid-21300926.summary_en: This population-based SEER study of 27,948 men with testicular cancer examined predictors of cancer-specific mortality. Diagnosis at age 40 or older doubled mortality for both seminoma and nonseminoma, and was most marked in metastatic disease. Unmarried status, lower socioeconomic status, and nonwhite race were also associated with higher risk among patients with nonseminoma. Omission of retroperitoneal lymph node dissection was associated with a sevenfold increase in death. The authors call for research into interventions to reduce these disparities.

pmid-21301051.summary_ja: 両側同時性セミノーマを有する25歳男性の症例報告である。両側根治的精巣摘除術と術後の腰大動脈領域への放射線療法を施行し、1年以上無病で経過したが、テストステロン補充に依存している。両側性腫瘍の頻度、不妊、心理的負担を文献的に考察し、選択例では精巣温存手術の可能性にも言及している。
pmid-21301051.summary_en: This case report describes a 25-year-old man with synchronous bilateral seminoma and azoospermia, treated with bilateral radical orchiectomy and adjuvant para-aortic radiotherapy. He remained disease-free more than a year later but depends on testosterone replacement. The authors review the 2-3% incidence of bilateral testicular tumors and the infertility and psychological burden of orchiectomy. They note testis-sparing surgery as an option in selected patients, and scrotal radiotherapy for carcinoma in situ in remaining testicular tissue. The authors conclude that bilateral orchiectomy remains the standard, with partial orchiectomy considered in selected cases.

pmid-21304588.summary_ja: Pten欠損マウス胚性幹細胞の分化過程で、奇形腫を形成する攻撃的な胎児性癌細胞が少数出現することを示した。その機序は、Nanogの抑制不全による生存と自己複製の増加である。幹細胞治療における腫瘍化リスクの理解に加え、胎児性癌と奇形腫形成の生物学に関する知見をもたらす。
pmid-21304588.summary_en: This murine study shows that Pten loss in pluripotent stem cells causes the emergence of a small population of aggressive, teratoma-initiating embryonic carcinoma cells during in vitro differentiation. The remaining 90-95% of differentiated cells were non-tumorigenic. The authors show that these embryonic carcinoma cells persist through increased survival and self-renewal due to failure to repress Nanog. The work addresses tumor initiation risk in stem cell-based therapies and provides mechanistic insight into embryonal carcinoma biology and teratoma formation.

pmid-21305635.summary_ja: 11施設の後方視的研究で、卵巣ディスジャーミノーマ21例の臨床経過と超音波所見を検討した。多くは血流豊富な充実性で分葉状の付属器腫瘤を呈し、中央値年齢は20歳であった。症状は疼痛や腹部膨満などだった。20～30歳女性で大きく分葉状の充実性血流豊富な付属器腫瘤を認めた場合、本症を疑うべきと結論した。
pmid-21305635.summary_en: This retrospective multicenter study describes the clinical and ultrasound features of 21 women with ovarian dysgerminoma, most of whom were around 20 years old. Most tumors were highly vascularized, solid, and lobulated adnexal masses with heterogeneous echogenicity. Presenting symptoms included pain, bloating, and menstrual disorders, and most cases were pure dysgerminomas. The authors use IOTA terminology and pattern recognition to characterize the tumors. They conclude that a large solid, lobulated, vascular adnexal mass in a woman aged 20 to 30 should raise suspicion of dysgerminoma.

pmid-21316095.summary_ja: 小児の副腎に原発した成熟奇形腫の1例の症例報告と文献レビューです。副腎奇形腫は極めて稀で、画像検査により診断されました。早期診断と外科的切除が治療上重要であり、術後化学療法の要否は治療結果により決まるとしています。予後予測が困難なため、長期の綿密なフォローアップを推奨しています。
pmid-21316095.summary_en: A child presented with a primary mature teratoma arising in the adrenal gland, an extremely rare site for such tumors. Diagnosis relied on radiologic examination. The authors stress early diagnosis and surgical resection as key to effective treatment, with postoperative chemotherapy depending on the outcome. Because prognosis is hard to predict, close lifelong follow-up is recommended. The article also reviews published data on adrenal mature teratomas.

pmid-21317810.summary_ja: 生後9か月の女児に発生した原発性横隔膜卵黄嚢腫瘍について、症例報告と文献レビューを行った論文です。カルボプラチンを含むレジメンにより腫瘍が縮小し、その後完全切除が行われました。治療終了8か月後も無病の状態を維持しています。既報の英語文献4例もあわせて検討されています。
pmid-21317810.summary_en: The authors report a primary yolk sac tumor of the diaphragm in a 9-month-old girl, an extremely rare site in children. Carboplatin-containing chemotherapy reduced tumor size, after which total resection was performed. The patient remained disease-free eight months after completing treatment. The report also reviews four previously published English-language cases of diaphragmatic yolk sac tumor, placing this case in the context of the limited literature.

pmid-21318640.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎の3症例（卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性、報告例中最高齢の症例、腫瘍を認めない若年男性）を報告し、文献をレビューした論文です。本症は成熟卵巣奇形腫と関連することが多く、十分に認識されていない病態です。支持療法、多職種による管理、免疫調節療法の必要性を強調しています。
pmid-21318640.summary_en: This paper reports three contrasting patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis: a young woman with an ovarian teratoma, the oldest case reported to date, and a young man without an identifiable tumor. It reviews the differential diagnosis, investigations, and treatment options for this under-recognized, immune-mediated syndrome, which is commonly associated with mature ovarian teratomas.
