pmid-21599893.summary_en: A 22-year-old man presented with a mediastinal mass obliterating the right cardiophrenic sinus, which was continuous with the pericardium and compressed the right atrium. Initial imaging suggested a pericardial or bronchogenic cyst. Surgery and pathology revealed a mature cystic teratoma with atrophic thymic tissue on the external surface. The authors highlight that this rare mature teratoma with extrinsic cardiac compression is difficult to diagnose noninvasively. The report emphasizes the need to consider teratoma in the differential diagnosis of mediastinal masses.

pmid-21602968.summary_ja: 18歳女性に生じた3個の仙骨前奇形腫の症例報告です。腹部経由で切除され、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。小児に多い仙尾部奇形腫は成人では稀であり、多発例はさらに珍しいことが示されています。
pmid-21602968.summary_en: This case report describes an 18-year-old woman with three presacral teratomas, an unusually multifocal presentation for an adult. The tumors were removed transabdominally and diagnosed as mature cystic teratomas. The authors note that sacrococcygeal teratomas are common in infants but rare in adults, and that multiple adult presacral masses are very uncommon.

pmid-21604208.summary_ja: 乳児と小児の仙尾部奇形腫22例を、神経機能や出血、再発の観点から検討した研究です。悪性例は化学療法後に約70%の生存率が得られ、良性例は早期手術で良好な経過でした。手術の遅れは悪性化のリスクを高めると結論づけられています。
pmid-21604208.summary_en: This series of 22 infants and children with sacrococcygeal teratoma was managed over 40 months, most presenting in the first two months of life. Fifteen underwent sacral excision and seven abdominosacral excision. Five patients had malignant tumors; those treated with chemotherapy had about a 70% survival rate. Benign tumors had excellent outcomes after early surgery, while delayed resection increased the risk of malignancy.

pmid-21610283.summary_ja: 30歳男性が腰背部や腹部の痛みを主訴に受診し、左後腹膜の巨大な嚢胞性腫瘤と左精巣腫瘤が見つかりました。精巣摘除術と後腹膜病変の切除により、精巣混合型胚細胞腫瘍と後腹膜の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断されました。若年男性の後腹膜病変では精巣腫瘍の転移を疑うべきとされています。
pmid-21610283.summary_en: A 30-year-old man presented with lumbar and abdominal pain and a large cystic left retroperitoneal mass. Imaging also showed a solid-cystic left testicular tumor. Orchiectomy and retroperitoneal resection revealed a testicular mixed germ cell tumor with seminoma and teratoma, plus a mature cystic teratoma in the retroperitoneum. The authors conclude that a retroperitoneal lesion in a young man should prompt evaluation for testicular tumor metastasis.

pmid-21610519.summary_ja: 1980年から2008年にMemorial Sloan-Kettering Cancer Centerで切除された原発性縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍57例を検討した研究です。91%でR0切除が達成され、全生存期間の中央値は31.5か月でした。化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーが正常化または低下することが、生存の最も強い独立した予測因子でした。
pmid-21610519.summary_en: This Memorial Sloan-Kettering series reviews 57 patients who underwent resection for primary mediastinal nonseminomatous germ cell tumors between 1980 and 2008. Most received platinum-based chemotherapy before surgery, and 91% achieved R0 resection. Median overall survival was 31.5 months. Normalized or decreased tumor markers after chemotherapy emerged as the strongest independent predictor of survival, while necrosis or teratoma on final pathology also correlated with better outcomes.

pmid-21612327.summary_ja: 8歳男児の右副腎に生じた成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の内部に、神経細胞腫が発生した症例報告です。組織学的に、奇形腫内の神経膠組織に小型で均一な細胞の充実性胞巣が認められました。中枢神経系原発ではなく、副腎由来の奇形腫に伴う稀な所見です。
pmid-21612327.summary_en: This report describes an 8-year-old boy with a neurocytoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the right adrenal gland. Histology showed solid sheets of small uniform cells within neuroglial tissue inside the teratoma. The authors note that this is only the second reported case of neurocytoma arising in a mature cystic teratoma, and that nervous system tumors in teratomas usually derive from glial or primitive neuroectodermal cells. The tumor arose outside the central nervous system.

pmid-21614915.summary_ja: 45歳女性の両側卵巣腫瘍の症例報告。右側は卵巣甲状腺腫カルチノイド、左側は成熟嚢胞性奇形腫であった。高度の便秘を呈し、カルチノイド腫瘍細胞でPYYのmRNA発現が確認された。腹腔鏡下に切除したところ便秘は著明に改善した。明らかな転移は認められず、カルチノイド症候群が疑われる場合は病理診断で本疾患を認識することが重要であると述べている。
pmid-21614915.summary_en: This case report describes a 45-year-old woman with a bilateral ovarian tumor, one side a strumal carcinoid and the other a mature cystic teratoma, presenting with severe constipation. The strumal carcinoid produced peptide YY (PYY) by mRNA analysis, and laparoscopic resection of the tumor markedly improved her constipation. No macroscopic metastases were seen. The authors highlight the importance of recognizing this entity in pathology, particularly when carcinoid syndrome is suspected, because it carries a better prognosis than most other malignant ovarian tumors.

pmid-21614931.summary_ja: 74歳女性の症例報告。性器出血で受診し、右卵巣に9.5cmの嚢胞性腫瘤を認めた。切除標本では甲状腺型濾胞と機能性卵巣間質からなる単胚葉性奇形腫と診断された。広範な脱落膜反応も認められ、免疫組織化学的所見から卵巣甲状腺腫と異所性脱落膜を伴う機能性間質が示された。高齢女性でこれらの組織像が併存するまれな症例として報告されている。
pmid-21614931.summary_en: This case report describes a 74-year-old woman with vaginal bleeding and a 9.5 cm cystic right ovarian mass, diagnosed after oophorectomy as a monodermal teratoma composed of thyroid-type follicles with functional ovarian stroma. Extensive decidual reaction was also observed, and the patient underwent total abdominal hysterectomy with oophorectomy. Morphologic and immunohistochemical examination supported the diagnosis of struma ovarii with functional stroma and ectopic decidua. The report highlights the rare combination of these features in an elderly patient.

pmid-21615418.summary_ja: 病期I非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍における血管侵襲と遺伝子異常の関連を検討した。血管侵襲は転移性再発の予後因子である。FISHで17q12領域のゲインを42例中12例(29%)に確認した。67例の免疫組織化学では、CCL2(MCP-1)の過剰発現が血管侵襲と有意に関連したが(p=0.049)、VEGF-A、MMP2、MMP9では関連は認められなかった。CCL2が浸潤機序に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21615418.summary_en: This study examined vascular invasion (VI) in clinical stage I non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumours, a key predictor of metastatic relapse. Array CGH had linked VI to a 17q12 gain containing inflammatory cytokine genes. Using FISH, the authors confirmed gain in 29% of assessable samples. Immunohistochemistry in 67 stage I NSGCT showed that CCL2 (MCP-1) overexpression was associated with VI (p=0.049), whereas VEGF-A, MMP2 and MMP9 were not. The findings suggest CCL2 may contribute to invasion mechanisms, with possible implications for managing stage I disease.

pmid-21616227.summary_ja: 新生児仙尾部奇形腫の切除に際し、腹腔鏡下に正中仙骨動脈を結紮して血管制御を行った成功例を報告した。この手技の新生児例は過去に7例のみ記載されていた。腫瘍による解剖学的な変形や内視鏡下での術者の位置失認が、誤った動脈切断の危険因子になりうると指摘している。腹腔鏡手術と開腹手術の双方で役立つ安全確認の指標が示されている。
pmid-21616227.summary_en: This report describes laparoscopic median sacral artery ligation for vascular control during excision of a neonatal sacrococcygeal teratoma. Only seven neonatal cases of this technique had been described. The authors present a successful case and identify anatomical distortion by the tumor and surgeon disorientation during endoscopy as risk factors for inadvertent arterial division. They demonstrate an observation that serves as a useful safety check for laparoscopic and open procedures.

pmid-21619995.summary_ja: 65歳女性の前縦隔嚢胞性腫瘍の症例報告。10年間、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫として経過観察されていた。胸部CTで嚢胞内部の構造変化が認められ手術に至った。切除標本では成熟奇形腫の一部に腺癌が認められ、縦隔成熟奇形腫の悪性転化と診断された。嚢胞壁に変化が認められることはまれであるため、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫には積極的な切除が推奨されると述べている。
pmid-21619995.summary_en: This case report describes a 65-year-old woman with an anterior mediastinal cystic tumor, followed for ten years as a mature cystic teratoma. Chest CT showed structural changes in the cyst, prompting surgical resection. Pathology confirmed mature teratoma, with adenocarcinoma in part of the cystic lesion, consistent with malignant change in a mediastinal mature teratoma. The authors note that the cyst wall rarely shows changes, and recommend aggressive resection of mature cystic teratomas.

pmid-21623194.summary_ja: 卵巣の成熟嚢胞性奇形腫内に生じた脱分化型軟骨肉腫の症例報告である。奇形腫の悪性転化で最も多いのは扁平上皮癌であり、本症例の類型はこれまで報告がなかった。臨床病理学的特徴を提示し、卵巣奇形腫におけるまれな肉腫性悪性転化への認識の重要性を示している。
pmid-21623194.summary_en: This case report describes a dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma arising within a mature cystic teratoma of the ovary, a rare form of malignant transformation. The authors summarize prior literature, noting that squamous cell carcinoma is the most common malignancy in such teratomas and that dedifferentiated chondrosarcoma had not previously been reported in this setting. They present the clinicopathologic features of this definitive case. The report highlights the importance of recognizing unusual sarcomatous transformation in ovarian teratomas for pathologists and clinicians.

pmid-21623833.summary_ja: 米国SEERおよびドイツの地域がん登録データを用い、混合組織型の精巣胚細胞腫瘍を混合型胚細胞腫瘍(MGCT)として分類したことが罹患率動向に与える影響を検討した。1988~2007年にMGCTの罹患率は407%増加した一方、MGCTを除く奇形腫は71%減少した。特定の非セミノーマ組織型の減少は分類変更によるところが大きいと結論している。
pmid-21623833.summary_en: Using US SEER and German registry data, this study examines how classifying tumors with mixed histology as mixed germ cell tumor (MGCT) affects incidence trends of testicular germ cell tumors. MGCT incidence rose 407% from 1988 to 2007, while incidence of teratoma excluding MGCT fell 71%, and embryonal carcinoma and choriocarcinoma also declined. The authors conclude that apparent declines in specific non-seminoma histologies largely reflect increased use of the MGCT code, so histotype-specific trend analyses should be interpreted cautiously.

pmid-21625076.summary_ja: 16歳男性の片側性女性化乳房が乳腺炎と誤診され、抗菌薬が無効であった症例である。内分泌科での精査により左の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍と診断され、左高位鼠径精巣摘除術と化学療法が施行された。女性化乳房を認める患者では精巣がんの可能性を考慮し、身体診察、検査、超音波検査を行うことを提唱している。
pmid-21625076.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old boy whose unilateral gynecomastia was initially misdiagnosed as mastitis and did not respond to antibiotics. Endocrinology referral led to diagnosis of a left nonseminomatous germ cell tumor. He underwent left high inguinal orchidectomy followed by chemotherapy. The authors advise that primary care physicians consider testicular cancer in adolescents with gynecomastia, and recommend physical examination, laboratory testing, and testicular ultrasonography in all such patients.

pmid-21626506.summary_ja: ノルウェーの住民ベースの7,102例を対象に、片側精巣胚細胞腫瘍後の対側異時性発生リスクを評価した。シスプラチン導入(1980年)の前後で比較したところ、20年累積発生率は1.9%から3.9%へ上昇した。1980年以降では転移性疾患の患者は局所病変の患者に比べ二次腫瘍のリスクが約半分であり、シスプラチン併用化学療法の効果が示唆された。
pmid-21626506.summary_en: This population-based cohort study of 7,102 Norwegian men with unilateral testicular germ cell tumor evaluates the risk of metachronous contralateral tumors across two periods, before and after cisplatin became available in 1980. The 20-year cumulative incidence rose from 1.9% to 3.9%. In the later period, patients with metastatic disease had roughly half the risk of a second tumor compared with those with localized disease, supporting a protective effect of cisplatin-based chemotherapy in metastatic cases.

pmid-21626872.summary_ja: セミノーマが肝臓および後腹膜リンパ節に転移した21歳男性の症例である。肝区域切除とリンパ節郭清の術後に左正中神経麻痺を発症し、母指から中指橈側にかけて運動麻痺と感覚低下が生じた。症状は2週間で消失した。手術中の体位保持に加え、術前のパクリタキセル使用も原因となりうると考察している。
pmid-21626872.summary_en: This case report describes a 21-year-old man with seminoma metastatic to the liver and retroperitoneal lymph nodes who underwent hepatic segmentectomy and lymph node dissection. After surgery he developed left median nerve palsy, with motor weakness and hypesthesia of the thumb, index finger and radial half of the middle finger. Symptoms resolved over two weeks. The authors attribute the palsy to arm positioning during surgery and suggest that preoperative paclitaxel should be considered as a possible contributing factor.

pmid-21627751.summary_ja: 本シリーズは、1979年から2005年に大規模専門施設で精巣胚細胞腫瘍の治療を受けた60歳以上の患者60例を検討したものである。大半はセミノーマ（73%）であった。病期Iのセミノーマは監視、補助放射線療法、補助カルボプラチンで管理され、転移性疾患の15例には併存疾患に応じた化学療法が行われた。毒性は管理可能で毒性死はなく、著者らは高齢男性にも根治を目的とした治療が妥当だと結論づけた。
pmid-21627751.summary_en: This series reviews 60 patients aged 60 years or older treated for testicular germ cell tumours at a large referral centre between 1979 and 2005, representing 4% of 1461 patients. Most had seminoma (73%). Stage I seminoma was managed with surveillance, adjuvant radiotherapy, or adjuvant carboplatin, and stage I non-seminomas with surveillance. Fifteen patients received chemotherapy for metastatic disease, with regimens tailored to comorbidity. Toxicity was manageable and there were no toxic deaths. Four patients died of germ cell cancer, and the authors conclude that curative intent is appropriate in older men.

pmid-21631526.summary_ja: 本研究は、正常なヒト男性の胚細胞発生および精巣胚細胞腫瘍における多能性因子LIN28、OCT3/4、NANOG、SOX2の発現を検討した。免疫組織化学と定量的近接ライゲーションアッセイを組織検体と細胞株に適用した。LIN28は原始胚細胞およびII型腫瘍（前駆病変、セミノーマ、胎児性癌、卵黄嚢腫瘍を含む）で検出された。奇形腫および精母細胞性セミノーマは陰性で、絨毛癌は不均一であった。siRNAによるノックダウンから、LIN28がセミノーマと胎児性癌の未分化状態の維持に関与し、OCT3/4およびNANOGの上流に位置すると考えられた。
pmid-21631526.summary_en: This study examines expression of the pluripotency factors LIN28, OCT3/4, NANOG and SOX2 in normal human male germ cell development and in testicular germ cell tumours. Immunohistochemistry and a quantitative proximity ligation assay were applied to tissue samples and cell lines. LIN28 was detected in primordial germ cells and in type II tumours, including precursor lesions, seminoma, embryonal carcinoma and yolk sac tumour. Teratomas and spermatocytic seminomas were negative, and choriocarcinoma was heterogeneous. siRNA knockdown indicated that LIN28 helps maintain the undifferentiated state of seminoma and embryonal carcinoma, likely upstream of OCT3/4 and NANOG.

pmid-21632119.summary_ja: 正常妊娠初期胎盤、部分胞状奇胎、全胞状奇胎、絨毛癌におけるPIBF、レプチン、レプチン受容体の発現を検討した。PIBFは正常絨毛栄養膜と部分胞状奇胎で発現し、全胞状奇胎で低下、絨毛癌では消失していた。siRNAを用いた実験により、PIBFはレプチンおよびその受容体の発現に影響を与えることが示された。PIBF発現は栄養膜浸潤能と逆相関すると結論された。
pmid-21632119.summary_en: This study examined PIBF, leptin and leptin receptor expression in normal first-trimester placentae, partial and complete hydatidiform moles, and choriocarcinomas. PIBF was expressed in normal villous trophoblast and partial mole, decreased in complete mole, and was absent in choriocarcinoma. Leptin and its receptor were present in complete mole and choriocarcinoma but not in partial mole. In siRNA experiments on trophoblast cells, PIBF knockdown upregulated the leptin receptor and PIBF treatment reduced leptin expression. The authors conclude that PIBF expression is inversely related to trophoblast invasiveness.

pmid-21632173.summary_ja: EAUによる2011年精巣がんガイドラインの短縮版で、診断、治療、フォローアップを扱う。多職種作業部会がMedline、Embase、コクランのエビデンスなどを基に推奨を策定した。主な変更点は、臨床病期Iのセミノーマに対し長期毒性データに基づき補助放射線療法を第一選択として推奨しないことである。予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍は、臨床試験下の基幹施設での治療が推奨される。
pmid-21632173.summary_en: This is the short version of the 2011 European Association of Urology guidelines on testicular cancer, covering diagnosis, treatment and follow-up. Recommendations were compiled by a multidisciplinary working group from Medline and Embase searches, Cochrane evidence and the European Germ Cell Cancer Consensus Group, with evidence levels and grades assigned by expert panels. Key changes include that adjuvant radiotherapy is no longer recommended as first-line adjuvant treatment for clinical stage I seminoma, based on long-term toxicity data. Treatment in reference centres within trials is advised for poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumours. TNM 2009 is recommended, and fertility counselling is emphasised.

pmid-21633303.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞株BeWoに対する中医薬ブファリンの効果を試験管内で検討した。細胞増殖、細胞周期、アポトーシス、ミトコンドリア膜電位を評価した。ブファリンはBeWo細胞の増殖を抑制し、S期の細胞を減少させ、G0/G1期の細胞を増加させた。アネキシンV染色とミトコンドリア膜電位の消失によりアポトーシスの誘導が確認された。絨毛癌の治療薬としての可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21633303.summary_en: This in vitro study evaluated the traditional Chinese medicine bufalin in the choriocarcinoma cell line BeWo. Cell growth, cell cycle distribution, apoptosis and mitochondrial membrane potential were assessed after treatment with various concentrations. BeWo cells were sensitive to bufalin, which reduced the proportion of cells in S phase and increased G0/G1 cells. Apoptosis was confirmed by annexin V staining and loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, accompanied by altered expression of genes related to growth, malignant phenotype and apoptosis. The authors suggest bufalin may be a therapeutic candidate for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-21637070.summary_ja: 排尿困難と前立腺の硬結を主訴とした35歳男性の症例報告である。LDHはわずかに上昇したが、AFPは正常範囲であった。CTとMRIで大きな前立腺腫瘤を認め、当初は肉腫や悪性リンパ腫が疑われた。18F-FDG陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)で前立腺に限局する集積を認め、生検で性腺外セミノーマと診断された。原発性前立腺セミノーマは極めてまれであり、FDG PETの有用性が示された。
pmid-21637070.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old man with urinary difficulty and a nodular, hardened prostate. Serum lactic dehydrogenase was slightly elevated, while prostate acid phosphate, CEA and alpha-fetoprotein were within normal limits. CT and MRI showed a large prostatic mass, initially suspected to be sarcoma or lymphoma. Fluorine-18 FDG PET showed focal uptake confined to the prostate, and biopsy confirmed an extragonadal seminoma. The report highlights that primary seminoma of the prostate is extremely rare and that FDG PET was useful in its evaluation.

pmid-21639901.summary_ja: 68歳女性の両側卵巣奇形腫に癌肉腫を合併した症例。FIGOステージIIICと診断され、術前化学療法、中間減量術、最適減量術が施行された。術後のフォローアップでは領域または遠隔転移は認められなかった。初期治療は予後因子に基づき個別に選択すべきと結論している。
pmid-21639901.summary_en: A 68-year-old woman presented with bilateral ovarian tumors diagnosed as teratoma complicated by carcinosarcoma, FIGO stage IIIC. She received neoadjuvant chemotherapy, interval cytoreduction, and optimal cytoreduction. Postoperative and gynecologic follow-up showed no regional or distant metastasis. The authors emphasize that initial treatment should be selected individually based on prognostic factors, since immature teratoma usually affects younger patients and presents at advanced stages.

pmid-21642359.summary_ja: 273組の症例と母親のペアを用いて、アンドロゲン受容体（AR）のCAG反復長と精巣胚細胞腫瘍リスクの関連を検討した。全体では関連はなかったが、CAG反復が短いほどセミノーマのリスクが有意に高く、用量反応的な傾向が認められた。他の組織型では関連は見られなかった。ARの転写活性亢進がセミノーマの発生に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21642359.summary_en: This study examined whether androgen receptor CAG repeat length affects testicular germ cell tumor risk using 273 case-mother pairs. No overall association was found, but shorter CAG repeats were significantly associated with seminoma risk, with a significant decreasing trend across categories. No such association was seen for other histologic types. The authors suggest increased androgen receptor transactivation may contribute to seminoma development or progression.

pmid-21648299.summary_ja: 続発性無月経と男性化徴候を呈した14歳女性の症例。原因は卵巣の成熟奇形腫と判明した。思春期の男性化の鑑別では、副腎や外因性の原因に加え、稀ではあるが卵巣腫瘍も考慮すべきであることを示す。
pmid-21648299.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl with one year of secondary amenorrhea and clinical virilization was found to have an ovarian mature teratoma as the cause. The case highlights that ovarian tumors, though rare, should be considered in the differential diagnosis of adolescent virilization alongside suprarenal and exogenous causes. The report describes the clinical presentation and identification of the tumor.

pmid-21649665.summary_ja: セミノーマ細胞株TCam-2をモデルに、TGF-β1、EGF、FGF4の添加により非セミノーマ系譜へ分化することを示した。BMP/SMAD経路の抑制とBLIMP1の発現低下が分化の端緒となり、主に絨毛癌様細胞へ分化した。セミノーマが追加の遺伝子変異を伴わずに非セミノーマへ転化しうることを示唆する。
pmid-21649665.summary_en: The authors used the seminoma cell line TCam-2 to test whether seminoma cells can differentiate into non-seminomatous lineages. Adding TGF-β1, EGF and FGF4 induced differentiation, initiated by repression of BMP/SMAD signaling and downregulation of BLIMP1. Cells predominantly adopted an extra-embryonic choriocarcinoma-like fate, likely driven by Hippo pathway components TEAD4 and YAP1. The findings support that seminomas can intrinsically transform into non-seminomas through microenvironmental changes without additional mutations.

pmid-21651573.summary_ja: 思春期・若年成人の精巣胚細胞腫瘍のトランスクリプトーム研究を統合したシステマティックレビューおよびメタ解析。KRAS、MYCN、TPD52に加え、CCT6A、IGFBP3、SALL2が共通して関与する遺伝子として同定された。胎児性癌では多能性遺伝子の過剰発現が見られ、組織型ごとに固有の遺伝子発現プログラムが存在する。
pmid-21651573.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis compiled transcriptome studies of testicular germ cell tumors in adolescents and young adults. It identified genes common across studies, including known cancer genes KRAS, MYCN and TPD52 and novel candidates CCT6A, IGFBP3 and SALL2. Embryonal carcinomas overexpressed pluripotency genes, while gene signatures were also identified for seminomas, teratomas and yolk sac tumors. The authors highlight distinct transcriptomic programs across histological subtypes despite similar genomes.

pmid-21651578.summary_ja: 未分化のヒトES細胞およびEC細胞を認識する新規モノクローナル抗体8種を作製し、細胞株での反応性、発生調節、生化学的性質、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学染色を検討した。抗体ごとに反応性が異なり、未分化幹細胞集団内のサブ状態を識別できる可能性が示された。
pmid-21651578.summary_en: This study generated eight novel monoclonal antibodies that recognize undifferentiated human embryonic stem (ES) and embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells. The authors characterized their reactivity across cell lines, developmental regulation, basic biochemistry, and immunohistochemical staining of testicular germ cell tumours. Results showed varied reactivity patterns among the antibodies against both ES and EC cells, suggesting they can distinguish distinct sub-states within the undifferentiated stem cell compartment. These markers may therefore provide finer resolution for characterizing pluripotent and germ cell tumour states.

pmid-21651648.summary_ja: 左卵巣の未熟奇形腫で手術を受けた31歳女性に、術後、右大腿の軟部組織への転移が生じた症例報告である。未熟奇形腫の血行性転移は通常、肺や肝臓、脳などの実質臓器に生じるため、軟部組織転移は極めてまれである。治療経過を報告し、文献をレビューしている。卵巣奇形腫のフォローアップ中に原因不明の腹腔外腫瘤が出現した場合には、軟部組織転移も鑑別に挙げるべきだと示唆している。
pmid-21651648.summary_en: A 31-year-old woman with immature teratoma of the left ovary developed metastasis to the soft tissue of the right thigh after surgery. Such soft tissue spread is extremely rare, since blood-borne metastases in immature ovarian teratoma usually involve organ parenchyma such as lungs, liver, or brain. The authors describe the treatment course and review the literature on this unusual metastatic pattern. The report highlights that soft tissue metastasis should be considered in patients with ovarian teratoma who develop unexplained extra-abdominal masses during follow-up.

pmid-21656530.summary_ja: 仙尾部奇形腫の周産期管理をまとめたレビューである。出生前には超音波検査やMRIで腫瘍の範囲と血行動態への影響を評価できる。胎児水腫は予後不良因子であり、胎児治療の判断材料となる。出生後は早期の外科的切除の前に全身状態を安定させ、悪性例では化学療法を検討する。合併症や再発を見逃さないため、慎重なフォローアップが重要であると強調している。
pmid-21656530.summary_en: This review summarizes the perinatal management of sacrococcygeal teratoma, one of the most common neonatal tumors. Routine anomaly screening, fetal Doppler ultrasound, and MRI enable prenatal diagnosis and assessment of tumor extent and hemodynamic risk. Fetal hydrops is a poor prognostic marker and may prompt fetal intervention. Affected newborns need stabilization before early surgical resection, with chemotherapy considered for malignant cases. Because the tumor and its treatment can cause significant morbidity, the authors emphasize careful postnatal follow-up for complications and recurrence.

pmid-21668453.summary_ja: セミノーマ由来のTCam-2細胞株が、セミノーマの機能解析に適したモデルとなるかを検討した。OCT3/4、NANOG、KIT、BLIMP1などの初期胚細胞マーカーを発現し、TGF-βスーパーファミリー受容体も保有していた。BMP4とレチノイン酸は生存や増殖を支持したが、アクチビンAは生存を改善しなかった。マウスで知られる胎児胚細胞の反応と一致し、胎児性胚細胞様の性質を示す。
pmid-21668453.summary_en: The authors assess whether the TCam-2 seminoma cell line is a suitable model for functional studies of seminoma. TCam-2 cells express early germ cell markers including OCT3/4, NANOG, KIT and BLIMP1, and express TGF-beta superfamily receptors. BMP4 and retinoic acid increase activin receptor transcripts and support cell survival and proliferation, while activin A does not enhance survival. The results mirror fetal germ cell responses seen in mice, supporting TCam-2 as a model of seminoma with a fetal germ cell-like identity.

pmid-21670167.summary_ja: 26週齢のC57BL/6マウスの子宮内膜に自然発生した良性奇形腫の報告。骨、軟骨、骨髄系細胞、メラノサイト、腺様細胞、横紋筋、神経様細胞など高分化な組織を含み、壊死を伴うが浸潤・転移は認めず、胎児組織は含まれなかった。
pmid-21670167.summary_en: This report describes a spontaneously arising benign teratoma in the uterus of a 26-week-old C57BL/6 mouse, an unusual site since teratomas typically occur in the testis and ovary. Histology showed well-differentiated tissues including bone, cartilage, myeloid cells, melanocytes, glandular cells, striated muscle and neural-like cells, with extensive necrosis but no invasion or metastasis. No fetal tissue was present, and the mouse had recently given birth. The lesion was diagnosed as a benign spontaneous uterine teratoma.

pmid-21674058.summary_ja: 本研究は、奇形腫感受性の129T2/SvJマウスと奇形腫非感受性のC57Bl/6およびCD1系統の胎児期雄性胚細胞の発生を比較した。有糸分裂停止への移行は系統間で類似していたが、129T2/SvJでは精巣索のサイズと胚細胞の含有量に違いがみられた。129T2/SvJの有糸分裂停止には、p27およびp15の上昇、RBの活性化、雄性分化マーカーの誘導、多能性ネットワークの抑制が伴っていた。これらの知見は、精巣腫瘍形成の理解に役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-21674058.summary_en: This study compares fetal male germ cell development in teratoma-susceptible 129T2/SvJ mice with teratoma-resistant C57Bl/6 and CD1 strains. Entry into mitotic arrest was similar across strains, but 129T2/SvJ mice showed differences in testis cord size and germ cell content. Mitotic arrest in 129T2/SvJ involved upregulation of p27, p15 and RB activation, induction of male differentiation markers NANOS2, DNMT3L and MILI, and repression of the pluripotency network. Findings may inform understanding of testis tumour formation.

pmid-21675097.summary_ja: 38歳男性で鼠径リンパ節に転移したセミノーマを報告。原発の精巣腫瘍は退縮しており、既往に精巣固定術がある。原発の退縮を伴うリンパ節病変としての発症は極めてまれで、セミノーマの非典型的な臨床経過として示された。
pmid-21675097.summary_en: This case report describes a 38-year-old man with metastatic seminoma in an inguinal lymph node. The primary testicular tumour had regressed, and the patient had a past history of orchiopexy. The authors highlight that this presentation, with a nodal metastasis arising alongside regression of the primary testis tumour, is extremely rare and represents an unusual clinical course of seminoma.

pmid-21682043.summary_ja: 縦隔非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の24歳男性に対し、BEP化学療法後に腫瘍が上大静脈と左腕頭静脈へ浸潤した症例。正中切開下に残存腫瘍と血管を切除し、奇静脈を温存しつつ人工血管で上大静脈を再建した。術後の静脈閉塞症状は認めなかった。
pmid-21682043.summary_en: A 24-year-old man with mediastinal non-seminomatous germ cell tumour, treated with four courses of BEP chemotherapy, underwent surgery. The tumour, although markedly reduced, invaded the superior vena cava and left brachiocephalic vein. Venography showed SVC obstruction. Residual tumour was excised with the SVC and left brachiocephalic vein via median sternotomy. The SVC was reconstructed with a ringed PTFE graft between the right brachiocephalic vein and right atrial appendage, preserving azygos flow. No venous occlusive symptoms occurred.

pmid-21682118.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患が疑われた23例を対象とし、造影剤を用いたカラードプラ超音波検査で血流評価を行った予備的研究である。侵入奇胎、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍の全例で腫瘍内血流を認め、非侵入性病変では認めなかった。筋層内の小さな侵入病変の検出にも有用で、侵入性病変の鑑別に役立つ可能性が示された。
pmid-21682118.summary_en: In this preliminary study of 23 patients with suspected gestational trophoblastic disease, contrast-enhanced color Doppler ultrasonography using Levovist was compared with pathology. Intratumoral blood flow was seen in all invasive or malignant GTDs (invasive moles, one choriocarcinoma, one placental site trophoblastic tumor) and in none of the noninvasive cases. Low resistance indices and enhanced flow helped detect small invasive lesions in the myometrium, suggesting contrast-enhanced CDU may help differentiate invasive from noninvasive GTD.

pmid-21682576.summary_ja: 7例の性腺芽腫（5例はディスジャーミノーマ（未分化胚細胞腫）に覆われていた）を免疫組織化学で検討した。性索間質細胞はFOXL2が強陽性、SOX9が陰性で、顆粒膜細胞由来と考えられた。移行部ではFOXL2が減少し、ディスジャーミノーマの進展や in situ 病変の同定に有用なマーカーとなる。精細管内胚細胞腫瘍との鑑別にも役立つ可能性がある。
pmid-21682576.summary_en: This study examined seven gonadoblastomas, five overgrown by dysgerminoma, using immunohistochemistry for the granulosa-associated transcription factor FOXL2 and the Sertoli-associated factor SOX9. Sex cord-stromal cells were strongly FOXL2-positive and SOX9-negative, supporting a granulosa cell origin. Germ cells were negative for both. FOXL2 decreased in transition zones, making it a useful marker for dysgerminoma overgrowth and in situ lesions, and helping distinguish gonadoblastoma from intratubular germ cell neoplasia and Sertoli-type components.

pmid-21683185.summary_ja: 14歳女児が頸部の嚢胞性腫脹と頸椎の変形で受診した。既往に胃重複嚢胞の治療歴があった。切除標本の病理検査で成熟奇形腫と診断された。頸部成熟奇形腫、椎体奇形、胃重複嚢胞の併存という稀な組み合わせについて、発生学的な関連が考察されている。
pmid-21683185.summary_en: A 14-year-old girl presented with a cervical cystic mass and deformity of the cervical vertebrae. She had previously undergone surgery for a gastric duplication cyst. Pathology of the resected mass showed a mature teratoma. The authors discuss embryologic links that might explain the unusual association of a cervical mature teratoma with vertebral anomalies and gastric duplication cyst, suggesting a common developmental origin.

pmid-21683219.summary_ja: 2004〜2009年に胎児仙尾部奇形腫と診断された10例を後方視的に検討した。妊娠24週以前の腫瘍体積と推定胎児体重の比（TFR）が予後を予測するかを評価した。TFRが0.12を超える例は全例で予後不良であり、感度100%、特異度83%であった。TFRは出生前カウンセリングや高リスク胎児の同定に有用と考えられる。
pmid-21683219.summary_en: This retrospective review of 10 fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (2004-2009) assessed whether the tumor volume to fetal weight ratio (TFR) before 24 weeks predicts outcome. A TFR above 0.12 was associated with all poor outcomes, giving 100% sensitivity and 83% specificity. All four fetuses that developed hydrops had TFR above 0.12. The authors propose TFR as an early prenatal prognostic tool to guide counseling and identify high-risk fetuses.

pmid-21683220.summary_ja: 2004〜2009年に仙尾部奇形腫で当施設を受診した30例を後方視的に検討し、泌尿器合併症の頻度と重症度を評価した。フォローアップできた20例中9例で神経因性膀胱を認め、そのうち5例は腎障害も伴っていた。腎障害例は全例Altman II/III型の高度例であった。泌尿器合併症は一般的であり、出生前および術前のカウンセリングに含めるべきと結論された。
pmid-21683220.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 30 patients with sacrococcygeal teratoma (2004-2009) examined urologic complications. Twenty-two were diagnosed prenatally. Among the 20 with follow-up, nine developed neurogenic bladder, and five of these also had renal injury. All patients with renal injury had higher-grade Altman type II/III tumors. The authors conclude urologic problems are common and should be included in prenatal and preoperative counseling and in evaluation.

pmid-21683236.summary_ja: 11か月の女児が閉塞性黄疸で受診し、総胆管原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍と診断された。総胆管原発の卵黄嚢腫瘍の報告はこれが初めてとされる。画像検査では管腔内腫瘤、肝内胆管拡張、膵頭部への浸潤が確認された。完全切除後、シスプラチン、エトポシド、ブレオマイシンによる術後化学療法が行われた。性腺外の卵黄嚢腫瘍の発生部位の範囲を広げる症例報告である。
pmid-21683236.summary_en: The authors report an 11-month-old girl with obstructive jaundice caused by a yolk sac tumor arising from the common bile duct, a site not previously described for primary YST. Imaging showed an intraluminal mass with intrahepatic biliary dilatation and infiltration of the pancreatic head. Complete resection was performed, followed by postoperative chemotherapy with cisplatin, etoposide, and bleomycin. This report expands the recognized extragonadal sites of yolk sac tumor.

pmid-21683984.summary_ja: 閉塞性無精子症、非閉塞性無精子症、セミノーマの精巣生検を比較した。REG IのmRNA量に群間差はなかったが、タンパク質は純粋なセミノーマや上皮内癌を伴う精細管で強く発現していた。非閉塞性無精子症では残存細胞にも陽性であった。不妊精巣における腫瘍発生の予後マーカーとしての可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21683984.summary_en: Testicular biopsies from men with obstructive azoospermia (normal spermatogenesis), nonobstructive azoospermia (impaired spermatogenesis), and seminoma were analyzed for regenerating I (REG I) transcripts and protein. Transcript levels did not differ between groups, but REG I protein was strongly expressed in pure seminoma and in in situ carcinoma-associated tubules, and was present in persisting cells in nonobstructive azoospermia. The authors propose REG I as a potential prognostic marker of tumor development in the infertile testis.

pmid-21684828.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫から発生した卵巣扁平上皮癌の症例報告である。良性胚細胞腫瘍の悪性転化を示す。腫瘍マーカーや画像所見が非特異的なため術前診断は困難とされる。悪性転化前の画像所見が提示されており、この稀な合併症の認識に役立つ。
pmid-21684828.summary_en: This case report describes ovarian squamous cell carcinoma arising from a mature cystic teratoma, representing malignant transformation of a benign germ cell tumor. The authors note that preoperative diagnosis is difficult because tumor markers and imaging findings are often nonspecific. The article emphasizes prior imaging that displays the characteristic findings of transformation from a mature cystic teratoma to squamous cell carcinoma, which may aid recognition of this uncommon complication.

pmid-21685776.summary_ja: 本総説は、若年男性で看護師がよく遭遇する最も一般的な悪性腫瘍である精巣がんを解説している。手術、放射線療法、シスプラチン併用化学療法の進歩により、精巣がんは治癒可能ながんの典型例となった。生存者は長期間生存する可能性が高いため、再発の可能性や治療の晩期合併症を見つけるための生涯にわたるフォローアップの重要性が強調されている。
pmid-21685776.summary_en: This nurse practitioner-oriented review summarizes testicular cancer, the most common malignancy NPs encounter in young men. It highlights how advances in surgery, radiotherapy, and cisplatin-based chemotherapy have made testicular cancer a model of curability. Because survivors may live for many years, the article emphasizes lifelong follow-up to detect possible recurrence and to manage long-term treatment-related sequelae.

pmid-21687933.summary_ja: 本研究は、トリテルペン系サポニンであるチューベイモシドI（TBMS1）のヒト絨毛癌細胞株JEG-3に対する細胞傷害性を検討した。TBMS1は細胞増殖を抑制し、G2期での細胞周期停止とアポトーシスを誘導した。その機序として、ミトコンドリア膜電位の低下、シトクロムcの放出、カスパーゼ-3の活性化が認められ、Bax/Bcl-2の発現変化やNF-κB、p38/MAPK、ERK1/2、Aktシグナルの調節も関与していた。著者らは、TBMS1が絨毛癌に有効なアポトーシス誘導剤になり得ると結論づけている。
pmid-21687933.summary_en: This study examines the cytotoxic effects of tubeimoside I, a triterpenoid saponin, on human choriocarcinoma JEG-3 cells. TBMS1 inhibited cell growth, caused G2-phase arrest, and induced apoptosis accompanied by loss of mitochondrial membrane potential, cytochrome c release, and caspase-3 activation. It also altered Bax and Bcl-2 expression, suppressed NF-κB, and modulated p38/MAPK, ERK1/2, and Akt signaling. The authors conclude that TBMS1 is an effective apoptosis-inducing agent for choriocarcinoma cells.

pmid-21690479.summary_ja: 本研究は、オンタリオ州の精巣がん患者2,569例を対象とした住民ベースのコホート研究で、繰り返される腹骨盤部CT検査による診断用放射線被曝が腹骨盤部の二次性悪性腫瘍リスクを高めるかを検討した。最初の5年間で中央値10回のCT検査を受け、約110mSvの被曝があった。二次性悪性腫瘍は14例に認められたが、被曝量との関連はみられず、10mSv増加あたりのハザード比は0.99であった。著者らは、この程度の診断用放射線被曝は二次がんのリスクを上昇させないと結論づけている。
pmid-21690479.summary_en: This population-based cohort study of 2,569 men with testicular cancer in Ontario examined whether diagnostic radiation from serial abdominopelvic CT scans increases the risk of second abdominopelvic malignancies. Men received a median of 10 CT scans and about 110 mSv in the first five years. Fourteen developed a second abdominopelvic cancer, and radiation dose was not associated with excess risk (hazard ratio 0.99 per 10 mSv). The authors conclude that diagnostic radiation at these levels did not increase second cancer risk.

pmid-21691529.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、腹痛と性器出血で救急外来を受診した胞状奇胎の患者を報告している。複数回の尿妊娠検査が陰性であったにもかかわらず、ぶどう房状の大きな嚢胞性腫瘤を排出し、胞状奇胎の臨床像を示した。定性hCG検査の偽陰性は高用量フック効果によると考えられ、診断時には肺の絨毛癌を認めた。著者らは、妊娠関連出血が疑われる場合には偽陰性の尿検査が適切な診療を遅らせうることを強調している。
pmid-21691529.summary_en: This case report describes a molar pregnancy presenting to the emergency department with abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding. Despite several negative urine pregnancy tests, the patient passed a large grape-like vesicular mass, consistent with hydatidiform mole. The false-negative qualitative hCG results were attributed to the high-dose hook effect. Pulmonary choriocarcinoma was present at diagnosis. The authors emphasize that false-negative urine tests can delay appropriate care in suspected pregnancy-related bleeding.

pmid-21691568.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、精巣に触知可能な病変がないものの後腹膜腫瘤を呈した31歳男性を紹介している。原発の精巣病変が組織学的に退縮した後も転移性の胚細胞腫瘍が残存する「燃え尽き型」の胚細胞腫瘍の一例である。著者らは、触診で精巣に異常がなくても、初期診断には丁寧な精巣の臨床診察と陰嚢の超音波検査が重要であると強調している。
pmid-21691568.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old man presenting with a retroperitoneal mass and no palpable testicular lesion. Such presentations represent a burned-out germ cell tumor, in which metastatic germ cell tumor persists after histologic regression of the primary testicular lesion. The report emphasizes that careful clinical examination of the testes and scrotal ultrasonography are essential for initial diagnosis, even when the testis appears normal on palpation.

pmid-21696393.summary_ja: 本研究は、臨床情報付きの小児胚細胞腫瘍の検体を用い、骨形成タンパク質（BMP）-SMADシグナルを解析した。BMP活性は未分化なセミノーマやディスジャーミノーマでは認められず、分化型の卵黄嚢腫瘍のほとんどで認められた。TGF-β/BMP経路遺伝子の発現解析によりジャーミノーマと卵黄嚢腫瘍を区別する遺伝子群が同定され、マイクロRNA(miRNA)の解析では本経路を標的とするmiRNAの制御が示された。BMPシグナルは小児胚細胞腫瘍の新たな治療標的となりうると示唆されている。
pmid-21696393.summary_en: This study examined bone morphogenetic protein (BMP)-SMAD signalling in a clinically annotated set of paediatric germ cell tumours. BMP activity was absent in undifferentiated seminomas and dysgerminomas but present in most differentiated yolk sac tumours. Gene expression profiling of TGF-β/BMP pathway genes distinguished germinomas from yolk sac tumours, and miRNA profiling revealed regulation of miRNAs targeting this pathway. The authors suggest BMP signalling may be a new therapeutic target for childhood GCTs.

pmid-21701667.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、在胎28週で早産した男児に生じ、出生直後に死亡したエピグナトゥス（未熟奇形腫）を紹介している。エピグナトゥスは極めて稀な口腔咽頭奇形腫で、新生児期には気道閉塞により死亡率が高い。著者らは、分娩計画や気道確保（気管挿管または気管切開）、その後の腫瘍完全切除のために出生前診断が不可欠であると強調している。
pmid-21701667.summary_en: This report describes an epignathus immature teratoma originating from the basisphenoid in a 28-week preterm male neonate who died immediately after birth. Epignathus is an extremely rare oropharyngeal teratoma with high neonatal mortality from airway obstruction. The authors stress that prenatal diagnosis is essential to plan delivery and airway management, such as endotracheal intubation or tracheostomy, followed by complete tumour resection.

pmid-21703035.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、膵組織を含む15×14×8cmの巨大な縦隔成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する35歳女性を紹介している。血清アミラーゼは正常であったが、腫瘍摘出後の嚢胞内液からは599U/lのアミラーゼ活性が検出された。腫瘍は完全切除され、術後合併症はなかった。著者らは、嚢胞液の酵素活性は術前・術中診断の補助となりうるが、生存率や治療方針には影響しないと結論づけている。
pmid-21703035.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with a giant (15 × 14 × 8 cm) mediastinal mature cystic teratoma containing pancreatic tissue. Cyst fluid showed amylase activity of 599 U/l despite normal serum levels, a finding not previously reported in this context. The tumour was completely resected and the patient recovered without complications. The authors conclude that cyst fluid enzyme activity may aid preoperative or intraoperative diagnosis, although it does not affect survival.

pmid-21703555.summary_ja: 15年間に当院で診断された小児悪性卵巣腫瘍15例の後方視的検討。主訴は腹痛が最多で、組織型は卵黄嚢腫瘍、未熟奇形腫、ディスジャーミノーマなどだった。死亡3例はいずれも進行期で、10年全生存率は77%。早期病期では治癒が見込めるため、腹痛を訴える若年女児の鑑別診断として早期に考慮すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-21703555.summary_en: This 15-year single-institution retrospective review of 15 children with malignant ovarian tumors found abdominal pain as the most common presenting symptom. Histology included yolk sac tumors, immature teratomas, dysgerminomas, malignant mixed germ cell tumors and one carcinosarcoma. Most patients had early-stage disease, and all three deaths had advanced-stage disease at diagnosis. Thirteen received platinum-based chemotherapy. The 10-year overall survival was 77% and disease-free survival 69%. The authors conclude these tumors are highly curable when not advanced and stress considering them in young girls with abdominal pain.

pmid-21704446.summary_ja: シスプラチン抵抗性または多発再発の胚細胞腫瘍76例を対象とした2件の第II相試験の長期成績。生存者の追跡期間中央値は19か月。GOP群で無病生存者が多く（17%対3%）、部分寛解後の積極的な二次手術が救援治療の重要な要素と結論づけている。約10〜15%で長期生存が得られた。
pmid-21704446.summary_en: This report updates long-term outcomes of two phase 2 trials of gemcitabine plus oxaliplatin with or without paclitaxel (GO/GOP) in 76 patients with cisplatin-refractory or multiply relapsed germ cell tumors. With median follow-up of 19 months in survivors, 11% of all patients remained disease-free beyond two years, mostly in the GOP arm (17% versus 3%). Aggressive secondary surgery after partial remission was considered crucial. Long-term survival was achieved in about 10 to 15% of such patients, with overall survival of at least 33 months in the eight disease-free patients.

pmid-21704961.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫に関連した抗NMDA受容体脳炎の症例報告。若年女性に生じ、精神神経症状により診断が遅れることがある。関連する奇形腫の早期摘出が予後を改善する点を強調している。精神症状や神経症状を呈する若年女性では、卵巣奇形腫を基礎疾患として考慮することの重要性を示す。
pmid-21704961.summary_en: This case report describes a patient with anti-N-methyl-D-aspartate receptor encephalitis associated with an ovarian teratoma. The disease affects young women, and neuropsychiatric symptoms can delay diagnosis. Early surgical removal of the associated teratoma is highlighted as improving prognosis. The report underscores the importance of considering ovarian teratoma as the underlying cause in young women presenting with psychiatric or neurological symptoms.

pmid-21706474.summary_ja: 高齢男性にまれな精母細胞性セミノーマ36例を、OCT2、SSX2-4、SAGE1の免疫組織化学で解析した。OCT2陽性型とSSX2-4陽性型の2種類の表現型が識別され、異なる精原細胞サブポピュレーションを反映すると考えられた。腫瘍は精原細胞由来で、不均一性は起源細胞や進行中の部分分化に関連する可能性がある。
pmid-21706474.summary_en: This study examines spermatocytic seminoma, a rare testicular tumor of older men, using immunohistochemistry for OCT2, SSX2-4 and SAGE1 across 36 cases, four intratubular lesions and normal testis at developmental stages. Two distinct subtypes were identified, OCT2-positive and SSX2-4-positive, reflecting different spermatogonial subpopulations. SAGE1 marked post-pubertal germ cells. The authors conclude that the tumor arises from spermatogonia and is heterogeneous, possibly linked to the cell of origin or partial differentiation during tumor progression.

pmid-21706852.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫を伴う抗NMDA受容体脳炎の17歳女性2例の比較。長期人工呼吸を要した例と、早期の奇形腫切除と免疫抑制療法により後遺症なく回復した例を示す。早期切除と免疫抑制が良好な転帰に寄与した可能性があり、精神科医と神経内科医、婦人科医の早期連携の重要性を指摘している。
pmid-21706852.summary_en: This report describes two 17-year-old girls with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis associated with ovarian teratoma and contrasting clinical courses. Case 1 had prolonged consciousness disturbance requiring long-term ventilation. Case 2 underwent early teratoma surgery and immunosuppressive therapy, and recovered without sequelae. The authors suggest early resection and immune suppression contributed to the favorable outcome. They stress that psychiatrists often see patients first, so early cooperation with neurologists and gynecologists is essential.

pmid-21712824.summary_ja: 小児の悪性胚細胞腫瘍について、DNAメチル化を卵黄嚢腫瘍とジャーミノーマで比較した研究である。ジャーミノーマは遺伝子制御領域のメチル化が対照とほぼ同等だった。一方、卵黄嚢腫瘍はメチル化表現型を示し、Caspase-8依存性アポトーシス関連遺伝子が不活性化していた。DNMT3Bの発現上昇との関連が示唆され、従来の化学療法への抵抗性を説明しうる。
pmid-21712824.summary_en: This study profiled DNA methylation in pediatric malignant germ cell tumours, comparing germinomas with yolk sac tumours. Germinomas showed LINE-1 hypomethylation with largely normal methylation of gene regulatory regions. Yolk sac tumours displayed a methylator phenotype, with silencing of Caspase-8-dependent apoptosis genes linked to higher DNMT3B expression. The authors suggest this epigenetic silencing may explain the more aggressive course of yolk sac tumours and their relative resistance to conventional chemotherapy.

pmid-21714871.summary_ja: モロッコの一施設で後方視的に検討された精母細胞性セミノーマ4例の報告である。全例が病期I(精巣内に限局)で、コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)、αフェトプロテイン(AFP)、ヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)は正常だった。精巣摘除術を行い、1例に放射線療法を追加した。中央値6年のフォローアップで再発や転移はなく、この亜群では放射線療法の省略が可能と考えられた。
pmid-21714871.summary_en: This retrospective institutional series from Morocco describes four cases of spermatocytic seminoma, a rare testicular germ cell tumour occurring at older age. All patients had stage I disease confined to the testis, with normal CT, AFP and hCG. Treatment was orchidectomy, with adjuvant radiotherapy in one patient. After a median follow-up of six years, no relapse or metastasis occurred. The authors suggest that radiotherapy can safely be omitted in this subgroup.

pmid-21715360.summary_ja: 成人の原発性精巣奇形腫の内部に、腎芽腫(ウィルムス腫瘍型)が唯一の非胚細胞成分として認められた症例を報告している。このような奇形性ウィルムス腫瘍は極めてまれで、分類や治療に標準的基準がない。両者の共存は、胚細胞腫瘍内での腎芽腫様分化の発生機序の解明に寄与しうる。
pmid-21715360.summary_en: This report describes an adult case of primary testicular teratoma in which nephroblastoma (Wilms-type) was the only non-germ cell component. The authors note that such teratoid Wilms tumours are thought to be of germ cell origin, are very rare, and lack standardized categorization and treatment. Teratoma and nephroblastoma coexisting in the same non-atrophic testis may clarify developmental mechanisms of nephroblastomatous differentiation within germ cell tumours.

pmid-21716913.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で治療後に完全寛解となった59歳男性の症例報告である。治療後の陽電子放射断層撮影-コンピュータ断層撮影(PET-CT)で、左腋窩リンパ節に新たな高代謝病変が認められた。検査10日前のインフルエンザワクチン接種が原因と判断され、無治療で消失した。直近のワクチン接種が、フォローアップ時のPET-CTで偽陽性を生じうることを示した。
pmid-21716913.summary_en: This case report describes a 59-year-old man with testicular germ cell tumour in complete remission whose post-treatment PET-CT showed new hypermetabolic lesions in the left axillary lymph nodes. These were attributed to an influenza vaccination given 10 days before the scan and resolved without treatment. The report highlights that recent vaccination can cause false-positive findings on follow-up PET-CT in patients with testicular cancer.

pmid-21718876.summary_ja: 22歳女性の成熟型縦隔奇形腫の症例で、喀毛(trichoptysis)を呈した。喀毛は胸腔内奇形腫に特異的な徴候とされるが、これまで縦隔発生例は報告されていない。著者らはこの徴候の診断的意義を強調している。内視鏡・画像所見、外科的管理、組織学的特徴が提示されている。
pmid-21718876.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-year-old woman with a mature mediastinal teratoma presenting with trichoptysis, a rare sign of intrathoracic teratoma that had not previously been reported with mediastinal localization. The authors emphasize that trichoptysis is pathognomonic for intrathoracic teratomas, yet only eight cases had been described before. The paper presents endoscopic and radiologic findings, surgical management, and histologic features of this mediastinal germ cell tumour.

pmid-21721143.summary_ja: 健康な12歳男児が突然の喀血と再発性の肺浸潤影で受診した。CTで縦隔腫瘤が見つかり、生検で成熟奇形腫と診断された。被膜を有し破裂していない縦隔成熟奇形腫では、喀血が初発症状となり得ることを示し、その症状が診断の契機となった。精査の重要性も示された症例報告である。
pmid-21721143.summary_en: A previously healthy 12-year-old boy presented with sudden hemoptysis and recurrent consolidation. CT revealed a mediastinal mass, and biopsy showed a mature teratoma. The authors emphasize that hemoptysis, though unusual, can be the presenting symptom of a well-encapsulated, unruptured mature mediastinal teratoma in an otherwise healthy child, and that the symptom prompted the diagnostic workup that identified the tumor.

pmid-21724123.summary_ja: 成熟嚢胞性奇形腫で悪性転化を伴う症例と良性症例のCT所見を後方視的に比較した。悪性例では結節状で造影される軟部成分、嚢胞壁との鈍角、壁外進展、転移が多く、統計学的に有意な差がみられた。これらの所見は術前に悪性と良性を鑑別する手がかりとなる。
pmid-21724123.summary_en: This retrospective CT study compared 12 mature cystic teratomas with malignant transformation against benign mature cystic teratomas. Using size- and age-matched cohorts, malignant tumors more often showed nodular, enhancing soft tissue components with obtuse angles to the cyst wall, and were more likely to show transmural growth, lymphadenopathy, and disseminated disease. These features allow differentiation of malignant from benign teratomas on CT, which is useful for preoperative assessment.

pmid-21724441.summary_ja: 精巣腫瘍を伴わず、孤立性の右股関節痛で発見された縦隔原発セミノーマの24歳男性例を報告した。胸部腫瘤は臨床的に無症状で、針生検でセミノーマと診断された。多発病変であったためエトポシド・イホスファミド・シスプラチン療法が選択された。早期治療での良好な予後から、リウマチ医も胚細胞腫瘍を認識すべきだと論じている。
pmid-21724441.summary_en: The authors report a 24-year-old man with isolated right hip pain whose primitive mediastinal seminoma was discovered through bone metastasis, without any testicular tumor. The chest mass was clinically silent and was diagnosed by needle biopsy. Given multiple lesions and lower toxicity, etoposide-ifosfamide-cisplatin chemotherapy was chosen. The paper discusses CT, MRI, and PET imaging and treatment strategies, emphasizing that germ cell tumors need recognition by rheumatologists because early treatment yields an excellent prognosis.

pmid-21724533.summary_ja: 病理学的には子宮内膜腺癌と診断されたが、臨床経過は胚細胞腫瘍に一致した女性例を報告した。β-hCGとLDHの急上昇と両側多発肺転移を認めた。低用量の全身化学療法を受けたが、治療合併症として急性呼吸窮迫症候群を発症し死亡した。病理診断と臨床像の乖離と、多発肺転移を伴う胚細胞腫瘍の予後不良性が示された。
pmid-21724533.summary_en: The authors describe a woman initially pathologically diagnosed with endometrial adenocarcinoma who clinically behaved as a germ cell tumor. Rapidly rising β-hCG and LDH levels accompanied the development of multiple bilateral lung metastases. She received low-dose systemic combination chemotherapy but developed acute respiratory distress syndrome as a treatment complication and died. The case highlights the diagnostic discrepancy and the poor prognosis of germ cell tumors with multiple lung metastases.

pmid-21725619.summary_ja: マウスF9胎児性癌細胞株と担癌マウスを用い、TCF3の抗腫瘍効果を検討した。TCF3の過剰発現により細胞増殖・コロニー形成・遊走が抑制され、腫瘍体積と重量が減少し生存期間が延長した。Oct4の発現も低下しており、TCF3はOct4発現の制御を介して胎児性癌の悪性形質を抑制すると考えられる。
pmid-21725619.summary_en: This study investigated the effect of T-cell factor 3 (TCF3) on embryonal carcinoma using the mouse F9 EC cell line in vitro and a tumor-bearing mouse model. Overexpressing TCF3 suppressed proliferation, colony formation, and migration of F9 cells, and reduced tumor volume and weight in vivo while prolonging survival. TCF3 overexpression also downregulated Oct4, suggesting that TCF3 inhibits EC malignancy through regulation of Oct4 expression.

pmid-21725972.summary_ja: 高齢男性の精巣にのみ見られる良性の胚細胞腫瘍、精母細胞性セミノーマの発生機序を概説した。精原細胞マーカーの発現解析から、A淡色型・B型精原細胞由来が多く、一部はA暗色型精原細胞由来と考えられ、腫瘍は不均一である。通常のセミノーマとは独立した発生機序を持つと論じている。
pmid-21725972.summary_en: This article reviews the pathogenesis of spermatocytic seminoma, a benign germ cell tumor found only in the testis of elderly men. Expression studies of spermatogonial markers suggest it is heterogeneous, arising mostly from A-pale or B spermatogonia and a minority from A-dark spermatogonia. The authors argue that spermatocytic seminoma has a pathogenesis independent of classical seminoma and that an earlier cell of origin may explain its unique properties.

pmid-21726338.summary_ja: 本研究は、白血病阻害因子(LIF)が絨毛癌由来のJEG-3細胞におけるマイクロRNA(miRNA)発現をどう変化させるかを検討したものである。LIF刺激によりmiR-141は50%以上低下し、miR-21とmiR-93は増加した。miR-141のサイレンシングはJEG-3細胞の増殖を完全に抑制したが、過剰発現では効果がなかった。LIFは栄養膜細胞のmiRNA発現を調節すると結論づけられている。
pmid-21726338.summary_en: This study examined how leukemia inhibitory factor (LIF) alters microRNA expression in JEG-3 choriocarcinoma cells, a trophoblast-derived model. LIF stimulation reduced miR-141 by more than 50% while increasing miR-21 and miR-93. Silencing miR-141 completely inhibited JEG-3 proliferation, whereas overexpression had no effect. The authors conclude that LIF regulates microRNA expression in trophoblastic cells, which may underlie several of its functional effects.

pmid-21731217.summary_ja: 7歳男児が無痛性の嚢胞性陰嚢腫脹で受診し、水瘤に類似していた。超音波検査では充実性腫瘤を認め、精巣摘除術の病理組織学で成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と診断された。小児の精巣腫瘍は稀で多くが良性であるが、良性の陰嚢疾患に似ることがあるため、病理組織学的評価が重要であると述べている。
pmid-21731217.summary_en: A 7-year-old boy presented with a painless, cystic, transilluminating scrotal swelling that mimicked a hydrocele. Ultrasonography showed a solid mass, and orchidectomy with histopathology revealed a mature cystic teratoma of the testis. The report notes that testicular tumors in prepubertal children are uncommon and usually benign. It highlights that such masses can mimic benign scrotal conditions, so histopathological evaluation is important.

pmid-21731235.summary_ja: 本短報は、多脾症候群、腹部奇形腫、横隔膜挙上症の合併を報告しており、著者らはこれまで報告されていないとしている。抄録には症例の合併のみが記載され、詳細な臨床経過、病理所見、フォローアップは示されていない。先天異常と腫瘍関連異常が一人の患者に同時に認められた記録として意義がある。
pmid-21731235.summary_en: This short report describes an association of polysplenia syndrome, an abdominal teratoma, and diaphragmatic eventration that the authors state has not been reported before. The abstract gives only the case association and no detailed clinical course, pathology, or follow-up. The report is of interest mainly as a documented co-occurrence of congenital and tumor-related abnormalities in one patient.

pmid-21731981.summary_ja: 2008年から2009年に当施設で管理された胎児仙尾部奇形腫の2症例を報告する。1例目は超音波検査で経過観察され、妊娠37週で帝王切開により出生した新生児は、生後1日目の切除を問題なく受けた。2例目は胎児水腫と貧血を認め、子宮内胎児輸血を3回施行された。出生時に大量出血を来し、蘇生に努めたものの新生児は死亡した。
pmid-21731981.summary_en: This report describes two fetal sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) cases managed at one institution from 2008 to 2009. In the first, the tumor was monitored by serial ultrasonography, and the neonate underwent uneventful resection on day 1 after cesarean delivery at 37 weeks. In the second, hydrops and anemia developed, and three in utero fetal blood transfusions were given. A large friable tumor caused massive hemorrhage at birth, and the neonate died despite resuscitation.

pmid-21751454.summary_ja: 本総説は、思春期および若年女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫（MCT）の管理を扱い、再発や悪性転化のリスク、腹腔鏡下嚢胞切除術の役割、妊孕性温存について論じる。両側MCTを有する17歳の症例は開腹術で治療され、3年後に再発を認めた。24か月の連続超音波検査で緩徐な増大が確認された後、待機的管理が行われた。著者らは、若年患者では介入せず慎重にフォローアップすることが、卵巣機能と将来の妊孕性の温存に妥当でありうると結論づけた。
pmid-21751454.summary_en: This review addresses management of ovarian mature cystic teratomas (MCTs) in adolescents and young women, including recurrence and malignant transformation risks, the role of laparoscopic cystectomy, and fertility preservation. A case of a 17-year-old with bilateral MCTs treated by laparotomy is presented, who developed recurrent cysts three years later. After 24 months of serial ultrasound showing slow growth, the patient was managed expectantly. The authors conclude that close follow-up without intervention may be reasonable in young patients to preserve ovarian function and future fertility.

pmid-21763829.summary_ja: 単施設で、32週未満に娩出された胎児仙尾部奇形腫症例を後方視的に検討した（胎児手術例は除外）。対象9例はI型4例、II型5例で、4例が新生児期を生存した。28週未満で娩出された唯一の生存例は子宮外治療（EXIT）を受けた。劇症の胎児水腫がなければ、高リスク例では待機的管理ではなく予防的な早期娩出が良好な転帰をもたらしうると結論づける。
pmid-21763829.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution study reviewed fetuses with sacrococcygeal teratoma (SCT) delivered before 32 weeks of gestation, excluding those that underwent fetal surgery. Nine fetuses were delivered early, four with type I and five with type II tumors, and four survived the neonatal period. The only survivor delivered before 28 weeks underwent ex utero intrapartum therapy. The authors suggest that, absent fulminant hydrops, preemptive early delivery can yield surprisingly good outcomes in selected high-risk fetal SCT, rather than watchful waiting, which often led to fetal death.

pmid-21764111.summary_ja: 1970〜2005年に治療された卵巣未熟奇形腫の34例（病期IA〜IIIA）の単施設コホート研究。多くは治癒し、41.8%が補助療法を受けた。再発4例はいずれも組織学的グレード2または3で、22か月以内に発生し、2年無増悪生存率は87.1%だった。再発例の3例が死亡した。グレードの高さが再発と関連し、妊娠は6例で計11回みられた。
pmid-21764111.summary_en: This single-institution cohort of 34 women with ovarian immature teratoma (stages IA to IIIA, treated 1970 to 2005) found that most patients were cured. Adjuvant therapy was given to 41.8%. Four patients recurred within 22 months, all with grade 2 or 3 tumors, giving a 2-year progression-free survival of 87.1%. Three recurrent patients died. Eleven pregnancies occurred in six women, three of them after chemotherapy. Higher histologic grade predicted recurrence, which could be fatal, mostly within two years of diagnosis.

pmid-21764427.summary_ja: 予後不良の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍51例に対し、パクリタキセルを加えたBEP（T-BEP）を導入化学療法として用いた第II相試験。完全奏効は25%、腫瘍マーカー陰性化は59%だった。第1コースで感染症による毒性死2例が生じ、第1コースはBEPに変更された。1年無増悪生存率は58%で、T-BEPは予後不良例の無増悪生存期間を改善しなかった。
pmid-21764427.summary_en: This phase II study tested paclitaxel added to BEP (T-BEP) as induction chemotherapy in 51 patients with poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. Complete response occurred in 25%, and 59% were marker-negative. An unplanned analysis showed excessive toxicity at cycle 1, including two toxic deaths, so the first cycle was changed to BEP. The 1-year progression-free survival rate was 58%. The authors concluded that T-BEP did not improve progression-free survival in poor-prognosis nonseminomatous germ cell tumors, though it was safe from cycle 2 onward.

pmid-21769318.summary_ja: 44歳男性が腹痛、黒色便、体重減少で受診し、胃腫瘤と肝転移を認めた。β-hCGは23,717.5 MIU/mLと著明に上昇していた。精巣超音波では腫瘤はなく、胃生検では低分化腺癌でβ-hCG染色陽性だった。転移性原発性胃絨毛腺癌と診断され、ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法を受けたが、約12か月後に汎血球減少症とDICで死亡した。
pmid-21769318.summary_en: A 44-year-old man presented with abdominal pain, melena, and weight loss, with a gastric mass, liver metastases, and markedly elevated beta-hCG (23,717.5 MIU/mL). Scrotal ultrasound showed no testicular mass, and gastric biopsy showed poorly differentiated adenocarcinoma with beta-hCG staining. He was diagnosed with metastatic primary gastric choriocarcinoma and received BEP chemotherapy. beta-hCG fell to 23 MIU/mL, but restaging CT showed growth of metastases, and he died of pancytopenia and DIC about 12 months after presentation. The authors emphasize the need for a high index of suspicion.

pmid-21775673.summary_ja: 順遺伝学的スクリーニングで、未分化胚細胞からなる自然発生の胚細胞腫瘍を生じるゼブラフィッシュ変異体を解析し、alk6bの不活性化変異を同定した。変異によりBMPシグナルが障害され、胚細胞の分化が阻害された。ヒトのセミノーマや胎児性癌でもBMPシグナルの欠如が見られ、BMP経路の重要性が示唆された。
pmid-21775673.summary_en: Using a forward genetic screen, the authors identified an inactivating alk6b mutation in a zebrafish line that develops spontaneous germ cell tumors of undifferentiated germ cells. The mutation impaired BMP signaling, altered BMP target gene expression, and disrupted germ-cell differentiation. Human seminomas and embryonal carcinomas likewise lacked BMP signaling, whereas normal testis and differentiated GCTs retained it. The findings suggest a germ-cell-autonomous role for BMP signaling in differentiation and highlight the BMP pathway in human GCTs.

pmid-21776193.summary_ja: 44歳男性の精巣奇形腫で、悪性転化を伴っていた。右精巣摘除後、肺の高異型度胎児性横紋筋肉腫に対して右肺全摘術が行われた。3か月後に肝転移が出現したが、VACとVIの交互療法で完全に消失した。腫瘍はデスミン、ミオゲニン、MyoD1陽性で、i(12p)を認めた。トポイソメラーゼ阻害薬の有用性を前向きに検討すべきとされた。
pmid-21776193.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with a testicular teratoma with malignant transformation underwent right orchiectomy, then right pneumonectomy for pulmonary masses of high-grade embryonal rhabdomyosarcoma. Liver metastasis appeared three months after diagnosis and resolved completely after alternating VAC and VI chemotherapy. The tumors were desmin-, myogenin-, and MyoD1-positive, with i(12p) on cytogenetic analysis. High expression of several topoisomerase and resistance-related genes was observed. The authors suggest that topoisomerase inhibitors and topoisomerase expression as biomarkers should be tested prospectively.

pmid-21776879.summary_ja: 2000〜2008年にサラエボの泌尿器科で治療された精巣がん58例の後方視的研究。発生数は増加傾向で、70%が20〜39歳だった。組織型は混合型（46%）、セミノーマ（26%）、胎児性癌（16%）の順に多かった。β-hCGはセミノーマの53%、非セミノーマの80%で陽性だった。AFPとβ-hCGは治療評価に優れた腫瘍マーカーと結論づけられた。
pmid-21776879.summary_en: This retrospective study of 58 men with testicular cancer, treated at a Sarajevo urology clinic from 2000 to 2008, found rising incidence, with 70% aged 20 to 39. Mixed tumors (46%) and seminoma (26%) were most common, followed by embryonal carcinoma (16%). beta-hCG was positive in 53% of seminomas and 80% of non-seminomas, while CEA was positive in only 9%. All patients underwent radical orchiectomy, and 27.5% had retroperitoneal lymphadenectomy. The authors conclude that AFP and beta-hCG are excellent markers for evaluating treatment.

pmid-21780320.summary_ja: 本研究は、精巣胚細胞腫瘍325例（混合型94例を含む）を対象に、組織マイクロアレイと免疫組織化学を用いてMAGEC2の発現を検討した。MAGEC2はセミノーマの94%で陽性であったが、胎児性癌では全例陰性であった。POU5F1、SOX2、SOX17、KIT、CD30との比較も行われた。MAGEC2はセミノーマと胎児性癌の鑑別に有用であり、精巣胚細胞腫瘍の鑑別診断における追加マーカーとなりうると結論された。
pmid-21780320.summary_en: This tissue microarray study examined MAGEC2 expression in 325 primary testicular germ cell tumors, including 94 mixed tumors, using immunohistochemistry. MAGEC2 was detected in 94% of seminomas but in no embryonal carcinomas. Its performance was compared with POU5F1, SOX2, SOX17, KIT and CD30. MAGEC2 clearly distinguished seminoma from embryonal carcinoma, suggesting it is a useful additional marker for the differential diagnosis of testicular germ cell tumors.

pmid-21782217.summary_ja: 本後方視的研究は、精巣摘除時に血清AFP高値を伴う純粋セミノーマの22例を検討し、多くの症例で後腹膜に非セミノーマ性胚細胞成分が認められた。純粋奇形腫、悪性転化、生存NSGCTが多くみられ、後腹膜にセミノーマを認めたのは1例のみであった。多くの患者が病期II～IIIであり、7例が再発して救援化学療法を受けた。著者らは、精巣摘除時にAFP高値を伴う純粋セミノーマは後腹膜NSGCTを強く示唆するため、慎重な管理が必要であると結論づけている。
pmid-21782217.summary_en: This retrospective study of 22 patients with pure seminoma at orchiectomy and elevated serum AFP found that most had non-seminomatous germ cell elements in the retroperitoneum. Pure teratoma, malignant transformation, and viable NSGCT were common, while only one patient had retroperitoneal seminoma. Most patients had Stage II-III disease, and 7 relapsed and received salvage chemotherapy. The authors conclude that elevated AFP with pure seminoma at orchiectomy strongly predicts retroperitoneal NSGCT, so these patients require careful management.

pmid-21787741.summary_ja: 本研究は、活性型H-RAS（HRASV12）を導入したHTR8/SVneo栄養膜細胞由来のiC3-1細胞をマウスに接種し、妊娠性絨毛癌のマウスモデルを樹立した。iC3-1細胞はMAPKおよびPI3K経路の恒常的活性化を示し、接種した全マウスに致死的な腫瘍を形成した。腫瘍は合胞体栄養膜細胞様および細胞栄養膜細胞様の細胞からなり、HLA-G、サイトケラチン、hCGを発現していた。SOX3の発現上昇が見られ、そのノックダウンにより腫瘍形成能が低下したことから、絨毛癌の発症に関与すると示唆された。耐性例を含む治療研究のためのツールとして有用とされる。
pmid-21787741.summary_en: The authors established a murine model of gestational choriocarcinoma by inoculating mice with iC3-1 cells, derived from HTR8/SVneo trophoblast cells transduced with activated HRASV12. The cells showed constitutive MAPK and PI3K activation and formed lethal tumors in all inoculated mice. Tumors contained syncytiotrophoblast-like and cytotrophoblast-like cells and expressed HLA-G, cytokeratin and hCG. SOX3 overexpression was implicated in pathogenesis, since its knockdown reduced tumorigenicity. The model is proposed as a tool for studying treatment strategies, including for chemoresistant disease.

pmid-21790653.summary_ja: 本総説は、ヒト精原幹細胞（SSC）が精母細胞性セミノーマの起源細胞でありうるかを検討している。Adark型およびApale型精原細胞を含むヒト精子形成の概要と、SSCの単離に用いられるGPR125などの表現型マーカーを整理している。GDNFによる自己複製機構はマウスとヒトで共通する。精母細胞性セミノーマは主に高齢男性に発生し、転移はまれである。腫瘍の発現マーカーは減数分裂前期細胞に類似するが、形態学的・免疫表現型の特徴から精原幹細胞由来の可能性も示唆される。
pmid-21790653.summary_en: This review examines whether human spermatogonial stem cells (SSCs) could be the cell of origin of spermatocytic seminoma. It summarizes human spermatogenesis, including Adark and Apale spermatogonia, and phenotypic markers such as GPR125 that enable SSC isolation. It also highlights GDNF-driven self-renewal conserved between mice and humans. Spermatocytic seminomas occur mainly in older men and rarely metastasize. Their marker profile resembles meiotic prophase cells, but morphology and immunophenotype also support a spermatogonial stem cell origin.

pmid-21791949.summary_ja: 本総説は、性分化疾患（DSD）において悪性胚細胞腫瘍、いわゆるタイプII胚細胞腫瘍が生じる機序に関する最新知見を統合している。Y染色体の一部を含む患者では胚細胞の腫瘍化リスクが高く、性腺の発達異常と腫瘍化の病態生理が議論されている。リスクはDSDの診断群によって大きく異なり、表現型との関連も検討された。これらの知見は臨床管理や経過観察の方針決定に資すると考えられる。
pmid-21791949.summary_en: This review integrates current knowledge on how disorders of sex development (DSD) predispose to malignant germ cell tumor formation, so-called type II germ cell tumors. It discusses gonadal maldevelopment and the pathophysiology of neoplastic transformation of germ cells in DSD patients carrying Y-chromosome material. Tumor risk differs considerably among DSD diagnostic groups. The authors also explore correlations between patient phenotype and germ cell tumor risk, which can inform clinical management and surveillance decisions.

pmid-21792032.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、生後6週の男児に発症した肝原発の乳児型絨毛癌を報告している。発熱、蒼白、肝腫大を呈し、超音波検査で正中腹部の巨大腫瘤を認め、β-hCGの著明高値と生検により診断された。ブレオマイシン、シスプラチン、エトポシドの6サイクルで腫瘍は縮小したが切除不能のままであった。肝移植後にメトトレキサートを2サイクル投与された。化学療法に反応が乏しい切除不能な乳児型絨毛癌に対して、肝移植が治癒をもたらしうると結論された。
pmid-21792032.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-week-old boy with infantile choriocarcinoma of the liver, presenting with fever, pallor and hepatomegaly. Ultrasound showed a large midline abdominal mass, and markedly elevated beta-hCG was confirmed as choriocarcinoma by biopsy. He received six cycles of bleomycin, cisplatin and etoposide, which reduced tumor size, but the tumor remained unresectable. After liver transplantation he received two cycles of methotrexate. The authors conclude that liver transplantation can cure unresectable infantile choriocarcinoma that responds poorly to chemotherapy.

pmid-21793665.summary_ja: 10歳女児の右甲状腺葉に原発した純粋卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例です。細針吸引細胞診で診断の契機となり、切除標本の広範なサンプリングでも奇形腫などの他の胚細胞成分は認められませんでした。切除後に血清AFPが著明に上昇し、両側肺結節が転移を疑う所見として描出されました。ブレオマイシン、エトポシド、シスプラチンによる化学療法に良好に反応しました。
pmid-21793665.summary_en: The authors describe a 10-year-old girl with a primary pure yolk sac tumor of the right thyroid lobe, reported as the first such case. Fine-needle aspiration raised the diagnosis, and extensive sampling of the thyroidectomy specimen found no teratoma or other germ cell component. Serum alpha-fetoprotein rose markedly after excision, and imaging showed bilateral pulmonary nodules suggestive of metastatic disease without a mediastinal mass. The tumor responded favorably to bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin chemotherapy.

pmid-21795662.summary_ja: 本研究では、抗NMDA受容体脳炎患者の脳における補体沈着と抗体産生細胞(形質細胞)を検討しました。患者抗体は in vitro で補体を結合しましたが、脳組織には補体沈着は認められませんでした。一方、奇形腫21例の組織では補体が検出されました。脳では CD138陽性の形質細胞が多数認められ、髄腔内抗体合成を説明しうる所見です。
pmid-21795662.summary_en: This study examined whether complement and antibody-secreting plasma cells are present in the brains of patients with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, a condition often associated with ovarian teratoma. Patient antibodies bound complement in vitro, but complement deposits were not detected in patient brain tissue, whereas teratoma tissue from 21 patients contained complement. Brain samples showed abundant CD138-positive plasma cells and B and T cells in perivascular regions. The authors conclude that complement-mediated mechanisms are unlikely to play a substantial pathogenic role, while plasma cell infiltrates may explain intrathecal antibody synthesis.

pmid-21795985.summary_ja: MITO施設の卵巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍123例を後方視的に解析しました。再発率は17.8%で、45歳超とMITO施設以外での治療が主な再発予測因子でした。5年全生存期間(全生存率)は88.8%で、病期I超と卵黄嚢腫瘍組織型が独立した予後不良因子でした。多くの症例で妊孕性温存手術が行われています。
pmid-21795985.summary_en: This MITO-9 retrospective analysis of 123 patients with malignant ovarian germ cell tumors evaluated outcomes and recurrence risk factors across MITO centers. Dysgerminomas, immature teratomas, mixed germ cell tumors, and yolk sac tumors were the main histologies. Recurrence occurred in 17.8 percent, with age over 45 years and treatment outside referral centers as the main predictors. Five-year overall survival was 88.8 percent, and stage above I and yolk sac histology were independent poor prognostic factors. Most patients underwent fertility-sparing surgery.

pmid-21797113.summary_ja: 絨毛癌の転移能に関わる遺伝子を、高転移性のJEG-3細胞と低転移性のJAR細胞の比較により検討しました。FN、MMP-2、uPA、CAV-1、VEGF-Bが上位の遺伝子でした。VEGF-B shRNAにより発現を抑制すると、JEG-3細胞のマトリゲル浸潤が有意に低下しました。VEGF-Bが絨毛癌の転移能に重要な役割を果たすと結論づけています。
pmid-21797113.summary_en: The authors used cDNA microarray to compare gene expression between highly metastatic JEG-3 and weakly metastatic JAR choriocarcinoma cell lines. They identified 51 upregulated genes correlated with metastatic ability, with FN, MMP-2, uPA, CAV-1, and VEGF-B ranking highest. Knocking down VEGF-B with shRNA reduced its mRNA expression and significantly decreased invasion of JEG-3 cells in Matrigel assays. The study concludes that VEGF-B plays an important role in the metastatic capability of human choriocarcinoma, and that reducing its expression weakens invasive ability.

pmid-21797119.summary_ja: 本研究は、1990年から2010年に治療された小児卵巣胚細胞腫瘍137例の単施設後方視的レビューであり、奇形腫が最も多く、次いで卵黄嚢腫瘍であった。主症状は腹痛と腹部膨満で、21例が卵巣捻転を呈した。大部分は病期Iであった。奇形腫患者は手術のみを受け、55例は手術と化学療法を受けた。卵巣温存腫瘍摘出術は48例に施行された。治療を断念して死亡した16例を除外すると、5年無再発生存率と全生存率はそれぞれ93.4%と98.3%であった。著者らは、可能な場合には卵巣組織の温存を推奨している。
pmid-21797119.summary_en: This single-institution retrospective review of 137 children with ovarian germ cell tumors treated from 1990 to 2010 found teratomas most common, followed by yolk sac tumors. Abdominal pain and distension were the main symptoms, and 21 patients presented with ovarian torsion. Most patients were stage I. Patients with mature or immature teratomas underwent surgery alone, while 55 received surgery plus chemotherapy. Ovarian-sparing tumorectomy was performed in 48 patients. Excluding patients who declined treatment and died, 5-year relapse-free and overall survival were 93.4 and 98.3 percent, and the authors recommend preserving ovarian tissue when feasible.

pmid-21797132.summary_ja: 胞状奇胎の既往がある28歳女性が頻回の頭痛で受診しました。hCGと乳酸脱水素酵素が著明に上昇し、MRIで左側頭部に急速に増大する出血性腫瘤を認めました。後腹膜を含む複数部位の組織は絨毛癌と診断されました。正中外後腹膜原発の絨毛癌が神経症状で発症しうることを示す症例です。
pmid-21797132.summary_en: A 28-year-old woman with a history of dilatation and curettage for hydatidiform mole presented with frequent headaches. Laboratory testing showed markedly elevated hCG and lactate dehydrogenase, and brain MRI revealed a rapidly growing hemorrhagic mass in the left temporal area. Histology of tumor samples from multiple sites, including the retroperitoneum, was consistent with choriocarcinoma. The report describes an off-midline retroperitoneal choriocarcinoma that presented with neurologic symptoms, illustrating that such choriocarcinoma can first present with neurologic findings.

pmid-21803708.summary_ja: 本症例報告は、左副腎を圧迫し非機能性副腎偶発腫瘍に類似した、後腹膜の良性成熟嚢胞性奇形腫を有する50歳女性を記述している。検査で機能性腫瘍は否定され、腫瘍は腹腔鏡下に切除された。組織学的には呼吸上皮に覆われた嚢胞と、軟骨、骨、神経節組織を認めた。術後経過は順調で、18か月時点で再発はない。著者らは、後腹膜奇形腫を副腎偶発腫瘍の鑑別診断に含めるべきだと述べている。
pmid-21803708.summary_en: This case report describes a 50-year-old woman with a retroperitoneal benign mature cystic teratoma that compressed the left adrenal gland and mimicked a nonfunctioning adrenal incidentaloma. Laboratory tests excluded a functioning tumor, and the lesion was resected laparoscopically. Histology showed cysts lined by respiratory epithelium with cartilage, bone, and ganglionic tissue. The patient had an uneventful postoperative course and no recurrence at 18 months. The authors recommend including retroperitoneal teratoma in the differential diagnosis of adrenal incidentalomas.

pmid-21804387.summary_ja: 35歳女性の卵巣腫瘍例で、卵巣未分化胚細胞腫(20%)と線維肉腫(80%)が混在していた。腹痛と体重減少で受診した。手術と併用化学療法を行ったが病勢は急速に進行し、診断後18か月で死亡した。純粋な卵巣未分化胚細胞腫に線維肉腫を伴う例の既報は見当たらないとしている。
pmid-21804387.summary_en: This case report describes a 35-year-old woman with an ovarian tumor composed of dysgerminoma (20%) and fibrosarcoma (80%), presenting with abdominal pain and weight loss. Despite surgery and combination chemotherapy, the disease progressed rapidly and the patient died 18 months after diagnosis. The authors note that no prior report of ovarian fibrosarcoma associated with pure dysgerminoma was found in the literature. Sarcomatous components have, however, been described in mixed and extragonadal germ cell tumors and in some testicular spermatocytic seminomas.

pmid-21804392.summary_ja: 閉経後女性の卵巣卵黄嚢腫瘍4例を報告した。3例には上皮成分(漿液性癌、明細胞腺癌など)が認められ、1例は前駆病変が不明であった。既報24例を含めて検討し、通常の卵巣胚細胞腫瘍用化学療法への反応が低いことから、独立した疾患単位として積極的治療が必要と論じている。プラチナ製剤ベースの化学療法が推奨されている。
pmid-21804392.summary_en: This study reports four cases of yolk sac tumor in postmenopausal women, three with an identified epithelial component (serous carcinoma, clear cell adenocarcinoma, and an endometrioid and clear cell admixture) and one without a recognizable precursor. Reviewing 24 reported cases, the authors argue these tumors form a distinct entity that responds poorly to chemotherapy used for ovarian germ cell tumors. They recommend aggressive treatment with platinum-based regimens covering both epithelial and germ cell components. Recent stage I patients treated this way remained disease-free beyond one year.

pmid-21806332.summary_ja: 予後不良因子を持つ進行胚細胞腫瘍患者に対する、自家幹細胞支持下の大量化学療法(HDCT)の成績をまとめた総説である。末梢血幹細胞移植や支持療法の進歩により、治療関連死亡は3%未満に低下した。一次治療では通常用量化学療法に対する優位性は示されず、主にサルベージ療法に限定されている。HDCT後に再発した例は治癒困難とみなされる。
pmid-21806332.summary_en: This review examines high-dose chemotherapy (HDCT) with autologous stem cell support in advanced germ cell tumor patients with poor-risk features, both as salvage and first-line therapy. Advances in peripheral blood stem cell transplantation and supportive care have reduced treatment-related mortality to under 3% in recent reports. Three large randomized phase III trials did not show a benefit of HDCT over conventional-dose chemotherapy in the first-line setting, so routine use is generally reserved for salvage. Prognostic models for salvage HDCT are discussed, and patients who relapse after HDCT are usually considered incurable.

pmid-21807171.summary_ja: 小児骨盤内腫瘍の画像所見をまとめた総説である。重なり合う画像所見のため性状診断が難しい点を踏まえ、精巣、卵巣、子宮、膀胱の腫瘤に加えて仙尾部奇形腫を取り上げている。臨床像と画像所見から鑑別診断の範囲を絞り込む要点を示している。小児の骨盤内胚細胞腫瘍を他の病変と区別する際の参考になる。
pmid-21807171.summary_en: This review describes imaging features of pediatric pelvic neoplasms, which often overlap in appearance and are difficult to characterize. It covers testicular, ovarian, uterine, and bladder masses, along with sacrococcygeal teratoma. Key clinical features and imaging findings are highlighted to help narrow the differential diagnosis. The article is useful for radiologists distinguishing germ cell tumors such as sacrococcygeal teratoma and ovarian masses from other pelvic lesions in children.

pmid-21811174.summary_ja: オーストラリアの妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)女性176例を対象とした横断研究である。うつと不安の高値はそれぞれ22%と26%、性機能障害は52%に認められた。化学療法を受けた女性は性生活への悪影響をより感じていた。社会的に不利な立場の女性や、その後妊娠しなかった女性は心理社会的転帰が不良であり、化学療法を要しない患者にもサポートが必要である。
pmid-21811174.summary_en: This cross-sectional study of 176 Australian women with gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD) assessed long-term psychological morbidity, sexual functioning, and relationships using validated questionnaires and medical records. Elevated depression and anxiety were reported by 22% and 26%, and 52% reported sexual dysfunction. Women who received chemotherapy more often felt that GTD had harmed their sex life, though objective measures showed no group difference. Socially disadvantaged women and those without subsequent conception had poorer outcomes, supporting ongoing psychosocial care even for those not needing chemotherapy.

pmid-21814322.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の化学療法後残存腫瘤に対し後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた24例のうち、晩期再発例と残存腫瘤例の計2例で結核が判明した症例報告である。腫瘍マーカーは正常で、PETでは残存腫瘤に集積亢進がみられた。化学療法後残存腫瘤における結核の初めての報告である。
pmid-21814322.summary_en: This case series reports two of 24 patients who underwent retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for postchemotherapy residual masses in testicular germ cell tumor and were found to have tuberculosis. One patient had a late relapse and the other had a residual mass. Tumor markers were normal, and PET showed increased uptake in the residual mass. The authors note that tuberculosis in postchemotherapy residual masses has not been reported before, so clinicians should consider it in the differential diagnosis of residual disease.

pmid-21814325.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の後腹膜リンパ節転移が前腹壁を突き破って発育(フンギング)した極めてまれな症例報告である。化学療法に良好な反応を示した。進行例ではこのような局所進展が起こりうること、またこの特異な進展様式でも化学療法が有効でありうることを示している。
pmid-21814325.summary_en: This case report describes testicular germ cell tumor with retroperitoneal lymph node metastases that fungated through the anterior abdominal wall, an extremely rare presentation. The patient showed a favorable response to chemotherapy. The report highlights that such extension can occur in advanced disease and that chemotherapy can remain effective even with this unusual pattern of local spread.

pmid-21819630.summary_ja: 原発性純粋セミノーマとリンパ節転移の管理、および病期別の治療選択肢を概説した総説である。治癒率は高く、特に病期Iでは予後が良好である。放射線療法、積極的監視、化学療法の中から、毒性と患者の希望を考慮して選択する必要があることを示している。
pmid-21819630.summary_en: This review covers management of primary pure seminoma and its nodal involvement, then compares therapeutic options by stage. It notes that cure rates are high and prognosis is excellent, especially in stage I. Options include radiotherapy, active surveillance, and chemotherapy, and the choice should weigh toxicity and patient preference.

pmid-21821490.summary_ja: SEOMによる精巣セミノーマの診断と治療に関する臨床ガイドラインの要旨である。精巣摘除術後は、腫瘍マーカー測定（αフェトプロテイン(AFP)陰性）、腹部CT、胸部X線検査による病期分類を行う。病期Iの患者は積極的監視または補助カルボプラチン化学療法を選択できる。進行例および性腺外セミノーマにはIGCCCGリスク分類に従いBEP化学療法を行う。残存病変は3cm未満なら監視し、3cm以上はPETで評価して、PET陽性の病変のみ手術を行う。
pmid-21821490.summary_en: These SEOM clinical guidelines outline diagnosis and treatment of testicular seminoma. After orchiectomy, staging includes serial tumor marker assays with negative AFP, abdominal CT, and chest X-ray. Stage I patients may undergo active surveillance or receive adjuvant carboplatin. Advanced disease and extragonadal seminoma receive BEP chemotherapy per IGCCCG risk. Residual masses under 3 cm are observed, while larger ones are evaluated by PET and resected only if PET-positive.

pmid-21821491.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の診療をまとめたSEOMガイドラインである。病期分類、化学療法、化学療法後残存病変の3つの決定樹で管理を整理している。BEPが標準治療で、BEP後に進行した場合はTIPが救援治療となる。大量化学療法の位置づけは未確立である。
pmid-21821491.summary_en: These SEOM guidelines for non-seminomatous germ cell cancer summarize management through three decision trees covering staging, chemotherapy, and postchemotherapy residual disease. BEP remains standard, the role of high-dose chemotherapy is not established, and TIP is standard salvage therapy after BEP. Residual disease should be surgically removed, and poor-prognosis patients should be referred to expert centers.

pmid-21823510.summary_ja: 17歳女性が精神症状で発症し、骨盤MRIで右卵巣腫瘍を認めた。右卵巣摘出術の病理組織学的診断は未熟卵巣奇形腫であった。血漿交換療法と大量メチルプレドニゾロンを行い、意識障害は完全に改善した。抗NMDAR抗体は血清と脳脊髄液で陽性で、臨床症状の改善に伴い減少した。奇形腫の摘出と免疫療法の併用が良好な回復につながった症例である。
pmid-21823510.summary_en: This report describes a 17-year-old woman with anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis who developed psychiatric symptoms and was found to have a right ovarian tumor on pelvic MRI. After right salpingo-oophorectomy, histopathology confirmed an immature ovarian teratoma. Plasmapheresis and high-dose methylprednisolone were given, and consciousness fully improved with discharge on day 50. Serum and cerebrospinal fluid were positive for NMDAR antibodies, and the antibody levels decreased in parallel with clinical recovery. The case illustrates that teratoma removal combined with immunotherapy can lead to excellent neurological recovery.

pmid-21826274.summary_ja: ドバイの三次施設で2年間に管理された妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍35例を後方視的に解析した。全胞状奇胎が最多で、絨毛癌や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍は認めなかった。大多数は初回の吸引掻爬で治癒し、25%が単剤化学療法を要した。選択的な子宮頸管熟化と、地域的な登録体制の必要性が示された。
pmid-21826274.summary_en: This retrospective study analyzed 35 women with gestational trophoblastic neoplasia managed at a tertiary center in Dubai over two years. Complete mole was most common, followed by partial mole, and no choriocarcinoma or placental site trophoblastic tumor was observed. Most cases were cured by primary suction curettage, repeat evacuation cured some, and 25% required single-agent chemotherapy. The authors suggest cervical preparation with prostaglandins in selected cases and call for a regional registry.

pmid-21838164.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)患者で、血清および尿中の胎盤増殖因子(PlGF)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)を測定した。血清PlGFとhCGの相関は非線形であった。PlGF中央値は絨毛癌を含む悪性群で良性群より有意に高く、hCGには差がなかった。悪性GTDではPlGF産生が亢進している可能性が示唆された。
pmid-21838164.summary_en: This study measured serum and urine placental growth factor (PlGF) and hCG in patients with gestational trophoblastic disease using ELISA. Serum PlGF and hCG were not linearly correlated, and urine and serum PlGF did not correlate. Median serum PlGF was significantly higher in malignant GTD, including choriocarcinoma, than in benign disease such as hydatidiform mole, while hCG did not differ between groups. The authors suggest that PlGF production is higher in malignant GTD.

pmid-21838170.summary_ja: 妊娠中に肺・肝・脳へ転移した絨毛癌と診断された28歳女性の症例報告である。妊娠中にEMA-CO療法を開始し、妊娠32週で発育の正常な女児を出産した。高リスク妊娠性絨毛性腫瘍では、早期の細胞障害性薬物投与が重要であることを強調している。出産時期は母体の治療と胎児リスクの両面から検討すべきとしている。
pmid-21838170.summary_en: This case report describes a 28-year-old woman with choriocarcinoma metastatic to the lungs, liver and brain, diagnosed during a viable intrauterine pregnancy. She received EMA-CO chemotherapy during pregnancy and delivered a developmentally normal female infant at 32 weeks. The authors emphasize that early cytotoxic chemotherapy is important for high-risk gestational trophoblastic tumors and that delivery timing should balance maternal treatment needs against fetal risk.

pmid-21838905.summary_ja: 16歳のインド人男児に生じた腰仙部の良性嚢胞性奇形腫の症例報告である。出生時から存在し、15cm×15cmまで増大した腫瘤を、椎体に至るまで完全切除した。この部位・男児での発生は極めて稀であり、悪性化の傾向があるため積極的な診断と治療が必要と述べている。
pmid-21838905.summary_en: This case report describes a 16-year-old Indian boy with a lumbosacral mass present since birth that grew to 15 by 15 cm. Investigations and histopathologic examination confirmed a benign cystic teratoma, which was completely excised from its base to the vertebrae. The authors note that this lesion is very rare in this location and in boys. They argue that benign cystic teratomas should be diagnosed and managed aggressively because they can progress toward malignancy.

pmid-21840909.summary_ja: フランスの絨毛性疾患専門施設における後方視的研究で、基準病理医による再読が初回診断を確認した割合を検討した。完全奇胎(96%)と侵入奇胎(96%)では一致率が高かったが、部分奇胎(64%)、絨毛癌(86%)、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(60%)では低かった。疑わしい奇胎の標本を系統的に再読することで、診療の質が向上すると結論している。
pmid-21840909.summary_en: This observational retrospective study from the French Trophoblastic Disease Reference Centre (1999 to 2011) evaluated how often referent pathologists confirmed diagnoses made by initial pathologists. Among 1851 hydatidiform moles and 150 gestational trophoblastic tumours, agreement was high for complete moles (96%) and invasive moles (96%), but lower for partial moles (64%), choriocarcinoma (86%) and placental site trophoblastic tumour (60%).
