pmid-20380607.summary_ja: 精巣奇形腫の男性22例と、年齢・性別・BMIをそろえた対照22例で、臍部CT画像上の内臓脂肪と皮下脂肪の比を比較した研究である。奇形腫患者の比は対照の1.56倍で、統計学的に有意であった。内臓脂肪の蓄積が精巣奇形腫と関連する可能性が示唆されたが、小規模な単施設研究であり因果関係は不明である。
pmid-20380607.summary_en: This case-control study compared abdominal adipose tissue distribution on a single CT slice at the umbilicus in 22 men with testicular teratoma and 22 age-, sex-, and BMI-matched controls. The ratio of visceral to subcutaneous fat was 1.56 times higher in teratoma patients than in controls, a statistically significant difference. The authors suggest that patients with testicular teratoma have relatively more visceral adiposity, consistent with findings in other malignancies. The study is small and single-center, and it does not establish causality.

pmid-20381116.summary_ja: 24歳男性の精巣腫瘍で、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍と奇形腫が混在する症例を報告する。術前のβ-hCGは高値、AFPは正常であった。FISHで12番染色体短腕の増加が確認され、トロホブラスト成分が胚細胞由来であることが示された。術後3年時点で無治療のまま生存している。
pmid-20381116.summary_en: This case report describes a 24-year-old man with a right testicular tumor composed of placental site trophoblastic tumor and teratoma, a combination not previously published. Serum beta-hCG was elevated while AFP was normal. Immunohistochemistry and FISH showing a gain on chromosome 12 short arm supported a germ cell origin of the trophoblastic component. Adjacent tubules contained intratubular germ cell neoplasia. The patient remained alive and well three years after orchiectomy without further treatment.

pmid-20383188.summary_ja: HIV陽性の44歳男性で、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍(病期1)に根治的精巣摘除術を受けた。術後のhCG高値から播種性と誤診され、化学療法を受けた。原因はhCG免疫測定におけるヘテロフィル抗体による偽高値であり、ブロッキング剤で否定された。救援療法は不要で、完全寛解を維持している。
pmid-20383188.summary_en: A 44-year-old HIV-positive man with stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumor after radical orchiectomy had persistently elevated hCG, which led to a misdiagnosis of disseminated disease. He received four cycles of etoposide and cisplatin. Postchemotherapy CT showed no metastatic disease, yet hCG remained elevated. The cause was heterophile antibody interference in the immunoassay, confirmed when a blocking agent eliminated detectable hCG. No salvage therapy was needed, and the patient remains in complete remission.

pmid-20384797.summary_ja: 正常精子形成、無精子症、精巣腫瘍(大部分はセミノーマ)の男性から採取した組織で、SCFとc-kitの発現をリアルタイムRT-PCRにより比較した研究である。精巣腫瘍でc-kitの発現が最も高く、セミノーマの発生との関連が示唆された。ライディッヒ細胞もc-kit転写産物の供給源となる可能性がある。
pmid-20384797.summary_en: This study measured SCF and c-kit transcript levels by real-time RT-PCR in testicular fractions from men with normal spermatogenesis, azoospermia, and testicular neoplasms, mostly seminomas. c-kit was expressed more highly than SCF across groups and was significantly highest in testicular tumours, suggesting that c-kit overexpression is associated with seminoma development. Sertoli cell only syndrome showed comparable SCF and c-kit levels, pointing to Leydig cells as a possible additional c-kit source. The authors conclude that c-kit is dynamic across testicular pathologies.

pmid-20387262.summary_ja: 未切除の仙尾部奇形腫が神経芽腫へ悪性転化した6歳女児の症例報告である。胚細胞腫瘍の悪性転化は稀であり、文献的考察が加えられている。完全切除が転化予防に必要であり、転化時は手術と組織型に応じた全身化学療法を組み合わせるべきと結論している。
pmid-20387262.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-year-old girl whose unresected sacrococcygeal teratoma underwent malignant transformation into neuroblastoma. The authors review the literature on malignant transformation of germ cell tumors, a rare entity. The case shows that complete resection of germ cell tumors is necessary to prevent transformation. When malignant transformation occurs, treatment should combine surgery with histology-adapted systemic chemotherapy.

pmid-20387513.summary_ja: 2010年の報告で、埼玉県がんセンターにおける1997～2007年の進行男性胚細胞腫瘍51例を後方視的に解析した。IGCCC分類別の5年生存率は良好群100%、中間群74%、不良群76%。初回化学療法後に腫瘍マーカーの低下が不良だった症例は全生存期間が有意に低かった（71%対94%）。早期の二次化学療法と腫瘍マーカー動態による層別化が生存率向上に寄与した可能性が示された。
pmid-20387513.summary_en: This retrospective study of 51 men with advanced germ cell tumors treated at Saitama Cancer Center (1997-2007) assessed outcomes by IGCCC risk group. Five-year survival was 100%, 74%, and 76% for good-, intermediate-, and poor-risk patients. Patients with unsatisfactory tumor marker decline after two chemotherapy cycles, mainly due to hCG, had significantly worse five-year overall survival (71% vs 94%). Earlier second-line chemotherapy and marker kinetics appeared to improve outcomes, and unfavorable marker decline remains a key challenge.

pmid-20387517.summary_ja: 37歳男性の後腹膜性性腺外胚細胞腫瘍の症例報告。肺や鎖骨上窩・腋窩リンパ節への転移を伴い、AFP、hCG、LDHが著明に上昇していた。BEP 3コース後、TIPと末梢血幹細胞移植を併用し、腫瘍マーカーは正常化した。残存腫瘍を外科的切除し、組織学的に生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、24か月間無病で経過している。
pmid-20387517.summary_en: A 37-year-old man presented with lumbago and fever and was found to have a huge retroperitoneal extragonadal germ cell tumor with pulmonary, supraclavicular, and axillary lymph node involvement, with markedly elevated AFP, hCG, and LDH. The testes were normal. He received three cycles of BEP with partial response, followed by TIP with peripheral blood stem cell transplantation, achieving marker normalization. Residual masses were resected, with no viable tumor found histologically, and he remained disease-free for 24 months.

pmid-20387519.summary_ja: 29歳男性の両側精巣腫瘍の症例報告。両側精巣摘除を行い、右側はセミノーマと未熟奇形腫、左側はセミノーマであった。肺転移と傍大静脈リンパ節転移に対しBEP療法を施行し、肺病変は消失した。PET-CTでFDG集積を認めなくなった残存リンパ節を後腹膜リンパ節郭清で切除し、生存腫瘍細胞は認めず、10か月間再発なく経過した。
pmid-20387519.summary_en: A 29-year-old man presented with bilateral testicular tumors and underwent bilateral high orchiectomy after sperm cryopreservation. Histology showed seminoma with immature teratoma on the right and seminoma on the left. After lung metastases developed, he received BEP chemotherapy; lung lesions resolved, but a residual peri-caval lymph node remained and was resected after PET-CT showed no FDG uptake. No viable tumor was found, and he remained disease-free at 10 months under androgen replacement.

pmid-20391969.summary_ja: 小児の奇形腫・奇形腫様病変11例について、術前の穿刺吸引細胞診所見を検討した。扁平上皮細胞が奇形腫診断の主な所見であり、神経外胚葉成分や中胚葉成分も認められた。未熟間葉成分が2例で認められた。細胞診による診断には臨床・画像情報が不可欠であり、神経芽細胞腫やWilms腫瘍などとの鑑別が重要と結論された。
pmid-20391969.summary_en: This cytology study reviewed 11 childhood teratoma/teratoid lesions that had prior fine needle aspiration, in patients aged 3 months to 12 years. Clinicoradiologic diagnoses had included neuroblastoma, Wilms tumor, and teratoma. Squamous cells were the main finding in teratomas, with neuroectodermal and mesodermal elements also present, and immature mesenchymal fragments appeared in two cases. The authors conclude that clinical and radiologic information is essential for accurate cytologic diagnosis.

pmid-20392142.summary_ja: 33歳女性の卵管完全胞状奇胎の症例報告。腹腔鏡下左卵管切除の1か月後、回腸転移による消化管出血を来した。小腸切除吻合後、メトトレキサートによる術後補助化学療法を9コース施行し、20か月再発なく経過した。異所性胞状奇胎の消化管転移は穿孔や大量出血の危険があると指摘されている。
pmid-20392142.summary_en: A 33-year-old woman with a tubal complete hydatidiform mole developed gastrointestinal bleeding from an ileal metastasis one month after laparoscopic left salpingectomy. She underwent small bowel resection with anastomosis and received nine cycles of adjuvant methotrexate. She remained free of recurrence 20 months later. The authors report the first case of a Fallopian tube molar pregnancy with ileal metastasis and highlight the risk of perforation and bleeding in ectopic molar pregnancy.

pmid-20395037.summary_ja: 単側精巣がんに対しシスプラチン併用化学療法を2～4コース受けた316例の生存者を対象とした全国多施設調査。妊娠を試みた106例の80%が治療後に父親となり、コース数が少ないほど成功率は高かった（2コース100%、4コース76%）。FSHはコース数とともに上昇したが、精子数やテストステロンに差はなかった。
pmid-20395037.summary_en: This national multicentre survey of 316 men treated for unilateral testicular cancer with two to four cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy assessed paternity and gonadal function. Among 106 men attempting conception, 80% achieved paternity at a median 12-year follow-up. Paternity rates decreased with more chemotherapy cycles (100% with two, 76% with four), and follicle-stimulating hormone was higher with more cycles. Testosterone, luteinising hormone, and sperm counts did not differ significantly.

pmid-20395447.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の親株と耐性株の3ペアを用いた発現マイクロアレイ解析で、CCND1が最も差のある遺伝子として同定された。臨床検体でもCCND1発現は耐性例で有意に高値だった。卵巣がんや前立腺がんでも過剰発現が認められた。CCND1のsiRNAによる抑制とシスプラチン併用は、単独よりも細胞増殖を有意に抑制した。
pmid-20395447.summary_en: This study examined cisplatin resistance in testicular germ cell tumors by comparing three pairs of parental and resistant cell lines using expression microarrays. CCND1 was the most differentially expressed gene, and its expression was significantly higher in clinically resistant testicular tumors. CCND1 was also overexpressed in ovarian and prostate cancers. Combined CCND1 knockdown and cisplatin more effectively suppressed tumor cell growth in vitro, suggesting CCND1 as a potential stratification marker and therapeutic target.

pmid-20395523.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍63例を対象に、TCL1タンパクの発現を免疫組織化学で検討した。セミノーマとIGCNUの大部分で陽性、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍では陰性であった。TCL1はIGCNUやセミノーマの診断補助、およびセミノーマと非セミノーマの鑑別に有用である可能性が示された。
pmid-20395523.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined TCL1 protein expression across 63 testicular germ cell tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and mixed germ cell tumors, plus intratubular germ cell neoplasia (IGCNU). TCL1 was detected in most seminomas and all IGCNU cases but not in nonseminomatous tumors. The findings suggest TCL1 is associated with an undifferentiated state and may help confirm IGCNU or seminoma and distinguish seminoma from nonseminomatous germ cell tumors.

pmid-20400071.summary_ja: 30歳未経妊女性で、同一右卵巣に子宮内膜症、成熟嚢胞性奇形腫、粘液性嚢胞腺腫が共存した。片側卵巣摘出術と病期分類のための開腹術が行われた。文献上3例目とされ、単一臓器内の複合病変の診断と手術の難しさを示す。
pmid-20400071.summary_en: This case report describes a 30-year-old nulligravida woman with coexisting endometriosis and mature cystic teratoma in the same right ovary, along with a mucinous cystadenoma. Management involved unilateral oophorectomy and staging laparotomy. The authors note this is only the third such case reported in the literature, highlighting the diagnostic and surgical challenges of multiple pathologies within one ovary.

pmid-20403162.summary_ja: セミノーマにおけるウロキナーゼ型プラスミノーゲン活性化系の発現を正常精巣と比較した。腫瘍ではuPAとuPARが増加し、PAI-2は減少していた。PAI-1のmRNA量は腫瘍サイズと相関した。uPAとuPARの増加が精巣がんの進展に関与する可能性が示唆される。
pmid-20403162.summary_en: This study characterized the urokinase plasminogen activating system in human seminomas compared with normal testis. Quantitative RT-PCR, Western blot, zymography, and immunohistochemistry showed increased uPA and uPAR expression in tumors, while PAI-2 was reduced. Tumor size correlated with PAI-1 mRNA levels. The findings suggest that elevated uPA and uPAR may contribute to testicular cancer progression.

pmid-20407319.summary_ja: 腹膜外転移を伴う悪性卵巣甲状腺腫27例の自然経過を検討した。癒着、1L以上の腹水、漿膜損傷、10cm以上の腫瘍径、広範な乳頭癌成分が予後不良因子であった。経過は緩徐で、37%が原病死した。再発は術後2か月から29年の間に生じたため、長期フォローアップが推奨される。
pmid-20407319.summary_en: This study describes the natural history of 27 cases of biologically malignant struma ovarii with extraovarian spread. Adverse predictors included adhesions, ascites of at least 1 L, serosal rupture, tumor size of 10 cm or more, and extensive papillary carcinoma. Clinical course was protracted; 37% died of disease. Recurrence occurred from 2 months to 29 years after surgery, so long-term follow-up is recommended.

pmid-20407325.summary_ja: 13歳女児の右卵巣腫瘤（10cm）で、αフェトプロテイン高値を呈した卵黄嚢腫瘍の症例を報告した。線維肉腫成分が95%を占めていた。付属器摘出術と大網摘出術後にシスプラチンを含む化学療法を7コース施行し、7か月時点で無病生存していた。
pmid-20407325.summary_en: This case report describes a 13-year-old girl with a 10-cm right ovarian mass, elevated alpha-fetoprotein, and a yolk sac tumor with a predominant (95%) fibrosarcoma component. After adnexectomy and omentectomy, she received seven cycles of cisplatin-based chemotherapy and remained disease free at 7-month follow-up. The authors note this is the first reported yolk sac tumor with fibrosarcoma in a teenage female.

pmid-20410807.summary_ja: 縦隔原発胚細胞腫瘍の診断において、SALL4、OCT4、NANOG、SOX2、UTF1、TCL1の6種の幹細胞マーカーの有用性を検討した。卵黄嚢腫瘍ではSALL4が広く陽性を示し、AFPなどの従来マーカーより感度が高かった。胸腺腫や悪性リンパ腫は陰性で、特異度も高いことが示された。既存マーカーより高感度な診断指標として有用と考えられる。
pmid-20410807.summary_en: This study evaluates six stem cell markers (SALL4, OCT4, NANOG, SOX2, UTF1, TCL1) for diagnosing primary mediastinal germ cell tumors, including seminomas, embryonal carcinomas, yolk sac tumors, and teratomas. SALL4 was expressed in nearly all yolk sac tumors, where it outperformed AFP, glypican-3, and PLAP. Across GCT subtypes these markers showed high sensitivity and specificity, exceeding conventional markers, and thymomas, thymic carcinomas, and lymphomas were negative. The findings support their use in diagnosing mediastinal GCTs.

pmid-20411023.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍の組織亜型における紡錘体蛋白の発現を、279例の精巣摘除標本で免疫組織化学的に検討した。上皮内癌ではBUB1BとMAD2が低下し、AURKAは上昇していた。AURKAはセミノーマと非セミノーマの双方で高値を示した。上皮内癌から浸潤性精巣がんへの移行に関与する可能性が示唆された。
pmid-20411023.summary_en: This study used tissue microarrays from 279 orchidectomy specimens to examine spindle proteins (AURKA, AURKB, BUB1B, MAD2) across normal testis, carcinoma in situ, and histological subtypes of testicular germ cell tumors. BUB1B and MAD2 were reduced in carcinoma in situ compared with normal testis, while AURKA was increased. AURKA was elevated in both seminomas and non-seminomas, and BUB1B decreased in non-seminomas. The authors propose these changes may mark the transition from in situ to invasive testicular cancer.

pmid-20411342.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍を有する272例の男性で、マウスでTGCTリスクに関連するヒトDND1遺伝子の生殖細胞系列変異を検索した。非家族例の胎児性癌で、非同義置換p.Asp219Gluが認められたが、この変異は非罹患の血縁者にも存在し、対照210染色体には認められなかった。in silico解析では非病原性と予測され、腫瘍では野生型アレルが保持されていた。著者らは、生殖細胞系列のDND1変異がヒトTGCTの感受性に大きく寄与する可能性は低いと結論づけている。
pmid-20411342.summary_en: This study screened 272 men with testicular germ cell tumors for germline mutations in the human DND1 gene, a gene linked to TGCT susceptibility in the 129/Sv mouse. One nonsynonymous variant, p.Asp219Glu, was found in a non-familial embryonal carcinoma case, but it was also present in unaffected relatives and absent from 210 control chromosomes. It was predicted to be non-pathogenic, and the wild-type allele was retained in the tumor. The authors conclude that germline DND1 mutations are unlikely to contribute significantly to human TGCT susceptibility.

pmid-20413688.summary_ja: 妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるp21活性化キナーゼ（PAK）の役割を検討した。PAK1のmRNAと蛋白は、胞状奇胎、特に転移や持続性病変を呈した症例、絨毛癌、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍で高発現していた。PAK1発現は増殖マーカーKi-67およびMCM7と正の相関を示した。絨毛癌細胞株でPAK1をノックダウンすると増殖、遊走、浸潤が低下した。PAK1は妊娠性絨毛性疾患の病態進展に関与すると考えられる。
pmid-20413688.summary_en: This study examined p21-activated kinases in gestational trophoblastic disease. PAK1 mRNA and protein were elevated in hydatidiform moles, particularly those that became metastatic or persistent, and in choriocarcinomas and placental site trophoblastic tumors. PAK1 expression correlated with the proliferation markers Ki-67 and MCM7. In choriocarcinoma cell lines, PAK1 knockdown reduced proliferation, migration, and invasion. PAK1 may contribute to the aggressive behavior and clinical progression of GTD.

pmid-20414041.summary_ja: 卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の扁平上皮癌で、病期Icの後に再発した2症例を報告した。症例1はTC療法後に再発し、二次化学療法にもかかわらず死亡した。症例2は乳癌の化学療法中に骨盤内再発し、動脈塞栓術とシスプラチンで部分寛解を得た。成熟嚢胞性奇形腫由来の再発扁平上皮癌に対し、経カテーテル的動脈塞栓術が二次治療として有効な可能性が示唆された。
pmid-20414041.summary_en: This report describes two patients with squamous cell carcinoma arising from ovarian mature cystic teratomas, both with stage Ic disease that later recurred. Case 1 relapsed after paclitaxel-carboplatin chemotherapy and died despite second-line treatment. Case 2 developed pelvic recurrence after chemotherapy for concurrent breast cancer and responded partially to transcatheter arterial embolization with cisplatin. The authors suggest that transcatheter arterial embolization may be an effective second-line option for recurrent squamous cell carcinoma arising from mature cystic teratoma.

pmid-20415215.summary_ja: 出産後2か月で胸痛と喀血を呈した31歳女性の、子宮絨毛癌による肺転移例を報告した。β-hCGは4000IU/mLを超え、子宮側方の腫瘤と肝病変を認めた。化学療法3コース後に大量肺塞栓症で死亡した。生殖年齢の女性で多発性肺陰影を認めた場合は絨毛癌を鑑別に挙げ、β-hCG測定を行うことが重要である。
pmid-20415215.summary_en: This case report describes a 31-year-old woman with pulmonary metastases from uterine choriocarcinoma, presenting with thoracic pain and hemoptysis two months after childbirth. Beta-hCG exceeded 4000 IU/mL, and a lateral uterine mass with hepatic lesions was found. Despite three cycles of chemotherapy, she died from massive pulmonary embolism. The authors emphasize that choriocarcinoma should be considered in women of reproductive age with multiple pulmonary opacities, and that beta-hCG measurement is essential.

pmid-20419965.summary_ja: カラチの三次医療機関で卵巣癌患者75例の初発症状と組織型を検討した。腹痛が最多の症状で、半数以上が病期III～IVで診断された。組織型では漿液性乳頭状腺癌が最も多く、卵黄嚢腫瘍とディスジャーミノーマは合わせて約6.6%であった。40歳以上の女性で持続する症状は精査すべきであると結論づけられた。
pmid-20419965.summary_en: This study reviewed 75 women with ovarian cancer at a Karachi hospital to identify presenting symptoms and histological types. Abdominal pain was the most common symptom, and most patients presented at stage III or IV. Papillary serous adenocarcinoma was most frequent, while yolk sac tumor and dysgerminoma together accounted for about 6.6% of cases. The authors emphasize the need to investigate persistent symptoms in women over 40.

pmid-20420172.summary_ja: 抗NMDA受容体脳炎は、抗体を介し治療反応性を示す脳炎で、主に卵巣奇形腫を有する若年女性に発症する。症状の経過、抗体が標的とするNR1細胞外エピトープ、NMDAR減少がドパミン作動性・グルタミン酸作動性神経伝達に影響する機序の仮説を概説している。著者らは、早期の腫瘍切除と積極的な免疫療法が機能回復を促進すること、重症の難治例では試験開腹術を考慮してよいことを述べている。剖検で微小奇形腫が見つかった症例も含まれる。
pmid-20420172.summary_en: This review summarizes anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis, an antibody-mediated, treatment-responsive encephalitis that typically affects young women with ovarian teratoma. It describes the predictable sequential symptom course, the NR1 extracellular epitope targeted by antibodies, and proposed mechanisms of NMDAR reduction affecting dopaminergic and glutamatergic neurotransmission. The authors note that early tumor resection combined with aggressive immunotherapy promotes functional recovery, and that exploratory laparotomy may be considered in severe refractory cases, including one case where microscopic teratoma was found at autopsy.

pmid-20422175.summary_ja: 5歳女児に生じた成熟型甲状腺奇形腫の症例報告。核医学検査で右葉の取り込み低下、CTでは石灰化や脂肪・嚢胞成分を欠く分葉状軟部組織腫瘤を認めた。組織学的には成熟した神経・軟骨・上皮組織から成り、成熟型甲状腺奇形腫の画像的特徴に新たな知見を加えた。
pmid-20422175.summary_en: This case report describes a 5-year-old girl with a mature thyroid teratoma, an unusual extragonadal germ cell tumor site. Technetium-99m scintigraphy showed reduced uptake in the right thyroid lobe. CT revealed a slightly lobulated soft-tissue mass without calcification, fat or cystic components, which is atypical for teratoma. Histology showed mature neural, cartilaginous and epithelial tissues. The authors suggest the case adds new insight into the CT appearance of mature thyroid teratomas, which may help recognize this rare entity in imaging.

pmid-20429899.summary_ja: 縦隔セミノーマで化学療法(ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチン)を4サイクル受け完全奏効した44歳男性が、治療3か月後に好酸球性肺炎を発症した症例。高用量ステロイドで改善し、ブレオマイシンの遅発性毒性として注意が必要であることを示す。
pmid-20429899.summary_en: A 44-year-old man with primary mediastinal seminoma and superior vena cava syndrome received four cycles of bleomycin, etoposide and cisplatin and achieved a complete response. Three months later he developed dyspnea, severe hypoxemia and peripheral eosinophilia, with bilateral diffuse interstitial infiltrates that did not respond to antibiotics. Lung biopsy confirmed eosinophilic pneumonia, which resolved with high-dose prednisone. The authors conclude that eosinophilic pneumonia can be a late sequela of bleomycin toxicity and may respond dramatically to steroids.

pmid-20431225.summary_ja: 14か月の小児に発生した巨大な頸胸部奇形腫の治療経験の報告。小児奇形腫の約3～5%を占める頸部奇形腫では、気道狭窄が最も重大な出生後合併症である。気道を閉塞しうる頸部腫瘤の早期把握には出生前診断が重要であると強調している。
pmid-20431225.summary_en: This report describes the management of a huge cervico-thoracic teratoma in a 14-month-old Nigerian child. Cervical teratoma accounts for about three to five percent of pediatric teratomas. The most serious postnatal complication is airway compromise from the neck mass. The authors emphasize that prenatal diagnosis is crucial for early recognition of neck masses that could obstruct the airway, and they describe their surgical experience with this case.

pmid-20434038.summary_ja: 台湾で1988～2005年に治療された縦隔成熟奇形腫57例の後方視的解析。胸腔鏡下手術は開胸手術に比べ手術時間や集中治療室滞在期間が短く、症状を有する症例では合併症を伴う手術が多かった。高度の癒着がなければ胸腔鏡下切除は可能と結論づけている。
pmid-20434038.summary_en: This retrospective review analyzed 57 cases of mediastinal mature teratoma treated in Taiwan between 1988 and 2005. Most patients were young women, and 21 tumors (36.8%) contained pancreatic tissue. Thoracoscopic surgery, performed in 14 patients, was associated with shorter operative time, fewer ventilator days and shorter intensive care unit stays. Tumors with pancreatic tissue and symptomatic patients had more complicated surgery. The authors conclude that thoracoscopic resection is feasible without dense adhesions, while symptoms may be a relative contraindication.

pmid-20434716.summary_ja: 思春期前の精巣および精巣傍組織腫瘍を扱った包括的レビュー。精巣胚細胞腫瘍には良性奇形腫、類表皮嚢胞、悪性卵黄嚢腫瘍などが含まれる。臨床像、画像、病理、治療管理を解説し、稀少疾患のため集約的な病理診断と全国規模の臨床試験の重要性を述べている。
pmid-20434716.summary_en: This comprehensive review covers prepubertal testicular and paratesticular tumours, which are distinct from postpubertal tumours. Testicular germ cell tumours include benign teratoma, epidermoid cyst and malignant yolk sac tumour, while stromal tumours include juvenile granulosa-cell, Leydig-cell and Sertoli-cell tumours. Paratesticular tumours may be benign or malignant, such as rhabdomyosarcoma. The authors discuss clinical presentation, imaging, pathology and management, and note that centralised pathology and national trials have been important for optimal treatment of malignant tumours.

pmid-20435575.summary_ja: 心血管危険因子のない非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の若年男性が、シスプラチン併用化学療法中に虚血性脳卒中を発症した症例報告。動脈血栓塞栓症は稀だが重大な合併症であり、迅速な対応が転帰を左右すると指摘している。関連文献のレビューも含む。
pmid-20435575.summary_en: This case report describes a young man with non-seminomatous testicular germ cell tumour and no cardiovascular risk factors who developed an ischemic stroke during cisplatin-based chemotherapy. The authors note that arterial thromboembolism, though rare, is a serious complication in young patients receiving cisplatin, and that rapid treatment is associated with favorable outcomes. Oncologists should recognize stroke symptoms and alert a stroke unit promptly. A review of the relevant literature is also presented.

pmid-20436676.summary_ja: マウス胎児性癌(EC)細胞P19の核を用いた核移植により多能性幹細胞を作製した。EC細胞単独と比べて四倍体凝集胚の発生が延長された。H19の発現回復はDMRのメチル化状態に依存し、Nanogの誘導はプロモーターのメチル化に依らなかった。トランスクリプトーム解析でEC細胞とES細胞の中間的な性質が示され、初期化の失敗に関わりうる候補遺伝子が同定された。
pmid-20436676.summary_en: Mouse P19 embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells were used as nuclear donors in somatic cell nuclear transfer to generate pluripotent stem cells (P19 NTES cells). These cells prolonged tetraploid aggregated embryo development compared with EC cells alone. H19 imprinting recovery depended on DMR methylation, whereas Nanog induction was independent of promoter methylation. Transcriptome analysis placed P19 NTES cells as intermediates between EC cells and ES cells, identifying candidate genes that may explain the failed reprogramming of EC cells.

pmid-20438407.summary_ja: 精巣の管内胚細胞性新生物と胚細胞腫瘍の免疫組織化学マーカーをレビューした。OCT3/4とNANOGは管内胚細胞性新生物、セミノーマ、胎児性癌の検出に感度と特異度が高いが、成熟が遅延した非腫瘍性胚細胞も染色しうる。SALL4は非精巣部位で胚細胞腫瘍と体細胞性癌を鑑別するのに有用である。グリピカン3は卵黄嚢腫瘍においてαフェトプロテイン(AFP)より感度が高い。
pmid-20438407.summary_en: This review covers immunohistochemical markers for intratubular germ cell neoplasia and invasive germ cell tumors of the testis. OCT3/4 and NANOG are highly sensitive and specific for intratubular germ cell neoplasia, seminoma, and embryonal carcinoma, although they can also stain non-neoplastic germ cells with delayed maturation. SALL4 helps distinguish germ cell tumors from somatic carcinomas at non-testicular sites. Glypican 3 is more sensitive than AFP for yolk sac tumor. SOX2 and SOX17 help separate seminoma from embryonal carcinoma, especially after chemotherapy, and suggested panels are provided.

pmid-20438667.summary_ja: 8年間に小児外科で治療された卵巣腫瘍37例を後方視的に解析した。良性30例、悪性7例で、悪性の5例は胚細胞腫瘍（卵黄嚢腫瘍2例、未熟奇形腫2例、ディスジャーミノーマ1例）だった。全例が術後に化学療法を受け、8か月から6年のフォローアップ期間中無病生存を維持した。正確な病期分類と完全切除が重要と結論づけられた。
pmid-20438667.summary_en: This retrospective review of 37 girls treated for ovarian tumors over eight years at a single pediatric center found that 30 had benign disease and 7 were malignant. The malignant group comprised five germ cell tumors (two yolk sac tumors, two immature teratomas, one dysgerminoma) and two sex cord stromal tumors. Most patients underwent salpingo-oophorectomy, and many procedures were performed laparoscopically. All malignant cases received postoperative chemotherapy and remained disease-free during follow-up of 8 months to 6 years. Accurate staging and complete resection were emphasized.

pmid-20438911.summary_ja: 新生児の頭蓋窩へ進展した巨大眼窩奇形腫の症例を報告している。臨床像、画像所見、手術アプローチを記載した。手術手技と患側眼の温存に焦点を当て、文献上の類似症例と比較している。詳細な組織病理学的所見も示されている。
pmid-20438911.summary_en: This case report describes a huge orbital teratoma in a newborn that extended into the cranial fossa. The authors detail the clinical features, radiologic findings, and surgical approach. The discussion focuses on surgical technique and preservation of the affected eye, comparing their approach with the few similar cases in the literature. Detailed histopathologic findings are also provided. The case highlights the challenges of managing extensive orbital and intracranial involvement in a neonate.

pmid-20441513.summary_ja: 卵巣奇形腫の単胚葉性変異である卵巣甲状腺腫由来の甲状腺型癌をレビューした。乳頭癌が最も多く、次いで濾胞癌や新たに認識された卵巣起源の高分化濾胞癌が続く。手術は全腹式子宮摘出と両側卵管卵巣摘出から、妊孕性温存のための片側卵巣摘出や嚢胞摘出まで幅広い。補助療法として放射線療法、化学療法、甲状腺摘出、放射性ヨウ素アブレーションがあり、予後は概ね良好である。
pmid-20441513.summary_en: This review addresses thyroid-type carcinomas arising in struma ovarii, a monodermal variant of ovarian teratoma. Papillary carcinoma is the most common type, followed by follicular carcinoma and the newly recognized highly differentiated follicular carcinoma of ovarian origin. Surgical management ranges from total abdominal hysterectomy with bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy to fertility-sparing unilateral oophorectomy or cystectomy. Adjuvant options include external radiotherapy, chemotherapy, thyroidectomy, and radioactive iodine ablation, and the prognosis is generally favorable.

pmid-20443156.summary_ja: 臨床病期I精巣がんの管理について、治癒率が高いことを踏まえて意思決定の要点をレビューした。多くの症例では補助化学療法または監視療法が選択肢となり、セミノーマには放射線療法、非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の選択例には後腹膜リンパ節郭清が用いられる。各選択肢の利点と欠点を比較検討し、治療を抑えることが有効な場合があると強調している。
pmid-20443156.summary_en: This review examines management decisions for clinical stage I testicular cancer, which is highly curable. Options include adjuvant chemotherapy or surveillance for most patients, radiotherapy for seminoma, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection for selected patients with nonseminomatous germ cell tumors. The authors weigh the advantages and disadvantages of each option at each decision point, emphasizing that less treatment can sometimes achieve the same cure.

pmid-20447912.summary_ja: 本研究は、Cancer Incidence in Five Continentsのデータを用いて1973〜2002年の精巣がんの年齢調整発生率を国際比較した。北欧系集団で最も高く、アジア・アフリカでは低かった。欧州系集団で増加が顕著であり、セミノーマと非セミノーマの傾向は類似していた。共通のリスク因子の存在が示唆され、増加の要因解明にはさらなる病因研究が必要とされる。
pmid-20447912.summary_en: This Cancer Incidence in Five Continentsbased analysis reports age-standardized testicular cancer incidence from 1973 to 2002 across the Americas, Asia, Europe and Oceania. Rates were highest in Northern European populations and lowest in Asian and African populations, with the strongest increases in European-ancestry groups and some plateauing in Denmark and Geneva. Trends for seminoma and nonseminoma were similar, suggesting shared risk factors. The authors call for etiologic studies to explain the unexplained divergent trends.

pmid-20448383.summary_ja: 1999〜2005年に単施設で精巣摘除術後の病期Iセミノーマ91例に対し行われた後方視的解析である。照射範囲による再発率の差は小さく、5年全生存期間（全生存率）は98.8%であった。治療体積や線量による有意差は認められず、20Gy/10分割の放射線療法が適切な補助療法として提案されている。
pmid-20448383.summary_en: This retrospective analysis reviewed 91 patients with stage I testicular seminoma treated with adjuvant radiotherapy after orchiectomy at a single center between 1999 and 2005. Patients received para-aortic field alone or para-aortic plus ipsilateral pelvic fields, with median follow-up of 57 months. Relapse rates were low in both groups (6% and 4%), and 5-year overall survival was 98.8%. Neither treatment volume nor dose significantly affected outcomes. The authors recommend 20 Gy in 10 fractions as an adequate adjuvant regimen.

pmid-20449689.summary_ja: 初期妊娠と満期の胎盤を対象に、PACAP38とPACAP27の濃度をラジオイムノアッセイで測定した。PACAP38は主要な型であり、妊娠の進行とともに増加していた。絨毛癌由来のJAR細胞を用いた検討では、PACAPはメトトレキサートの効果や細胞生存に影響しなかった。本知見は、PACAPが一部の化学療法薬の効果を弱めないことを示唆する。
pmid-20449689.summary_en: The study measured PACAP38 and PACAP27 concentrations in first-trimester and term human placentas by radioimmunoassay, finding PACAP38 predominant and increasing with gestation. Using JAR choriocarcinoma cells, the authors assessed survival by flow cytometry and MTT assays with and without methotrexate. PACAP did not affect JAR cell survival or sensitivity to methotrexate-induced death. The findings suggest PACAP does not diminish the efficacy of this chemotherapeutic agent.

pmid-20459141.summary_ja: レチノイン酸で分化誘導したNTERA-2胎児性癌細胞を対象に、分化初期6日間の核タンパク質の発現変化を解析した。iTRAQとExacTagによる標識と質量分析を組み合わせ、有意に変動するタンパク質を同定した。得られたデータから神経分化に関わる核内タンパク質ネットワークを構築し、分化の初期過程とバイオマーカー候補の理解に寄与する。
pmid-20459141.summary_en: The authors profiled nuclear protein changes in NTERA-2 embryonal carcinoma cells during the first six days of retinoic acid-induced differentiation. Differentiation stage was verified with established gene expression markers. Using iTRAQ and ExacTag labeling with LC-ESI tandem mass spectrometry, they identified proteins with significantly altered expression over time. Bioinformatic analysis produced a nuclear protein interactome network reflecting temporal dynamics during neuronal differentiation. The work provides insight into early differentiation events and candidate biomarkers.

pmid-20460473.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍でDNMTファミリーの発現を解析し、DNMT3Lが腫瘍組織に特異的に発現することを見出した。胎児性癌細胞株でDNMT3LをsiRNAによりノックダウンすると、増殖抑制とアポトーシスが誘導された。免疫組織化学では、胎児性癌成分の検出においてCD30やSOX2より特異的であった。DNMT3Lは胎児性癌の新規マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-20460473.summary_en: The study examined DNA methyltransferase expression in testicular germ cell tumors and found DNMT3L specifically expressed in TGCTs, not normal testis or somatic cancers. siRNA knockdown of DNMT3L in two embryonal carcinoma cell lines suppressed growth and induced apoptosis. Immunohistochemistry detected DNMT3L only in EC components and was more specific than CD30 or SOX2 for identifying EC cells. The authors conclude DNMT3L is a novel marker essential for embryonal carcinoma growth.

pmid-20462094.summary_ja: 胸腺腫、縦隔胚細胞腫瘍、リンパ腫の胸部コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)検査50例を後方視的に検討した。縦隔胚細胞腫瘍では腫瘤内の脂肪濃度が57.1%に認められ、他の前縦隔腫瘍より有意に多かった。リンパ節腫大はリンパ腫で有意に多く認められた。腫瘤内の脂肪は縦隔胚細胞腫瘍を強く示唆する所見である。
pmid-20462094.summary_en: This retrospective review assessed 50 chest CT studies with pathological diagnoses of thymoma (28), mediastinal germ cell tumor (14), and lymphoma (8). Two blinded radiologists evaluated fat, cyst, calcification, enhancement, mediastinal invasion, and lymphadenopathy. Fat density within the mass was significantly more frequent in germ cell tumors (57.1%) than in other anterior mediastinal tumors. Mediastinal lymphadenopathy was significantly associated with lymphoma, supporting its use in narrowing the differential diagnosis.

pmid-20462675.summary_ja: 男性新生児の軟口蓋に生じたキノコ型奇形腫を、軟口蓋裂を伴う症例として報告する。主訴は哺乳障害であった。腫瘤を手術で摘出したところ哺乳は正常に戻り、軟口蓋裂の手術に向けてフォローアップされている。著者らは、キノコ型の形態はこれまで報告されていないと述べている。
pmid-20462675.summary_en: This case report describes a male neonate with a mushroom-shaped teratoma of the soft palate associated with a soft palate cleft. Feeding difficulty was the presenting symptom. Surgical removal of the mass normalized feeding, and the infant is under follow-up for planned cleft palate repair. The authors note that this mushroom-shaped morphology has not been reported before.

pmid-20462838.summary_ja: 35年間に単一施設で治療した小児の充実性卵巣腫瘍53例を検討した研究。成熟奇形腫が最も多く、次いで未熟奇形腫とディスジャーミノーマであった。保存的手術と白金製剤を用いた化学療法により、5年全生存期間(全生存率)は97%と良好であった。卵巣腫瘍は小児の腹痛の鑑別診断に含めるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-20462838.summary_en: This single-institution review of 53 children with solid ovarian tumours over 35 years found mature teratoma as the most common histology, followed by immature teratoma and dysgerminoma. Most patients had early-stage disease, and recurrence occurred in only two patients. Five-year overall survival was 97%, and five-year event-free survival was 94%. Conservative surgery with platinum-based chemotherapy yielded excellent outcomes while preserving fertility. The authors emphasize including ovarian tumours in the differential diagnosis of childhood abdominal pain.

pmid-20463055.summary_ja: 絨毛癌細胞におけるBDNF/TrkBシグナルの役割を検討した基礎研究。TrkB阻害剤K252aや可溶性TrkB細胞外ドメインは細胞増殖を抑制し、アポトーシスを増加させた。マウス移植モデルでもK252aは腫瘍増殖を抑制し、腫瘍マーカーであるhCG-βを低下させた。BDNF/TrkB経路の阻害が絨毛癌に対する新たな治療戦略となる可能性が示唆された。
pmid-20463055.summary_en: This study examines whether inhibiting the BDNF/TrkB signaling pathway suppresses choriocarcinoma cell growth. Using cultured choriocarcinoma cells, the authors found that a soluble TrkB ectodomain and the Trk inhibitor K252a reduced proliferation and increased apoptosis, while the inactive K252b had no effect. PCR array analyses showed altered cell cycle and apoptosis genes. In nude mice bearing choriocarcinoma tumours, K252a suppressed tumour growth and reduced hCG-beta levels. The authors suggest BDNF/TrkB inhibition may be a novel therapeutic strategy for choriocarcinoma.

pmid-20465557.summary_ja: 卵巣類皮嚢腫の手術314例を後方視的に検討し、回収バッグの使用が腹腔内への内容物漏出と肉芽腫性腹膜炎の予防に有用かを評価した。回収バッグを使用した症例では腹腔内漏出は認められなかった。腹腔鏡下摘出時には回収バッグの日常的な使用が有用であると結論づけている。
pmid-20465557.summary_en: This retrospective study of 314 women undergoing surgery for ovarian dermoid cysts over 20 years compared total laparoscopic removal with an endoscopic retrieval bag. Accidental rupture was more frequent without the bag, but no intraperitoneal spillage occurred when the bag was used. Two of 26 women with spillage developed granulomatous peritonitis. The authors conclude that routine use of a retrieval bag minimises the risk of granulomatous peritonitis during laparoscopic removal of dermoid cysts.

pmid-20472276.summary_ja: IGCCCG中間・不良リスクの非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍65例を後方視的に検討した研究。BEP化学療法中のαフェトプロテイン(AFP)とヒト絨毛性ゴナドトロピン(hCG)の減少曲線から算出したAUC(AFP-hCG)を評価した。良好群は無増悪生存期間が有意に良好であり、既存の指標より予測精度が高かった。
pmid-20472276.summary_en: This single-centre retrospective study of 65 patients with IGCCCG intermediate- or poor-risk nonseminomatous germ cell tumours treated with BEP chemotherapy evaluated the modelled area under the curve of AFP and hCG, AUC(AFP-hCG), as a predictor. Patients with a favourable AUC(AFP-hCG) had significantly better progression-free survival (100% vs 71.5%). It outperformed half-life and time-to-normalisation in ROC analysis. The authors recommend validating this dynamic marker parameter in larger studies.

pmid-20473617.summary_ja: 胎児の頸部および口腔奇形腫（エピグナサスを含む）について、病因、病理、出生前診断、治療、予後をPubMed/MEDLINEの文献から系統的にまとめたレビュー。超音波検査で妊娠15～16週頃から診断可能で、3D超音波検査と磁気共鳴画像法(MRI)は頭蓋内進展の評価に有用とされる。出生前の染色体検査と計画的分娩、子宮外治療（EXIT）または腫瘍切除を検討すべきと結論づけている。
pmid-20473617.summary_en: This systematic review of PubMed/Medline literature summarises the aetiology, pathology, prenatal diagnosis, treatment and prognosis of fetal cervical and oral teratomas, including epignathus. Teratomas are rare, usually benign congenital tumours with a multifactorial origin. Prenatal ultrasound can detect them from 15 to 16 weeks, while 3D ultrasound and MRI help assess location and intracranial extension. The authors recommend karyotyping and planned delivery with ex utero intrapartum treatment or tumour resection.

pmid-20483564.summary_ja: 新生児の頭頸部に発生した大型の未熟奇形腫（エピグナトゥス）の症例報告です。出生前診断に基づき、EXITを計画して帝王切開と気管切開で気道を確保しました。被膜や茎を欠き正常組織との区別が困難でしたが、複数回の外科的処置と補助化学療法により制御されました。術後の血清αフェトプロテイン(AFP)が有用な指標となる可能性が示唆され、4年経過して再発は認めていません。
pmid-20483564.summary_en: This case report describes a neonate with a massive immature teratoma (epignathus) arising from the head and neck. Prenatal diagnosis enabled a planned ex utero intrapartum treatment (EXIT) procedure with cesarean delivery and tracheotomy to secure the airway. Because the tumor lacked a pedicle and capsule, it was difficult to separate from normal tissue, and multidisciplinary management with serial surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy was required. Postoperative serum AFP was suggested as a useful surveillance marker. After four years, there has been no recurrence and no respiratory or swallowing problems.

pmid-20484416.summary_ja: 転移性胚細胞腫瘍の11例を対象に、18F-FDGと18F-FLTによる陽電子放射断層撮影(PET)/コンピュータ断層撮影(CT)で早期治療反応と残存腫瘤の組織型予測能を検討しました。化学療法後のFDGの陰性的中率は低く、FLTの追加でも改善しませんでした。奇形腫の2例はいずれも両トレーサーで偽陰性でした。PET陰性の残存腫瘤でも外科的切除が必要と結論づけています。
pmid-20484416.summary_en: This study assessed whether combined 18F-FLT and 18F-FDG PET/CT improves management of metastatic germ cell tumors. Eleven patients were imaged before chemotherapy, after one cycle, and after completion of treatment, and results were compared with CT, tumor markers, and histopathology or follow-up. FDG had limited negative predictive value for residual viable tumor after chemotherapy, and FLT did not overcome this limitation. Both teratoma cases were false-negative on both tracers. The authors conclude that PET-negative residual masses still require resection.

pmid-20493830.summary_ja: 10年間に持続的な低値または不一致のhCG症例を扱ったUSA hCG参照サービスの報告です。565例のうち、妊娠性絨毛性疾患(GTD)や胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍(PSTT)を含むhCG関連疾患を同定しました。偽陽性や下垂体hCGなども含まれています。ハイパーグリコシル化hCGなど複数の新たな測定法を検証し、鑑別法を提示しています。
pmid-20493830.summary_en: This report summarizes ten years of experience at the USA hCG Reference Service, which evaluated persistently low or discordant hCG results. Among 565 cases, the service identified 71 aggressive and 52 minimally invasive gestational trophoblastic diseases, 168 quiescent GTD, and 22 placental site trophoblastic tumors, along with false-positive hCG, pituitary hCG, and nontrophoblastic tumors. The authors describe and validate multiple new assays, including hyperglycosylated hCG, nicked hCG, and free beta-subunit, to distinguish these hCG-related disorders.

pmid-20494011.summary_ja: 無症状の51歳女性で心膜内成熟奇形腫が偶発的に発見された症例報告。成熟奇形腫は縦隔の胚細胞腫瘍で最も多いが、心膜内発生は稀で、通常は乳児期に心臓圧迫症状で診断される。本例は成人になるまで無症状で経過しうることを示している。
pmid-20494011.summary_en: This case report describes an asymptomatic 51-year-old woman in whom an intrapericardial mature teratoma was incidentally discovered. Benign mature teratomas are the most common germ cell tumors of the anterior mediastinum, and intrapericardial location is rare, usually presenting in infancy with cardiac compression symptoms. The authors highlight that this adult presentation was incidental, illustrating that intrapericardial teratomas can remain silent into adulthood. The paper reviews the typical clinical presentation of this rare entity.

pmid-20495335.summary_ja: FIGOスコア17の高リスク妊娠性絨毛性疾患による転移性絨毛癌の53歳女性の症例報告。EMA/CO療法後に間質性肺疾患を生じた後、パクリタキセルとカルボプラチンの併用化学療法を行い、11コース後にhCG-βは0.1 ng/mL未満に低下した。白金製剤とタキサン製剤の組み合わせの最適化の必要性を指摘している。
pmid-20495335.summary_en: This case report describes a 53-year-old woman with metastatic choriocarcinoma classified as high-risk gestational trophoblastic disease (FIGO score 17). After initial EMA/CO chemotherapy caused interstitial lung disease, she was treated with paclitaxel and carboplatin, and serum hCG-beta fell below 0.1 ng/mL after 11 courses. The authors suggest that a paclitaxel-carboplatin regimen may be effective for high-risk GTD, while calling for exploration of more effective platinum-taxane combinations or schedules.

pmid-20502259.summary_ja: 精巣の非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍における化学療法後の肺転移残存病変に対する肺転移巣切除術の総説。後方視的研究では低い死亡率で安全に施行でき、生存腫瘍が残る患者の5年生存率は42〜61%と報告されている。手術と非手術療法を比較する前向き試験はまだない。
pmid-20502259.summary_en: This review examines thoracic metastasectomy for pulmonary metastases remaining after chemotherapy in nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis. Evidence from retrospective studies indicates that resection of residual lesions after adjuvant chemotherapy can be performed with low mortality and yields long-term survival. Five-year survival was 42-61% in patients with viable tumor after chemotherapy. The authors note that no algorithm reliably predicts histology, and no prospective randomized trials compare surgery with nonsurgical management.

pmid-20505423.summary_ja: 出生前に頸部腫瘤が診断された36週男児の症例報告。頸部奇形腫は小児奇形腫の1.5〜5.5%を占める稀な腫瘍である。EXIT手技で出産し、生後5日目に摘出、病理で悪性胚細胞腫瘍と判明した。NICUで化学療法レジメンを組み、多職種連携で治療を行い、生後88日目に無合併症で退院した。
pmid-20505423.summary_en: A case report of a 36-week male neonate prenatally diagnosed with a large cervical mass, later confirmed as a malignant germ cell tumor on pathology after cervical teratoma resection on day 5 of life. The infant was delivered via the EXIT procedure and cared for in the neonatal intensive care unit, where a chemotherapy regimen was developed. The authors highlight an interdisciplinary team approach. The infant was discharged on day 88 without complications and remained cancer-free.

pmid-20509912.summary_ja: イヌの精巣セミノーマ23例をPLAP免疫組織化学とPAS染色で古典型(SE)とスペルマトサイト型(SS)に分類した研究。SEはSSより微小血管密度が有意に高く、腫瘍細胞の血管浸潤を伴う例では血管パラメータも大きかった。イヌSEは血管新生と相関し、ヒトと同様の転移能を持つ可能性を示した。
pmid-20509912.summary_en: This study classified 23 canine testicular seminomas as classical seminoma or spermatocytic seminoma using PLAP immunohistochemistry and PAS staining. Classical seminomas, all intratubular or diffuse, showed significantly higher microvessel density and vascular parameters than spermatocytic types, highest in mixed intratubular/diffuse patterns. Vessels invaded by tumor cells had larger perimeter and area. The authors conclude that canine classical seminoma correlates with angiogenesis and may have metastatic potential similar to humans.

pmid-20514616.summary_ja: MAHO/MAKEI研究のレジストリ解析で、頭蓋外胚細胞腫瘍を有し脳転移をきたした小児・思春期患者15例を検討した。多くは縦隔または精巣原発の男性思春期患者で、絨毛癌の組織型が多かった。脳転移は6例で診断時に、9例で経過中に認められた。二次性転移の患者では、神経症状の出現に先立ってAFPおよび/またはhCGが再上昇していた。著者らは、神経症状や腫瘍マーカーの変化がみられた際は早期のCNS画像検査を推奨している。
pmid-20514616.summary_en: This registry analysis of the MAHO/MAKEI studies examines 15 children and adolescents with extracranial germ cell tumours who developed brain metastases. Most were male adolescents with mediastinal or testicular primaries, and choriocarcinoma histology was common. Brain metastases were detected at diagnosis in 6 patients and during follow-up in 9. Rising AFP and/or hCG preceded neurological symptoms in secondary metastases. Only one patient with primary brain metastases survived, while four of nine with secondary metastases achieved remission. The authors recommend early CNS imaging and tumour marker assessment when neurological symptoms appear.

pmid-20514623.summary_ja: 頭蓋骨に生じた先天性奇形腫が、繰り返し手術を受けたのち15か月時に混合性悪性胚細胞腫瘍として再発した22か月女児の症例報告です。化学療法と追加手術では制御できず、54Gyの陽子線治療により局所制御と軽度の副作用が得られました。頭頸部胚細胞腫瘍で従来の放射線療法の晩期影響が懸念される場合の選択肢として、中央登録を伴う治療プロトコルへの組み込みを提案しています。
pmid-20514623.summary_en: This case report describes a 22-month-old girl with a congenital teratoma of the skull that recurred at 15 months as a mixed malignant germ cell tumour despite repeated surgery. Chemotherapy failed to control the tumour, and further surgery was considered unpromising. High-dose proton beam therapy (54 Gy) was given at 22 months, achieving local control with only mild side effects. The authors suggest proton therapy may be an option for head and neck germ cell tumours when chemotherapy and surgery fail and conventional radiotherapy risks long-term effects. They recommend incorporating it into treatment protocols with central documentation.

pmid-20515338.summary_ja: 新生児期に切除されたAltman III型の成熟仙尾部奇形腫の女児と、その弟のL4腰仙部脂肪髄膜瘤の症例を報告しています。両者は尾側胚節の発生異常を生じやすい遺伝的素因を共有しているという仮説を提唱しています。兄弟での仙尾部奇形腫と脂肪髄膜瘤の併発はこれまで報告がなく、脊髄奇形腫形成に関する代替理論を支持する知見です。
pmid-20515338.summary_en: This report describes two siblings: a girl with a mature Altman type III sacrococcygeal teratoma resected as a neonate, and her younger brother with an L4 lipomyelomeningocele. The authors propose that both conditions may arise from a shared inherited tendency to developmental errors in the caudal embryonic segments. Since familial forms of each condition are known, this would be the first reported occurrence of lipomyelomeningocele and sacrococcygeal teratoma in siblings. The findings support an alternative theory linking lumbosacral lipomas with spinal and sacrococcygeal teratoma formation.

pmid-20515864.summary_ja: 帝王切開前の胎児心エコーで診断された、早産児の心膜内奇形腫の症例報告です。心臓の基部に接する多嚢胞性の大きな腫瘤と心膜液貯留を認め、出生後に外科的切除により除去されました。良性であっても心臓や大血管を圧迫し致死的となりうるため、出生前診断が分娩と手術の計画に重要であると述べています。6年後も発達は正常でした。
pmid-20515864.summary_en: This case report describes an intrapericardial teratoma identified by fetal echocardiography before Caesarean delivery in a premature neonate. The tumour, a large polycystic mass at the base of the heart with pericardial effusion, was successfully removed surgically after birth. Although benign, such tumours can be fatal through compression of the heart or great vessels, so prenatal diagnosis helps plan delivery and surgery. The postoperative course was uneventful, and at six years the child showed normal development and a normal echocardiogram.

pmid-20519928.summary_ja: 31歳男性が下肢浮腫と呼吸困難で受診し、右精巣腫瘍、多発肺結節、下大静脈血栓が判明した。下大静脈フィルター留置後に併用化学療法を行い、高位鼠径精巣摘除術を施行した。病理検査で血管侵襲を伴う胎児性癌と精索への進展が確認された。国内で精巣腫瘍に下大静脈血栓を伴う14例目の報告である。
pmid-20519928.summary_en: A 31-year-old man presented with leg edema and dyspnea and was found to have a right testicular tumor, multiple lung nodules, and an inferior vena cava thrombus. An IVC filter was placed, followed by combination chemotherapy and high inguinal orchiectomy. Pathology showed embryonal carcinoma with vascular invasion and extension into the spermatic cord. The authors note this is the 14th reported Japanese case of testicular tumor with IVC thrombus.

pmid-20530278.summary_ja: 成人男性の胚細胞腫瘍における血清腫瘍マーカーの適切な使用について、ASCOが示した診療ガイドラインである。スクリーニングや精巣摘除術の適応決定、原発不明癌の治療選択には用いないことを推奨している。非セミノーマでは、精巣摘除術の前後や化学療法前にAFP・hCG・LDHを測定して病期を評価し、後腹膜リンパ節郭清前や再発監視にAFP・hCGを用いる。根拠の多くは後方視的研究である。
pmid-20530278.summary_en: This ASCO clinical practice guideline addresses serum tumor markers in adult males with germ cell tumors. Based on MEDLINE and EMBASE review and an expert panel's consensus from 82 reports, it recommends against using markers for screening, deciding on orchiectomy, or treating cancer of unknown primary. For testicular nonseminomas, AFP, hCG, and LDH are measured for staging around orchiectomy, and AFP and hCG guide monitoring before RPLND, during chemotherapy, and for relapse. For seminoma, markers are used selectively, and not for stage I surveillance. Most evidence is retrospective.

pmid-20532676.summary_ja: 74歳女性が下腹部痛と腸閉塞様症状で受診した複合骨盤内腫瘤の症例である。主体はブレンナー腫瘍で、甲状腺組織の小島が高分化型乳頭癌へ悪性転化した卵巣甲状腺腫を伴い、腹膜にも良性甲状腺組織の播種がみられた。根治的手術を受け、7年間のフォローアップで無病生存している。両者の併存や悪性卵巣甲状腺腫はまれであり、腹膜播種、甲状腺中毒症、腹膜甲状腺腫症を伴うことがあると報告している。
pmid-20532676.summary_en: A 74-year-old woman presented with lower abdominal pain and intermittent intestinal subocclusion from a complex pelvic mass. The mass was predominantly a Brenner tumor with struma ovarii containing a single small island of thyroid tissue that had undergone malignant transformation into well-differentiated papillary carcinoma. Normal thyroid tissue had also spread to the peritoneum. She underwent radical surgery and remains disease-free after 7 years of follow-up. The authors note that coexisting Brenner tumor and malignant struma ovarii are rare and sometimes associated with peritoneal spread, strumosis, or thyrotoxicosis.

pmid-20532795.summary_ja: 非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍の異種移植モデルと患者検体を用い、OCT4陰性の胎児性癌細胞を免疫組織化学で検討した研究である。シスプラチン耐性株由来の異種移植片はOCT4陰性の胎児性癌のみで構成された。化学療法後の残存転移巣もOCT4陰性細胞のみからなり、対応する精巣原発巣はOCT4陽性であった。これらの細胞は一部の原発巣や感受性株の異種移植片にも見られた。著者らは、耐性NSGCTの増殖をこの細胞型が担う可能性を提唱している。
pmid-20532795.summary_en: This immunohistochemical study examined OCT4-negative embryonal carcinoma (EC) cells in nonseminomatous germ cell tumor (NSGCT), using xenografts from a cisplatin-sensitive line (H12.1) and a resistant line (1411HP), as well as patient samples. Resistant xenografts consisted exclusively of OCT4-negative EC. Post-chemotherapy residual metastases contained only OCT4-negative EC, while matched primary testicular tumors were OCT4-positive. Such cells were also found in some primary tumors and sensitive xenografts. The authors propose these cells are early extraembryonic progenitors that may drive resistant growth.

pmid-20534400.summary_ja: 84例の患者から採取した109検体の胚細胞腫瘍を用い、EGFR、HER-2/neu、KITの発現を免疫組織化学で検討した研究である。EGFRは28%、HER-2/neuは13%に陽性で、主に非セミノーマで認められた。KITはセミノーマのほぼ全例で発現し、絨毛癌や奇形癌の亜型ではほとんど認められなかった。中央値10.6年の追跡でも、いずれのマーカーも無再発生存期間や全生存期間と有意な関連はなく、予後・予測因子としての意義は乏しいと結論づけている。
pmid-20534400.summary_en: This study assessed EGFR, HER-2/neu, and KIT expression by immunohistochemistry in 109 paraffin-embedded germ cell tumors from 84 patients, and evaluated their predictive and prognostic value. EGFR and HER-2/neu were detected in 28% and 13% of tumors, mostly nonseminomatous. KIT was expressed in nearly all seminomas and was almost absent in choriocarcinoma and teratocarcinoma subtypes. EGFR showed a borderline inverse association with tumor response. With a median follow-up of 10.6 years, none of the markers were significantly associated with relapse-free or overall survival.

pmid-20534997.summary_ja: 本研究は卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫における髄膜上皮様増殖の頻度と意義を検討した。連続25例中10例（40%）で、異所性髄膜上皮過誤腫に類似した髄膜上皮成分が認められ、それらは常に皮膚付属器や神経膠組織に隣接していた。全例で頭頸部由来の組織が確認され、奇形腫の構成が頭側の胚発生を反映することが示唆された。
pmid-20534997.summary_en: This study examined meningothelial proliferations in ovarian mature cystic teratomas. Analyzing 25 consecutive cases, the authors found meningothelial tissue resembling ectopic meningothelial hamartoma in 40% of cases, always adjacent to ectodermal skin and glial tissue. Head-and-neck-type tissues such as scalp skin, brain, cartilage, teeth, and thyroid were present in all cases. The findings suggest that ovarian teratoma elements parallel anterior embryonic plate development, favoring cranial differentiation.

pmid-20535289.summary_ja: 精細管内胚細胞腫瘍（ITGCN）は若年男性の浸潤性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の前駆病変であり、両側精巣がんの臨床的意義を文献的に検討した総説である。胎児型ゴノサイトの遺残との関連、危険因子、診断と治療について概説している。ハイリスク男性に対する生検の是非には議論が残るが、両側精巣がんはプラチナ製剤を用いた化学療法で良好な成績が得られている。管理は危険因子、経過観察の遵守、妊孕性の希望に応じて個別化すべきとされる。
pmid-20535289.summary_en: This literature review addresses intratubular germ cell neoplasia (ITGCN), the precursor of invasive testicular germ cell tumors in young men, and the clinical implications of bilateral testicular cancer. It covers pathogenesis linked to persistence of fetal gonocytes, risk factors, and diagnostic and treatment approaches. Controversies persist about biopsy of at-risk men, though bilateral testicular cancer has excellent outcomes with platinum-based chemotherapy. Management should be individualized according to risk, surveillance compliance, and fertility preferences.

pmid-20535290.summary_ja: 臨床病期Iの精巣非セミノーマ性胚細胞腫瘍に対する経過観察、初回化学療法、後腹膜リンパ節郭清の選択肢を概説した総説である。胎児性癌優位の組織型とリンパ管侵襲の有無により、後腹膜微小転移のリスクを高リスク群（約50%）と低リスク群（約20%）に層別化できる。いずれの治療法でも生存率は99〜100%と同等であり、治療に伴う有害事象を考慮して患者主導で選択すべきとされる。
pmid-20535290.summary_en: This review examines management options for clinical stage I nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis: surveillance, primary chemotherapy, and retroperitoneal lymph node dissection. Pathologic risk stratification using embryonal carcinoma dominance and lymphovascular invasion identifies patients with about 50% versus 20% risk of occult retroperitoneal disease. Survival is roughly 99 to 100% across all approaches, so the choice should be patient-driven, weighing treatment-related morbidity.

pmid-20535291.summary_ja: 精巣がんの管理に用いられる予後因子と腫瘍マーカーを概説した総説である。現在一般的に用いられる腫瘍マーカーに加え、研究段階の新規バイオマーカーについても紹介している。再発を予測する主要な予後因子として、腫瘍径、精巣網浸潤、リンパ管侵襲、組織型が挙げられる。これらを腫瘍マーカーとともにリスク適応型の治療判断に組み込むべきと結論づけている。
pmid-20535291.summary_en: This review covers prognostic features and tumor markers used in testicular cancer management. It discusses commonly used markers and potential novel biomarkers under investigation. Key prognostic factors predicting relapse include tumor size, rete testis invasion, lymphovascular invasion, and histology. The authors conclude that these markers and prognostic features should be integrated into risk-adapted treatment decisions, reflecting high cure rates achieved through multidisciplinary care.

pmid-20535292.summary_ja: セミノーマの管理における近年の変化をまとめた総説である。セミノーマは放射線療法と化学療法に感受性が高く、現在は治療後の晩期合併症を減らすことに重点が置かれている。臨床病期Iでは経過観察または補助カルボプラチンが選択肢となり、進行転移例では併用化学療法が確立している。
pmid-20535292.summary_en: This update reviews recent changes in seminoma management. Seminomas are highly sensitive to radiotherapy and chemotherapy, and current focus is on reducing late treatment sequelae. For clinical stage I disease, surveillance or adjuvant carboplatin is an option. Combination chemotherapy is established for advanced metastatic disease. The article summarizes the literature to outline how these approaches have evolved over recent years.

pmid-20535293.summary_ja: IGCCCG基準で予後良好に分類される転移性非セミノーマ性精巣胚細胞腫瘍の病期別管理を検討した総説である。バルキーな病変や臨床病期ISでは初回化学療法が推奨され、2cm未満の後腹膜病変では初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清が適する。1cmを超える腫瘤や後腹膜外病変は奇形腫や化学抵抗性のリスクから外科的切除が望まれ、長期治癒率は92%を超える。
pmid-20535293.summary_en: This review addresses management of favorable-risk metastatic nonseminomatous germ cell tumors of the testis, stratified by IGCCCG criteria. Primary chemotherapy is preferred for bulky or stage IS disease, while primary retroperitoneal lymph node dissection suits small retroperitoneal masses under 2 cm. Adjuvant chemotherapy is reserved for pathologically advanced cases. Masses over 1 cm and extra-retroperitoneal lesions warrant surgical resection due to teratoma or chemoresistant risk. Long-term cure rates exceed 92%.

pmid-20535295.summary_ja: 精巣胚細胞腫瘍で初回後腹膜リンパ節郭清を受けた後の後腹膜再発に対する外科的治療を論じた総説である。初回郭清が不十分だと奇形腫成分が残存しやすく、再発の大きな要因となる。後腹膜再発例は三次医療機関で経験豊富な外科医による再手術と化学療法で治療すべきで、約70%の長期生存が期待できるとされる。
pmid-20535295.summary_en: This article examines surgical management of retroperitoneal relapse after prior retroperitoneal lymph node dissection in testicular germ cell tumor. Suboptimal initial dissection, often leaving teratomatous elements unresected, is a major factor in relapse. Patients with retroperitoneal recurrence should be treated with reoperative RPLND and chemotherapy at tertiary centers by experienced surgeons. Long-term survival near 70% can be achieved with this approach.

pmid-20541153.summary_ja: 性分化疾患（DSD）が II型胚細胞腫瘍の主要な危険因子であることを論じた総説である。DSD患者間で悪性転化のリスクは大きく異なり、その決定因子の一部は近年になって同定された。これらの知見を基に、過剰治療を避けた早期診断や低リスク例での予防的性腺摘出を含む臨床的判断の指針を作成することが目指されている。
pmid-20541153.summary_en: This review discusses disorders of sex development as a major risk factor for type II germ cell tumors, including seminomas, dysgerminomas, and non-seminomatous tumors. Malignant transformation risk varies widely among DSD patients depending on several parameters, some recently identified. The authors suggest that understanding these factors could enable a clinical decision tree for early diagnosis without overtreatment, including prophylactic gonadectomy in low-risk cases.

pmid-20543847.summary_ja: 英国の精巣胚細胞腫瘍患者979例と対照4,947例を用いたゲノムワイド関連解析で、3つの新たな感受性遺伝子座を同定した。うち2か所はTERT-CLPTM1L領域とATF7IP領域で、テロメア制御に関わる遺伝子を含む。残る1か所はDMRT1を含み、マウス奇形腫感受性との関連が知られている。テロメア制御が発症リスクに関与することが示唆された。
pmid-20543847.summary_en: This genome-wide association study of 979 UK testicular germ cell tumor cases and 4,947 controls, with replication in 664 further cases and 3,456 controls, identifies three new susceptibility loci. Two involve telomere regulators near TERT-CLPTM1L on chromosome 5 and ATF7IP on chromosome 12. The third contains DMRT1 on chromosome 9, a sex-determination gene previously linked to teratoma susceptibility in mice. The findings implicate telomere biology in germ cell tumor risk.

pmid-20544252.summary_ja: 転移性精巣がんの40歳男性で、高位精巣摘除後にブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンによる化学療法を開始した。病理は卵黄嚢腫瘍だったが血清hCGが630,000 mIU/mlと著増し、絨毛癌成分の存在が示唆された。絨毛癌症候群による肺出血で呼吸不全を来したが、集中治療で救命された。hCGが極端に高い症例では本合併症に注意が必要と報告している。
pmid-20544252.summary_en: A 40-year-old man with metastatic testicular cancer involving lung, liver, retroperitoneal nodes, and brain underwent high orchiectomy, then induction chemotherapy with bleomycin, etoposide, and cisplatin. Pathology showed yolk sac tumor, but serum hCG reached 630,000 mIU/ml, suggesting a choriocarcinoma component. He developed respiratory failure from pulmonary hemorrhage, consistent with choriocarcinoma syndrome, and recovered with intensive supportive care. The authors advise clinicians to recognize this complication in patients with very high hCG levels.

pmid-20544870.summary_ja: 妊娠中に直径15cmを超えて急速に増大した卵巣嚢胞性奇形腫の症例である。超音波で嚢胞内に移動する脂肪性の浮遊球を認めた。右卵巣摘出術が行われ、病理学的に成熟嚢胞性奇形腫と確定した。角化物と脂肪からなる浮遊球は本腫瘍に特徴的な所見とされ、妊娠中の奇形腫増大は稀であると報告している。
pmid-20544870.summary_en: A pregnant woman had a rapidly enlarging ovarian cystic teratoma exceeding 15 cm in diameter, with sonographic intracystic mobile fat balls. A right oophorectomy was performed. Histology confirmed a mature cystic teratoma, and the floating balls of keratin and fat were considered pathognomonic. The authors note that teratoma growth during pregnancy is rare and that ultrasound findings can support the diagnosis.

pmid-20549462.summary_ja: 突然の胸痛で搬入された43歳男性で、血清CA19-9が4377 U/mlと著明に上昇した縦隔腫瘍を認めた。切除標本は周囲出血を伴う成熟奇形腫で、上皮成分がCA19-9陽性を示した。術後にCA19-9は正常化し経過は良好であった。腫瘍内出血による急変や、縦隔奇形腫でのCA19-9上昇の可能性が示された。
pmid-20549462.summary_en: A 43-year-old man presented with sudden chest pain and was found to have a mediastinal tumor with serum CA19-9 at 4377 U/ml. The tumor had solid, fluid, and cystic components. Resection revealed a mature teratoma with peritumoral bleeding, and epithelial components stained positive for CA19-9. Serum CA19-9 normalized postoperatively with an uneventful course. The report highlights that intratumoral hemorrhage can cause sudden symptoms and that CA19-9 may be elevated in mediastinal teratoma.

pmid-20549704.summary_ja: ヒト胎児性癌細胞はCripto-1(CR-1)の発現量によりHighとLowの2群に分かれる。NTERA2/D1細胞を用いた解析で、CR-1 High細胞はLow細胞より腫瘍スフェア形成と異種移植での腫瘍形成能が高かった。CR-1 Highでは多能性遺伝子Oct4、Sox2、Nanogが多く発現していた。CR-1発現はSmad2/3シグナルやプロモーターのDNAメチル化で制御されることも示された。Cripto-1は腫瘍形成能を持つ未分化集団の表面マーカーとなりうる。
pmid-20549704.summary_en: Human embryonal carcinoma cells contain Cripto-1 (CR-1) High and Low subpopulations. Using NTERA2/D1 cells, the authors show that CR-1 High cells form tumor spheres and xenografts more efficiently than CR-1 Low cells. The CR-1 High fraction is enriched for Oct4, Sox2, and Nanog. CR-1 expression is controlled by Smad2/3 signaling, Oct4/Nanog, and promoter methylation, identifying Cripto-1 as a surface marker of a tumorigenic, undifferentiated population.

pmid-20551554.summary_ja: 18歳女性が腹骨盤部腫瘤で受診し、左付属器に石灰化巣を伴う大きな骨盤内腫瘤を認めた。切除標本は重量3150gで、性腺芽腫の胞巣と卵黄嚢腫瘍の成分が併存していた。卵黄嚢腫瘍は腸管分化と硝子様小体を示した。性腺芽腫と卵黄嚢腫瘍の合併は極めて稀であり、免疫組織化学が診断の助けになるとしている。
pmid-20551554.summary_en: An 18-year-old woman presented with an abdominopelvic mass and calcific foci in the left adnexa. Ultrasound showed a 15 by 14 cm heterogeneous pelvic mass. Resection showed a 3150 g tumor with gonadoblastic nests and yolk sac tumor areas, the latter showing enteric differentiation and hyaline globules. The authors note that gonadoblastoma coexisting with yolk sac tumor is exceedingly rare and suggest immunohistochemistry aids diagnosis.

pmid-20557709.summary_ja: 男児新生児の舌に発生した良性奇形腫の症例報告です。奇形腫は三胚葉由来の組織から構成される腫瘍で、口腔内に生じることは稀です。新生児では気道や哺乳への影響が問題となるため、早期の認識と完全切除が重要と述べられています。先天性舌腫瘤の鑑別に奇形腫を考慮する必要性を示す文献的考察も含まれます。
pmid-20557709.summary_en: This case report describes a benign teratoma arising from the tongue in a male neonate. Teratomas are neoplasms composed of tissues from all three germ layers, and oral-cavity presentations are uncommon. The authors describe the infant's clinical course and review the literature on lingual teratomas. Because such lesions can compromise the airway and feeding in newborns, early recognition and complete surgical excision are important. The report emphasizes that teratoma should be considered in the differential diagnosis of congenital tongue masses.

pmid-20567123.summary_ja: 胃原発絨毛癌の43歳女性の症例です。胃潰瘍性病変の生検で絨毛癌と診断されました。S-1/CDDPによる術前化学療法でリンパ節転移が消失し、胃切除術を施行しました。しかし術後4か月で肝・副腎転移と再発により死亡しています。予後不良な胃原発絨毛癌に対し、より有効な化学療法戦略の必要性を指摘する症例報告です。
pmid-20567123.summary_en: A 43-year-old woman with primary gastric choriocarcinoma, presenting with epigastric discomfort and an ulcerative gastric lesion confirmed by biopsy, received five courses of neoadjuvant S-1/cisplatin chemotherapy for Virchow and intra-abdominal lymph node metastases. Nodal disease regressed, allowing curative gastrectomy. Four months later she died of multiple liver and adrenal metastases and recurrent nodal disease. The authors conclude that improved chemotherapeutic strategies are needed for this rare entity with a poor prognosis.

pmid-20572009.summary_ja: 胎児セルトリ細胞でSin3aを欠失させ、雄性生殖系列幹細胞のニッチ形成への寄与を解析した研究です。変異体では未分化精原細胞が減少し、精子細胞の伸長も阻害されました。また胎児胚細胞の移植実験で奇形腫形成が抑制されました。セルトリ細胞のエピゲノムが胚細胞腫瘍の起始細胞を含むニッチの成立に関わることを示唆しています。
pmid-20572009.summary_en: This study deletes the chromatin modifier Sin3a specifically in fetal Sertoli cells to examine their niche function for male germline stem cells. Mutant gonads lacked undifferentiated spermatogonia, showed loss of stem cell markers and disrupted CXCL12/CXCR4 signaling, and exhibited a block in spermatid elongation. Sin3a deletion also suppressed teratoma formation by fetal germ cells in transplantation assays. The authors conclude that the Sertoli cell epigenome shapes the niche for both germline stem cells and tumor-initiating cells, linking niche biology to germ cell tumor initiation.

pmid-20573313.summary_ja: 48歳女性の左上腹部に生じた巨大嚢胞性腫瘤の症例です。画像検査では起源を特定できず、開腹術で後腹膜の嚢胞性腫瘤が確認されました。病理学的に、後腹膜の成熟奇形腫の内部に神経内分泌癌が発生していたと診断されています。この併存の報告は2例目であり、後腹膜奇形腫内の悪性転化を考慮する必要性を示す症例報告です。
pmid-20573313.summary_en: A 48-year-old woman presented with a large cystic left upper quadrant mass whose origin could not be determined radiologically. Laparotomy revealed a retroperitoneal cystic mass between the left adrenal, spleen and gastro-oesophageal junction. Histology showed a mature teratoma of the retroperitoneum with neuroendocrine carcinoma arising within it. The authors note this is only the second reported case of this combination, which underscores the need to consider malignant transformation within retroperitoneal teratomas.

pmid-20573373.summary_ja: 精巣悪性胚細胞腫瘍の精巣摘除標本136例を解析し、精巣網浸潤と精細管内胚細胞腫瘍の関係を検討した研究です。精巣網浸潤は約半数で認められ、腫瘍マーカー高値や血管リンパ管侵襲と関連していました。一方、転移率や予後への独立した影響は認められていません。精巣摘除標本では精巣網の状態を記録すべきと結論づけています。
pmid-20573373.summary_en: This pathology series of 136 malignant germ cell tumor orchiectomy specimens examined rete testis invasion and intratubular germ cell neoplasia. Rete testis invasion occurred in about half of evaluable cases and was associated with intratubular neoplasia and elevated serum tumor markers. However, metastatic rates did not differ significantly between groups (35% vs 48%), and rete testis invasion did not independently predict outcome. The authors recommend routine documentation of rete testis status in orchiectomy specimens.

pmid-20578177.summary_ja: 精巣微小石灰化が併存する精巣胚細胞腫瘍や分類不能型精細管内胚細胞腫瘍を予測するかを検討した33研究のシステマティックレビューとメタ解析です。無症状の男性では有意なリスク増加は認められませんでした。一方、紹介症例集団ではリスク比が約8.5～10.5と高値でした。リスク因子を有する症例に対する管理ガイドラインの改訂が提案されています。
pmid-20578177.summary_en: This systematic review and meta-analysis of 33 studies evaluated whether testicular microlithiasis predicts concurrent testicular germ cell tumor and intratubular germ cell neoplasia of unclassified type. In asymptomatic men, microlithiasis was not associated with increased risk. In referral populations, however, it carried risk ratios of about 8.5 for concurrent testicular germ cell tumor and 10.5 for intratubular neoplasia. Because follow-up data were heterogeneous, prospective risk could not be summarized. The authors propose modifying management guidelines for high-risk patients.

pmid-20579786.summary_ja: 生後6週の乳児に生じた舌の先天性良性奇形腫の症例報告である。舌先の二分化、重度の舌小帯短縮症、多指症を合併していた。腫瘍は切除され、舌小帯も合併症なく切離された。舌の奇形腫は稀で、頭頸部の他の先天異常を伴うことが多いと示された。
pmid-20579786.summary_en: This case report describes a 6-week-old infant with a congenital benign teratoma of the tongue, accompanied by a bifid tongue tip, severe ankyloglossia, and polydactyly. Teratomas of the tongue are rare and often occur with other head and neck anomalies. The tumor was excised, and the tongue-tie was released without complications. The report highlights the association of lingual teratoma with multiple congenital anomalies in a neonate.

pmid-20585926.summary_ja: 52歳女性の卵巣成熟嚢胞性奇形腫の症例である。腫瘍は10日後に破裂し、多量の腹水を生じた。切除後に扁平上皮癌への悪性転化が確認された。破裂と悪性転化を伴う奇形腫の治療前後の画像を提示しており、このような報告は従来なかったとしている。
pmid-20585926.summary_en: This report describes a 52-year-old woman with an ovarian mature cystic teratoma that ruptured and underwent malignant transformation to squamous cell carcinoma. CT and MRI showed a large cystic mass with enhancing solid components, followed by rupture with massive ascites. After resection, histology confirmed squamous cell carcinoma. The authors present before-and-after imaging of a ruptured cystic teratoma with malignant transformation, which they note has not been previously described.

pmid-20587905.summary_ja: 1999年から2008年に当院で治療された思春期前の精巣腫瘍の児22例を後方視的に解析した。成熟奇形腫が最多で、卵黄嚢腫瘍は18.16%であった。良性腫瘍が大半を占め、全例で腫瘍制御と精巣温存が得られた。良性腫瘍に対する精巣温存手術は実行可能で安全と結論している。
pmid-20587905.summary_en: This retrospective single-institution review analyzed 22 children with prepubertal testicular tumors treated between 1999 and 2008, with a mean age of 4.6 years. Mature teratoma was most common (49.94%), followed by epidermoid cysts, immature teratoma, and yolk sac tumor (18.16%). Most tumors were benign, and all surgeries achieved cancer control while preserving the testis. The authors conclude that testis-sparing surgery is feasible and safe for benign tumors with long-term follow-up.

pmid-20590464.summary_ja: 二絨毛膜二羽膜双胎妊娠で、胎児の顔面から突出する奇形腫（エピグナトゥス）を超音波検査で出生前に診断した症例報告である。羊水穿刺でαフェトプロテイン(AFP)の上昇が確認された。腫瘍増大と羊水過多のため妊娠22週に選択的胎児減数術が行われ、合併症を生じた。剖検と組織学的検査が超音波診断を裏付けた。
pmid-20590464.summary_en: This case report describes a prenatal ultrasound diagnosis of epignathus, a teratoma protruding from the fetal face, in a dichorionic-diamniotic twin pregnancy. Amniocentesis revealed a 46,XX fetus with elevated alpha-fetoprotein. Tumor growth and polyhydramnios led to selective feticide at 22 weeks, complicated by iatrogenic abortion and early neonatal death of the cotwin. Necropsy and histology supported the ultrasound-based diagnosis.

pmid-20592932.summary_ja: 成人女性の膵臓に原発した性腺外卵黄嚢腫瘍と、肝転移を伴った症例の報告です。造影CTでは膵頸部から体部にかけて不均一な単発の腫瘤と、肝臓の2か所の低吸収病変が描出されました。手術が行われ、病理学的検査で卵黄嚢腫瘍と確定診断されています。
pmid-20592932.summary_en: This case report describes an extragonadal yolk sac tumor arising in the pancreas of an adult woman, with hepatic metastases. Contrast-enhanced CT showed a heterogeneous solitary mass in the pancreatic neck and body together with two low-density hepatic lesions. Surgery was performed, and pathological examination confirmed yolk sac tumor. The report highlights the rarity of this entity and the imaging features that may help recognize it.

pmid-20593487.summary_ja: 正常の胎児・乳児・成人の胚細胞と251例の胚細胞腫瘍について、全体的DNAメチル化を免疫染色で評価しています。セミノーマなどの未分化腫瘍は低メチル化を示し、奇形腫、卵黄嚢腫瘍、絨毛癌では高メチル化が認められました。セミノーマ細胞株では脱メチル化によりシスプラチン耐性が低下し、KLF11やCFLARなどの候補遺伝子も同定されています。
pmid-20593487.summary_en: This study examined global DNA methylation in normal fetal, infantile, and adult germ cells and in 251 germ cell tumors, using immunostaining for 5-methylcytidine. Undifferentiated tumors such as seminomas and gonadoblastomas were hypomethylated, whereas teratomas, yolk sac tumors, and choriocarcinomas were more methylated. In the seminoma cell line TCam-2, demethylation with 5-azacytidine reduced cisplatin resistance and altered stem cell and germ cell marker expression. Candidate genes KLF11 and CFLAR were identified.

pmid-20598039.summary_ja: 34歳女性の卵巣原発甲状腺腫様カルチノイドの症例報告です。病期IAの境界悪性例で、術後3年半で多発骨転移と乳腺転移が出現し、化学療法は奏効しませんでした。Ki-67とトポイソメラーゼIIαが高値の非定型カルチノイドは予後不良の可能性があると述べています。
pmid-20598039.summary_en: This case report describes a 34-year-old woman with primary strumal carcinoid of the ovary, stage IA and borderline malignant. Histology showed atypical nuclei, high mitotic activity and focal necrosis, and immunostaining was positive for neuroendocrine markers and thyroglobulin. Three and a half years after surgery, multiple bone and breast metastases appeared and chemotherapy was ineffective. The authors suggest that atypical ovarian carcinoids with high Ki-67 and topoisomerase IIα expression may have a poor prognosis.

pmid-20598061.summary_ja: 46,XX核型の20歳女性に両側卵巣の性腺芽腫とディスジャーミノーマの併存を認めた症例報告です。超音波検査で20×14cmの骨盤内腫瘤が描出され、両側卵管卵巣摘出術が行われました。放射線療法とBEP化学療法の後、ホルモン補充療法を開始し、治療から5年8か月の時点で再発なく良好です。
pmid-20598061.summary_en: This case report describes a 20-year-old woman with a 46,XX karyotype who had bilateral gonadoblastoma with coexisting dysgerminoma. A 20 × 14 cm pelvic mass was detected by ultrasonography, and bilateral salpingo-oophorectomy was performed. She received radiotherapy and BEP chemotherapy, followed by hormone replacement therapy. More than five years after treatment, she remained well without recurrence.

pmid-20599258.summary_ja: 本研究は、MITO施設で治療された第I期未熟卵巣奇形腫の患者28例を後方視的に検討したイタリアの多施設共同研究である。大半の患者が妊孕性温存手術を受け、9例が白金系補助化学療法を受けた。全体の再発率は21.4%で、G1では再発がなく、G2・G3で高率であった。再発率は病期、分化度、補助化学療法の有無による有意差はなかった。著者らは、化学療法は初回治療ではなく再発時に用いるべきことを示唆している。
pmid-20599258.summary_en: This retrospective Italian multicentre study reviewed 28 patients with stage I immature ovarian teratoma treated in MITO centers, most of whom underwent fertility-sparing surgery. Nine received adjuvant platinum-based chemotherapy. Overall recurrence was 21.4%, with no recurrences in grade 1 tumors and higher rates in grade 2 and 3. Recurrence did not differ significantly by stage, grade or adjuvant chemotherapy. The authors suggest chemotherapy may be reserved for recurrence rather than used as primary therapy.

pmid-20600549.summary_ja: メタロチオネイン(MT)欠損マウスと野生型マウスに、妊娠期から授乳期にかけて酢酸鉛を飲水投与し、出生した雄を2年まで観察した。MT欠損マウスでのみ、早期の鉛曝露により精巣奇形腫が増加した(最大28%、対照4%)。腎や膀胱の前腫瘍性病変も増え、MT欠損は鉛による発がん感受性を高めることが示された。
pmid-20600549.summary_en: In this mouse study, pregnant metallothionein-knockout and wild-type mice received lead acetate in drinking water from gestation through lactation. Male offspring were exposed until 8 weeks and observed to 2 years. High-dose lead reduced survival in both strains. Only in knockout mice did early-life lead exposure increase testicular teratomas, reaching 28% versus 4% in controls. Knockout mice also developed renal cystic hyperplasia and urinary bladder hyperplasia, suggesting metallothionein deficiency increases susceptibility to lead-induced testicular and preneoplastic lesions.

pmid-20602187.summary_ja: 1976〜2002年に当院で精巣がんの治療を受けた297名を対象とした質問票調査である。治療後に子どもを持つ割合は50.5%で、治療前の40.1%より多かった。妊孕性は非神経温存型後腹膜リンパ節郭清で37%と最も低かった。妊孕性に最も影響する要因は非神経温存型の後腹膜リンパ節郭清であり、可能な限り避けるべきと結論づけている。
pmid-20602187.summary_en: This questionnaire survey assessed fertility in 297 men (60.6% response) treated for testicular cancer at one institution from 1976 to 2002. Fatherhood after treatment (50.5%) was higher than before treatment (40.1%) among men trying to conceive. Post-treatment fatherhood was 59% after surgery alone, 68% with radiotherapy and 50% with chemotherapy, without significant difference. Fertility was markedly lower after non-nerve-sparing RPLND (37%) than after nerve-sparing RPLND (62%) or when RPLND was not performed (77%). The authors recommend avoiding non-nerve-sparing RPLND whenever possible.

pmid-20605495.summary_ja: 健康だった14歳女児が意識混濁から昏睡に進行した。画像検査で付属器腫瘤が見つかり、外科的切除により成熟奇形腫と判明した。髄液からはNMDA受容体のNR1/NR2複合体に対する抗体が検出され、抗NMDA受容体脳炎と診断された。卵巣奇形腫と傍腫瘍性脳炎の関連は、婦人科医が理解しておく必要があると指摘している。
pmid-20605495.summary_en: A previously healthy 14-year-old girl developed confusion that progressed to coma. Imaging revealed an adnexal mass, which was surgically removed and confirmed as a mature teratoma. Cerebrospinal fluid was positive for antibodies to NR1/NR2 heteromers of NMDA receptors. The authors note that cystic teratomas are among the most common benign ovarian lesions in young women, and that the association between ovarian teratomas and paraneoplastic encephalitis, reported in neurology literature, needs clarification for gynecologists who may be consulted on such patients.

pmid-20606623.summary_ja: 腹痛・背部痛の63歳男性で、傍大動脈腫瘤が原発不明がんとして紹介された。生検の再検討でセミノーマと判明し、精巣内病変も認められた。再CTでは転移性腫瘤が完全に消失していた。根治的精巣摘除術と術後放射線療法を行い、6か月後も無病であった。
pmid-20606623.summary_en: A 63-year-old man presented with abdominal and back pain and a 5 cm para-aortic mass, initially diagnosed as retroperitoneal carcinoma of unknown primary. Left testicular atrophy was noted. Review of the original biopsy showed seminoma histology, and imaging revealed small intratesticular lesions. Repeat CT showed complete resolution of the metastatic mass. He underwent left orchiectomy and adjuvant radiation therapy and remained free of disease six months later. The case shows that metastatic seminoma can regress spontaneously and may be mistaken for carcinoma of unknown primary.

pmid-20608935.summary_ja: 成人精巣胚細胞腫瘍110例の209組織成分を対象に、EGFRタンパク過剰発現と遺伝子増幅を免疫組織化学およびFISHで解析した。過剰発現は絨毛癌(88%)で最も多く、卵黄嚢腫瘍(44%)、セミノーマ(28%)、胎児性癌(11%)で認められた。遺伝子増幅・コピー数増加はタンパク過剰発現と有意に相関し、腫瘍の浸潤や形態変化への関与が示唆された。
pmid-20608935.summary_en: This study examined EGFR protein overexpression and gene amplification in 209 histologically distinct components from 110 adult testicular germ cell tumor cases, using immunohistochemistry and FISH. EGFR overexpression was seen in 88% of choriocarcinomas, 44% of yolk sac tumors, 28% of seminomas and 11% of embryonal carcinomas, but not in IGCNU lesions or immature teratomas. Gene amplification was most frequent in choriocarcinomas (60%). Both amplification and high copy number correlated with protein overexpression, suggesting EGFR alterations may contribute to invasive progression and morphological evolution.

pmid-20613905.summary_ja: 26歳の女性が、未熟卵巣奇形腫(FIGO病期1、分化度I)に対して腹腔鏡下卵管卵巣摘出術を受けたが、AFPが高値であった。その後再発し、AFPは2,400 ng/mLに上昇した。ブレオマイシン・エトポシド・シスプラチンを3コース施行後、AFPは正常化したものの腫瘍は増大した。growing teratoma syndromeが疑われ、開腹による完全切除が行われ、成熟奇形腫のみが認められた。術後6か月で無病生存し、月経も再開していた。著者らは、悪性卵巣腫瘍の腹腔鏡下治療には安全性と切除の妥当性に関する懸念があると指摘している。
pmid-20613905.summary_en: A 26-year-old woman underwent laparoscopic salpingo-oophorectomy for FIGO stage I ovarian immature teratoma, grade I, with high AFP. Recurrence developed with AFP rising to 2,400 ng/mL. After three cycles of bleomycin-etoposide-cisplatin, AFP normalized but the mass grew. Suspecting growing teratoma syndrome, she underwent laparotomy with complete excision, which showed only mature teratoma. At six months she was disease-free and had resumed menstruation. The authors note that laparoscopic management of malignant ovarian tumors raises safety and adequacy concerns.

pmid-20618736.summary_ja: 36歳男性の後腹膜混合型胚細胞腫瘍に、乳頭状腎細胞癌様の体細胞型悪性腫瘍成分が認められた症例報告である。同時性の縦隔奇形腫にはこの成分はなく、両腫瘍で12pと17番染色体の増加が認められた。胚細胞腫瘍内の他の悪性組織型は治療方針を変えうるため、通常の乳頭状腎細胞癌との鑑別が重要である。12p等染色体の検出が診断に有用とされる。
pmid-20618736.summary_en: This case report describes a 36-year-old man with a retroperitoneal mixed germ cell tumor that contained a somatic-type malignancy resembling papillary renal cell carcinoma, while a synchronous mediastinal teratoma showed no such component. Both tumors showed gains of 12p and chromosome 17 material, and the somatic component lacked c-MET mutation. The authors describe this as the first such report. They emphasize that this lesion must be distinguished from conventional papillary renal cell carcinoma, because other malignant histologies within a germ cell tumor can change treatment. Detection of isochromosome 12p may help the diagnosis.

pmid-20621016.summary_ja: 不妊の25歳女性が左卵巣類皮嚢腫に対して腹腔鏡手術を受け、異所性卵巣、右卵管采の異常、中部卵管の両側分節性欠損などの奇形の組み合わせが見つかった。嚢胞性奇形腫を含むこの組み合わせは未報告とされる。著者らは、原因はミュラー管・ウォルフ管の上皮由来ではなく、胎生初期の生殖隆起の間葉の異常にあると考察している。
pmid-20621016.summary_en: This report describes a 25-year-old infertile woman who underwent laparoscopy for a left ovarian dermoid cyst and was found to have several linked anomalies. These included an ectopic ovary connected to an abnormal right fimbria, an isolated right ovary in its normal position, and bilateral segmental absence of the middle portion of the fallopian tubes. The authors note that this combination, which includes cystic teratoma, has not been reported before. They suggest that the underlying defect may lie in the mesenchyme of the early embryonic gonadal ridges rather than in the epithelial origin of the müllerian and wolffian ducts.

pmid-20625099.summary_ja: 妊娠8〜17週で抗NMDA受容体脳炎を発症した若年女性3例を報告している。精神症状、意識低下、痙攣、ジスキネジア、自律神経障害がみられた。2例に卵巣奇形腫が認められ摘出された。1例では再発性両側奇形腫のため妊娠が中絶された。全例で神経症状は大きく回復し、評価された新生児は正常であった。
pmid-20625099.summary_en: This case report describes three young women who developed anti-NMDA receptor encephalitis at 8 to 17 weeks of gestation. They had psychiatric symptoms, decreased consciousness, seizures, dyskinesias, and autonomic dysfunction. Cerebrospinal fluid showed pleocytosis and higher antibody titers than serum, and MRI was normal. Two patients had ovarian teratomas that were removed, and one pregnancy was terminated because of recurrent bilateral teratomas. All patients had substantial neurological recovery, and the two newborns were normal. The authors conclude that anti-NMDAR encephalitis in pregnancy can have a good outcome for mother and newborn.

pmid-20625745.summary_ja: 乳児期に発生した胃原発の奇形腫を報告しており、腎芽性成分が主体であった。これまでの胃奇形腫の多くは成熟成分からなり、一部は未熟成分を含む。腎芽性遺残の存在は既報に記載がなく、性腺外奇形腫の組織学的スペクトラムを広げる報告である。
pmid-20625745.summary_en: This paper reports a gastric teratoma in infancy, an uncommon extragonadal tumor in which nephroblastic elements predominated. Most gastric teratomas described in the literature contain mature elements, and some contain immature elements. The authors note that nephroblastic rests have not previously been described in gastric teratoma in the available literature. The report extends the known histologic spectrum of extragonadal teratomas in pediatric patients and documents a previously unrecognized component within this tumor type.

pmid-20626177.summary_ja: シェフィールド絨毛性疾患センターでの後方視的検討で、非満期妊娠後の絨毛癌64例を満期分娩後の症例と比較した。非満期群では診断までの期間が長く、hCG値は低かった。両群とも生存率は90%超で、肺以外の転移部位と個数が予後に影響し、先行妊娠の種類より重要であった。
pmid-20626177.summary_en: This retrospective review from the Sheffield Trophoblastic Centre compared 64 patients with choriocarcinoma after a nonterm pregnancy with patients after a term pregnancy. Time to diagnosis was longer after nonterm pregnancy, and hCG levels were lower. Metastasis rates were similar in both groups, but more nonterm patients received methotrexate alone. Survival exceeded 90% in both groups. Metastatic site and number, excluding pulmonary metastases, affected outcome more than the type of antecedent pregnancy.

pmid-20626181.summary_ja: 間欠的な段階的曝露によりフロクスウリジン(FUDR)耐性の絨毛癌細胞株JeG-3/FUDRAを樹立した。耐性指数は31.62であった。β-hCG分泌とチミジル酸合成酵素(TS)mRNA発現は薬剤濃度に応じて一定の傾向を示さず、TS mRNAは化学療法耐性の予測マーカーとしての有用性が限られると結論づけている。
pmid-20626181.summary_en: The authors established a floxuridine (FUDR)-resistant choriocarcinoma subline, JeG-3/FUDRA, by intermittent exposure to escalating drug doses. Its resistance index was 31.62. Free beta-hCG secretion changed non-monotonically with FUDR concentration. Thymidylate synthase mRNA levels also varied with the exposure dose and phase without a consistent pattern. The authors conclude that TS mRNA levels have limited value as biomarkers for predicting resistance to FUDR-based chemotherapy.

pmid-20626185.summary_ja: 2002〜2008年のフィリピンの病院ベースの後方視的研究で、妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の発生率と管理の変遷を検討した。全国の胞状奇胎発生率は妊娠1,000件あたり2.4、絨毛癌・GTNは0.56であった。経済的困窮者が多いため、生存率や寛解率を損なわずに化学療法費を抑える治療変更が行われ、転帰は改善した。
pmid-20626185.summary_en: This Philippine hospital-based study reviewed charts of GTD patients diagnosed from 2002 to 2008. The national hydatidiform mole prevalence was 2.4 per 1,000 pregnancies, and choriocarcinoma/GTN prevalence was 0.56 per 1,000. Rates were markedly higher at the University of Philippines-Philippine General Hospital. Because patients are often indigent, treatment was modified to reduce chemotherapy costs without compromising survival or remission rates. Outcomes have improved, which the authors attribute to physician education and timely referral.
